jobs.title: Data Solution Architect
jobs.description: Millions of records can still leave basic questions unanswered. Which records match? What's missing? Who can see the data? Before an AI Module can use a client's data, someone has to make that data reliable, usable, and secure. That's the work we're hiring for. IntoFocus AI builds governed AI Modules that turn deep subject\-matter expertise into repeatable solutions for defined, valuable business problems across many clients. We're looking for a hands\-on engineer to design, build, and secure the data foundation behind those Modules. Location: Jacksonville, FL. Hybrid, mostly in office, with some at\-home sprint days. Type: Contract\-to\-hire. Target start: November 2026\. The data comes from CRMs, ERPs, accounting systems, databases, APIs, and flat files. It can run to millions of records or more. Some of it is messy. Some of it is sensitive. You'll do the practical engineering work needed to bring it in, transform it, govern it, and serve it reliably and safely. What you'll work on: * Build and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines for large client data sets. * Map, clean, deduplicate, and reconcile records, then verify that the data is complete. * Design reusable schemas and storage that work across many clients. * Protect financial and personal data with least\-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, client data separation, and logging. * Put lineage, retention, validation, monitoring, and quality checks in place. * Prepare and manage data for AI use, including retrieval sources, embeddings, and approved knowledge bases. * Tune data systems for speed, infrastructure cost, and token cost. * Document data flows, definitions, runbooks, and security controls. * Work with our implementation lead and explain data risks in plain language. Client contact is occasional and usually alongside the implementation lead. We're looking for someone who has built data pipelines at volume and is comfortable working in SQL and Python. You should know how to handle complex migrations and reconcile messy data, model it for use beyond a single project, and apply practical security and privacy controls. Clear documentation and the ability to explain a problem without jargon matter here. Experience preparing data for AI or LLM systems is preferred. The core of the role, though, is data engineering: making the foundation sound enough for the work built on top of it. Apply through Indeed. Experience: * SQL, Python, and ETL: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jacksonville, FL 32256

jobs.title: Executive Director, Technology
jobs.description: #### **About Endpoints News Media Company, LLC** Endpoints News, founded in 2016, is a leading news media company with a clear mission: to deliver the best news product in biopharma and be the essential daily read for industry leaders globally. Now a part of the Financial Times family, Endpoints News has 290,000\+ registered readers and continues to grow its reach with breaking news, in\-depth analysis, live and virtual events and award\-winning journalism.#### **The Role** This is a leadership role. You lead the technology function across engineering, delivery and operations: setting the standard, making the calls, growing the people, running the work, and answering to the business for what it delivers. You also ship. The team is small and everyone at Endpoints is an IC at some level, including the people who lead. You'll be in the codebase every week and carrying real work of your own, because that's how things get built here and because it's the only way to lead a team this size credibly. You'll report to the SVP, Design, Product and Technology and work alongside them daily. A lot of the job is the two of you thinking out loud: what's worth building, what it would take, what it would cost. You'll help shape the technical strategy together (architecture direction, build\-versus\-buy, where the platform goes next), with the SVP owning the final call and the direction for product and design. The technical thinking is yours, and we'd much rather hear "here's how we could do that" than "here's why we can't". You'll be the technology counterpart to editorial and commercial leadership. The remit is wider than engineering. Delivery, technical program management, the operational layer, the business systems the company runs on, and the vendors who extend the team all sit with you, and the team beneath you will grow to reflect that. This role is based in the United States and is fully remote.#### **What You'll Do** * Lead and grow the technology team across engineering, delivery and operations. Own the people side fully — hiring, performance, development and the hard conversations — and manage through a manager as the function scales. * Shape the technical strategy with the SVP — architecture direction, build, buy and integrate calls, and where the platform needs to go next. The SVP owns the final decision; you own the thinking that informs it and the delivery that follows. * Turn product direction into shipped work. Own everything between the outcome, standard and date and working software in production — scoping, technical requirements, sequencing, and the commitments we make back to editorial and business stakeholders. * Run delivery across the technology function. Own the cadence, the dependencies and the visibility that lets the rest of the company know what's coming and when. * Answer for what the team ships. Set the standard, review architecture and overrule it on technical grounds where required, and put mechanisms in place that catch problems before production. * Ship code every week. The team is small and everyone here builds, including the people who lead. You'll carry real work of your own — the hard problems, the spikes that set direction, the things that have to land — alongside the team rather than above it. * Stand up new products and evolve the existing ones across news, subscriptions and identity, data and events, including the wind\-down of what the new platform replaces. * Lead security across everything we run: what's exposed, who has access, what's still running that shouldn't be, third\-party risk, and the response when something happens. * Own the content and data spine. You and your team build the spine, not the surface: the interface is design's \- our designers author the design system and ship it to production themselves. Shape the content model, keep the CMS moving, build the APIs and MCP services every surface and every team draws on, and finish that shift across the rest of the estate. * Own the operational layer — environments, CI, previews, observability, and the road to production that lets a designer ship with confidence. * Own the internal systems and tooling the business runs on — the integrations across CRM, events, email and subscriptions, and the services that let business teams work directly with our own data. * Direct the contractors and vendors who extend the team, and hold their output to the same standard as our own. * Get sound AI\-assisted work from non\-engineers live quickly, and know when it isn't sound. * Partner with editorial and business leadership to turn ideas into shipped features at the pace a newsroom requires. #### **Technical Requirement** Our actual stack, not a generic list. We care more about depth than about covering every line. ##### **Hands\-on, every week** * TypeScript, Node.js, modern tooling * Payload CMS on PostgreSQL, or equivalent depth in a headless, code\-first CMS * Content modeling and API design — GraphQL and REST * Next.js, and Astro wi 've owned delivery, operations, vendor relationships and stakeholder commitments — not just the codebase — and you've been the person the business holds to account for technology outcomes. * And a builder every week. Everyone at Endpoints contributes as an IC at some level, and at this team size that includes you. You'll be writing and shipping production code regularly, not symbolically. * You take a short ask and build the right thing. A sentence of business intent is enough for you to come back with what it means technically, what it costs and what it breaks. * Real backend and infrastructure depth, even where you no longer use it daily. You'll be accountable for work you don't write. * You've worked where designers ship their own code. * You've directed contractors and vendors and held their output to your own standard. * A thinking partner. The SVP will bring you ideas and expect a real conversation: what it would take, what it would break, and what a better version might be. You make your case, and you commit once the call is made. * Comfortable being the technical voice in a room of editorial and commercial leaders, and translating in both directions. * A background in media or publishing is a strong plus, not a requirement. #### **Compensation** Total compensation opportunity: \~$215,000, inclusive of \~$175k base and \~$40k annual bonus. *It's important to note that salary information provided in job descriptions is subject to change and may be dependent on a variety of factors such as location, experience, and qualifications. The salary range provided is meant to give potential applicants an idea of the compensation they can expect, but it is not a guarantee of a specific salary. Actual salary may vary based on individual factors and negotiations. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on salary history or other personal factors.*#### **Why Join Us?** **Work From Anywhere!****Positive, Supportive, and Collaborative Work Culture.** **Paid Time Off**: Generous PTO is offered annually, plus 12 company holidays and 2 floating holidays! **Medical Insurance**: Endpoints pays 70% of premiums for employee, spouse, and/or dependents. **Fully\-Paid Benefits for Employees:** Dental and Vision insurance, Short\-Term and Long Term Disability, $50,000 Basic Life and AD\&D Insurance, and our Employee Assistance Program. **Additional Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident Insurance:** Offered through Guardian. **MDLIVE:** See a doctor, mental health professional, nutritionist, or dermatologist on your time and online! **Family Leave**: All employees are eligible for fully\-paid Primary or Secondary Caregiver Leave for the birth or adoption of a child. **Paid Volunteer Days:** Provides employees with the opportunity to engage in community service \& volunteer activities. **401K:** Endpoints will match 100% of the first 3% of an employee's contribution; followed by 50% match of the next 2%. **Equipment Provided:** Laptop, monitor, and additional equipment needs.**WFH Stipend:** $75 per month to cover the costs of working from home.**Home Office Stipend:** $500 annually to help you create your dream office. **Benefits Marketplace:** We’ve partnered with Bennie to provide discounted products for employees such as other insurances, family planning \& support, behavioral health, wellness, pet insurance, and financial wellness. **MetLife Legal:** We’ve partnered with MetLife Legal Services to provide a discounted legal plan for our employees. *Endpoints News is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse backgrounds and thoughts and welcome everyone to apply for employment with us. We are committed to fostering an environment that is inclusive, transparent, and collaborative. Mutual respect is central to how Endpoints News operates, and we believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills. We embrace our differences and know that we are stronger working together.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Rely Health** At Rely Health, we leverage a comprehensive suite of technology tools to ensure every patient receives personalized support throughout their healthcare journey. Our patient care navigators utilize advanced AI\-driven solutions, multi\-channel communication platforms, and real\-time data analytics to provide high\-quality, cost\-effective, and accessible care to diverse communities across the United States. By combining human empathy with cutting\-edge technology, Rely Health ensures comprehensive, efficient, and accessible care navigation for all patients, regardless of their location or circumstances. Our solution not only reduces worry and frustration for patients and their families but also improves overall health outcomes and reduces the total cost of care **About the role** * The Forward\-Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a **customer\-proximate, outcomes\-driven** individual contributor who makes Rely’s programs work end\-to\-end in the real world. This role sits at the intersection of **engineering, product, and operations** and is “navigator\-based”: you work closely with navigators and ops, and collaborate directly with customers and Sales/AM to ensure we deliver outcomes. **What you'll do** **This role is not static.** Tools and platforms evolve month\-to\-month as we adopt vendors, build internal systems, and improve the stack. Success requires comfort learning new tools quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality, reliability, and delivery. ### **Important note: what “engineering” means here** This is **not** a backend production engineering role. * You will build **internal tools, scripts, workflow configurations, dashboards, and prototypes** (often using AI\-assisted / low\-code tooling). * You will not be asked to own production backend services ### **What You’ll Do** ### **1\) Build \& Operate Operational Workflows (System of Work / Patient Manager)** * Configure and evolve workflows that power navigator execution: routing, task creation, campaigns, automation, and program logic. * Partner with Product/Ops to ensure workflow configuration reflects real operations and reduces failure modes. * Build internal helpers/tools that make workflows easier to operate and safer to change ### **2\) Build \& Operate Agent Workflows (Agent System)** * Build and maintain agent workflows that handle operational tasks end\-to\-end: tool use, guardrails, escalation paths, and failure handling. * Shadow real workflows, identify friction, and ship improvements that reduce manual work and increase closure. * Maintain reusable components/templates so we don’t rebuild one\-offs for every customer. ### **3\) Build \& Improve Automated Communication Agents (Voice and beyond)** * Build and iterate automated agents that interact with patients/customers (voice, messaging, or other channels as needed). * Ensure behavior is operationally correct (right intent, right routing, right follow\-ups) and measurable. * Follow quality gates/playbooks for customer\-facing automation (testing/evals, rollout/rollback, post\-deploy verification). ### **4\) Customer Outcomes, Expansion, and Getting Customers to the Next Level** * Identify where outcomes break by learning the customer’s real operations and constraints. * Partner with Sales/AM and customer stakeholders to move customers to the next level (new workflows, higher volume, broader scope, deeper adoption) by shipping what’s needed to make it real. * Turn early signals into concrete pilots with tight scope, measurable success criteria, and clear timelines. * Convert repeated customer needs into scalable patterns (templates, components, playbooks) so we scale beyond one account. ### **5\) Rapid Viability** **Standardization (Process \+ Quality Gates)** * Push viable solutions into production quickly: small increments, clear ownership, and verifiable results. * Create/upgrade the right proof for changes: simulations, structured reviews, eval sets, regression checks, audit queries, dashboards, or other validation mechanisms. * Do the necessary research (artifacts, logs, customer workflows, tool capabilities) to choose the right approach and avoid rework. ### **6\) Enablement, Documentation, and Team Lift** * Write short runbooks, checklists, and “how this works” docs so we don’t relearn the same lessons. * Pair with teammates, share patterns/pitfalls, and contribute to a culture of high\-quality execution. * As you ramp, help newer hires ramp faster through clear documentation and lightweight support. ### **Operating Standards** * You own outcomes for workflows you touch: **triage** **RCA** **fix** **verification**. * Changes ship through a tracked change process with traceability (PRs, reviews, versioning, release notes). * Meaningful changes include appropriate validation, rollout/rollback thinking, and post\-deploy verification. * When a workflow has a specific playbook (e.g., calling), follow it. * **HIPAA / PHI handling:** you’ll work in a healthcare environment. We expect careful handling of sensitive data, least\-privilege access, audibility, and secure operational practices. **Qualifications** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not exhaustive lists of all duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skills, abilities, and working conditions associated with it. Rely Health does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Rely Health is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. **Working Conditions** Requires frequent use of the telephone and computer. Prolonged periods of sitting at the desk, computer work and reading can be anticipated. **Benefits** * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance * LT/ST Disability and Life Insurance * Technology reimbursement * Paid time off (Vacation, Sick, Holiday) * Paid Parental leave * Professional development * Technology Reimbursement

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Do you believe that powerful software is only as good as the interface the user actually interacts with? We are looking for a Front End Engineer to join our Rochester, NY team to build responsive, fast, and intuitive web applications that people genuinely enjoy navigating. **The Opportunity** You will bridge the gap between static design and live functionality. Rather than just dropping code into a pre\-built template, you will architect the client\-side logic that makes our applications fast, accessible, and responsive. We are looking for a builder who cares about clean components, pixel\-perfect execution, and delivering a seamless experience across every device and browser. **Key Responsibilities** * Build interactive, highly responsive web interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks (such as React, Vue, or Angular) * Translate UI/UX wireframes from Figma into clean, semantic HTML, CSS, and interactive code * Optimize application performance for maximum speed, ensuring fast load times and smooth rendering * Collaborate directly with backend engineers to connect RESTful APIs and handle data flow securely on the client side * Identify, troubleshoot, and debug cross\-browser compatibility issues and frontend performance bottlenecks * Maintain and contribute to our internal UI component library to ensure visual consistency across all our digital products **Skills We’re Looking For** * 3\+ years of professional experience building and deploying complex web applications * Deep expertise in JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3/SASS * Hands\-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework, preferably React or Vue.js * A solid understanding of state management (Redux, Context API, Pinia, etc.) * Practical familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive mobile\-first design principles * A sharp eye for design and the practical communication skills to push back if a proposed layout compromises usability or performance * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or equivalent practical engineering experience **Schedule \& Location** * Full\-time * Monday\-Friday * Rochester, NY * Standard business hours * Salary: $110,000\-$120,000 per year **Why Join Us?** This is a chance to take ownership of what the customer actually sees and touches. You will have the room to advocate for better user experiences, introduce cleaner frontend architecture, and see your code directly impact how people interact with our core products. **Apply Today** If you take pride in writing clean, scalable frontend code and want to build digital interfaces that matter, submit your resume and a link to your GitHub or online portfolio to our team today. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Python, React.js)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will develop and support cloud\-native Python services on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you carrying user stories from refinement all the way through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build back\-end features in Python on a cloud\-native AWS stack, starting from user stories. * Build the React.js screens and components that put those features in front of users. * Automate workflows using AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and related AWS services. * Develop the application programming interfaces (APIs) and integrations that link internal systems with commercial products. * Write unit and integration tests, join code reviews, and resolve the defects you find, carrying the work all the way to production. * Help automate the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline, write code that is secure and accessible, and support your services in production. * Work with AI\-assisted development tools every day, and review and test everything they produce. * Help uphold quality development practices, including test\-driven development and automated testing. You deliver and own tested, working code through production, including the defects you identify and resolve. You automate business operations that replace manual checks, validations, and spreadsheet workflows, and you build deployment pipelines so releasing services becomes routine. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional hands\-on software development experience, with back\-end work in Python and front\-end work in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Familiarity with cloud development on AWS, including AWS Lambda and Amazon S3 * The ability to take a defined specification to working, tested code and own it through production, using object\-oriented design, design patterns, and data modeling * Experience with relational databases, for example PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, backed by sound analytical judgment * Delivery experience in an Agile framework such as Scrum or Kanban, tracking work in a tool such as Jira * Excellent communication skills, including working directly with non\-technical client stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions * Accurate estimation of your assigned tasks and work effort * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Production workloads delivered hands\-on in AWS, an AWS certification, or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Consulting experience in a client\-facing setting * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tools * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices **Who you are** You care about what you build, and you judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. You move with shifting priorities, and when you pick up a new tool or domain, you develop enough depth to make judgment calls in it rather than follow instructions. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to create something new or improve an existing system. * Delivery habits to match: version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility. * Clear, plain\-language communication with the people who depend on your work, and the habit of listening for what they need. * The exactness to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review
jobs.description: Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review assignments. * Grade junior software engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Junior Software Engineer engineering review * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. jobs.title: MID Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: **The role** Cogniify is hiring a hands\-on engineer to build secure identity and loyalty integrations for AI\-assisted commerce. You will connect AI agents, merchant applications and digital identity wallets so customers can access verified membership benefits while protecting their personal information. This role focuses on backend development, identity protocols and verifiable credentials, with Python, MCP and AI\-agent runtime integration. You will build working integrations, test fraud scenarios and create reference implementations that merchants can adopt. **What you will do** * Build UCP integrations that carry verified loyalty information from platform agents to merchants. * Use Python to integrate agent runtimes with identity and loyalty APIs, handling asynchronous calls, structured results, timeouts and failures. * Build or integrate MCP tools that let AI agents access verified loyalty functions. Enforce identity and authorization checks server\-side before merchant actions are executed. * Develop a sample merchant that verifies trust signals, checks loyalty eligibility through backend APIs, applies member pricing and stock reservations, and records pending loyalty earnings. * Implement OAuth Authorization Code with PKCE for customer account linking before loyalty points are redeemed or transferred. * Design an HTTP trust\-header contract and build a Cloudflare Worker verifier with JWKS caching, spoofed\-header removal and rate limiting. * Build Node.js/TypeScript middleware that exposes verified loyalty context to merchant application handlers. * Create a verifiable credential proof of concept covering issuance to a wallet, selective disclosure, presentation and merchant verification. * Test replay across merchants, token reuse, enumeration, account takeover and stock reservation abuse. Verify that personal information does not reach the AI agent. * Write merchant integration guides, build reference clients and servers, and demonstrate the complete flow through a sample storefront. **Required experience and skills** * 5\+ years of hands\-on TypeScript/Node.js development, with experience building backend APIs and integrations. Familiarity with Node 22 and Next.js or a similar framework. * Hands\-on Python backend integration experience, including asyncio, typed code and automated testing. * Experience integrating AI\-agent runtimes or tool\-using LLM applications with external APIs, including MCP server or client integration and structured tool results. * Strong HTTP fundamentals and the ability to build servers and reference clients that follow protocol specifications. * Production implementation of OAuth 2\.0 Authorization Code with PKCE, OpenID Connect and JWT/JWS token verification. * Experience with ES256 or EdDSA signatures, JWKS key rotation, audience validation, token expiry and replay protection using token identifiers. * Hands\-on verifiable credential experience, including W3C VC 2\.0, OID4VCI, OID4VP and SD\-JWT VC. * Familiarity with did:web, did:key and at least one identity wallet SDK, such as Credo or an equivalent. * Cloudflare Workers or equivalent edge development, including KV or Durable Objects, header verification and rate limiting. * Ability to interpret MCP, UCP, OpenID and relevant RFC specifications, including RFC 9421 and RFC 8693, and implement independently against acceptance criteria. **Good to have** * BBS\+ or zero\-knowledge proof tooling. * Google UCP or Merchant Center integrations. * Loyalty programmes, promotions systems, e\-commerce fraud prevention or bot management. * Experience with Claude or comparable LLM APIs and agent SDKs. **What you will deliver in the first 90 days** A UCP loyalty signal and platform\-agent reference implementation with Python and MCP integration; a sample merchant with loyalty tiers; an HTTP header contract, edge verifier and middleware SDK; a credential issuer, wallet and verifier proof of concept; a fraud test suite; integration guides; and a working storefront demonstration. jobs.description: **About APADCode** ------------------ APADCode is an early\-stage AI startup building the infrastructure for a more meaningful way to evaluate software engineers. Our platform conducts live, adaptive technical interviews and captures how candidates approach problems, reason about trade\-offs, write code, and respond to challenges. Behind the product is a two\-engine architecture combining real\-time AI interview orchestration with structured reasoning analysis. We've moved beyond prototypes into real hiring workflows. Now we're looking for engineers who want to help build the systems that will take us further. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Member of Technical Staff to help own the architecture and evolution of APADCode's core backend platform. At the heart of our product is a stateful AI interviewer that needs to manage multi\-stage technical conversations, coordinate live coding interactions, make context\-aware decisions, and preserve a complete record of what happened. You'll work on the engineering challenges behind making that experience reliable, responsive, secure, and scalable, while building the data infrastructure that powers our AI evaluation engine. jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the design and delivery of cloud\-native Python services on Amazon Web Services (AWS), taking each one from refinement through production. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you making the design decisions that join a solution's components and carrying the result through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design and deliver the Python services and application components that form your part of the platform. * Design the React.js front end that users work in, and set the standards other developers build it to. * Build automated workflows across AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS). * Design the application programming interfaces (APIs), integrations, and data flows that link your services to the rest of the platform. * Build and improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and automated tests your team releases through, along with how it supports production. * Run code reviews, resolve design tradeoffs, tackle difficult production issues, and mentor the developers around you. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to speed up implementation and review, while staying accountable for the code you deliver. * Take the lead on quality development practices, including test\-driven development, code reviews, and application security standards. * Produce accurate project estimates and contribute to project planning, delivery forecasting, and resource allocation. You deliver one integrated solution whose parts work together to a single quality bar. You turn spreadsheet\-bound validations and workflows into automation, and the way you work makes the developers around you better. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional hands\-on back\-end software development experience in Python * 5\+ years of hands\-on front\-end software development experience in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Strong hands\-on experience building cloud\-native applications on AWS, using AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, and Amazon RDS * Strong experience with relational databases, for example PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Strong experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Advanced knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, design patterns, object\-oriented programming, data modeling, and database design * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills * Experience leading Agile delivery under Scrum or Kanban, with work tracked in an issue tracker such as Jira * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted developer tools such as Amazon Q Developer or GitHub Copilot * A track record of leading a development team and mentoring its developers * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An AWS certification or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Experience leading technical delivery teams in client\-facing consulting * Experience applying DevSecOps best practices and implementing CI/CD pipelines **Who you are** You own what you build, and you put real time into making the developers around you better, through code review, through explaining your reasoning, and through the standard you set. People bring you the hard calls because you make them well, and you keep the team steady and productive when priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Deep command of modern cloud development, with the range to create something new or improve what is already in operation. * Strong delivery habits across version control, automated testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility, with the standing to set them for a team. * The judgment to weigh competing solution approaches, settle design tradeoffs across components, and own the technical direction of your assigned area. * Plain explanations of your work for the people who depend on it, and careful listening for what they need. * Precision where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. ### **THE ROLE** A collector borrows against a card sitting in our vault. We size the advance off its Alt Value, underwrite it, disburse the money, and manage the loan until the last dollar comes back or the collateral is released. Today too much of that path runs on people: manual approvals, hand\-checked disbursements, a triage queue that grows when a transfer goes sideways, and screens that don't always tell the borrower where their money is. Your job is to turn that into a product. You'll implement our new underwriting design hand in hand with our data scientists, automate the loan workflow end to end, own disbursement failures until they stop happening, and ship the borrower and operator experiences on top, built from our designs. This is a full\-stack seat: the same engineer who fixes the idempotency bug builds the screen that tells the borrower their funds are on the way. The north star: T7 (trailing 7\-day) Disbursement within SLA rate, with a target of 99%. Every underwriting change, automation, triage fix, and screen you ship either moves that number or protects it. Supporting KPIs: time from application to underwriting decision, share of loans that go from application to funded with no manual touch, disbursement exceptions per week, and support tickets asking "where is my money," driven toward zero. In lending, a disbursement that "probably went out" is a failure. The people who are great at this have owned a lending or payments product where it mattered, from the state machine to the pixels. They think in idempotency and reconciliation because they've been on the wrong side of both, and they care that the UI tells the truth about what the system is doing. ### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The underwriting revamp.** We're redesigning how we underwrite cash advances and term loans, and you'll implement the new design end to end, working hand in hand with our data scientists. That means turning their models and credit policy into a production decisioning service: inputs computed reliably, every decision versioned and explainable, and every rule or model change shipped through shadow mode and backtests before it goes live. Done looks like the new logic deciding every application, with Data Science able to iterate on it without an engineering rewrite. * **The automated loan workflow.** Application, underwriting decision, offer, acceptance, disbursement, servicing, repayment, delinquency, and collateral release, modeled as an explicit state machine with every transition logged. Manual steps become rules, and rules become auditable. Done looks like a standard advance funding with no human in the loop, and a non\-standard one landing in front of the right person with the context already attached. * **Disbursement triage, fixed at the root.** Failed, duplicated, delayed, and stuck disbursements. You'll find out why each class of break happens (a retry without an idempotency key, a webhook that arrived out of order, a rail that returned after we marked it settled) and close it for good. Done looks like the triage queue shrinking week over week, with the T7 SLA rate to prove it. * **The borrower experience, built to design.** The cash advance offer, acceptance, disbursement status, repayment, payoff, and loan history screens across web and mobile, implemented faithfully from our designs and improved through what you learn in production. You own design fidelity, accessibility, and performance, and you make sure the status a borrower sees is the status the loan is actually in. * **Operator and triage tooling.** The internal console where Credit, Operations, and Support see every loan and disbursement, spot the stuck ones, and resolve them with the context already on screen. Watch what they do in spreadsheets today, then delete the spreadsheet. * **Loan servicing and money movement.** Scheduled auto\-pay, partial payments, payoff quotes, reversals, and the edge cases between them, over ACH, RTP, and wires. Every movement integrates cleanly with the ledger so it posts, reconciles, and has an owner. You'll work closely with the Ledger team and own the product consequences of settlement timing, not just the API call. * **Risk controls in the workflow.** Limits, holds, loan\-to\-value checks, and step\-up review triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. You'll know what each control costs in conversion. * **The bar.** Rigorous code reviews, clear technical docs, and mentorship for the rest of the Credit team. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried borrower exactly where their money is. * Pragmatism. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. * You've implemented credit decisioning or underwriting logic in production alongside data scientists: turning a model or policy spec into a reliable, versioned, testable service, with shadow mode, backtesting, and a clean rollout. **Bonus:** workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions or similar); credit or risk modeling; direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, or Increase; asset\-backed or secured lending; design systems or internal tooling for operations teams; KYC/KYB, bank partnerships, or audit\-readiness exposure. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take Alt's credit product first. * Reference checks, 15 minutes with a former manager(s) . **Compensation:** $200,000 – $220,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $200K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career)
jobs.description: ***Who We Are*** ---------------- The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non\-partisan, non\-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co\-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co\-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of *The Righteous Mind* and *The Anxious Generation*. ***The Role*** -------------- We're seeking an early\-career Software Engineer to help build the technology behind CDI's learning programs. You'll work on Perspectives, our online learning platform, and our AI\-powered dialogue practice experience, helping students build the skills to bridge divides and giving educators better tools to support their learning. You'll work directly with and be mentored by our Senior Technical Lead, and collaborate closely with our Product team. You'll contribute to real product features, fix bugs, help keep our platform reliable, and improve the systems we use to build and maintain software. You'll start with clearly scoped work, get regular guidance and code review, and take on more responsibility, including production support, as your skills grow. AI agents are part of our everyday engineering workflow. You'll learn to break problems into manageable pieces, evaluate implementation approaches, and review and test agent\-generated code so you understand the work you ship. Our stack includes TypeScript, React, and Next.js; Java and Spring Boot; Python; and AWS. You don't need to arrive knowing all of it. ***With guidance and mentorship from our Senior Technical Lead, you'll:*** -------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Build and improve features for students, instructors, and CDI staff, such as learning activities, progress displays, and tools for managing courses and learners. * Work with our Senior Technical Lead and Product team to break product needs into clear tasks, and deliver small, well\-tested changes. * Use AI coding agents to help implement features, investigate bugs, and explore unfamiliar code. Read, question, and test their output before treating it as finished. * Diagnose problems by reproducing them, tracing application behavior, and using logs and tests to understand what went wrong. * Write and maintain automated tests, check user\-facing behavior, and participate in code reviews with attention to accessibility, reliability, and protecting learner data. * Help monitor and support our production systems, building toward taking part in incident response. * Contribute to the tools and practices that make AI\-assisted development effective at CDI, including project context, custom agents and skills, tool integrations, and agent\-assisted code review. * Document what you learn, communicate progress and blockers, and ask for help early when something is unclear. ***Who You Are*** ----------------- #### **Required** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least one hands\-on engineering project beyond coursework, such as an internship, co\-op, job, freelance project, or sustained open\-source contribution, where you worked in a shared codebase and had your code reviewed. * A working foundation in at least one programming language, and a project you can explain: how it works, the decisions you made, and how you investigated problems. * Understanding of web application basics, including how a user interface communicates with an API and how an application stores and retrieves data. * Ability to read and modify code, work through problems step by step, and test your changes to make sure they work as expected. * Thoughtful use of AI development tools: willingness to learn how to direct them, critically evaluate their output, and ask questions when something is unclear. * Clear communication and follow\-through, including responding constructively to feedback, flagging when you're blocked, and knowing when to ask for help. * Motivation for CDI's mission and framework, or exposure to Java, Spring Boot, or Python. * Familiarity with automated testing or SQL. * Interest in accessible design or education technology. ***What We Offer*** ------------------- * new skills, deepen existing ones, and stay inspired in your work * **Remote Work Support** — up to $500 reimbursed for home office equipment and up to $50/month reimbursed for home internet or cell phone expenses ***The Details*** ----------------- * **Compensation:** $72,000 \- $82,000 * **Location:** Remote, must be based in the U.S. * **Schedule:** Full\-time, flexible within U.S. time zones jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career) – C++ & Systems
jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Software Engineer (Early Career) – C\+\+ \& Systems **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking a **Software Engineer** to help build and maintain the real\-time data pipeline behind our sensing platform: acquiring data from multiple sensors, processing and storing it on Linux\-based systems, and delivering it to the applications our customers rely on. You will work primarily in modern C\+\+ and Python, with mentorship from senior engineers, and you will be hands\-on with real hardware in our lab to test and validate what you build. This is a role for someone who wants to grow into a well\-rounded systems engineer by shipping production software end to end, from a first design discussion to a feature running at a customer site. **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain software components in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) for Linux\-based systems, with guidance from senior engineers * Implement features, fix bugs, and write unit and integration tests across the data pipeline, from sensor acquisition through processing and storage to the services that deliver results to applications * Write and maintain Python scripts for automation, testing, and data analysis * Read, and where needed modify, existing code written in other languages across our codebase * Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, and verify their output through testing, profiling, and code review * Run the system on real hardware in the lab to test and validate your changes, including setting up sensors and collecting data * Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and follow team conventions for code quality * Help diagnose and debug issues across software and hardware boundaries, working with firmware and hardware engineers * Measure and improve performance of existing code under the direction of senior engineers * Document your work so that others on the team can build on it **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome) * 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co\-ops, research, and substantial personal or open\-source projects count * Solid foundation in C\+\+, including memory management, references and pointers, the standard library, and basic object\-oriented and generic programming * Strong ability to read, understand, and write Python, including working within existing Python codebases used for automation, testing, and data analysis * Ability to pick up new programming languages quickly; our codebase spans several languages and you will need to read, and occasionally modify, code outside of C\+\+ and Python * Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and concurrency basics * Comfortable with the everyday toolchain: Linux command line, build tools (CMake or similar), a debugger, and Git\-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review) * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, and the judgment to review and test what they produce * Comfortable working hands\-on with lab and test equipment: setting up sensors, running the system on real hardware, and collecting data for testing and validation (we will train you on our specific equipment) * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with teammates across disciplines **Nice to have:** * Experience with Qt, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing * Experience with profiling and debugging tools such as perf, Valgrind, GDB, or sanitizers * Familiarity with hardware communication interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, or Serial * Contributions to open\-source projects **What You'll Learn** You will work on a real\-time sensing platform that is already running at some of the largest manufacturers in the world, on a small team where your code reaches customers quickly. * How a high\-throughput, multi\-sensor data pipeline is built end to end, from acquisition through processing and storage, and kept reliable in production * Modern C\+\+ and Linux systems engineering, with regular code review and mentorship from senior engineers * How software, firmware, and hardware teams work together to ship a physical product * How to use AI coding tools effectively and responsibly in a professional engineering workflow * A clear path to grow into a mid\-level engineer with ownership of your own components **Benefits** * Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience * jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a full\-stack Product Engineer to turn Pramaana’s research into products that customers and developers can use and trust. You’ll make complex reasoning accessible through intuitive interfaces and thoughtful developer experiences, helping users understand, inspect, and verify AI outputs. This is a hands\-on, early\-stage role spanning customer\-facing applications, developer APIs, and new product experiments. You won’t be confined to one feature or product. You’ll help discover what users need, build the experience across the stack, and improve it through real\-world use. You’ll work closely with product, design, engineering, and research, taking ownership of projects from the MVP through production. We’re looking for someone who cares about both how AI works and how people experience it \- and who enjoys making complex technology feel straightforward. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build complete product experiences.** Take problems from initial exploration to working software, owning the frontend, backend, data models, integrations, and testing needed to deliver a useful result. * **Create thoughtful, responsive interfaces.** Build workflows that help users bring in knowledge, review rules, ask questions, and inspect results and supporting evidence. Pay attention to interaction details, accessibility, loading states, and errors. * **Develop reliable APIs and services.** Build the systems behind document processing, asynchronous jobs, verification workflows, and customer integrations. Make progress, failures, and recovery understandable to users. * **Turn research capabilities into usable products.** Partner with researchers to integrate models, agents, and verification services. Help bridge the gap between a promising technical demonstration and an experience customers can depend on. * **Learn directly from users.** Work with customers and internal stakeholders to understand their workflows, test assumptions, and identify useful improvements. Instrument features and use feedback and usage data to guide iteration. * **Own quality beyond launch.** Write tests, review code, monitor the features you ship, and investigate production issues. Improve performance, security, and reliability as usage grows. * **Build foundations that support multiple products.** Create reusable components, services, and integration patterns. jobs.title: Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview**Navitas Semiconductor is seeking an experienced Staff Product Engineer to lead product engineering activities for GaN power semiconductor devices, from early silicon and new product introduction (NPI) through qualification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering. This role connects device physics, electrical characterization, manufacturing processes, reliability, and power electronics. The successful candidate will take technical ownership of product readiness—including device performance, CP/FT test strategy, yield, parametric variation, datasheet validation, and qualification risk—and drive cross\-functional resolution of complex issues. **Key Responsibilities**Product Engineering – NPI, Production Ramp \& Sustaining * Own product engineering readiness from initial silicon evaluation through qualification, production release, and high\-volume manufacturing. * Drive electrical characterization, datasheet validation, test limit and guardband development, process window definition, and qualification readiness. * Analyze wafer probe (CP) and final test (FT) results, including yield trends, parametric distributions, correlations, and manufacturing variation. * Lead yield improvement and root\-cause investigations using statistical analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and cross\-functional technical reviews. * Resolve sustaining issues involving yield excursions, parametric drift, electrical failures, reliability concerns, and failure analysis; coordinate corrective actions. * Work directly with wafer fabs, OSATs, and Test Engineering on manufacturing process control, test correlation, product changes, and production ramp risks. Device Physics \& Electrical Characterization * Plan and perform electrical characterization, including breakdown voltage, leakage, threshold voltage, on\-resistance, dynamic RDS(on), and switching behavior. * Correlate device performance with device structure, process variation, trapping effects, and reliability mechanisms; translate findings into actionable recommendations. * Support development, evaluation, and manufacturing qualification of 100 V and 650 V GaN devices and integrated power technologies. * Contribute technical assessments of product margins, degradation mechanisms, and reliability data to qualification and production release decisions. Power Electronics \& Applications Interface * Support device\-level and application\-representative characterization, including double\-pulse testing, switching losses, dynamic RDS(on), and gate\-drive behavior. * Collaborate with Applications Engineering on characterization fixtures and evaluation platforms; understand effects of parasitics, ringing, dv/dt, and thermal conditions. * Correlate system\-level switching results with semiconductor device behavior and provide feedback to Device, Process, and Test Engineering. Cross\-Functional Technical Leadership * Lead complex technical investigations and present clear data\-driven recommendations, product risks, and release\-readiness assessments. * Partner with Device Engineering, Process Integration, Reliability, Quality, Test, Applications, wafer fabs, and OSAT partners to resolve product issues. * Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and support customer\-facing investigations during qualification and production ramp. **Required Qualifications*** BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Physics, Power Electronics, or a related discipline. * 8\+ years of relevant semiconductor product engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated technical expertise. * Proven experience with NPI, product qualification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering for semiconductor devices. * Strong understanding of power semiconductor device physics, electrical characterization, manufacturing variation, and reliability mechanisms. * Experience analyzing CP/FT data, parametric distributions, yield trends, and test limits using statistical and problem\-solving methods. * Hands\-on laboratory capability in electrical characterization of power devices, with demonstrated independent technical leadership and cross\-functional communication. **Preferred Qualifications*** Direct experience with GaN HEMTs, SiC MOSFETs, or comparable power semiconductor technologies. * Familiarity with dynamic RDS(on), double\-pulse testing, switching loss measurements, and gate\-drive effects. * Experience working with wafer fabrication, assembly/packaging, OSAT, and outsourced test partners. * Background in failure analysis, accelerated reliability testing, or semiconductor degradation physics. * Experience with DOE, statistical process control, and engineering data\-analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab, Python, or equivalent). The salary range for this role is $110,000–$160,000\. Final compensation will depend on the candidate’s experience, skills, and work location.

Track closeout requirements and ensure all systems achieve final acceptance. **Troubleshoot and Resolve Technical Issues:** Identify root causes of failures during testing. Work with subs and vendors to resolve issues quickly. Ensure fixes are retested and validated. **Support Turnover and Owner Training:** Ensure systems meet the owner’s operational requirements. Participate in training sessions for operations staff. Deliver final documentation packages and ensure a smooth handoff. jobs.title: Hyper Converged Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** The HCI Platform Analyst is responsible for supporting and operating enterprise hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) environments across data center and hybrid platforms. This role focuses on day\-to\-day operations, monitoring, provisioning, and troubleshooting across integrated stacks including compute, storage, and networking. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on operator with foundational HCI knowledge who can execute standard procedures, support infrastructure stacks end\-to\-end, and maintain stable, secure, and performant environments under established engineering standards. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Support day\-to\-day operations of hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) stacks, including compute nodes, storage nodes, and integrated networking components. * Assist with building, deploying, and expanding HCI clusters under guidance of senior engineers. * Install, configure, and support hypervisor platforms (VMware ESXi/vCenter preferred) across HCI environments. * Perform routine system administration tasks including patching, upgrades, monitoring, and lifecycle maintenance of HCI systems. * Execute code currency and patching activities, ensuring environments remain compliant with vendor and security standards. * Support provisioning and management of virtual machines, storage resources, and cluster configurations. * Assist with management of Layer 2 switching, VLAN configurations, and basic network connectivity within HCI stacks. * Support and troubleshoot infrastructure components including compute, storage, and network layers. * Monitor infrastructure performance (CPU, memory, storage, latency) and escalate issues when thresholds are exceeded. * Assist with OS installations, system builds, and server provisioning activities. * Support license management tracking and validation for infrastructure platforms and software. * Execute standard migration activities (VM migrations, storage moves, cluster workload balancing) following runbooks. * Coordinate with vendors for support cases, troubleshooting, and hardware/software issue resolution. * Provide support for observability and monitoring platforms, ensuring accurate alerting and visibility into system health. * Perform remote hands activities, including coordination with data center teams for hardware tasks and troubleshooting. * Support infrastructure services including DNS, VLANs, VIPs, and load balancing integrations required by application workloads. * Follow operational runbooks for incident response, change implementation, and maintenance activities. * Troubleshoot L2\-level infrastructure issues and escalate complex problems with clear diagnostics. * Maintain system documentation, runbooks, and inventory records. * Participate in 24×7 on\-call rotation, providing after\-hours support for infrastructure incidents. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Skills and Competencies:** * Foundational knowledge of hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concepts (compute \+ storage \+ networking stack). * Working knowledge of VMware virtualization platforms (ESXi, vCenter). * Basic understanding of server hardware, compute nodes, and storage integration within HCI environments. * Familiarity with Layer 2 networking concepts, including VLANs and basic switching. * Exposure to infrastructure services such as DNS, VIPs, and load balancing. * Understanding of infrastructure lifecycle management (patching, upgrades, firmware updates). * Basic understanding of infrastructure monitoring and observability tools. * Exposure to automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or similar) is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills in a production support environment. * Ability to follow standard operating procedures and execute tasks with discipline. * Strong attention to detail and ownership in execution of operational tasks. * Ability to collaborate across infrastructure, network, and application teams. * Willingness to learn and grow into deeper infrastructure engineering responsibilities. * Dell VxRails, or HPe dHCI experience. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience. * 2–5\+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, system administration, or data center support roles. * Hands\-on experience with virtualization platforms (VMware preferred). * Exposure to enterprise infrastructure environments (compute, storage, or networking). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to hyperconverged infrastructure platforms (Nutanix, VMware vSAN, or similar). * Experience with server provisioning, OS installation, and lifecycle management. * Familiarity with VLANs, DNS, and basic networking concepts. * Exposure to monitoring, observability, or infrastructure tools. * Basic automation or scripting experience. * Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem management). **Required Licensing or Certifications:** * HPe or Dell/EMC certifications * Cloud certifications * HCI certifications **Working Conditions:** * May require after‑hours, weekend, or off‑shift work during incidents, maintenance windows, or critical business events. * Participation in a rotating 24×7 on‑call support model is required. * If applicable, list the travel requirements for the job. * Hybrid work 4:1, 1 day WFH. **Travel:** * Light travel, 10%.

jobs.title: Computer Vision & AI Specialist
