As a pivotal contributor to our mission of scaling solar energy production at an unparalleled pace, Maximo is leading the charge to meet the urgent global demand for net\-zero emissions. Maximo team members are firm believers that accelerating decarbonization necessitates audacious actions, empowering the world to fulfill future needs. **Job Description** ------------------- We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Robotics Perception and AI Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, optimizing and implementing cutting\-edge perception and AI algorithms to enable our robots to understand and interact with the world around them. You will leverage your deep expertise in computer vision, machine learning, and robotics to drive innovation and solve complex challenges. Duties will include developing advanced perception algorithms for tasks such as object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation, as well as leading the technical roadmap for the perception part aligned with our vision and Product Roadmap. A successful candidate is strongly motivated and passionate about solving perception and AI/ML problems and pushing the boundaries of what is possible today and will be an entrepreneurial, mission\-driven individual responsible for actively progressing, developing, and executing the technical roadmap of our solar module installation robotic system. This individual will take on the responsibility of defining, designing, and implementing the perception software stack architecture and guide the Robotics and Hardware engineers to identify the best sensor suite. In addition, this person will take the ownership of developing and maintaining machine learning pipeline, deploying new models to production, and monitoring their performance collaborating closely with the engineer team to ensure seamless integration of machine learning models and perception algorithm into our applications. As a specialist in the Maximo business, this position will work collaboratively across the Maximo, external industry partners across the value chain, and AES teams, including engineering, business development, construction, finance, supply chain, and strategy. **Major Responsibilities** * Develop and implement advanced high\-performing perception algorithms for real\-time tasks such as object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on variety of sensor data (Lidar, Camera, etc) * Design, train, optimize, deploy and maintain AI/ML models for robust and accurate perception in challenging environments. * Enhance our machine learning pipeline and related tools to support development, experimentation, continuous integration, continuous delivery, verification/validation, and monitoring of AI/ML models in the field. * Integrate perception systems with robotic platforms to enable autonomous manipulation, navigation, and human\-robot interaction. * Analyze and process sensor data (e.g., camera, lidar, radar, etc.) to extract meaningful information. * Translate product level requirements into technical design criteria. * Work with engineers (robotics, hardware, etc.) and product team to define hardware/software architecture and technical roadmap * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software engineers, and control engineers, to ensure seamless integration of perception systems. * Stay up to date with the latest advancements in computer vision, machine learning, and robotics to drive innovation and improve product performance. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning. **Requirements** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in computer vision, machine learning, and/or robotics. * Strong theoretical foundation in computer vision, image processing, and machine learning algorithms. * Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, and ROS2\. * Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Experience with real\-time systems and embedded platforms. * Knowledge of robotics platforms and sensor systems. * **Founder’s mentality**: Entrepreneurial passion for getting things done and a “make it happen” attitude with an intellectual curiosity to seek new opportunities. * **Skill and Behavior:** Capability to work dynamically and collaboratively across multiple teams in a fast\-paced and technical business environment with minimal supervision. Excellent communication skills. jobs.title: Engineering Manager

We are creating a platform fundamentally driven by AI, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions. The best teams here ship work customers come to rely on, and that takes a particular kind of engineering practice. It means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. It means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. It means reaching for AI as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. And it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later. As an Engineering Manager at Altana, that's the work, and you'll build and lead the team doing it. You'll embed with product and design, turn hypotheses about where the real pain is into shipped, adopted products, and own the hiring, growth, and performance of the engineers on your team. Your success is measured the same way the team's is: by the value it delivers to customers, how quickly and steadily it ships, and how well its systems hold up as output grows. **You Will** * **Build the team and help each person grow.** Own performance management end to end, and use each engineer's career goals to shape what they work on. * **Stay close to customers, and bring your team with you.** Get on customer calls, review session recordings, and know the top friction points in your area at any moment. Know where the team's time goes, and pay down operational debt before it slows you down. * **Own what you run.** Keep incidents rare and responses fast, share on\-call load fairly, treat cost as a design input, and work with our security team to keep your area secure. * **Create a team where people do their best work.** Build a culture that handles ambiguity well and makes everyone feel safe sharing ideas. **You Have** * Real\-world professional experience writing back end or data\-driven software in demanding environments. * Strong hands\-on engineering skills. You've deployed production code to cloud environments, and you can still ship work you're proud of. Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan. * Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support. * Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre\-tax funds for childcare expenses The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process. ### **Our Values** Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana's culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers. * **Trust:** Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable. * **Resilience:** In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward. * **Stewardship:** We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission. * **Courage:** Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. Familiarity with rotating machinery, internal combustion engines, centrifugal pumps, or industrial equipment. * Exposure to IoT platforms, SCADA systems, or fleet telemetry data. * Experience with machine learning algorithms for anomaly detection, classification, regression, or failure prediction. * Familiarity with cloud\-based analytics platforms or edge\-computing applications. * Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure analysis, or condition\-based maintenance. * Experience working with high\-frequency time\-series data. **Reference** JOB\-1454 **Company** ARi **Location** Viginia Beach, Virginia

jobs.title: Mobility Architect
jobs.description: **Job Title:** **Mobility Architec** Location: Hybrid \- 2 days a week on\-site \- Suitland, MD Salary: 190K\-265K **Summary** The **Mobility Architect** is responsible for designing, defining, and governing the end\-to\-end enterprise mobility strategy and architecture. This role bridges high\-level business requirements with technical execution, focusing on secure device lifecycle management, mobile device management (MDM) / unified endpoint management (UEM) integrations, mobile application management (MAM), identity and access management (IAM), and zero\-trust security postures across iOS, Android, and other mobile operating systems. **Key Responsibilities** * **Strategic Architecture \& Roadmapping:** Design scalable, secure, and future\-proof enterprise mobility frameworks that align with organizational goals and cloud\-first security mandates. * **Solution Design:** Lead the architectural design of enterprise MDM/UEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Workspace ONE) alongside related ecosystems such as mobile threat defense (MTD), identity providers (Azure AD/Entra ID), and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). * **Security \& Compliance Governance:** Ensure all mobile solutions comply with federal, state, or industry security frameworks (e.g., NIST, FedRAMP, HIPAA) by integrating robust encryption, conditional access policies, and data loss prevention (DLP) controls. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with network engineers, security architects, cloud teams, and application developers to integrate mobile services cleanly into existing IT infrastructure. * **Technical Leadership:** Guide engineering teams through the implementation of complex deployment models (BYOD, COPE, COBO) and resolve high\-tier architectural challenges. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** * **Experience:** 8\+ years of IT experience, with at least 4–5 years specializing in enterprise mobility architecture and endpoint management design. * **Core Technical Expertise:** * + Deep mastery of enterprise UEM/MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune, VMware Workspace ONE, MobileIron/Ivanti). + Comprehensive understanding of mobile operating systems (Apple iOS/iPadOS, Android Enterprise, Windows 11 mobile). + Familiarity with Mobile Threat Defense (MTD), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), secure tunnels, and Per\-App VPN configurations. * **Identity \& Security Integration:** Strong experience integrating mobile architectures with modern identity frameworks (OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect, Conditional Access, Multi\-Factor Authentication). * **Certifications:** Industry certifications such as TOGAF, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or OEM\-specific mobility expert certifications are highly preferred. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Mobility Platform SME **Role Summary** The **Mobility Platform SME** serves as the operational and technical authority for day\-to\-day and advanced platform engineering within the enterprise mobility ecosystem. While the Architect focuses on high\-level design, the Platform SME is hands\-on with configuration, administration, lifecycle maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of the core UEM/MDM platforms and associated device\-management pipelines. **Key Responsibilities** * **Platform Administration \& Engineering:** Configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise mobility platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, customized MDM environments), handling profile configurations, compliance policies, and application packaging/deployment. * **Troubleshooting \& Tier\-3 Support:** Resolve complex, escalated technical issues related to mobile device enrollment, connectivity failures, app distribution errors, and OS upgrade compatibility. * **Automation \& Scripting:** Develop scripts (PowerShell, Graph API, Python) to automate routine administrative tasks, device reporting, compliance checks, and provisioning workflows. * **Patch \& Lifecycle Management:** Monitor and manage OS version rollouts, security patches, and application updates across the enterprise mobile fleet to minimize disruption and maintain compliance. * **Documentation \& Training:** Create comprehensive operational runbooks, technical documentation, and knowledge\-transfer materials for helpdesk and tier\-1/tier\-2 support teams. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on IT experience with a heavy focus on device engineering, platform administration, and mobile device management. * **Core Technical Expertise:** * + Advanced, hands\-on administration experience with UEM tools (especially Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager or specialized agency MDM solutions). + Expert knowledge of Apple Automated Device Enrollment (formerly DEP), Apple Volume Purchase Program (VPP), and Android Enterprise management setups. + Experience with app wrapping, mobile application management (MAM), and enterprise app store integration. * **Scripting \& Automation:** Proficiency in PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, or Bash for automating administrative tasks and system integrations. * **Problem\-Solving \& Diagnostics:** Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot deep\-seated device\-to\-cloud telemetry issues, certificate errors, and policy deployment failures. * **Education/Certifications:** Relevant platform certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate) and a degree in Information Technology or a related technical discipline. **Core Capabilities:*** Advanced and Managed IT Services * Agile Software Development * DevSecOps * Cybersecurity * Health IT * C4ISR \& SIGINT * Data Center Engineering \& Operations * Engineering \& Installation **Why ActioNet?** At ActioNet, our Passion for Customers**: We are committed to our customers by driving and sustaining Service Delivery Excellence. * **Commitment to Community**: We are committed to giving back to our community, helping others, We are passionate about the inspirational missions of our customers, and we entrust our employees and teams to deliver exceptional performance to enable the safety, security, health, and well\-being of our nation.**What's in It** **For** **You?** As an ActioNeter, you get to be part of an exceptional team and a corporate culture that nurtures mutual success for our customers, employees, and communities. jobs.title: Windows, Azure, Virtualization Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Suitland, MD – Local candidates preferred; hybrid/on\-site as needed. Primary location: REMOTE **Schedule:** Supports East Coast business hours, 6:00 AM–3:00 PM ET **Salary:** Starting at $122,000 **Position Summary** -------------------- Windows, Azure, Virtualization Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining enterprise Windows infrastructure, cloud environments, and virtualization platforms. This role requires hands\-on experience with Windows Server administration, Microsoft cloud technologies, virtual machines (VMs), and Advanced Group Policy Management (AGPM). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in modernizing and securing Windows environments, managing Group Policy Objects (GPOs) through advanced change control and governance processes, and supporting cloud\-based and hybrid infrastructure. Responsibilities include infrastructure optimization, automation, system migrations, security hardening, and troubleshooting complex technical issues across on\-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments. This position requires a hands\-on technical professional who can work independently, collaborate with cross\-functional IT teams, and provide technical guidance to junior team members. Local candidates must be available to work on\-site as needed, typically two days per week. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- ### **Windows Infrastructure \& Advanced Group Policy Management** * Design, implement, administer, and maintain enterprise Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file services. * Administer and manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs), including policy creation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization. * Implement and manage **Advanced Group Policy Management (AGPM)**, including controlled change management, version control, approval workflows, auditing, and rollback of Group Policy changes. * Troubleshoot complex Active Directory, Group Policy, authentication, and Windows configuration issues across enterprise environments. * Manage Windows operating system deployments, patching, upgrades, configuration standards, and lifecycle maintenance. * Administer Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft Entra ID as applicable to the environment. * Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate infrastructure administration, configuration, reporting, and operational tasks. ### **Cloud Infrastructure \& Virtualization** * Design, configure, administer, and optimize virtualized infrastructure, including VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper\-V, and cloud\-hosted virtual machines. * Support Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity integration, monitoring, and security. * Manage VM provisioning, configuration, performance monitoring, capacity planning, patching, and lifecycle management. * Support hybrid infrastructure integrating on\-premises Windows environments with Microsoft Azure and other cloud services. * Troubleshoot VM performance, resource allocation, availability, connectivity, and operating system issues. * Participate in cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, and workload optimization initiatives. * Implement and maintain backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions for virtualized and cloud environments. * Identify opportunities to improve scalability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency through cloud and virtualization technologies. ### **Windows Security \& Compliance** * Implement and maintain Windows security controls, including AGPM/GPO security configurations, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Servers, BitLocker, and Windows Firewall. * Apply security baselines, hardening standards, least\-privilege access, multifactor authentication, and identity management controls. * Monitor vulnerabilities, security events, and configuration compliance; coordinate remediation and corrective actions. * Maintain secure configuration and change management practices for Windows servers, endpoints, virtual machines, and cloud resources. * Support security assessments, audits, compliance reviews, and incident response activities in coordination with cybersecurity teams. * Ensure infrastructure configurations align with organizational security policies and applicable compliance requirements. ### **Infrastructure Operations \& Technical Leadership** * Troubleshoot and resolve complex Windows, cloud, virtualization, and infrastructure issues. * Lead or support infrastructure migrations, upgrades, modernization projects, and new technology implementations. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures. * Collaborate with cloud, networking, cybersecurity, application, and service desk teams to maintain reliable enterprise services. * Evaluate emerging Microsoft, cloud, and virtualization technologies and recommend practical improvements. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior administrators and engineers. **Professional Qualifications** ------------------------------- ### **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum of 3 years of experience in Windows infrastructure administration, systems engineering, or enterprise IT infrastructure. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience administering Windows Server environments and enterprise Active Directory. * **Hands\-on experience with Advanced Group Policy Management (AGPM), including GPO change control, versioning, approvals, and rollback.** * Experience supporting cloud infrastructure and virtualized environments, with an emphasis on Microsoft Azure and VM administration. * Ability to work on\-site in the Fairfax, VA area as needed, approximately two days per week. ### **Required Technical Skills** * Windows Server administration (2016, 2019, 2022, and newer versions). * Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), AGPM, DNS, DHCP, and PKI. * Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud\-hosted virtual machines. * Virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper\-V. * Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity environments. * PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation. * Windows patch management, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation. * Cloud and VM monitoring, troubleshooting, resource optimization, and lifecycle management. * Backup, recovery, storage, and disaster recovery fundamentals. * Enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, switching, and firewalls. * Enterprise security controls, configuration management, and compliance best practices. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience migrating workloads from on\-premises infrastructure to cloud or hybrid environments. * Experience with Azure Monitor, Azure Backup, Azure networking, and cloud security controls. * Experience with Microsoft Defender security solutions and Microsoft endpoint management tools. * Experience automating routine infrastructure tasks and configuration management with PowerShell. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code or configuration automation tools. ### **Preferred Certifications** **Microsoft** * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate **Other relevant certifications** * VMware certifications or equivalent hands\-on virtualization experience. * Microsoft or vendor\-specific certifications related to cloud infrastructure, virtualization, or systems administration. *ActioNet is an equal opportunity employer and value inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate* *on the basis of* *race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* ***\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*Direct Applicants, only.*** ***No Agencies, No third\-party recruiters, please\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\****

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description: **Adaptive6 is the leading Cloud and AI Cost Governance platform. From complex cloud architectures to modern AI workloads and AI agents, we empower engineering and FinOps teams to take full control of their enterprise spend. We don’t just report numbers \- we provide actionable intelligence and continuous cost optimization that directly impacts the bottom line.** **Trusted by industry giants like Ticketmaster and Bayer (who achieved a 20x ROI), our customers consistently see massive value within days.** **We're hiring a Customer Success Director, based in the US, to own the post\-sale relationship with our largest North American enterprise customers and to build the US side of our Customer Success practice.** **You own one outcome: customers who get so much value from Adaptive6 that renewals are seamless and expansion is the natural next step.** **This is a player\-coach role. You'll personally own a portfolio of strategic accounts from kickoff through renewal and expansion, run the operating cadence we use to manage the book, and as we grow, hire and lead the Customer Success Managers who join you in the US.** **﻿What you'll do** * **Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end to end: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal and expansion.** * **Get customers to realized savings fast: agree on savings goals at kickoff and drive remediation with the customer's engineering teams.** * **Build multi\-threaded relationships from the FinOps lead and platform engineers up to the VP of Cloud Engineering, the CFO office and procurement, and run quarterly executive business reviews that tie Adaptive6 to the customer's own targets.** * **Lead adoption of AI cost governance: AI and LLM spend visibility, MCP and API usage, and connecting the AI tools customers already use. This is our fastest\-growing expansion motion.** * **Navigate enterprise security and compliance: vendor questionnaires, SOC 2 and AI risk assessments, IAM and permission reviews. You know how to get a stalled security review moving.** * **Be the voice of the customer inside Adaptive6: file and prioritize customer requests with Product and R\&D, run escalations with clear severity and ownership, close the loop with the customer, and make sure release notes reach them.** * **Run the operating cadence: per\-account health, tier and lifecycle stage; sync with Sales, Solutions Engineering and R\&D; renewal risk and expansion signals.** * **Turn happy customers into public proof: references, reviews, case studies and conference talks, backed by NPS and CSAT programs that tell us who is ready.** * **Build with AI: our CS team automates its own work with AI agents and assistants. You'll use them daily, improve them, and build your own.** * **Hire, onboard and lead US\-based Customer Success Managers as the book grows, and write the playbooks they run.** Requirements: * **5\+ years in Customer Success or strategic account management for enterprise B2B SaaS, including 3\+ years owning strategic accounts ($150K\+ ACV) or leading a CS team.** * **3\+ years working with Cloud Infrastructure, FinOps, DevOps, platform engineering, CSPM or observability personas. You're comfortable in a conversation about IAM roles, CloudFormation stacks, Kubernetes cost allocation, Terraform or Azure federated identity.** * **Executive presence with VP and C\-level sponsors, and equal comfort with the engineer who has to do the work.** * **Fluent in data: you read usage and savings dashboards, build your own views, and you never bring a customer a health score you can't defend.** * **Program management discipline: you run onboarding, escalations and EBRs on a cadence, with written status, owners and dates.** * **Hands\-on with the modern CS stack and a daily user of AI assistants and agents in your own work.** * **Based in the US, with willingness to travel about 25% for on\-site customer visits and industry events.** **Nice to have:** * **FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands\-on FinOps experience inside an enterprise.** * **Experience at a cloud cost, cloud security or infrastructure platform company.** * **Experience with AI and LLM spend management (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Copilot) or with MCP\-based integrations.** * **You've built an automation or an agent that saved your team real hours, and you can show it.** * **Experience growing a CS function from a small team: playbooks, health scoring, renewal process, hiring.**

jobs.title: Software Developer I
jobs.description: **About Advantage Design Group** Advantage Design Group is a creative and technology company and the largest producer of online orientation programs in North America. Our platform, which powers Advantage Orientation and HR Engage, has more than 400 deployments across higher education and the private sector in three countries. It turns enrollment and hiring into digital orientation experiences for new students and employees, with interactive video and content built around each client's brand. Our team of about 50, based in Jacksonville, Florida, creates every part of that experience, including content development, branded interface design, video production and software engineering. **About the Opportunity** We are looking for an early\-career developer who wants to write real production code and grow with a team that will invest in them. As a Software Developer I, you will spend most of your time writing, testing and maintaining C\# and .NET code for the platform behind Advantage Orientation and HR Engage, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and help you sharpen your skills. This role is the first step on our Web Developer career path. As you build experience, you will take on larger pieces of work and more ownership, with a defined path to .NET Developer, Senior .NET Developer and, for those who want to lead, Developer Team Lead. We support that growth with internal training, mentorship, and company\-funded learning. **Why Jacksonville?** Grow your career at Advantage and make coastal Northeast Florida home. Jacksonville offers 22 miles of beaches, the nation's largest urban park system, the St. Johns River and a creative food and arts scene. Florida also has no personal state income tax, which means more of your paycheck stays with you. **What You Do** * Write, test and maintain production code in C\# and .NET, with guidance and code review from senior engineers. * Build and update features across SQL Server, front\-end pages and ADG's content platform. * Take part in code reviews, learning from feedback on your own work and offering thoughtful feedback to teammates. * Join system design discussions and learn the reasoning behind the team's architecture decisions. * Troubleshoot and fix issues, and document what you learn so the whole team benefits. * Work with designers, video producers, and project managers to bring client experiences to life. * Participate in internal training, team projects, and peer mentorship to grow your skills. **Required Experience** * Up to two years of professional software development experience. Internships, co\-ops, coursework, and substantial personal projects count. * Working knowledge of C\# and object\-oriented programming. * Basic understanding of .NET and ASP.NET (MVC or Core). * Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL. * Experience using Git or another version control system. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred. In lieu of a degree, candidates with equivalent experience gained through prior work, internships, a coding program or substantial project work, demonstrating a working knowledge of C\# and .NET development, will be considered. **How You Work** You will be learning a lot in this role, and how you approach that matters to us. We're looking for someone who can: * Ask questions early, take feedback well, and put it to work in the next thing you build. * Own your tasks and keep them moving without frequent check\-ins and speak up when you're stuck. * Explain what you built and why in plain language, to engineers and to colleagues outside engineering. * Test your own work, pay attention to detail, and keep the people using the platform in mind. **Preferred Experience** * Internship, co\-op or professional experience on a .NET development team. * Exposure to RESTful APIs, Razor, or a content management system such as Umbraco. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipelines. * Awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) and secure coding practices. * A portfolio, GitHub profile or project you can walk us through. **Compensation and Benefits** The base salary is $65,000–$80,000, depending on experience. Benefits include a 401(k) match, profit sharing, health, dental and vision coverage, paid vacation, flex time, gym membership, and company\-funded training. You will also have mentorship from senior engineers and a defined career path with clear expectations at each step. **Work Location** This full\-time role is based in Jacksonville, Florida, and begins onsite so you can work closely with the team while learning about our platform and clients. Once you're established in the role, the schedule moves to hybrid, with two remote days per week. **Interested in Joining Our Team?** **Apply Here!** (https://advantage\-design\-group.breezy.hr/) Learn more about us at AdvantageDesignGroup.com (https://advantagedesigngroup.com/), and explore Welcome.AdvantageDesignGroup.com (https://welcome.advantagedesigngroup.com/). *Advantage Design Group® is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.* Work Location: In person

jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event\-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large\-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost\-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale. The vision for the Lakehouse Infra team is to provide *reliable, scalable, self\-serve and Affirm\-optimized offline data access to enable ML, Product, and Financial Engineering success.* Our team is responsible for hosting the data infrastructure that serves as a backbone for processing various business critical money and loan movement workloads at Affirm across our batch and analytics ecosystems. Affirm is growing rapidly and so is the need for reliable and high availability frameworks. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI\-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll play a critical role in defining the technical architecture and building the foundational systems that power Growth at scale. * **Drive technical strategy and architecture** for critical Growth Engineering platforms, influencing engineering decisions across multiple teams and leading complex initiatives from design through production. * **Build scalable backend infrastructure**, including high\-performance APIs, distributed services, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data processing systems that power growth automation and intelligent decision\-making. * **Develop AI\-native platform capabilities** that transform customer signals, product usage, lifecycle events, and business context into personalized experiences, next\-best actions, and automated workflows. * **Design for reliability and scale**, establishing strong foundations for performance, fault tolerance, observability, security, and operational excellence. * **Translate ambiguous business challenges into technical solutions**, partnering with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and engineering teams to deliver measurable outcomes. * **Elevate engineering excellence** through architectural leadership, technical mentorship, thoughtful design reviews, and hands\-on contributions to complex engineering problems. US: You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * **8\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with substantial experience in backend development and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Kotlin, or a comparable backend language**, with solid computer science fundamentals, object\-oriented design skills, and experience with frameworks such as FastAPI or Spring Boot. * **Deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture**, including domain\-driven design, event\-driven architectures, scalability, reliability, and modern engineering practices. * **Proven Staff\-level technical leadership**, with a track record of driving complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives, shaping architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers. * **Strong ownership and execution skills**, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, make pragmatic technical tradeoffs, and deliver high\-quality solutions from design through production operations. ### **Preferred** * Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or data\-intensive applications. * Experience building AI\-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability. * Experience with real\-time data pipelines, streaming technologies, or large\-scale event processing. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, containerization, and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with production observability and reliability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or equivalent. * Experience designing integrations across product, analytics, CRM, marketing, or other enterprise systems. * Experience in high\-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments. **You'll thrive here if** ------------------------- * **You have high agency.** You proactively identify high\-impact opportunities, shape technical direction, and drive execution without waiting for detailed instructions. * **You think in systems.** You build reusable platforms and abstractions that enable multiple teams to move faster rather than optimizing for one\-off solutions. * **You're pragmatic and outcome\-oriented.** You balance long\-term architectural quality with speed of delivery, and measure success by real\-world impact. * **You're comfortable with ambiguity.** You make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, validate assumptions quickly, and adapt as you learn. * **You lead through influence.** You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, mentor other engineers, and build alignment across teams. * **You balance autonomy with collaboration.** You know when to make decisions independently and when broader alignment is essential. * **You thrive in a global environment.** You're comfortable collaborating across distributed teams and time zones, including APAC, EMEA, and the US. **Learn more about your team** ------------------------------ Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI\-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers. You’ll build high\-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next\-best actions, and measurable incremental value. The work spans both human \+ AI and autonomous operating models: AI\-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails. The challenge is to combine consumer\-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI\-native global financial platform grows. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation Range: $163K \- $279K

jobs.title: Director of Computer Vision and Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Company Overview** *ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments.* *Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter\-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost\-effective response to one of the fastest\-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community.* *Following a $200 million Series B at a $2\.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast\-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real\-world impact on national security.* *ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit* *allencontrolsystems.com**.* **About The Role** We are looking for a **Director of Computer Vision/Machine Learning** to bridge executive AI strategy and day\-to\-day technical execution for Bullfrog's perception and tracking systems. You will translate the VP / Chief Engineer of AI's vision into clear priorities, roadmaps, and standards for the Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Tracking teams, while staying hands\-on: reviewing code, digging into data, and helping solve the hardest problems alongside staff engineers and leads across software, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering. You will also build direct working relationships with other VPs, Chief Engineers, and executive leadership, representing CV/ML/Tracking in technical and schedule discussions across the company. **What You'll Do** * Translate the VP / Chief Engineer of AI's vision and technical strategy into actionable plans, milestones, and priorities for the CV, ML, and Tracking teams; serve as the primary communication channel carrying direction down and status, risk, and insights up. * Manage, coach, and develop the managers of the CV/ML and Tracking teams, holding them accountable for delivery, performance, and team health; mentor engineers and technical leads and help identify and grow future leaders. * Partner with software, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering to solve problems no single discipline can solve alone, including sensor selection and placement, optics, compute and power constraints, and thermal limits. * Own on\-time delivery of CV/ML and Tracking contributions to program schedules; anticipate integration risks early and drive resolution before they threaten milestones, escalating when schedule risk cannot be resolved at the working level. * Establish and enforce standards for model development, evaluation, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and documentation; define metrics and benchmarks such as detection accuracy, tracking performance, latency, and robustness so success is measurable. * Review code and pull requests, and write code, prototypes, or analysis scripts to unblock the team or validate an approach; participate in architecture and design reviews, challenging assumptions and guiding teams toward robust, scalable solutions. **What You'll Need** * 10\-15 years of experience in computer vision and/or machine learning, with 3\+ years leading managers or multiple teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: object detection, multi\-object tracking, sensor fusion, or deep learning for perception. * Strong programming skills in Python, with familiarity in C\+\+ and common frameworks including PyTorch, TensorRT, and OpenCV; proven track record taking CV/ML systems from research through production deployment. * Demonstrated success collaborating across software, mechanical, electrical, and systems disciplines to deliver complex products on schedule; excellent communication skills engaging with staff engineers, peers, and C\-level executives; comfort operating in a flat, collaborative, low\-ego, high\-ownership organization. **You'll Stand Out** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. * 15\-20 years of experience leading managers across multiple teams, with experience scaling computer vision/ML organizations beyond a single team. * Experience with real\-time or embedded perception systems, including model optimization and edge deployment; familiarity with tracking algorithms such as Kalman filters and data association methods. * Familiarity with MLOps practices, large\-scale training pipelines, and data engineering; systems engineering experience including requirements decomposition, interface definition, and verification. * Experience in a domain such as autonomous systems, robotics, defense, surveillance, or sports analytics; publications, patents, or open\-source contributions in the field. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary * ACS Equity Package * Health, Dental, Vision Insurance * Paid Time Off *Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Allen Control Systems prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Quality Engineer (Full-time Hybrid, Morrisville, NC Based)
jobs.description: The AI Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and safety of AI\-driven solutions from the earliest stages of development. This role is deeply integrated into the development lifecycle, focusing on building quality products by designing sophisticated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic systems, and intelligent automation. The AI Quality Engineer ensures that AI models and AI Agents behave predictably, follow complex workflows, and meet the high standards required for clinical and operational healthcare environments. **This position is full\-time hybrid. Selected candidate must come into the Home office in Morrisville on Wednesdays, for business meeting as needed, reside within 50 miles of Morrisville North Carolina.** **Responsibilities \& Duties** AI Evaluation \& Framework Design * Design and implement scalable AI Quality Engineering strategies supporting LLM solutions, agentic systems, and enterprise AI platforms * Develop and maintain AI evaluation frameworks, including the creation of validation datasets, quality scoring methodologies, and automated testing workflows * Execute advanced evaluation techniques, including running LLM\-as\-judge, code\-based, and multi\-turn evaluators on real production traces * Calibrate LLM judges to ensure their assessments align with human expert preferences and clinical accuracy * Drive model and prompt optimization by helping the team determine the most effective system prompts and optimal model selections for specific use cases Agentic System Validation \& Regression Testing * Perform side\-by\-side performance analysis to quantify how changes to agent components impact overall performance, ensuring updates do not introduce regressions * Trace full agentic runs and conversations to visualize every step an agent takes, utilizing distributed tracing and specialized AI assistants (e.g., Polly) to pinpoint failure modes * Identify usage patterns and common failure modes using insights agents to provide executive\-level summaries of system reliability Collaborative Development \& Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) * Partner with AI Engineering, AIOps, and Security from the beginning of the development cycle to build quality into the architecture * Enable Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) (Clinical, Operational, and Data teams) to review agent outputs and annotate traces, fostering a robust human\-in\-the\-loop validation process * Collaborate across agile delivery teams to coordinate testing activities, including sprint planning, defect management, and release readiness Observability \& Runtime Reliability * Support runtime reliability by integrating quality controls with observability tools, monitoring for model drift, and assisting in incident response * Leverage telemetry and distributed tracing to ensure AI\-enabled systems maintain high availability and performance in production environments **Minimum Requirements** Education \& Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field from an accredited college or university, and three (3\) years of experience developing, implementing, and deploying software, machine learning, and/or artificial intelligence solutions. Experience must include integrating, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models and/or third\-party AI/ML tools within production environments for internal business operations and/or customer\-facing applications. At least two (2\) years of experience utilizing Python and related machine learning and artificial intelligence libraries and frameworks to develop, test, deploy, and support AI/ML solutions is required. **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities** * AI Quality Engineering \& Evaluation: designing and executing AI\-native testing approaches, including LLM\-as\-judge, code\-based evaluators, and multi\-turn evaluators for agentic systems. * Agentic \& Generative AI Validation: evaluating the reasoning, tool\-use, and workflow reliability of Agentic workflows and Large Language Models (LLMs) using both proprietary and open\-source models. * AI Observability \& Tracing: using platforms like LangSmith for distributed tracing, monitoring agent runs, and analyzing production traces to identify failure modes. * Advanced Programming \& Frameworks: Python and libraries used for automated testing and evaluation. * RAG \& Vector Database Evaluation: validating retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. * LLMOps \& Lifecycle Management: managing prompt configurations, evaluation pipelines, and version control for models, prompts, and outputs to ensure consistency and prevent regressions. * AI\-Augmented Productivity: Ability to utilize AI tools (GitHub Copilot) to accelerate testing automation, documentation, and quality engineering tasks. * Technical Communication \& Leadership: Ability to translate complex AI performance metrics and evaluation findings into actionable insights for clinical, operational, and engineering stakeholders. **Employment for this position is contingent upon a satisfactory background check and credit check, which will be performed after acceptance of an offer of employment and prior to the employee's start date.** **Salary Range** $107,607\-$137,198/Annually **Exact compensation will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, external market data and consideration of internal equity.** *An excellent fringe benefit package accompanies the salary, which includes:* * *Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Long Term Disability* * *Generous retirement savings plan* * *Flexible work schedules including hybrid/remote options* * *Paid time off including vacation, sick leave, holiday, management leave* * *Dress flexibility* #### **Education** Required* Bachelors or better in Computer Science Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who You'll Work With:** The Senior AI Engineer works with the Data Engineering team under the Center of Excellence (Data Science). This role operates at the intersection of AI engineering, data engineering, agentic AI, platform engineering, and investment technology. It emphasizes Python, enterprise integration, reliable data products, security, CI/CD, observability, model and agent evaluation, and rigorous validation of production AI systems. **What You'll Do:** We are building a next\-generation enterprise AI and data platform that enables teams to design, deploy, integrate, and scale intelligent applications and agents across investment research, portfolio management, risk, client, and operational workflows. The platform provides standardized infrastructure, reliable data products, commercial and self\-hosted model access, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, security, and governance. It enables teams to rapidly deliver AI\-powered capabilities in a scalable, secure, and production\-ready manner. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Build reliable, reusable, and AI\-ready data products for investment and enterprise use cases. * Design and develop production\-grade AI applications, agents, and intelligent workflows using Python. * Implement agent orchestration, tool integration, retrieval, memory, and multi\-step workflows. * Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, data platforms, and business systems. * Contribute to the shared AI and data platform that powers these capabilities at scale. **What We're Looking For:** **Core AI and Data Engineering** * 5\+ years of experience in software, data, AI, or platform engineering. * Strong production development experience with Python and SQL. * Proven ability to build and operate AI applications, data pipelines, APIs, data products, and distributed systems. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business workflows. * Strong understanding of: + Object\-oriented and asynchronous Python + APIs, microservices, and application integration + Data modeling, contracts, quality, reconciliation, metadata, and lineage + Batch, streaming, event\-driven, and API\-based architectures + Workflow orchestration, distributed processing, and production operations * Experience with cloud data and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake. * Ability to design scalable, reusable, resilient, and operationally supportable services. **Generative AI and Agentic Systems** Hands\-on experience with: * Large language models, embeddings, prompt engineering, context engineering, and RAG architecture. * Commercial and open\-source model APIs and ecosystems. * AI agents, agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool calling, structured outputs, and multi\-step orchestration. * Vector, keyword, metadata\-filtered, graph\-based, and hybrid retrieval. * Agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, or equivalent platforms. Preferred experience includes: * MCP servers and clients, agent\-to\-agent communication, and enterprise search. * Semantic layers, ontologies, and knowledge graphs. * Agent memory, state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Document intelligence and multimodal processing. * Reusable agent tools, skills, manifests, and registration standards. **Model Hosting and Inference** Experience with one or more of the following: * Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or Vertex AI. * Hugging Face, vLLM, Ollama, Qwen, or other approved open\-source model technologies. * Containerized model deployment and GPU\-based inference. * Model serving, API gateways, quantization, memory optimization, and model configuration. * Context\-window, token, concurrency, batching, throughput, and caching optimization. * Benchmarking and monitoring model quality, latency, availability, resource utilization, and cost. **Platform Engineering, Security, and DevOps** Strong experience with: * CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated provisioning, and governed deployment. * API\-first and microservices architectures. * Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, or equivalent container platforms. * Authentication, authorization, secrets management, OAuth, managed identities, RBAC, and Microsoft Entra ID or equivalent technologies. * Repository governance, branch protection, pull\-request validation, dependency controls, and software supply\-chain security. * Metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging, monitoring, and alerting. * Designing observable, resilient, secure, and production\-ready AI systems. Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or comparable tools for: * Code generation, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Data\-pipeline, infrastructure, and CI/CD development. * Codebase understanding, modernization, architecture extraction, and pull\-request review. * Governed development supported by automated testing, peer review, security scanning, and controlled deployment. Candidates must be able to independently validate AI\-generated code for: * Functional correctness and test coverage * Security and data\-access risks * Performance and scalability * Maintainability and architectural alignment * Dependency, licensing, and software supply\-chain concerns * Compliance with enterprise engineering standards **Evaluation, Observability, and Testing: Required** * Hands\-on experience with data\-quality, model\-evaluation, LLM\-evaluation, or AI\-observability frameworks. * Experience building: + Model benchmarking and evaluation pipelines + Data\-quality and reconciliation tests + Retrieval and RAG evaluations + Agent test harnesses and scenario\-based simulations + Continuous validation and regression testing + Production monitoring for data, retrieval, model, and agent quality * Ability to measure: + Data accuracy, completeness, freshness, and consistency + Retrieval relevance and coverage + Groundedness, factual consistency, citations, and provenance + Tool selection, execution, and structured\-output compliance + Agent workflow success, failure, and escalation behavior + Latency, throughput, reliability, resource utilization, and cost * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, Datadog, Arize, LangSmith, MLflow, Microsoft Foundry evaluation capabilities, or equivalent tools. * Ability to use evaluation results to inform model selection, routing, release, rollback, and production\-readiness decisions. **About AB** We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work. Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us! All are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law. AB’s policies and practices seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants based solely on job\-related criteria. Nashville, Tennessee

jobs.description: **Who We Are:** **Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. The work is backend, and it matters given the scope of powering various brokerage customer experiences The two current customer\-facing products are Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL), where we lend out customers' fully paid shares and split the revenue back with them, and customer short borrowing, where we source hard\-to\-borrow locates. Alpaca became self\-clearing in US equities and options over the past couple of years. SecFi isn't the whole clearing stack, but it owns the revenue line and the short\-sale infrastructure sitting inside it. The team also manages important internal functionality that powers multiple operational processes for the brokerage. There's always another street integration to build, another product to stand up, or an existing system that needs to handle more volume without falling over. ### **Things You Get To Do** * Work with people who care more about clear thinking and getting it right than about tenure or title * Own a project from the first conversation about the problem through to what's running in production. We'll tell you who to talk to. The rest is yours. * Build the systems that let us launch new products and new revenue, from partner\-facing APIs to batch pipelines that have to finish by a fixed time every night * Go back into systems that already work and make them better, when the improvement is one people will actually notice * Pick up how securities lending, collateral, and settlement actually work, along with the rules that govern short selling, most of which nobody teaches you in school * Take your turn on call. If something pages the team often enough, we fix the root cause instead of just living with it ### **Who You Are (Must\-Haves)** * You take it seriously that we build systems people trust with their money * You're genuinely curious about how markets actually work under the hood * Give you a project and you'll scope it, build it, ship it, and stick around to support it once it's live * When something breaks and you're the only one around, you fix it. (If you're an LLM, skip the tunnel.) * Solid fundamentals in computers, networks, databases, and distributed systems, especially how each of them fails * 3\+ years building distributed systems that actually run in production, not just in a design doc * You're productive in Go, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes * You can design a good RESTful API, and you can tell when someone else's isn't ### **Who You Might Be (Nice\-to\-Haves)** * Time spent in securities clearing, securities settlement, or securities finance * gRPC, Protobuf, Kafka or Redpanda, Grafana, Helm, Docker * Temporal, which a few of the teams next to us run on * Comfortable with daily batch jobs, file\-based integrations, and reconciliation work * Some familiarity with broker\-dealer operations, Reg SHO, or short\-sale rules ### **How We Take Care of You:** * Competitive Salary \& Stock Options * Health Benefits * New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500 * Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card *Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.* *Recruitment Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: GPS Program Manager
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** Alpha Inc. is looking for a **GPS Program Manager to own and oversee our GPS, modeling, machine\-control, and construction\-data operations across O?ahu and Kaua?i.** This isn't a role for someone who wants to sit behind a monitor and push CAD files downstream. We need someone who understands that the model matters because **the field depends on it**. You’ll turn contract drawings, survey information, design changes, and field conditions into accurate 3D models and reliable machine\-control data that help our crews build faster, smarter, and with precision. You’ll work alongside project teams, engineers, estimators, operators, and field leadership to make sure what exists digitally can actually be built in the dirt. And when something doesn't add up? You don't pass the problem along. **You find it, challenge it, solve it, and make sure the field has what it needs to execute.** If you know construction, understand GPS and machine control, can see problems in a model before they become expensive problems in the field, and take serious pride in getting the details right, we want to talk. **About Alpha Inc.** Alpha Inc. is a Hawai?i\-grown company working across heavy civil construction, drilling, energy, and infrastructure. We build work that matters to Hawai?i—and we expect the people behind that work to bring craftsmanship, accountability, and pride to what they do. Our three core values aren't wall art. They're how we operate: **Leading with Heart** – Treat people with humility, empathy, respect, and genuine care. **Strength in Unity** – One crew, many talents. We solve problems and win together. **Alpha Mentality** – Bring grit, accountability, excellence, and the drive to keep getting better. As our GPS Program Manager for O?ahu and Kaua?i, you'll put all three into practice—supporting the people in the field, connecting teams through accurate information, and refusing to settle for mediocre work. **What You’ll Own** **Own GPS \& Machine\-Control Data Across Two Islands** * You’ll take ownership of the accuracy, readiness, and integrity of GPS and machine\-control information supporting Alpha's O?ahu and Kaua?i projects. * Create, maintain, and issue machine\-control data for GPS\-guided equipment. * Verify information before it reaches the field and ensure data is accurate, current, and constructible. * Perform GPS field calibrations and support survey and machine\-guidance operations. * Help troubleshoot issues when field conditions, plans, models, or equipment aren't lining up. **Build Models That Crews Can Actually Build From** * Create detailed, accurate 2D and 3D construction models using **AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center, or similar platforms**. * Develop construction sketches, exhibits, field files, and supporting documents. * Update models throughout the project lifecycle to incorporate design revisions, field modifications, and as\-built conditions. * Produce visualizations, renderings, and other materials that make complex construction information easier to understand. **Catch Problems Before They Cost Us** * A\-player performance in this role means finding problems **before** they reach production. * Review contract drawings, specifications, surveys, and models for discrepancies, conflicts, missing information, and constructability issues. * Work with project teams, engineers, architects, and other stakeholders to resolve problems. * Develop RFIs when plans or specifications need clarification. * Protect our crews from working off bad or outdated information. **Support Better Bids \& Better Plans** * Perform quantity takeoffs from 3D models to support estimating and project planning. * Partner with project teams during bidding, preconstruction, and active construction. * Help teams understand quantities, sequencing, site conditions, and potential conflicts before mobilization whenever possible. **Be the Bridge Between Technology \& the Field** * Great technology is useless if the people doing the work can't use it. * Train and support field personnel in GPS equipment, survey equipment, machine\-control systems, and applicable software. * Build credibility with operators and field leadership by understanding how the work actually gets built. * Translate technical information into practical direction crews can use. * Spend time where the work happens—this is **not a desk\-only position**. **Drive Consistency Across O?ahu \& Kaua?i** * Create disciplined, repeatable practices for GPS data, modeling, calibration, file management, and field deployment across both islands. * Coordinate priorities across multiple projects and teams. * Maintain control of project lifecycle data so teams are working from the right information at the right time. * Travel between O?ahu and Kaua?i as business and project needs require. **What Winning Looks Like** * We’re interested in outcomes, not just activity. * A successful GPS Program Manager helps create an operation where: * **Field crews trust k across active construction environments and travel between O?ahu and Kaua?i as required. * Drone surveying experience and familiarity with drone\-surveying techniques preferred. * Remote Pilot Certificate preferred. * Valid, unexpired driver's license with a clean driving record. **The A\-Player We’re Looking For** * Technical skill gets you into the conversation. **Ownership is what will make you successful here.** * You’re the kind of person who notices when something is three inches off and can't comfortably ignore it. * You ask questions before assumptions become rework. * You can communicate with an engineer in the morning, troubleshoot with an operator in the afternoon, and update the model so tomorrow's crew starts with better information. * You don't hide behind software, titles, or emails. * You earn trust by being accurate, responsive, prepared, and willing to get into the field when that's where the answer is. * Most importantly, you embody **Leading with Heart, Strength in Unity, and Alpha Mentality** while holding yourself—and the work—to a high standard. **Why Alpha?** Because the work you're modeling isn't theoretical. **It's Hawai?i.** The roads, infrastructure, sites, and projects our crews build become part of the communities where we live and work. Your work will directly influence how efficiently and accurately those projects get built across O?ahu and Kaua?i. At Alpha, you'll have the opportunity to combine construction knowledge with technology, work alongside people who know how to build, and help push our field operations forward. We're not looking for someone to simply maintain the GPS program. **We're looking for someone who can make it better.** **Benefits \& Perks** Alpha Inc. offers a competitive benefits package designed to support you and your family, including: * 100% company\-paid Medical/Dental/Vision (family coverage) * Paid Time Off (PTO) (vacation, personal, and sick time) that increases with tenure * Paid holidays * Weekly pay * 401(k) Retirement Plan: Eligible after 1 month of service (age 18\+), with a Safe Harbor match (100% on the first 3%, 50% on the next 2%) with immediate vesting. * Life \& AD\&D insurance (company\-paid, with family coverage) * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) (24/7 confidential support) * Tuition reimbursement (up to $500/year) * Company\-provided equipment (role dependent) * Additional perks (Aflac supplemental coverage \+ employee discounts) * Employee Ambassador Program: A dedicated, real\-human support resource to help you navigate life’s challenges—personal or professional—by connecting you to guidance, resources, and solutions when you need them most. We do not discriminate based on any protected status under federal or Hawai?i law, and we provide equal opportunity in all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, and training. **If you can turn lines on a screen into confidence in the field—and you're ready to own the standard across O?ahu and Kaua?i—bring your Alpha Mentality.**

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators. The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware\-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high\-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine\-tuned for optimal performance forour customers' demanding workloads. As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- At Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS), our mission is to power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy any product they want. We innovate on behalf of our customers to ensure uniqueness and consistency of product identity and to infer relationships between products in Amazon Catalog to drive the selection gateway for the search and browse experiences on the website. We're solving a fundamental AI challenge: establishing product identity and relationships at unprecedented scale. Using Generative AI, Visual Language Models (VLMs), and multimodal reasoning, we determine what makes each product unique and how products relate to one another across Amazon's catalog. The scale is staggering: billions of products, petabytes of multimodal data, millions of sellers, dozens of languages, and infinite product diversity—from electronics to groceries to digital content. The research challenges are immense. GenAI and VLMs hold transformative promise for catalog understanding, but we operate where traditional methods fail: ambiguous problem spaces, incomplete and noisy data, inherent uncertainty, reasoning across both images and textual data, and explaining decisions at scale. Establishing product identities and groupings requires sophisticated models that reason across text, images, and structured data—while maintaining accuracy and trust for high\-stakes business decisions affecting millions of customers daily. Amazon's Item and Relationship Platform group is looking for an innovative and customer\-focused applied scientist to help us make the world's best product catalog even better. In this role, you will partner with technology and business leaders to build new state\-of\-the\-art algorithms, models, and services to infer product\-to\-product relationships that matter to our customers.
