jobs.description: **About Beacon Software** ------------------------- Beacon is acquiring and operating a portfolio of vertical SaaS companies. Most private equity firms scale by adding people. We are building Beacon to scale by adding software. The thesis is simple. Portfolio operations, value creation, and deal sourcing are bottlenecked by human attention, and the right software platform can lift that ceiling by an order of magnitude. We are building that platform. A cross\-portfolio datalake on open table formats, with a feature store on top that makes the data usable by both people and software. An action layer that runs workflows across three domains: how we run the portfolio, how we grow the portfolio, and how we acquire into it. A feedback loop underneath that captures every action and outcome with stable identifiers. By the next phase of buildout we will have 100\+ portfolio companies running on this platform. That is a problem set with serious data scale, real multi\-tenant isolation requirements, and very few precedents to copy from. Beacon has raised $550M\+ from investors including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, and the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp. **About the Role** ------------------ Members of Technical Staff (MTS) are the senior engineers who build the platform that everything else at Beacon runs on. You will own a piece of the core stack end\-to\-end: design, implementation, operations, and the long\-term technical direction of that area. This is a Staff Engineer role in everything but name. We run flat. The work is systems engineering at its core. Multi\-tenant data infrastructure across very different portcos. Event\-driven pipelines that have to be correct under partial failure. Service architectures that have to stay simple as the product surface grows. APIs and SDKs that other engineers — including FDEs out in the field — will build on every day. ML and agentic systems are part of the stack. They sit on top of a foundation that has to be solid first. This is not infrastructure for its own sake. The platform has to be solid before anything else at Beacon works. That is the job. **What You'll Do** ------------------ You will own one of these areas end\-to\-end: * **Data platform.** The cross\-portco data lake on Iceberg with Snowflake or Databricks as the query engine. Per\-portco S3 and KMS isolation. The ingestion pipeline from QuickBooks, HubSpot, Salesforce, PostHog, Intercom, Linear, Slack, Gmail, Postgres, Stripe, Zendesk, and our internal tools. The canonical data model that survives contact with very different portcos. The catalog and semantic layer on top so a query like "show me sales across all portcos" actually resolves. * **Core services and APIs.** The backend services that everything else at Beacon depends on: identity, access control, audit, workflow orchestration, the internal APIs that FDEs and ops engineers build against. The bar here is not novelty. It is correctness, latency, observability, and the kind of API design that ages well. * **Multi\-tenant isolation.** Per\-portco data, compute, and credential boundaries. Cross\-cloud (AWS and Azure) connectivity. Regional residency for portcos in regulated verticals. This is the unglamorous infrastructure work that determines whether we can onboard portco 50 as fast as portco 5\. * **Workflow and action runtime.** The execution layer that runs operational workflows across the three domains. Typed action surfaces, idempotency, retries, rollback paths, human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates, audit trails. Some workflows are scripted. Some are model\-driven. The runtime treats them as variations of the same primitive. * **Observability and evals.** The harness that tells us whether the system is working: traces, metrics, structured logs, replay infrastructure, regression suites, the ability to safely A/B\-test changes across the portfolio. Both for traditional services and for model\-driven workflows. * **Safety and blast radius.** Wrong actions against a portco's customers, revenue, or product are the worst kind of mistake we can make. Designing the autonomy tiers, the kill switches, the per\-action\-class blast\-radius caps, and the audit surfaces is foundational platform work, not an afterthought. **Who You Are** --------------- * **Senior engineering depth.** Staff or principal\-equivalent. You have built and operated systems that real businesses depend on. You write clean, idiomatic code in at least one of Python, Go, Rust, or TypeScript, and you can work in any of them. You have an opinion on how to structure a service and you can defend it without raising your voice. * **Distributed systems intuition.** You have lived through enough production incidents to know where things actually break. Idempotency, partial failure, retry semantics, eventual consistency, schema evolution, multi\-tenant isolation. These are not concepts you read about. You will be making decisions in week 1 that constrain what is possible in year 3\. jobs.description: **Tech Lead — ToolHound (Embedded, Beacon Software)** ===================================================== **Where the work is** --------------------- Beacon buys great vertical software businesses and makes them dramatically more valuable, not by squeezing them, but by giving them world\-class engineering and AI leadership they could never hire on their own. Our engineers go where the work is: embedded inside a single business, owning its technology end to end, and compounding its enterprise value quarter over quarter. This role is one of those seats. You will be the **technical leader for ToolHound**, a mature, profitable tool\-and\-asset\-management platform used by industrial, construction, energy, and manufacturing customers to track where every tool and asset is, who has it, and what it costs them. You won't advise from the outside. You'll own the codebase, set the roadmap, lead the team, and be measured on the value you create. This is an AI\-native rebuild, not maintenance. ToolHound is a profitable, established platform, and the mandate is to reimagine what it does with AI at the center, and you're the technical leader who owns that from the front. We're looking for a **jack of all trades**, a strong generalist who can go deep where it counts. Deep, current **.NET** expertise is the price of entry, because that's what ToolHound is built on today. Over time, ToolHound converges onto Beacon's shared engineering standards, and you'll be the one leading that journey. The right person is excited by both, mastering the stack in front of them *and* growing into a broader one. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the technical and product roadmap.** Decide what gets built and why, in partnership with the GM and customers. Translate business priorities (retention, expansion, new verticals, operational leverage) into a sequenced engineering plan you're accountable for. * **Drive everything technical.** Architecture, code quality, security, data modeling, performance, release engineering, and the migration path. You set the bar and you'll make the final technical decision. * **Ship AI that changes the business, not demos.** Take the natural\-language assistant and the broader AI surface from plan to production: evals, guardrails, tenant\-safe tool use, and features customers feel. You know when to lean on a foundation model, when to fine\-tune, and how to keep agentic workflows on the rails in a multi\-tenant system. * **Lead and grow the team.** Mentor the current engineer, raise their ceiling, and establish the best practices. * **Increase velocity and harden the codebase.** Make shipping faster *and* safer: modernize the stack, tighten the SQL and data layer, invest in test coverage and automation, and pay down risk so the platform can carry far more weight than it does today. * **Be the technical face of ToolHound.** Earn the trust of operators and customers, set expectations, and communicate clearly in writing. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **A senior .NET expert — day one.** Deep, current C\# / ASP.NET Core (through .NET 8–10\), comfortable owning a large, mature codebase immediately: reading it, fixing it, and reshaping it with judgment. This is the non\-negotiable starting requirement. * **A genuine generalist ("jack of all trades").** You're T\-shaped, deep in .NET now, but you pick up new languages, stacks, and clouds quickly and enjoy it. You can move across web, mobile, data, infra, and AI without waiting for permission, and you're energized (not threatened) by converging onto TypeScript/React, Go, Python, and AWS over time. * **Cloud and SQL depth.** You've designed, deployed, and operated real systems in the cloud, and can model, query, tune, and reason about production databases. * **Mobile fluency.** Hands\-on with cross\-platform mobile: .NET MAUI (or Xamarin/ native, with the ability to go deep on MAUI), including scanning, camera, and offline sync. * **AI\-native engineering.** You've shipped production software on foundation models (LLM tool use, retrieval, evals, guardrails), not just prototypes, and you have a point of view on doing it safely in a multi\-tenant product. * **Technical leadership.** You've led engineers. Set direction, mentored, raised quality in a small, high\-ownership team where the leader still ships code. * **Product and business instinct.** You can read what actually drives the business, prioritize accordingly, and defend a roadmap to a GM and to customers. * **A strong writer and communicator** who builds trust with non\-engineers. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience across our target technologies — **TypeScript/React, Go, Python**, **AWS**, **Kubernetes**, infrastructure\-as\-code, modern CI/CD, **Postgres**, and metrics/product\-analytics tooling — or a track record of learning stacks like these fast. * Vertical / B2B or industrial SaaS experience (asset management, inventory, field service, logistics, construction tech). * RFID / IoT / hardware\-integrated systems. * DevExpress reporting, multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, or licensing systems. * Experience modernizing or re\-platforming a legacy .NET codebase without a disruptive rewrite. **Our Values at Beacon Software** * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.description: **About Beazley Security** Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017\. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients. As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world\-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges. **Summary** Beazley Security has Claude and Microsoft Copilot deployed across the company. The next step is putting agents to work across every team in the business. This is our first hire dedicated to making that happen. You’ll work with operations, sales, finance, and other non\-technical teams to find manual work worth automating. You’ll build agents in Claude and Copilot Studio, get them into daily use, and measure the time they save. Early on you’ll build most of them yourself, while teaching teams to build their own. You’ll have a big say in what we tackle first and how we build it. This is the first hire for what we plan to grow into a team, so a lot of what you set up early will stick. Beazley Security protects client data and systems for a living, so you’ll build security and privacy into every agent from the start. You’ll help us establish safeguards to ensure that agents can go into production quickly and safely, by building upon our existing agentic security tooling and capabilities.**Responsibilities** * Spend time with teams across the business, watch how the work gets done, and pick the problems where an agent saves hours or removes a manual, error\-prone step. Agree on what success looks like before you build. * Turn a stream of AI ideas into a short, ranked backlog with a clear call on each: build it, help the team build it, or leave it alone. * Estimate what each agent will cost to run, including licensing and token consumption. Use our pre\-agreed guardrails so low\-risk agents go live quickly, and bring in Security, IT, Legal, or Privacy when a use case needs a closer look. * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and supporting automation using the Claude Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio. * Build a group of champions across the business, run hands\-on build sessions and office hours, and create the templates and playbooks teams use to build their own agents safely. * Help maintain a record of every agent in production with its owner, data sources, and access. Evaluate new AI tools when teams ask about them and recommend whether we adopt them. **Your First 90 Days** * **Days 1 to 30:** Get to know Beazley Security. Sit with at least three teams, map their most painful workflows, and build your first agent yourself. Get it into real use, even if it’s small. * **Days 31 to 60:** Two or three agents in production, each measured against a baseline of “value”. A published intake process, and your first AI champions identified. * **Days 61 to 90:** At least one team can point to manual work that’s gone. The agent register and build playbook are live. * **After that:** Champions build their own agents using your patterns, and your results justify the next hire onto this team. **What You'll Have** * Executive buy\-in and support. You report to our Chief Product and Technology Officer, who uses AI every day and has built several agents for internal use. Expect quick decisions and direct help when a project gets stuck. * A first project. A business sponsor and workflow lined up before day one. * A fast review path. Guardrails agreed with Security and Legal before you start, so low\-risk agents don’t sit in a queue. **Qualifications** * You’ve built AI agents or automations that are in daily use, with low\-code tools like Copilot Studio or with code (Python, TypeScript, and the Claude API). * You have hands\-on experience with prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and evaluating agent output, and you know where LLMs fail. * You’ve integrated with REST APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and enterprise authentication. * You’ve typically spent four or more years in a business\-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions consulting, business analysis, automation, or platform delivery. * You can learn a finance or sales operations workflow from the people who run it and build something that improves it. * You know when a use case needs a security or privacy review before it goes anywhere, and you can estimate what an agent will cost to run on Copilot credits or Claude API usage. * You’ve run workshops or training for non\-technical audiences, and you write clearly. * You’d rather ship a small agent that works than constantly plan and iterate on a big one. **Preferred** * Experience in cybersecurity. * Experience running an AI champions program, community of practice, or citizen developer program. * Experience setting up lightweight AI guardrails, like an agent inventory or risk tiers, that keep teams moving quickly. * Familiarity EU data protection requirements. * **When you apply, please** **include a link or a short screen recording of something you built.** **Beazley Security Offers** * Competitive salary and bonus. * Flexible working arrangements. * Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental. * 100% of employee\-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision). * Up to 5% matched 401k contribution. * Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training. * Participation in industry conferences and events.

jobs.title: Director, Embedded Engineering
jobs.description: Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single\-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT\-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development. Bevi is looking for a Director of Embedded Engineering to lead the team that builds the electronics and firmware at the heart of every Bevi machine. From the boards that drive our pumps, valves, sensors and chillers, to the firmware and embedded Linux/Android platform that keep thousands of connected machines running reliably in the field, this team makes the hardware come alive. You will own and manage the electrical and firmware engineers who design, bring up, and sustain our products, and you'll be the person who makes sure the boards, the code, and the system architecture fit together as one platform across our current fleet and our next generation of machines. This is a technical and people leadership role in equal measure. You'll set the embedded architecture and engineering standards, and you'll build and lead a team that needs both a strong technical leader and a strong people manager. This role reports to the VP of Engineering and sits on the engineering leadership team. It will operate in close partnership with Mechanical, Software, Systems, Quality, Manufacturing, and our contract manufacturing and design partners. As Bevi's product portfolio grows, there's room for this role to grow with it. ### **Your Day to Day** ### **Embedded Architecture \& Technical Direction** * Own the embedded system architecture across Bevi's products: the multi\-board electrical design, the single\-board computer and SoM platform, the microcontroller firmware, and the interfaces that tie them together. * Set the technical roadmap for embedded, including platform consolidation, next\-generation compute and control boards, and reuse across product lines so each new machine is not a clean\-sheet effort. * Make the hard tradeoff calls on reliability, cost, component availability, and speed of development, and bring a clear point of view to the engineering leadership team. * Stay hands\-on enough to review schematics, layouts, and firmware architecture, and to dig into a field failure with the team when it matters. ### **New Product Development \& Sustaining** * Lead EE and FW execution on new product programs from concept and prototype through board bring\-up, design verification, regulatory certification, and production release. * Own the health of embedded systems in the field: firmware releases, fleet diagnostics, remote management, and fast root\-cause analysis and corrective action when issues reach customers. * Drive component lifecycle management, second sourcing, and design changes that protect supply continuity and margin for products already in production. * Partner with Quality and Manufacturing on test strategy, end\-of\-line testing, and test fixtures so what we design can be built and verified at scale. ### **Team Leadership** * Manage and grow a team of Electrical Engineers and Firmware Engineers, giving each discipline what it needs to do great work while keeping both aligned to one platform. * Hire, coach, and develop engineers on technical depth and career growth, and build a team that can scale with Bevi's product roadmap. * Build clear ownership, documentation, and knowledge sharing so critical systems never depend on a single person. ### **Cross\-Functional \& Partner Leadership** * Work directly with Mechanical, Software, and Systems Engineering to define system requirements and protect design integrity from concept through production. * Manage external design partners, contract manufacturers (domestic and overseas), and component suppliers. Own design for manufacturability, NPI handoff, and production support for electronics at volume, including test coverage, yield, and corrective actions. * Represent embedded in program reviews, design reviews, and risk reviews, making sure embedded constraints shape decisions early rather than surfacing late. * Own embedded regulatory and compliance readiness (e.g., UL, FCC, CE/UKCA, EMC) in partnership with Compliance and Quality. ### **Process \& Engineering Excellence** * Establish and enforce standards for schematic and layout reviews, firmware code reviews, version control, release management, and documentation. * Build out hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, unit test frameworks, build automation, and CI/CD for firmware. * Champion the use of AI across the embedded team to accelerate design, code generation, testing, and debugging, and define how we integrate it responsibly into our workflows. ### **Requirements** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; MS is a plus. * 10\+ years of embedded hardware and firmware experience, with 5\+ years leading and growing teams that include both electrical and firmware engineers. * A track record of taking connected electromechanical products from prototype through production and sustaining them in the field at scale. * Experience taking electronics into high\-volume production with overseas contract manufacturers, including DFM/DFT, NPI transfer, PCBA yield and quality issues, and on\-site support at the CM. * Strong technical depth in board\-level electrical design (mixed\-signal, power, motor and actuator drive, sensor interfacing) and in embedded C/C\+\+ on ARM Cortex\-M microcontrollers, including bare\-metal and RTOS\-based systems. * Experience with embedded Linux or Android (AOSP) platforms on SBC or SoM\-based designs. * Hands\-on familiarity with communication interfaces and protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, USB, CAN, Ethernet, and wireless (WiFi, LTE, BLE). * Experience bringing products through regulatory certification (UL, FCC, CE/UKCA, EMC) and supporting international market entry. * Strong communicator who can hold their own with engineers in a design review and explain risk and tradeoffs clearly to executives. * Experience in food and beverage equipment, appliances, or other regulated consumer hardware is a plus. * Experience working in rapidly growing or scaling companies is a plus. * Ability to be in the office 3\+ days per week. \#LI\-CD1 \#LI\-HYBRID #### **Benefits:** * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer * 401(k) with company match * Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc * Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non\-birth parents * Fully employer paid disability and life insurances * Wellness and fitness reimbursements * Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs * Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra\-cycling, too * Happy hours, team\-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards \- and more. **A note on AI in our hiring process**: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note\-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in. Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community\-driven progress and the future of technology. *We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply!* *A member of the Bevi Talent team '**recruiting@bevi.co**' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.* #### **Accommodations:** Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.

Based in Los Angeles, this role focuses on real\-time security alert monitoring, triage, incident response, and active detection engineering across AI Cloud's production estate—spanning GPU/AIDC infrastructure, our core cloud platform, and public\-facing services. This is a technical, hands\-on operations and engineering role (not a policy or management position) working regular US Pacific daytime hours, featuring tight collaboration with our global security team. ### **Responsibilities** * **Security Monitoring \& Response:** Perform on\-shift triage, containment, escalation, and post\-incident writeups for P1/P2 security incidents across our GPU/AIDC infrastructure, cloud platform, and public services. * **SLA Adherence:** Consistently meet team SLAs for critical incidents (P1 acknowledgment within $\\le$ 15 minutes, response start within $\\le$ 30 minutes). * **Detection Engineering:** Continuously tune and build alert rules within our self\-built SIEM, HIDS, and WAF telemetry to suppress false positives and keep paging high\-signal. * **Alert\-Triage Automation:** Contribute to building and refining agentic triage workflows to automate routine responses and reduce noise. * **Cross\-Site Collaboration:** Conduct daily written and live handoffs with our Singapore security team to ensure seamless global operations across shifts. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in a SOC, Incident Response (IR), or Detection Engineering role, with comfort acting as the primary on\-shift responder. * **Infrastructure Fundamentals:** Strong Linux and Kubernetes fundamentals; comfortable operating across cloud platforms and bare\-metal/GPU environments. * **Query \& Scripting:** Practical SIEM query experience (OpenSearch, Splunk DSL, or similar) and scripting skills in **Python** or **Go**. * **Host Detection \& Log Analysis:** Direct experience with host\-based detection tools (Falco, Wazuh, auditd), log analysis, and standard IR tooling. * **Schedule Flexibility:** Willingness and ability to participate in a weekend on\-call rotation. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves / Preferred Qualifications** * **Specialized Threat Experience:** Hands\-on incident response experience with crypto\-mining malware or supply\-chain security incidents. * **Runtime \& eBPF Security:** Exposure to eBPF\-based detection or runtime security tools (e.g., Tetragon, Falco internals). * **AI/GPU Infrastructure:** Familiarity with high\-performance computing environments (NVIDIA DGX/HGX, InfiniBand, or RoCE networking). * **Languages:** Professional fluency in Mandarin to facilitate day\-to\-day collaboration with our Singapore engineering site (English is required). * **Certifications:** Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, or CISSP are a plus. \- *Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.description: **About Block Labs** ==================== Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of **Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming**. We don't just ship features; we engineer high\-scale, production\-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi\-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high\-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong. **The role** ============ We are building the frontend of a multi\-brand consumer platform in React, Next.js and TypeScript: one codebase serving several brands, where launching a brand should be a matter of configuration, not a copy. You will be the most senior frontend engineer in the company and the person the platform’s UI depends on. We don’t hire into squads. We work as a small number of very strong individual contributors, each owning a product end to end and shipping with AI agents at a pace that used to take a team. You get an outcome and constraints, not a backlog: you find the decisions nobody has made, scope the work, build it, ship it and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. Product ideas often arrive as working prototypes built with AI tools by people outside engineering. Your job is to steer them into production, not to reject them or rebuild them from zero. **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Own the frontend end to end: architecture, conventions, quality bar and production behaviour of a multi\-brand platform, with no spec handed to you. * Make adding a brand a configuration change: theming, brand\-aware routing and content, and clean boundaries between shared and brand\-specific code, all on a live product. * Build and own the design system and component library that engineers, designers and AI\-assisted prototyping all draw from. * Turn product prototypes into production features fast, and build the workflow and tooling that make this repeatable. * Ship with AI coding agents every day as your main way of working, with the checks that keep quality high at agent speed, and raise the bar for how others use them. * Ship consumer\-facing UI with real attention to detail, performance and accessibility. * Take UX and product concerns straight to the people who own the product, with alternatives and working examples, not just objections. **About You:** ============== * 8\+ years building production consumer\-facing web applications, several of them at Staff or equivalent ownership. * You have taken a frontend from a rough brief to production and owned it, and you can say exactly what was yours, what was your team’s and what was your agents’. * AI coding agents are how you build, not a helper. You have your own setup and can say precisely where agents make you faster, where they produce plausible but wrong output, and how you catch it. * Deep expertise in React, Next.js and modern TypeScript, with clear opinions on rendering strategies and when each is the wrong choice. * Hands\-on experience building or re\-architecting multi\-brand, multi\-tenant or white\-label frontends. * You have built or owned a design system and can discuss consistency versus flexibility, adoption and governance. * Strong UI and UX sensibility: you notice the small things and fix them without being asked. * Comfortable working with non\-engineers who build with AI tools, and you design for their output to be usable. * Demonstrable Core Web Vitals work in production. * You thrive with autonomy and light process, and you write clearly. Strong command of written and verbal English. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience with real\-time, high\-interaction consumer interfaces where latency and feel matter. * Background in fintech, crypto, real\-time gaming and entertainment platforms, or other high\-traffic consumer products. * Tooling, skills or integrations you built so agents work better inside a specific codebase or design system. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and cloud environments. **What this role is not** ========================= * Not a management or lead role. Influence comes from what you ship. * Not a pure architecture role. You write production code every day. * Not for someone who wants a team, a backlog or a complete spec before starting. **What kind of culture can I expect?** Mature, mission\-driven, and low\-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

jobs.title: Data Scientist & AI Engineer, Mid
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** Are you ready to embark on a journey where your skills in data and artificial intelligence will drive innovation and propel businesses into the future? Are you fascinated by the possibilities presented by artificial intelligence advances? In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open up new opportunities. As an aspiring data scientist AI engineer, you know you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors — from fraud detection to cancer research, to national intelligence — you see data scientists turning data into actions and you want to be part of the team. As a data scientist on our team, you’ll use your analytical skills to help create real\-world impact. You’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data\-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll work with and learn from your teammates as you develop algorithms and systems. You’ll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers so that your clients can make informed decisions. If you are driven by curiosity, thrive in a fast\-paced setting, and have a deep fascination with the potential of AI, this is the place where you can make a significant impact. Join us, and be part of a team that's not only shaping the future but also pushing the boundaries of what's possible. Join us. The world can’t wait. **You Have:** * 3\+ years of experience leveraging statistical programming languages to develop predictive data models, quantitative analyses, and data visualizations * 2\+ years of experience in Artificial Intelligence, including Machine Learning, Agentic AI, Natural Language Processing, and applied use of Large Language Models * Experience with front\-end development using React or Python\-based frameworks, such as Streamlit to build interactive, user\-facing data applications * Experience with generative AI and agentic AI libraries and frameworks for building LLM\-powered applications and autonomous agents * Experience writing efficient, clean, and maintainable code, using Git, testing, and code reviews to collaboratively develop reliable AI solutions * Ability to query, process, and build data pipelines for large, complex datasets using big data technologies * Ability to evaluate AI models using appropriate performance metrics, validation methods, and error analyses to assess accuracy, robustness, bias, fairness, and fitness for the intended use case * Public Trust * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or Mathematics **Nice If You Have:** * Experience with AWS or other cloud services * Experience with program automation, CI and CD, DevSecOps, or Agile * Experience with healthcare or medical device industry data * Experience with Agile methodologies and best practices * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenCode * Ability to apply experimental design principles to define evaluation criteria, establish baselines, identify appropriate comparison groups, and determine the data and methods needed to assess an AI solution before development begins * Master’s degree preferred; Doctorate degree a plus **Vetting:** Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client; Public Trust determination is required. **Compensation** At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page. jobs.title: Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** At Boston Engineering, we apply the brightest minds to deliver impactful solutions while providing a rewarding, career\-building environment for our team. We are seeking an **Innovation Engineer** to support our Vice President, Business Operations and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in advancing the company's innovation strategy, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and securing new business opportunities through technical insight, creativity, and disciplined execution. This role is ideal for an entrepreneurial\-minded engineering professional who thrives on transforming ideas into practical outcomes for both our clients and Boston Engineering. The position requires initiative, strong communication and organizational skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. **See Boston Engineering in action:** Learn how our engineers applied first\-principles thinking and reverse engineering to develop BIOSwimmer, an autonomous underwater robotic fish. * ️ WATCH: How Reverse Engineering Propels BIOSwimmer – The Robotic Fish **Job Description** * Evaluate new technology, product development, and systems engineering opportunities for both client and internal initiatives * Contribute to technical proposals, white papers, and responses to business opportunities (including RFPs, Sources Sought, SBIRs, and other government and commercial funding opportunities) * Represent Boston Engineering at business meetings, industry events, and with partners in the fields of robotics, data science (AR, VR, ML, AI), and advanced manufacturing * Ideate and translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for technical and nontechnical audiences. Develop visual materials such as graphics, presentations, and videos to effectively communicate solutions, product roadmaps, and company capabilities * Identify opportunities, analyze potential tools and best practices, and help implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, quality, and organizational efficiency * Support invention disclosure, prior\-art research, patent documentation, and coordination with inventors and intellectual\-property counsel * Facilitate coordination with Manufacturing Innovation Institutes, technology and supply chain partners, research and development organizations, and project stakeholders on collaborative efforts **Required Skills** * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create and present engaging content for diverse audiences * Proven organizational ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple initiatives, and follow through on deliverables * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross\-functional teams. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Sharepoint) **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in an engineering or manufacturing\-related field * 3 or more years of relevant professional experience required \- exceptional candidates with substantial internship, co\-op, or research experience will be considered * Demonstrated experience synthesizing information, conceptualizing solutions, and developing technical content for engineering, business, and government stakeholders * Familiarity with federal research and development programs and funding mechanisms * Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management system * Interest or experience in emerging technologies, including robotics, IoT, augmented/virtual reality (AR/VR), and artificial intelligence (AI **Additional Information** This role is restricted to US persons (i.e., US citizens, permanent residents, and other protected individuals under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 USC 1324b(a)(3\)) due to access to export\-controlled technology. Boston Engineering will require proof of status prior to employment. **Employment Type:** Full\-Time Role **Reports to:** Vice President, Business Operations **Location:** Office\-based role in Waltham, Massachusetts **Relocation:** Not available at this time **Travel:** Minimal **Salary Range:** The base salary range for this position is $90,000\-$115,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications. A comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, 401(k) match, and paid time off, is also provided. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. **Questions?** Please contact Christine Higgins, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Boston Engineering email: chiggins\-ctr@boston\-engineering.com LinkedIn: Christine Higgins \| LinkedIn

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Software Systems
jobs.description: Brain Corp is a San Diego, California, USA\-based AI company creating transformative core technology for the robotics industry. Our purpose is to create autonomous technology that helps the real world work better. Brain's robotic and AI solutions help retailers ensure that the right product is on the right shelf at the right price, in a clean environment. Through the BrainOS® Robotics Platform, which powers the largest global fleet of the Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in operation in commercial public spaces, Brain Corp delivers insightful and efficient automated solutions in both commercial floor cleaning and inventory management, empowering organizations and their employees to achieve more. Brain Corp currently powers more than 50,000 AMRs, representing the largest fleet of its kind in the world. Brain Corp is funded by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Clearbridge, and Qualcomm Ventures. Named a top workplace by the San Diego Union Tribune and USA today in 2025, we make life\-changing impacts through innovation, helping workers globally unlock their abilities in orchestration with intelligent machines. **Position Overview**: The Staff Software Engineer is a key technical leader within Brain Corp's Platform team, responsible for the architecture, evolution, and performance of core software systems powering our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). This includes ownership of the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), telemetry systems, and core C\+\+ middleware.This role is highly hands\-on and strategic, driving the re\-architecture of foundational robotics software to improve modularity, scalability, and performance. The engineer will lead technical direction across HAL and middleware layers, enabling efficient sensor integration, new hardware bring\-up, and high\-performance execution on embedded systems. Working cross\-functionally with hardware, autonomy and applications teams, this role will ensure that our robotics platform supports rapid innovation, robust field performance, and scalable deployment across a global fleet. **Essential Job Functions:** * Lead the technical direction and architecture of the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), ensuring modularity, scalability, and long\-term maintainability * Drive the migration and re\-architecture of HAL to support next\-generation robotics platforms and evolving hardware requirements * Own the design and evolution of the robotics telemetry and replay systems, improving observability, reliability, and data quality * Lead the migration of middleware components from Python to high\-performance C\+\+ implementations * Architect and develop robust C\+\+ middleware enabling efficient communication between sensors, compute, and autonomy systems * Integrate and bring up new hardware components, including sensors such as LiDARs, cameras, and IMUs * Optimize system performance across the robotics stack, including latency, throughput, memory usage, and CPU efficiency * Collaborate closely with hardware, apps, autonomy, and QA teams to ensure seamless system integration and deployment * Establish and enforce best practices in software design, code quality, testing, and documentation * Provide technical mentorship and leadership to engineers, guiding design reviews and complex debugging efforts * Contribute hands\-on code to critical components while balancing long\-term architectural improvements * Drive continuous improvement of development workflows, testing strategies, and system reliability **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements**: * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Proven experience working on robotics systems, embedded platforms, or hardware abstraction layers (HAL) * Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives or driving architectural changes in production systems **Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics**: * Expert\-level proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 or later), including multithreading, memory management, and performance optimization * Strong Python skills for scripting, tooling, and system integration * Deep understanding of hardware abstraction layers and low\-level system design * Hands\-on experience integrating sensors such as LiDARs, cameras, and IMUs into production systems * Strong experience with Linux\-based development environments (e.g., Ubuntu) * Experience designing and developing middleware systems or inter\-process communication frameworks * Familiarity with communication protocols such as MQTT, or similar paradigms * Experience with build systems (e.g., CMake) and unit testing frameworks (e.g., Google Test) * Proven ability to design scalable, maintainable, and modular system architectures * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in complex robotics or embedded environments * Experience with system performance profiling and optimization (CPU, memory, latency, throughput) * Proficiency with version control systems such as Git * Excellent communication skills and ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship without direct management responsibility **Things that Make a Difference:** * Experience with Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) or similar robotic systems * Prior experience leading or contributing to large\-scale system re\-architecture or migration efforts * Experience designing or improving telemetry and observability systems * Familiarity with custom middleware architectures (non\-ROS environments) * Background in real\-time or near\-real\-time systems * Experience working at the intersection of hardware and software integration * Passion for robotics, automation, and building high\-performance, scalable systems **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Essential functions may require maintaining the physical condition necessary for sitting, walking or standing for periods of time; operating a computer and keyboard; use of hands to finger and grasp; talk and hear at normal room levels; visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures; push or pull up to 20 pounds. **Salary Range:** The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in San Diego, California is $187,182 to $233,978\. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and length of experience within the job, type and length of experience within the industry, education, etc. Brain Corp is a multi\-state employer and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states. In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of: * A discretionary annual target bonus * Stock options * 401(k) plan with match (no waiting period and immediate vesting) * Comprehensive suite of insurance benefits for employees (and their families) to include a variety of medical plan options (including an HSA with employer contribution), dental, vision, life and disability insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Legal/Identity support plans, pet insurance. * Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical and Dependent Care) * Generous paid time off including flexible vacation, Paid Sick Leave, time off for volunteering in the community, 10 paid company holidays, and a winter company shutdown Additional Perks include: * Daily on\-site lunch available in the San Diego office * On\-campus gym including pool and tennis courts in the San Diego office * Opportunities to connect with colleagues including monthly game nights, hikes, wellness challenges, and community events * Internal continuous learning events * Opportunities to share your own interests and hobbies with the Company

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Firmware

jobs.title: Technical Resident
jobs.description: Are you passionate about the patient experience? At HCA Healthcare, we are committed to caring for patients with purpose and integrity. We care like family! Jump\-start your career as a(an) Technical Resident today with Ogden Regional Medical Center. ##### **Job Summary and Qualifications** \*\* This position pays a flat rate of $18/hr\*\* TECHNICAL RESIDENCY PROGRAM The Technical Residency Program is an apprenticeship program for junior developers, programmers, researchers, and analysts. It provides a learning opportunity to gain on\-the\-job training and experience in the field while building a strong colleague network within the organization. You will be assigned professional development sessions, a mentor, a project, and an opportunity to learn from industry leaders in the field of healthcare technology. Technical Resident apprenticeships are six months in duration, with the opportunity to be considered for conversion to full\-time employment. WHAT YOU’LL DO * Work alongside other team members and key partners on your assigned sponsored team. * Collaborate with an assigned mentor who will help you navigate the challenges associated with being an ITG employee. * Continually grow professionally and personally through various learning and development opportunities. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Individuals interested in one or more of the following areas: * Web Design * Social Media * Mobile Development * Data Science * Advanced Analytics * Data Management * UX/UI Design * DevOps * Automation * Security * Testing * IT Development * Programming * Candidates looking to start their career in technology or re\-enter the workforce. * Experience working collaboratively and clearly communicating in a professional work environment. * Self\-motivated and eager candidates with a passion for solving problems. * During your time as a Technical Resident, you will be part of the solution. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with omniscient systems purpose\-built for today's realities. CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised $1B in total funding from leading investors including 8VC, Accel, and NEA. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com. **The Role** You'll join a small, highly collaborative team in San Francisco building the cloud platform behind some of the world's most advanced radar systems. You'll design, build, and operate both the infrastructure and the backend services that move mission\-critical sensor data from radars in the field to the operators who depend on it. The platform is in production and growing fast, and your job is to scale it as our fleet of sensors, customers, and deployments grows. **What You'll Build** * **Cloud Infrastructure** \- design and operate our Azure infrastructure as code with Terraform: networking, Azure Container Apps, managed databases, and the CI/CD pipelines that deploy to them. * **Backend Platform Services** \- build and own high\-throughput Python (FastAPI) services and the data layer behind them (PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis, Cosmos DB) that ingest and stream real\-time sensor data. * **Platform Architecture** \- work with engineering teams across the company to define the architecture of the next generation of the platform. * **Operations** \- own security, reliability, and observability across the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network isolation, monitoring and alerting (Datadog), and incident response. **What We're Looking For** * Have built and operated production infrastructure in at least one major cloud \- Azure, AWS, or GCP \- defined in code with Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or CloudFormation. * Have run containerized production workloads (Docker) on a managed platform such as Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS or Fargate, Google Cloud Run, or Kubernetes. * Have strong cloud networking fundamentals: virtual networks, subnets, routing, DNS, load balancers, private endpoints, and firewalls. * Have built and operated production backend services in Python, Go, or a similar language, and understand what happens under load \- concurrency, async I/O, connection pooling, and resource limits. * Are fluent in distributed systems: consistency and replication, partitioning, caching, back\-pressure, idempotency, and how systems fail \- and how to design so that they degrade gracefully. * Have scaled a production system well beyond its original design, and fixed what broke on the way. * Build securely by default \- least\-privilege access, secrets kept out of code, and patched, hardened systems \- and can explain the trade\-offs behind those choices. **Experience in any of the following is a plus:** * Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or other regulated environments (FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800\-171 or 800\-53\). * Real\-time and streaming data systems: WebSockets, server\-sent events, pub/sub, and message queues. * Identity and cloud security: Entra ID, OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC, managed identities, service\-to\-service authentication, and policy as code.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: Solutions · Full\-time · Singapore; New Delhi; Mumbai SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **About the role** We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production\-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped. We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world\-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course\-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day\-to\-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi. ### **What you’ll do** * **Sell** + Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de\-risk delivery before a line of code is written + Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time\-boxed deliverables with clear ROI + Sell the vision and the plan to C\-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it + Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six\- and seven\-figure engagements**Deliver** + Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest\-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C\-suite + Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions + Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions + Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest + Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time**Manage People** + Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects + Hire top\-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production + Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex + Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume ### **You may be a fit if** * You have 8\+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job * You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript * You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real\-world model failures * You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest\-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement * You've built and scaled IC\-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Pretraining Data
jobs.description: Engineering · Full\-time · San Francisco SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **About the role** We’re looking for Software Engineers to build the data systems behind our frontier coding models’ initial training. You’ll work on large\-scale crawling, data platform, and pipeline infrastructure, turning raw dumps into the datasets our models train on, and making iteration with researchers fast and reliable. * **The Data Quality team** owns the entire road between raw internet\-scale data and the tokens that train frontier models. This team makes sure the right data, in the right form, hits the training clusters on time and at the quality bar required to push the scaling curve. This is done by building our own models, our own high\-performance pipelines, and by running the experiments that prove the data is actually stellar. * **The Data Platform Team** owns the infrastructure and pipelines that transform raw data dumps into training\-ready datasets. This team improves the speed, reliability, and developer experience of our initial training data pipelines so researchers can quickly experiment with new data sources, quality filters, taxonomies, multimodal data, and data mixes that improve model performance. * **The Crawling team** owns large\-scale web crawling and parsing that feeds the top of the funnel for initial training. They discover, schedule, fetch, and parse public web content so high\-quality documents become the raw scrapes that Data Quality and Data Platform turn into tokens and mixes. This is deep distributed systems work with real ownership: host coverage and prioritization, fetch success under antibot and trap content, HTML/document parsing quality, and reliability of the crawl infrastructure that must continuously supply every downstream data pipeline. ### **What you’ll do** * **on the Data Quality Team:** + Build and own high\-throughput, fully telemetered data pipelines that process frontier\-scale data with end\-to\-end traceability. If something breaks or drifts, your systems will tell us before the training run does. + Train and ship models that classify, rank, filter, clean, and identify data at extreme throughput. These models have to be both accurate *and* fast enough to sit in the critical path without becoming the bottleneck. + Design and run scaling\-ladder experiments on data\-mixture, repeatability, and quality depth that turn “this dataset feels good” into hard evidence the training team can trust. + Partner tightly with Data Acquisition to hunt down missing or low\-quality sources, and with the training teams to close the loop on what actually moves loss and downstream evals. + Treat data quality as a systems problem *and* a research problem. You will write performance\-critical code one week and design careful experiments the next. * **on the Data Platform Team:** + Build the platform that turns raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training\-ready datasets for frontier pretraining runs. + Own the pipelines, orchestration, and tooling that make pretraining data iteration fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible at scale. + Create clear signals for data quality, lineage, freshness, and pipeline health so researchers can trust what goes into each run. + Partner with initial training, crawling, data quality, and acquisition teams to turn new data ideas into measurable improvements in loss, evals, and model capability. * **on the Crawling Team:** + Build and scale the web crawling systems that discover, schedule, fetch, and parse high\-quality documents across the open web for initial training. + Improve URL seeding, scoring, and fair host scheduling so crawl capacity lands on the hosts and pages that matter most for model quality. + Raise crawl success and parsing quality — defeating antibot failures, improving extractors, and capturing content we previously could not get cleanly. + Debug and harden complex crawl infrastructure end\-to\-end for availability, recovery, and ingestion lag, and automate delivery of crawl datasets into the data pipeline. + Work independently (and alongside AI agents) and partner with Data Quality and Data Platform so new coverage shows up as better tokens in training runs. ### **You may be a fit if** * You have a strong infrastructure or data platform background, and ideally a spike of outlier depth somewhere (crawling/search infra is a plus, not a hard requirement) * You are a high\-slope engineer who has moved unusually fast — for example, staff\-level ownership within a few years — or you bring deep domain experience * You are able to architect and ship end\-to\-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents * You have strong intuitions about large\-scale distributed systems * You’re excited to learn how pre\-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs \#LI\-DNI

For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing.
