jobs.title: MMS/RPG Engineer
jobs.description: Specialization: IBM i / RPG I Location: Remote (US) CapNexus is an AWS consulting partner specializing in AI and cloud engineering. We build and deliver software through agentic engineering: we build and operate the systems that produce code, direct AI tooling to accelerate delivery, and exercise the judgment that keeps AI\-generated work correct. Everyone at CapNexus works fluently inside our delivery system, which combines agentic tooling, spec\-driven development, evidence\-based quality, and AI\-augmented delivery governance. **Who You Are and What You'll Do:** CapNexus is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own complex software outcomes: designing and building applications, APIs, and services, and raising the bar for the engineers around you. You'll work through our agentic delivery system, where AI tooling carries the mechanical load and you own the architecture, the correctness of what ships, and the growth of the people you mentor. We care more about how you think about building systems than which language you learned first. In this role, you'll focus on IBM i: building and supporting RPG applications, the DB2 for i data behind them, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the business. **Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain IBM i applications in free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, and CL, using ILE concepts such as procedures, service programs, and modules. * Work with DB2 for i through SQL and DDS, including physical and logical files and subfiles. Integrate IBM i applications with other systems through web services, JSON and XML, FTP, and the Integrated File System (IFS). * Support changes through testing, deployment, and post\-deployment, and resolve technical issues directly with client teams. * * Set coding and testing standards for IBM i work, and identify where modernizing an application pays off. * Own the technical outcome for a system area or major feature set: propose the approach, define the task breakdown, and deliver with minimal escalation. * Design APIs and data models that account for cost, scale, and failure, and build in observability (logging, tracing, and metrics) from the start. * Work with Cloud Engineers on infrastructure as code and CI/CD so what you build deploys the same way every time. * Partner with the Solutions Architect on solution design and with the Engagement Manager on delivery, and turn designs into a build plan the team can execute. * Set code\-quality standards for your area, and mentor Software Engineers I and II through pairing and reviews that teach, including how to direct AI tooling and check what it produces. * Join architecture presentations and technical deep\-dives alongside the Solutions Architect when the client needs your depth. **How You'll Work: Agentic Engineering:** You own outcomes on complex work, exercise architectural judgment, and raise the bar for those around you. * **Agentic tooling.** Set the tooling approach for a codebase or engagement: which work goes to a conversion engine, which is spec\-driven build, where the human\-in\-the\-loop gates belong, and how the toolchain is wired for the problem at hand. * **Spec validation and readiness.** Own the quality of the handoff from specification to build. Make sure specs are executable and actually satisfy the requirements, and hold delivered work to a defined readiness bar. When generated code is wrong, fix the spec, not just the output. * **Validating AI output.** Be the final judgment on correctness for high\-risk changes, including in unfamiliar domains, by designing the evidence that proves behavior is preserved. * **Delivery\-system ownership.** Design and maintain the project\-specific setup of our delivery tooling (steering, agent roles, templates, quality gates, and metrics) as durable capability, not one\-off scaffolding. **Judgment over correctness:** you can tell when confident, plausible\-looking AI output is quietly wrong. Tooling does the mechanical work; you're accountable for whether it's right. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * A strong grasp of architecture concepts: event\-driven and service\-based design, API design, data modeling, separation of concerns, and designing for change. * Experience owning a significant system from design through production, and mentoring the engineers who built it with you. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven or agentic development workflows, where specs drive code generation, for example Kiro, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, or Cursor with rules. Using AI only for autocomplete or snippets doesn't count. * A track record of catching what AI\-generated or refactored code gets quietly wrong, and of building the tests and gates that prove behavior is preserved. * Hands\-on experience programming on IBM i (AS/400, iSeries): free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, CL, and OS/400 commands. * Strong SQL skills on DB2 for i, plus working knowledge of DDS, subfiles, and older RPG (RPG III and fixed format). * Experience with IBM i Access Client Solutions or iSeries Navigator, the IFS, and JSON and XML. \| * Experience with Blue Yonder (JDA) MMS. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with AWS or application modernization, such as integrating IBM i applications with AWS services or moving IBM i workloads to modern platforms. * Experience with Java, including Java on IBM i or RPG\-to\-Java modernization. * Experience supporting IBM i in an enterprise data center. * Background in retail. **Our Culture:** Four keystones guide how we work: * **Customer obsessed, delivery focused.** We deliver what we promise. Trust \= consistency × time. * **Learning and sharing.** We hire lifetime learners, and teaching others matters as much as knowing. * **Growth and scalability.** We value cross\-functional skills over role boundaries, and simple solutions over clever ones. * **All work is strategic.** Every engagement, big or small, is a chance to earn trust that lasts. **We offer:** Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: Medical, dental, 401(k), and more CapNexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you. **No Agencies Please!**

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Perception and Controls
jobs.description: **Workplace Type:** Hybrid — Onsite 3–4 days per week across Santa Cruz and West Menlo Park, CA, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz **Reports To:** Robotics \& Controls Manager **About Capstan Medical** ------------------------- At Capstan Medical, we're building one of the most exciting and innovative companies in medtech: a first\-of\-its\-kind robotic platform for minimally invasive heart valve treatment. Our team combines surgical robotics, catheter\-based delivery, and next\-generation implants to turn complex procedures into safer, lower\-stress solutions for patients and clinicians. We're a collaborative, hands\-on team that moves fast, wears multiple hats, and believes the best ideas can come from anyone. Based in Santa Cruz, our workspace blends Bay Area innovation with a lifestyle near trails, beaches, and open space—a great place to do meaningful, career\-defining work. ### **About the Role** **Teach a heart valve robot to see where it is.** We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our robotics and controls team. You'll help our robot understand where its devices are inside the patient, using intraprocedural imaging such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography. That means building perception for image\-to\-robot registration and pose estimation, and taking it from research into a clinical system. This is not a model\-in\-a\-notebook role. Your work runs on a real\-time robotic system, informs what physicians see during the procedure, and ships under FDA design controls. You'll also help shape how we collect, organize, and learn from our robot and imaging data, and use it to improve our device models and controllers. You'll have a large say in how ML is done here, from the tools and standards we adopt to which problems we tackle first, and you'll be the person the rest of the team turns to for ML judgment. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop methods to register intraprocedural imaging, such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography, to the robot. * Estimate the pose of catheters and implants from medical images. * Combine image\-based estimates with robot kinematics and other sensing, and quantify the uncertainty of each estimate. * Build data pipelines that capture, align, label, and version imaging and robot data for training and evaluation. * Use simulation and synthetic data where real clinical data is limited. * Fit and improve models of device behavior from data, and work with controls engineers to turn them into better control. * Work with clinical engineers and physicians to learn what the images show, what matters in the procedure, and what accuracy is good enough. * Read the literature, prototype what looks promising, and tell us plainly what works on our data and what doesn't. * Deploy models on the robot and meet real\-time latency budgets. * Write the validation, test datasets, and design documentation that let learned components pass FDA design controls. ### **Skills** * **Real\-World Machine Learning:** You've taken models out of notebooks and into products that run on real data, with all its noise, drift, and edge cases. * **Computer Vision:** Strong background in classical and learned computer vision, especially pose estimation, segmentation, tracking, or 2D/3D registration. * **3D Geometry:** Solid grasp of rigid transforms, rotations, camera projection models, and calibration. * **Programming:** Strong Python and PyTorch skills. Comfortable reading and writing C\+\+. * **Data Engineering:** You build pipelines, datasets, and evaluation harnesses that others can trust and reuse. * **Research and Prototyping:** You keep up with recent papers, can tell which ideas will survive contact with our data, and enjoy turning them into working prototypes. * **Problem\-Solving:** Comfortable with high ambiguity. You can take a fuzzy goal, break it into experiments, and pick a direction without a spec. * **Communication:** Excellent communicator who can explain ML clearly to controls engineers, clinical engineers, and physicians, document work effectively, and help the team decide when a model is good enough to trust. ### **Requirements** * MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. PhD is a plus. * 4\+ years of professional experience in computer vision or machine learning, classical or learned, including at least one system shipped to production on real\-world data. * Experience working with scarce, noisy, or expensive data, using synthetic data, augmentation, self\-supervision, or physics priors to make up for it. * Experience building ML on data from physical systems such as robots, cameras, medical imaging, or sensors. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and own problems end\-to\-end. * Ability to work onsite 3–4 days per week, split flexibly between our Santa Cruz, CA and West Menlo Park, CA offices, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Ultrasound or echocardiography experience, strongly preferred. Fluoroscopy or X\-ray experience is also valuable, including 2D/3D registration or digitally reconstructed radiographs. * Experience tracking catheters, needles, surgical tools, or continuum robots in images. * Sensor fusion and state estimation, such as Kalman filters or factor graphs. * System identification or learned dynamics for control, including residual models on top of physics. * Robotics software experience with ROS/ROS2 and on\-device inference under latency constraints (ONNX, TensorRT). * Data platform and MLOps experience, including practices like dataset versioning and experiment tracking. * Medical device or safety\-critical background, including validating ML under FDA design controls. * Experience as an early ML engineer on a team, setting up the tools, data practices, and evaluation that others build on. * Publications at venues such as MICCAI, IPCAI, CVPR, ICRA, or IROS. ### **Why join us:** * We offer a fun, fast\-paced, collaborative environment where you will be working on transformational technologies in the cardiac healthcare space. * We offer outstanding benefits with medical, dental, and vision covered at 100% for you and your family, as well as flex time off. * We thrive in our work\-hard, play\-hard environment. Bring your bike or running shoes if you’d like or just be ready to enjoy a fun office outing. We enjoy time inside the office and out! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** CarGurus' Conversion team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II (Backend) to help dealers close more of the leads we send them. We turn shopper activity on our marketplace into a clear picture of who each buyer is and what they're looking for, then recommend the next move to the salesperson working that lead. Thousands of dealerships rely on it every day. You'll work in the Java and Spring Boot services behind all of this: enriching each lead as it arrives, consuming high\-volume event streams, and serving the APIs that power the dashboards dealers work in. It's a small team, so you'll take real ownership early. You'll partner closely with product, design, and other backend and frontend engineers to move projects from technical design through implementation and launch, and you'll see the result in dealer adoption and close rates. **What you'll do** * Design, build, and ship features in the Java and Spring Boot services that enrich every lead and power the insights dealers act on every day * Own your work from technical design through testing, code review, and production, with support from the team when you need it * Work with high\-volume event streams and the data behind them (Kafka, MongoDB, Redis) to keep shopper data fresh and APIs fast * Build intelligence features, including LLM\-backed ones, that recommend a dealer's next move rather than just handing them data * Diagnose and fix production issues across services, share in on\-call, and improve the alerting and observability we rely on * Partner with product and design to break ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable work, with a real say in what we build and how * Help raise the bar on how we test, deploy, and operate the services we own **What you'll bring** * 2\-4 years of hands\-on software development experience in a professional setting * Proficiency in Java, ideally with Spring Boot * Solid working knowledge of MongoDB or another NoSQL datastore, and comfort with SQL * Practical understanding of RESTful API design, microservices, and distributed systems, including event streams or message queues (Kafka, SQS, or similar) and caching trade\-offs * Hands\-on experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure * A strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis * A habit of writing automated tests, and a sense for which tests a change actually needs * Experience or interest in leveraging AI coding tools to accelerate development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) * Nice to have: Python, and hands\-on experience with LLM or agent frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph * Clear communication, curiosity, and a bias toward shipping, with genuine interest in learning the dealer domain **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- **About Citi:** Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **The Team:** ============= The **Startups \& Partnerships team** is the forward scout of the Citi's Head of AI Organization. Our mandate: identify, evaluate, and rapidly onboard the emerging technologies that will define Citi's next chapter with Artificial Intelligence as our number one strategic priority right now. We don't sit in a lab waiting for ideas to trickle in. We move across every line of business at Citi, sit down directly with business stakeholders and clients, and go toe\-to\-toe with the sharpest startups and frontier AI labs in the market. We run fast, we run lean, and we run with the full weight of a global institution behind us. **The Opportunity:** ==================== As an **AI Engineer** on the Startups \& Partnerships team, you will be at the **tip of the spear** for Citi's AI strategy \- building, testing, and shipping real applications that touch real business problems across the bank, not writing whitepapers about them from the sidelines. You'll get a level of exposure that's rare in a Tier\-1 global bank: direct access to business requirements, hands\-on evaluation of the newest models and platforms from the industry's leading AI labs, and the mandate to move at startup speed inside an institution operating at global scale. If you want to build things that matter, get them in front of real users fast, and shape how one of the world's largest financial institutions adopts AI \- this is the seat. **What You'll Do Day to Day** ============================= * **Build and ship AI applications** \- architect, develop, and deploy production\-grade AI\-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that solve real business problems across Citi's lines of business. * **Evaluate emerging AI technology** \- run structured proof\-of\-concepts and sandbox "bake\-offs" to rapidly assess new models, platforms, and startup tools (LLMs, agentic frameworks, orchestration layers) for real\-world fit. * **Prototype at speed** \- turn a business idea into a working demo in days, not quarters, and iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback. * **Integrate across the stack** \- connect LLMs and agentic systems to enterprise APIs, data pipelines, and lightweight front\-end or tooling layers to deliver end\-to\-end working solutions. * **Deliver PoCs into production pathways** \- work with governance, risk, and platform teams to shepherd validated solutions from prototype toward scaled deployment. * **Communicate impact** \- translate technical work into clear, compelling narratives for senior business and technology stakeholders. **Required Skills** =================== * A **full\-stack engineer with applied AI/LLM experience** \- this is explicitly **not** a data science or ML research role. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Semantic Layer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Ask three people at a construction company what a job costs to complete and you will get three answers. All of them are defensible. They come from different systems, different assumptions about what is committed versus spent, and different ideas about how far along the work really is. The semantic layer is where that gets settled. It is the set of governed definitions that say what a Clayco number means; built once, tested, documented, and used by every report, dashboard, and AI agent downstream. A metric here is not a query someone wrote. It is a decision about meaning that somebody owns. You will build that layer. The work is SQL and modeling discipline, done carefully, on data that matters to people who will notice if you get it wrong. **The Specifics of the Role** * Build semantic models on our Snowflake platform, with tests and documentation as part of finished work rather than cleanup afterward * Translate business logic from finance, operations, and project controls into models that hold up when someone audits them * Move legacy reporting logic onto governed models and help retire what it replaces * Keep models working as source systems change, so a field change upstream does not quietly break a number people trust * Answer the definitional questions that come back from the business, and write down the answers **Requirements** * **Real SQL.** Window functions, complex joins, and the judgment to know when a query is correct rather than merely returning rows. * **You care whether a number is right.** Enough to chase down a variance of a few hundred dollars because it means something is wrong with the logic, not because anyone asked you to. * **You ask until you understand.** The willingness to tell a finance director you do not follow the calculation yet, and keep asking until you do. * **You can be the person in the middle.** Telling two groups their reports disagree, explaining why, and helping them land on one answer. * We will hire someone early in their career for this if the fundamentals and the curiosity are there — you would have senior engineers around you to learn from. Dimensional modeling experience, dbt, or construction background are all welcome, none are required. **Some Things You Should Know** * Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required. * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! * This position is classified as a safety\-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing. **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description: The Atlanta Journal\-Constitution (AJC) is one of the most storied brands in journalism, with a legacy that stretches over a century. Our mission is to be the most essential and engaging source of news for the people of Atlanta, Georgia, and the South, and our vision is to transform this great institution into a modern media company. That's where you come in. The Atlanta Journal\-Constitution is seeking an experienced and dynamic hands\-on Sr. Manager, Data Engineering, Data Science and AI to lead our comprehensive data strategy and innovation initiatives. In this role, you will oversee the development, optimization, and maintenance of our consumer data ecosystem while building and mentoring high\-performing teams in data engineering, data science, and AI/ML. This role is pivotal in driving the next phase of our organization's growth, shaping the strategic direction of our data and analytics operations, and implementing best practices to ensure scalable, cutting\-edge data management and AI solutions. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in managing Snowflake environments, developing ETL processes, overseeing raw data loads, and advancing data warehousing capabilities. Additionally, you will lead the development of data science and AI/ML initiatives that drive business impact\-from predictive analytics and audience segmentation to recommendation engines and content optimization. This role will oversee the implementation and optimization of analytics tools, manage advanced analytics projects, and work cross\-functionally to translate data insights into actionable business strategies. **Please note, this role is based in Atlanta, GA.** **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Key Responsibilities** Data Engineering Leadership: * Oversee the configuration, optimization, and scalability of our Snowflake environment to ensure data integrity and accessibility. * Design and manage ETL pipelines for seamless data integration and transformation across platforms like Snowflake and AWS, using functions, stored procedures, and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect. * Leverage AWS tools, including EC2, Athena, and Kinesis, to optimize data ingestion, storage, and streaming pipelines. * Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate code deployment, testing, and quality assurance, ensuring efficient version control using tools like GitHub. * Design and optimize data transformation workflows using dbt to model, clean, and enrich datasets, ensuring high\-quality, maintainable, and testable data structures. * Lead the design and evolution of a robust data warehouse architecture to support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence needs. * Manage the ingestion of raw data from various sources, ensuring timely and accurate integration into Snowflake. * Integrate and optimize data pipelines from web analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Amplitude) into the data ecosystem. * Champion best practices in data governance, security, compliance, and quality management across all data operations. Data Science \& Advanced Analytics: * Oversee the design and execution of advanced statistical analyses, A/B testing frameworks, and causal inference studies to support data\-driven decision\-making. * Collaborate with Product and Editorial teams to identify high\-impact analytics opportunities and translate business questions into analytical solutions. * Build and maintain dashboards, reporting systems, and self\-service analytics tools that enable stakeholders to explore and understand key metrics. * Ensure proper instrumentation, event tracking, and data quality validation for analytical initiatives, working closely with Product to maintain data integrity. AI/ML Strategy \& Innovation: * Lead the exploration and implementation of generative AI and large language model (LLM) applications, including content analysis, personalization engines, and automated workflows. * Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and frameworks and assess their applicability to business needs. Team Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration: * Build, manage, and mentor a high\-performing team of data engineers, data scientists, and analytics professionals, fostering collaboration, professional growth, and accountability. * Partner with Product, Editorial, Engineering, and Business teams to understand data needs, define success metrics, and deliver scalable solutions aligned with organizational goals. * Advocate for data\-driven decision\-making throughout the organization and communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. **WHO YOU ARE** **Required Qualifications** * Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. **No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future.** * Applicants must currently live within a commutable distance to Atlanta GA and be comfortable commuting into the midtown office multiple times a week. * Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, or related field and at least 8\+ years of experience with 3\+ years in a management/leadership role; proficiency with data science libraries and frameworks (e.g., scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy). * Experience building and maintaining REST API's * Hands\-on experience with web analytics tools and integrating them into data ecosystems. jobs.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
jobs.description: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award\-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! Credit Acceptance makes vehicle ownership possible for consumers other lenders decline, through a dealer network, an originations and servicing platform, and pricing and decisioning models refined over decades. The technology estate underneath this business was built project by project over a long period, and modernizing it is the largest engineering opportunity at the company. As the Distinguished Engineer, you are the senior\-most individual contributor in Technology, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer. You will set the multi\-year technical strategy for the company while staying close enough to the code and systems to remain credible — this is not an architect role that reviews designs from a distance, nor a strong engineer role that goes deep in a single domain. Two things sit at the center of the job: the target architecture for the enterprise, and the architecture for running AI agents across it. You will not own a team; you will own the hardest technical problems the company has, and get them resolved by convincing the people who do own the teams. **Outcomes and Activities** * **Enterprise target architecture:** Convene the principal and staff engineers who own each domain to define the end\-state architecture across originations, servicing, marketplace, data, and AI, and use it to drive the multi\-year plan. Ensure every component has a defined interface with stated inputs and outputs, every unmade decision has a written principle standing in for it, and the document states honestly how close the organization is to the end state. Publish the architecture, including the tradeoffs that were rejected and why. * **Agentic AI architecture across the enterprise:** Own the enterprise agent architecture spanning servicing and collections, the dealer side, originations, and internal engineering and back\-office workflows, built on one common foundation rather than one stack per team. Establish a governed way for agents to discover and call business capabilities, data, and tools, using the Model Context Protocol as the integration layer. Define an identity and authorization model that treats an agent as a first\-class actor with its own least\-privilege entitlements, along with observability, evaluation, and cost controls that work consistently for every agent. Set policy on what an agent may decide independently versus what stays with a person, and define where that line moves and on what evidence. Design the architecture to produce an examiner\-ready record of what each agent saw, recommended, and touched, and set the evaluation and adversarial testing approach that makes agent outcomes defensible. Ensure the same foundation and controls apply to agents built by outside firms on the company's behalf. * **Migration off on\-premises infrastructure:** Own the technical strategy for migrating transactional and analytical workloads off on\-premises infrastructure to the company's strategic targets — AWS for transactional workloads and Databricks for analytical workloads — determining what lifts and shifts, what replatforms, what gets re\-architected on the way versus after, and what the steady\-state cost looks like. Own the resilience and recovery architecture for the target state. * **Data platform architecture:** Set the architecture for change\-data\-capture\-based ingestion, streaming where warranted, and a modern warehouse with no job\-scheduling dependency, moving the organization from largely batch analytical data movement to real time. Help settle the open question of who owns the transactional and analytical data models. * **Real\-time decisioning, model serving, and experimentation:** Architect for pricing and credit model and scorecard updates that drop in as a layer rather than requiring a multi\-quarter rebuild, and for an experimentation platform that supports orders of magnitude more concurrent experiments than a conventional release process allows. * **Marketplace and search architecture siness implications. * **Enterprise Problem\-Solving:** Ability to solve enterprise\-wide problems where no precedent exists and to own cross\-team shared infrastructure. * **Strategic Independence:** Ability to define and execute technical strategy for the entire organization, partner closely with executives, mobilize resources, and drive consensus across stakeholders at all levels. * **Visionary Leadership:** Bold strategic thinking paired with curiosity, ingenuity, and resourcefulness; recognized industry\-level thought leadership and a commitment to lifelong learning. * **Customer and Market Insight:** Company\-wide expertise in customer needs, using deep customer and market understanding to shape product and technical strategy and anticipate the impact of industry trends. * **Technical Writing:** Ability to produce architecture documentation clear and complete enough for others to act on independently. * **Executive Communication and Influence:** Ability to build consensus and influence direction across organizational and executive boundaries without formal authority. * **Talent Development:** Ability to raise the technical bar of engineers across the organization, including staff and principal engineers who are not direct reports. **Target Compensation:** A competitive base salary range from $232,500 \- $341,000\. This position is eligible for equity and annual cash bonuses. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role\-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications. Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego. INDENGLP \#zip \#LI\-Remote **Benefits** * Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work **Our Company Values:** To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: * Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions * Respectful by collaborating and actively listening * Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self\-awareness and making quality decisions * Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage * Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting **Expectations:** * Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines * All other duties as assigned * Attendance as required by department **Advice** ! We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! **P.S** . We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk! Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent. Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing a safe and inclusive working environment for all. As part of our Culture of Compliance, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value our culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of the person’s age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or any other legally protected characteristic. California Residents: Please click here for the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) notice regarding the personal information Credit Acceptance may collect from you.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer II, AI on Sensor – Mac, Linux, or Windows (Hybrid)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two\-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on\-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments. This is a **Sr. Software Development Engineer II** (SDE) role in the **CTIO** team that is bringing multiple AI\-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next\-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on\-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross\-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently. The **CTIO** team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends. **What You’ll Do:** * Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives. * Conceptualize and develop new product features. * Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross\-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux). * Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint. * Engage in cross\-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations. **What You’ll Need:** * Deep knowledge of C/C\+\+; jobs.description: **Job Title** Principal Machine Learning Engineer **Job Description Summary** We are seeking a Principal ML Engineer to build and maintain artificial intelligence and machine learning systems for our business. This role combines deep technical execution with broad influence: tackling the most complex machine learning problems, designing and implementing data architectures/models, MLOps and LLMOps, and monitoring and optimization as key software, while raising the bar for engineering excellence across the Data Organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Science \& AI, the Principal ML Engineer is expected to move fluidly across project/product teams — embedding in projects for days or months at a time to unblock, accelerate, and uplift delivery. They will mentor other engineers at every level, push standards for technical excellence, and help establish the ML engineering, and architectural principles that guide our work. The primary platform is Databricks and the Azure cloud ecosystem, with the expectation of evaluating and adopting additional data technologies as the platform evolves. **Job Description** **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a Principal ML Engineer to build and maintain artificial intelligence and machine learning systems for ourbusiness. This role combines deep technical execution with broad influence: tackling the most complex machine learning problems, designing and implementing data architectures/models, MLOps and LLMOps, and monitoring and optimization as key software, while raising the bar for engineering excellence across the Data Organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Science \& AI, the Principal ML Engineer is expected to move fluidly across project/product teams — embedding in projects for days or months at a time to unblock, accelerate, and uplift delivery. The primary platform is Databricks and the Azure cloud ecosystem, with the expectation of evaluating and adopting additional data technologies as the platform evolves. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **AI/ML Model Development** * Demonstrable experience shaping the end\-to\-end architecture, development, and deployment of AI, including machine learning, GenAI, and Agentic models that are tailored to business use cases. * Design and develop agentic AI systems — including multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-use, evaluation, and autonomous task\-execution pipelines — to automate complex enterprise workflows. * Enforce model development standards encompassing data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and documentation. * Partner with data engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and high\-quality data pipelines that support model training and inference. **AI Operations (MLOps / LLMOps)** * Implement the organization's MLOps and LLMOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines for data wrangling, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. * Help define and enforce standards for model versioning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and model registry management. * Implement robust model monitoring frameworks to detect performance degradation, data drift, concept drift, and bias in production systems, with automated alerting and retraining triggers. **AI Governance** * Implement AI governance frameworks, including policies for model risk management, fairness, explainability, privacy, and security. * Champion sound AI principles across the global business, ensuring that human oversight and accountability are embedded in every stage of the AI development lifecycle. **Essential Skills, Knowledge \& Experience** --------------------------------------------- * **10\+ years** building software or machine learning systems, including **6\+ years** shipping and operating machine learning in production — served, monitored, and maintained after launch. * Prior experience as the senior\-most or near\-senior\-most engineer on a production ML or data platform, with responsibility for architectural decisions others had to live with. * A track record of setting technical standards that outlasted your own involvement, and of leading through influence without formal authority. * Strong hands\-on **Python** and **SQL**, and the software engineering fundamentals that keep ML systems maintainable at scale — version control, automated testing, code review, modular design — plus the discipline to enforce them across teams. * Expert hands\-on proficiency with **Databricks** (Spark, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Delta Lake, Lakebase/Postgres, Unity Catalog, Model Serving) and the Azure data ecosystem. *Deep experience on a comparable lakehouse platform will be considered, with the expectation of becoming effective on Databricks quickly.* * Experience with **MLflow** or an equivalent for experiment tracking, model registry, tracing, and reproducibility. * **At least one year building agentic systems that reached production use, or equivalent demonstrated work.** You should be able to walk us through a system you built: how it was orchestrated, how you evaluated it, what guardrails you put around it, how it failed, and what standard you set for whoever built the next one. * Proven ability to mentor engineers at every level and materially raise the technical standard of the teams you work with. * Familiarity with modern machine learning frameworks and a strong instinct for reusable, scalable engineering patterns. **Preferred Skills, Knowledge \& Experience** --------------------------------------------- * Experience establishing an ML or AI platform capability in an organisation that did not previously have one. * Experience embedding across multiple teams, geographies and time zones as a principal\-level technical contributor. * Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling for data pipelines using Azure DevOps, Databricks Declarative Automation Bundles (DABs), GitHub Actions, Terraform, or equivalent. * Good understanding of data governance, metadata management, and cataloguing in enterprise environments. * Exposure to model serving and inference at scale — containers, REST endpoints, latency and throughput targets — or to feature stores, retrieval pipelines, or LLM cost\-attribution tooling. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool\-integration standards. * Commercial real estate, professional services, or another domain where the data is messy, entities are inconsistently defined, and subject matter experts are the source of truth. If you enjoy organized environments, supporting others through technology, and contributing to operational success, we’d love to hear from you. **A Day in the Life at Custom Alarm** The IT Systems Administrator keeps Custom Alarm’s technology reliable, secure, documented, cost\-effective, and aligned with business needs. jobs.title: Hardware Test and Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **About DigiStor** DigiStor develops secure data\-at\-rest storage solutions for enterprise, edge and sensitive computing environments. Our engineering teams bring together SSD technology, firmware and security to deliver storage that customers can depend on. **About the role** We are seeking a practical hardware engineer to validate DigiStor products in PCs, client systems, workstations and servers. You will build test configurations, investigate compatibility and connectivity issues, and produce clear reports that support product qualification and customer troubleshooting. The role focuses on hardware integration and system behavior. It suits someone who enjoys working at the bench and can isolate problems across platforms, storage devices, adapters, enclosures, drivers and cabling. This role is remote/hybrid but the person needs to be located in or near Austin, TX as the role will require travel to DigiStor testing locations. The role requires regular access to physical hardware; the ongoing work location and onsite expectations will be agreed during recruitment. **Key responsibilities** Create and execute hardware validation plans covering functionality, compatibility, connectivity, stability and regression testing. Assemble and configure PC, client, workstation and server test systems. Maintain controlled records of BIOS, drivers, operating systems and hardware. Validate storage devices, removable carriers, enclosures, host adapters and expansion cards across supported platforms and interface configurations. Test PCIe and storage connectivity, including NVMe, SATA, SAS, SCSI and USB where applicable. Check enumeration, negotiated link speed, width and error logs. Assess boot, reboot, sleep and resume, power cycling and hot\-plug behavior where supported. Check recovery and data integrity after state changes. Isolate failures through controlled changes to drives, slots, adapters, cables, firmware and host settings. Document repeatable reproduction steps. Use system diagnostics, storage workloads and bench equipment to investigate electrical, thermal, mechanical and integration issues with engineering colleagues. Produce reports with setup details, methods, pass or fail results and evidence. Track defects, verify fixes and maintain reusable compatibility matrices. **Required experience and capabilities** Hands\-on experience in hardware testing, system validation, integration testing or technical troubleshooting of PCs and client platforms. Confidence assembling and configuring systems, replacing components, updating BIOS and drivers, and checking that a configuration is suitable for the test. Working knowledge of PCIe and storage connectivity, including NVMe, SATA, SAS, SCSI and USB, with practical troubleshooting experience in several of these technologies. Understanding of how host controllers, expansion cards, bridges, backplanes, cabling and device firmware can affect compatibility and reliability. Ability to configure Windows and Linux test systems and use their diagnostic tools, device information and logs to investigate hardware behavior. Experience defining test cases and acceptance criteria, controlling variables, reproducing failures and generating clear, traceable technical reports. Good lab discipline, safe component handling and basic bench measurement skills. A relevant technical qualification or equivalent practical experience. **Additional experience we value** Experience with storage enclosures, removable drive systems, RAID or HBA configurations, and qualification on OEM PC or server platforms. Use of multimeters, oscilloscopes, protocol analyzers, thermal chambers or other hardware validation equipment. Bash, Python or PowerShell scripting for automated test execution and log collection; familiarity with fio, nvme\-cli or smartctl. Knowledge of SSD technology, self\-encrypting drives or secure storage products, and experience working with mechanical or electrical design teams. **What success looks like** Compatibility results are repeatable and linked to documented configurations. Failures are isolated with evidence, and fixes are verified across relevant platforms. Engineering and support teams can use the reports and test procedures to resolve issues and assess product readiness. *We are currently not accepting unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or staffing firms.* *DigiStor is committed to building an inclusive working environment. Employment decisions are based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications.*

jobs.description: **About Doss** ============== **DOSS is building an Operations Cloud for the real world.** ------------------------------------------------------------ A modern, AI\-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across: * Procurement * Inventory * Orders * Fulfillment * Finance **Built to replace spreadsheet chaos and rigid, consultant\-heavy ERPs.** Fast time\-to\-value, adaptable as the business evolves. DOSS is trusted by fast\-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence. About the role: Every ERP claims to be "AI\-powered." Almost none of them let an operator ask a question in plain language and get an answer grounded in their live procurement, inventory, and finance data, let alone let an agent safely take action on it. That's the goal of this job: you'll own applied AI across Doss: Dossbot (query, analyze, and automate via chat), AI\-assisted schema and workflow generation, and the agentic automations that turn back\-office busywork into background processes. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a seed\-stage AI company, backed by a top\-tier venture firm, building the ad layer for the AI era: interactive brand experiences embedded natively into apps and websites. Its ads are generated dynamically in real time and personalized to every single user, so every impression is hyper\-relevant. The recommendation stack is already live, serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users, with millions in annualized ad spend. Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads run in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor, and its ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native) is live in top App Store and Google Play apps. The team is small and based in San Francisco, with multiple prior exits and experience from leading tech and finance companies. ### **About the Role** The Applied AI Engineer owns the engine that makes real\-time, personalized ads possible: agents that generate playable mini\-games, short\-form video, and every variant in between on the fly, then learn from how they perform across millions of daily interactions and millions in annualized ad spend. This is a full\-stack applied AI role spanning model selection, agent orchestration, and production infrastructure, with direct business impact at every layer. The architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. The agents plug into a recommendation stack that is already serving ads in production, and every ad they create is served to real users and measured against real advertiser dollars. The stack runs on GCP, Redis, MongoDB, and Temporal. The role comes with ownership, equity, and a direct line to what ships. ### **What You'll Own** * **Playable generation agents:** Agents that turn an advertiser or app brief into a working, on\-brand HTML5 playable ad. * **Automated QA:** Checks that catch broken playable builds before a human does. * **Video generation pipelines:** Multimodal pipelines that produce short\-form video ads and variants across formats, hooks, and styles using frontier image and video models. * **Real\-time personalization loop:** Connect generation to the recommendation and ranking engine so each user gets creative made for them, read what wins (engagement, CTR, installs, ROAS), and feed it back so every impression gets more relevant. * **Agent infrastructure:** Orchestration, evals, and reliability so all of this runs in production at scale, not just in a demo. ### **What's Already Live** You inherit a working system with real traffic, not a blank slate: * A recommendation stack already serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users with millions of dollars in annualized ad spend * Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads running in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor * A proprietary ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native), live in top App Store and Google Play apps ### **Must\-Have** * Strong applied AI experience: has built and shipped an LLM, multimodal, or agentic system in production, beyond simple API wrappers. * Backend depth across infra, data, and serving end\-to\-end, not just the model layer (GCP, Redis, MongoDB, Temporal). * Comfort with ambiguity: the architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. * Bias toward shipping, suited to an early\-stage company that moves fast and figures things out. ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $250,000 USD per year, plus equity * **Visa Sponsorship:** Not available ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Equity * Ownership and a direct line to what ships ### **Interview Process** * Interview with the CTO * Take\-home assignment * Work trial * Offer

The full process can be completed in about one week.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Backend & Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is one of the world's largest AI entertainment platforms, backed by a top\-tier venture firm that led its Series A. Millions of people use it every day to create characters, worlds, stories, and relationships with AI, sending tens of millions of messages a day and spending well over an hour a day on the platform on average. The company trains its own models and runs its own inference, so far more of its stack is in\-house than at most companies its size. The team is very small and works in person in San Francisco. That combination means consumer\-scale traffic on infrastructure a very small team builds and operates itself, where each engineer's work reaches millions of users. ### **About the Role** This hire leads backend and infrastructure for the platform. They work directly with the CEO, who runs the backend today, alongside one growth engineer, one mobile engineer, and a few contractors. It is a full\-stack infrastructure role: keeping the platform up, making it faster and more resilient, and building the systems behind new features. Scale defines the work. Millions of daily users generate request volume closer to a large consumer company than a B2B SaaS business, and infrastructure problems often surface as product bugs: a slow page, a delayed job, a websocket that keeps reconnecting. The role suits an engineer who can trace an issue from the user experience down to the machine, fix the cause, and own technical decisions on a small team where those decisions stick. ### **What You'll Own** * The infrastructure behind new features, including recommendation systems, model fine\-tuning, and the inference pipeline * Production reliability: monitoring through Datadog and the logging stack, responding to incidents, and shipping fixes that address root causes * Performance and resilience across APIs, database queries, caching, background jobs, and real\-time connections * Continuous hardening of the existing stack, including bot mitigation * Architecture and capacity decisions as usage grows, and how the team deploys, monitors, and recovers ### **Must\-Have** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial work on backend systems or infrastructure * Has built and operated substantial backend systems in production, not only written code for them * Strong in TypeScript/Node.js and PostgreSQL * Generalist across the stack: can follow a problem across services and layers, including unfamiliar ones * Takes an unclear problem through to a production fix with little direction, and works well on a very small, high\-ownership team ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * NestJS, Redis, and Kubernetes * Distributed systems or GPU infrastructure experience ### **Key Details** * **Title:** Member of Technical Staff – Backend \& Infrastructure * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $300,000 USD per year * **Visa Sponsorship:** Available (H\-1B, O\-1\) ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Work on an AI interactive entertainment platform with millions of users * Small team with substantial ownership over technical decisions * Room to see work through from conception to production * Impact millions of users daily through performance improvements * Health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% of premiums covered * 401(k) match ### **Interview Process** * Phone screen (15–20 min) * Technical pairing (1–1\.5 hr) * On\-site technical (in person, SF office)

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a fast\-growing, Series A, AI\-native compliance software company serving financial institutions. Compliance is critical for banks, credit unions, and fintechs to get right, yet most of that work still runs manually in legacy tools or spreadsheets. The company replaces it with software that runs third\-party due diligence, screens marketing collateral, and keeps compliance teams current with a constantly changing regulatory landscape. The business has strong product\-market fit, with revenue growing more than 5x since its Series A and a customer base that includes well\-known, high\-growth fintech companies. Engineers join for the traction, the room for real agency and ownership, and a high caliber of talent on a small team. ### **About the Role** We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to build the core product experiences customers use every day. Risk and compliance teams run complex, highly structured workflows involving large volumes of data, documents, approvals, and collaboration. This engineer figures out how to make those workflows fast and intuitive, then builds the frontend and backend systems behind them, including AI\-powered features that automate work that has historically been manual. Engineers here own products end\-to\-end, from understanding the customer problem through technical design, shipping, and operating in production. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the CTO, on a small engineering team. The role suits an engineer who cares about how information is structured, how users move through a workflow, and how technical design enables a great experience. ### **What You'll Own** * Building and shipping new product features end\-to\-end across the frontend and backend * Major features from technical design through launch, in close partnership with other engineers and Customer Success * Intuitive user experiences for complex, data\-dense risk and compliance workflows * AI\-powered features that automate historically manual compliance work * Performance, reliability, and architecture of the application as the company scales, informed by direct work with customers ### **Requirements** **Must\-Have** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience building production web applications * Strong experience building modern, interactive frontend applications and the backend systems that support them * Excellent product and UX judgment, particularly for complex or data\-dense applications * Strong understanding of frontend architecture, application state, APIs, data modeling, and relational databases * Ability to take a product problem from initial concept through technical design, implementation, and production * High attention to detail and a strong bar for the quality, performance, and usability of what you ship **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience building AI\-powered product features * Experience working directly with customers to shape product direction ### **Key Details** * **Location:** New York City, NY (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 3\+ years * **Salary:** $180,000 – $250,000 USD per year * **Equity:** 0\.5% – 1% * **Visa Sponsorship:** Available (H\-1B, O\-1, OPT) ### **Benefits \& Perks** * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents * Lunch provided in office * Paid time off and paid company holidays * Meaningful equity (0\.5% – 1%) * Visa sponsorship for all visa types ### **Interview Process** * Intro call * Coding interview (optional) * Conversation with a Co\-Founder * Work trial * Offer

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in software development using Python and C\+\+. * Experience with machine learning (ML) hardware accelerators, ML compiler stacks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, XLA), and kernel development. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 2 years of experience with full\-stack system development for hardware accelerators. * 2 years of experience with collaborative, hyper\-scalar software development and engineering best practices. * Experience scoping, planning, and executing projects towards team goals in ambiguous environments. **About the job** ----------------- We are building a next\-generation compute platform for AI inference workloads, with an emphasis on memory technologies, Hardware (HW) acceleration, and Software (SW)/HW codesign. We are looking for enthusiastic engineers to join the project. This is a coding role for engineers who like to take initiative and get things done, with a focus on ML compiler stack and inference infrastructure. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Role Description:** ===================== Being a Product Manager at Defense Unicorns is more than just being part of the sparkliest Product team in defense tech. It means taking radical ownership over real products that make a real impact on real people. At Defense Unicorns, our mission is to make software a strategic deterrent, and our Product Management team clears the path. In this role, you'll report to the Director of Product and work with teams who deliver outcomes that are critical business enablers and directly support both our missions and other internal teams. This team's primary responsibility is the creation and maintenance of tooling and pipelines that support UDS application packaging, as well as maintenance of several packages which comprise our core software deliverables. **Responsibilities:** ===================== **The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.** * Passion for the intersection of business, open\-source software, and national security * Participate in and foster open source communities around Defense Unicorns' open source projects * Comfortable owning a product vision end\-to\-end and being accountable for delivering to several customer segments, including both paid and OSS * Managing the expectations and delivery of outcomes of unicorns engineers entrusted to you * Establishing and clearly communicating vision and objectives at all levels of the company \- from engineers to executives * Continuously balance customer, business, and technical priorities with limited resources * Synthesizing external customer requests into an internal product roadmap * Discipline required to work in a fast\-paced, remote environment * Keep our Growth and Delivery teams aligned on roadmap and value proposition in order to support product pricing, customer segmentation, and customer needs * Experience managing, updating and using task, information and code management tools like GitHub, Notion, Hubspot, Google Workspace, etc. * Continuous learning is a must. Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and best practices in Product Management, DevOps, regulated IT, and the CNCF community * Experience working with and continuously delivering software under Agile software development principles * Understand business strategy and adapt product strategy and roadmap to accomplish company objectives * Comfortable presenting information in customer facing engagements * Comfortable having technical conversations which engineering and design to trade off roadmap versus engineering effort needed **Preferred Experience and Qualifications:** ============================================ * A deep understanding of how DevSecOps pipelines operate and the tools which make them work * An understanding of core Kubernetes concepts, specifically images, Helm charts, and related technologies. * Excellent analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and metrics for informed decision\-making * Experience establishing a clear product roadmap and value proposition to prospective customers * Knowledge of and experience with monetization models for open source software ### **Who We Are** Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission\-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market. ### **What We Do** We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud\-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily. ### **Who We Serve** Defense Unicorns' customers are mission\-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading\-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission\-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products. ### **What We Work On** * Kubernetes * Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure) * Infrastructure\-as\-code (like Terraform/Pulumi) * Continuous Delivery and automation tooling * GitOps * Containers * CNCF projects and open source products and packages * Helm/Kustomize\-Value Stream Mapping * Building and improving security delivery * Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications ### **Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy** #### **Health:** * Medical/Dental/Vision * Premiums are 100% Company Paid * Health Savings Account * Life Insurance * Disability Insurance #### **Financial:** * 401k Retirement Plan * Company Stock Options * Home Office Budget #### **Leave:** * We offer all full\-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year's * Paid Parental Leave #### **Learning:** * Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions * Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees) *Don't have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.* *At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.* **CCPA DISCLOSURE**
