Recruiting for this role ends on May 31, 2027\. **What You'll Do** As a Deloitte Tax Consultant II, Software Back End Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of custom applications and modules that address business requirements. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building scalable backend services, learning Deloitte development standards, and collaborating effectively within agile delivery teams. Responsibilities: * Participate in requirements analysis and technical discussions. * Collaborate with US colleagues and vendor teams to support software design and architecture. * Write clean, scalable code using .NET programming languages. * Test and deploy applications and systems with guidance from senior team members. * Revise, update, refactor, and debug code. * Develop, support, and maintain applications and technology solutions. * Help ensure development efforts meet requirements for scope, functionality, quality, and timeliness. * Build familiarity with development tools, testing tools, methodologies, and processes. * Build familiarity with project management methodology and agile delivery processes. * Work collaboratively with onshore and offshore team members. * Demonstrate a working understanding of software development standards and version control practices. * Help maintain the quality of code released into production and support low bug rates. * Work on agile projects, participate in daily SCRUM calls, and provide task updates. * Working with infra team for deployment activities and any other infra support. * Analyze and respond to any Prod issues reported. **The Team** Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value\-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation. **Qualifications** Required: * Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co\-locate in person 2 \- 3 days per week * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a relevant discipline * 1\+ years of experience in software development, backend engineering, or application support with hands\-on experience or academic/project experience in C\#, SQL Server, OOPS concepts, and microservices architecture * Proven exposure to .NET Core, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL, NoSQL, Entity Framework 6 or above, Azure, and agile ways of working * Demonstrated knowledge of basic knowledge of object\-oriented programming concepts. * Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * One of the following active accreditations obtained, in process, or willing and able to obtain: * + Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA + If not CPA eligible: + - Licensed Attorney - Enrolled Agent - Technology Certifications: - * AWS Certified Solutions Architect * Certified Scrum Developer (CSD) * Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP) * ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) * Microsoft Azure Preferred: * Knowledge on Angular, Mongo DB, NPM and Azure Devops Build/Release configuration. * Self\-starter with solid analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Skill for writing reusable libraries. * Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills. * Strong troubleshooting skills and attention to detail. * Willingness to learn engineering best practices, design patterns, and database performance optimization. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $78,675 to $160,750\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Hiring our Heroes Fellowship (12-week Remote Program) - AI & Engineering
jobs.description: **Hiring Our Heroes Fellowship \- AI \& Engineering (Remote Fellowship)** Are you interested in maximizing your military professional experience while learning how to transfer your skills to the corporate world? As a Hiring Our Heroes AI \& Engineering Fellow at Deloitte, you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in our AI \& Engineering practice, gaining exposure to the work of industry leaders as they address complex challenges for clients. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree * Active Duty members in the US Armed Forces with authorization to participate in a DoD SkillBridge program by their respective command * Enrolled in Hiring Our Heroes foundation and eligible to participate in the fellowship program * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * 2\+ years of experience in application development or software development * Exposure to artificial intelligence through academic coursework, certifications, internships, or professional experience. * This Fellowship is a remote opportunity and available to eligible candidates located across the United States. \#DeloitteHoH

jobs.title: Data Protection and Management Engineer
jobs.description: Dentons US LLP is currently recruiting for a Data Protection and Management Engineer. This role will be responsible to build and operate the technical controls that keep the Firm's client and matter data confidential, correctly classified, and retained only as long as it should be. This is a hands\-on engineering role centered on data protection and management technologies. Data Protection and Management Engineer will own day\-to\-day operation of data security posture management, data loss prevention, insider risk management, and sensitivity labeling, and will support Records and Information Governance in applying retention and disposition across the same estate. You will work alongside document management system administrators on security policy management, ethical walls, and access controls, and partner with infrastructure, practice support, Risk, and the Office of General Counsel to protect confidential material without slowing the practice of law. **Responsibilities** * **Data Posture and Discovery \-** Operate the Firm's DSPM platform. Onboard and maintain data sources across Microsoft 365, the document management system, file shares, and cloud infrastructure; tune discovery and classification accuracy; and report on sensitive data location, exposure, and entitlement sprawl. * **Remediation of Data Exposure.** Partner with infrastructure, application, and practice support teams to remediate overshared repositories, excessive permissions, orphaned accounts, and unmanaged data stores identified through DSPM. Track remediation to closure and measure the reduction in data exposure over time. * **Data Loss Prevention \-** Author, test, and tune policies across email, endpoint, cloud applications, browser, and removable media; manage exception and business\-justification workflows; triage and investigate alerts; and reduce false positives while maintaining coverage of every egress channel. * **Retention and Disposition \-** Partner with Records and Information Governance to implement the Firm's retention schedule. Configure retention labels and policies, support disposition review and defensible destruction, and ensure legal holds correctly suspend retention where required. * **Data Minimization \-** Reduce redundant, obsolete, and trivial content as a protection control as much as a storage one. Identify aging and duplicate data, support decommissioning of legacy repositories, and report on volume under management and storage reclaimed. * **Document Management System Controls \-** Support DMS administrators in the operation of security policy management, ethical walls, and access management. Assist with need\-to\-know security models, matter\-level provisioning, access request workflows, periodic access reviews and recertification, and evidence for client audits and outside counsel guidelines. * **Insider Risk and Rights Management \-** Operate Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management, Information Protection, and Information Rights Management. Build and tune policies for departing timekeepers, lateral hires, and data staging and exfiltration, working within agreed privacy, escalation, and legal review protocols. * **Adoption of AI and New Technology \-** Apply data protection controls to generative AI and collaboration tools. Assess oversharing and content\-hygiene risk before rollout, define guardrails for prompt and output handling, and evaluate emerging tooling. * **Automation and Continuous Improvement.** Reduce manual effort through scripting and automation across policy deployment, label and retention operations, alert enrichment, evidence collection, and reporting. Identify opportunities to apply AI to classification, investigation, and triage workflows. * Occasional off\-hours work to support maintenance windows, participation in an on\-call rotation for data protection escalations, and limited travel to Firm offices may be required. **Experience \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 4\+ years of experience in data protection, information security, or a closely related infrastructure discipline, including at least 2 years of hands\-on work with data loss prevention, data classification, or insider risk tooling. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection and sensitivity labels, Insider Risk Management, Audit, and Communication Compliance. * Working knowledge of at least one DSPM or data access governance platform, such as Microsoft, Varonis, Cyera, BigID, or Netwrix, and familiarity with third\-party DLP and email security gateways. * Working familiarity with retention schedules, retention labeling, and defensible disposition, including how legal holds interact with retention. * Strong written communication and the ability to explain data protection risk to attorneys, business stakeholders, and firm leadership. * Experience in a law firm, professional services, or another environment with strict client confidentiality obligations. * Familiarity with legal document management systems and their security models, such as iManage Work with Security Policy Manager and Threat Manager, or NetDocuments. * Hands\-on experience with Purview Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management, or eDiscovery. * Certifications such as Microsoft SC\-401 (Information Security Administrator, formerly SC\-400\), SC\-200, CISSP, CIPT, IGP, or vendor\-specific data protection certifications. **Salary** Pursuant with states' laws, the salary range for this position is $120,000 \- $145,000, based on experience and local market. Dentons US LLP offers a competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, profit sharing, short\-term/long\-term disability, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays and discretionary bonuses. *Dentons US LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Disability/Vet. Pursuant to local ordinances, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* *If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity at Dentons US, LLP, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please call our Talent Acquisition Lead at \+1 314 259 5898 or contact us at dentonsusstaffrecruitment@dentons.com.* **About Dentons** ----------------- Redefining possibilities. Together, everywhere. For more information visit www.dentons.com

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast\-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. **We want people who are passionate about enabling the teams they work with to effectively and efficiently deliver value in line with the DO vision.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ As a Technical Program Manager on the Agentic AI team, you will drive value delivery for a set of technical programs that bring our AI\-powered products and platform capabilities to life — spanning agentic systems, LLM\-powered features, AI infrastructure, and the developer tooling that enables builders to ship intelligent applications. This individual will be an experienced cross\-functional leader who champions continuous improvement and thrives in a fast\-paced environment, applying technical literacy along with program management experience to navigate delivering on commitments as a leader on their team. In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, and AI research leaders to drive the delivery of valuable, often complex, technical programs that advance our Agentic AI Cloud and meet our customers' rapidly evolving AI needs. You will be the connective tissue across model teams, platform engineering, developer experience, and outside partners — embodying servant leadership to ensure efficient, effective value delivery. You will be a proactive collaborator while driving consensus where needed and influencing decisions when teams are stuck. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Drive value delivery for major Agentic AI programs — spanning model integrations, agentic framework development, AI platform capabilities, and developer tooling — including prioritization, planning, risk management, execution, and measurement of success * Partner with Product, Engineering, and AI research leaders, including senior leaders, throughout the life of the program on value delivery and process/practice improvements * Act as the central hub of communication, keeping model teams, platform engineers, developer experience teams, and external AI partners aligned to keep programs on track * Coordinate the steps from early capability planning and prototyping through production deployment, partnering with model providers, inference infrastructure teams, and internal platform teams * Drive decision\-making across multiple teams, orgs, and stakeholders spanning multiple locations, including with senior leaders * Proactively manage changes in scope and priority shifts; recognize risk early — whether a model capability gap, a latency constraint, or a shifting API dependency — and form mitigation plans as required * Build repeatable, scalable processes — and the visibility and operational infrastructure behind them — that get AI capabilities to market faster, improve reliability, and ensure effective, sustainable operations across teams and orgs * Evangelize technical project \& program management best practices within their team and across partner teams and orgs **What You'll Add to DigitalOcean** ----------------------------------- * 10\+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager delivering cross\-functional programs in a fast\-paced environment, with a preference for experience in AI/ML, platform engineering, or developer tooling * Proven track record planning and delivering complex programs, leading the resolution of blocking issues, and driving effective change management * Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — model training vs. inference, agentic architectures, LLM APIs, and the emerging landscape of AI developer tooling — and how these translate into real product and platform decisions * Hands\-on familiarity with agentic AI concepts, including multi\-step reasoning, tool use, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and the orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar) builders use to create intelligent applications * Experience coordinating external model providers, API partners, and open\-source communities to deliver AI\-powered product capabilities * Strong risk management skills, with a proven ability to spot risks early — a model capability gap, an inference latency constraint, or a shifting vendor dependency — and build plans to keep programs moving * Ability to influence and work through others where direct reporting relationships do not exist, acting as a reliable bridge between deeply technical AI teams and product and operational teams * Ability to distill complex or technical concepts — including nuanced AI/ML tradeoffs — into clear, structured communications and action plans * Ability to balance a detail\- and process\-oriented mindset with a focus on outcomes * Experience with project management tooling (e.g., the Atlassian suite — Jira and Confluence) for managing the flow of value and delivering curated information to appropriate stakeholders * Embraces AI as a force multiplier — actively using AI tools and agentic workflows to work faster and smarter, with a continuous eye for where AI can improve how programs get delivered and how the team operates * A growth mindset that prioritizes learning and improvement for yourself and the teams you work with **Compensation Range:** ----------------------- * $148,800 \- $186,000 * This is a hybrid role JR: 2026\-8073 *\#LI\-Hybrid* **Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean** -------------------------------------------- * **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting\-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions. * **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high\-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000\+ courses to support their continued growth and development. * **We care about your well\-being.** Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences. * **We reward our employees.** The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program. * **DigitalOcean is an equal\-opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. **Application Limit:** You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180\-day period. This policy promotes better role\-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ Docusign is seeking an experienced full\-stack software engineer to expand on its anti\-abuse strategies for protecting our customers and infrastructure against attack. The ideal candidate will have experience working on high\-scale distributed systems in a service\-oriented architecture. The team is part of the Docusign Platform organization and will build technology to help identify and block suspicious behaviors around our applications and services. Our team is looking for a talented individual with a passion for customer and infrastructure security. You will be helping define the vision and approach to fighting bots, spam, fraud and denial of service threats that are always changing. This position will demand critical thinking skills and a desire to analyze the patterns of abusers and turn that analysis into systems, including machine learning models, that can evaluate risks in real\-time. Your background will show that it involves strategy, delivery, and implementation in past roles and academic settings. Docusign is a global company, so a successful candidate will have the ability to work across different teams and geographies. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Engineering. **Responsibility** * Architect, implement and maintain some of Docusign's highest scale services * Build APIs to power the next generation of Docusign's customer multi\-screen experiences that are responsive, highly performant and Al driven * Drive developer efficiencies through engineering best practices, automation, and CI/CD * Work with world class telemetry systems to work through complex problems and solve them with data * Think through how systems will scale and fail as they grow * Take complicated problems and break them down into bite sized pieces, then ship every few weeks to get there * Work throughout the stack, from network protocols to database performance and back **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 5\+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree or 3\+ years of experience with a Master's degree * Experience with backend languages (C\#, Go, Java, Node.js) and frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript) * Experience querying and modifying data in relational databases * Experience consuming SOAP and RESTful web service APIs * Professional experience leveraging Al\-assisted development tools (for example, Al code\-completion, Al code\-generation, or Al\-powered refactoring) as part of the software delivery lifecycle **Preferred** * Experience debugging high\-priority production issues * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Node.js development experience * Experience using Al\-assisted tooling to triage issues, analyze logs, and propose remediation steps for complex integration problems * Experience contributing to team guidelines or enablement around safe and effective Al usage in engineering workflows **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $140,100\.00 \- $206,775\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Documo is on a mission to help businesses digitize and streamline their document workflows. As a fast\-growing B2B SaaS company, our platform makes it easier to handle unstructured files like faxes and forms through tools like Intelligent Document Processing \- turning messy paperwork into structured, usable data. We believe great products start with great people. That's why we invest in top talent, value strong culture, and prioritize customer success and design excellence. If you're excited to do impactful work and want to grow with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and purpose \- we'd love to meet you! **Job title** Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote) **Team** Engineering **Department function** The Engineering Department is crucial in designing, developing, and maintaining our company's software products. Our department manages critical areas such as development, infrastructure, operations, quality assurance, and product management, collaborating to provide reliable, secure, and scalable technology solutions. Our primary objective is to build and sustain software products that satisfy customer needs and align with our long\-term business strategy. The department is instrumental in researching and integrating new technologies to enhance our internal products and operations. We are also responsible for ensuring our products meet the company's IT, information security, and compliance program requirements. **Department Responsibilities** * Providing the strategic technical direction for the business * Architecting, developing, and maintaining Documo's software product catalog in collaboration with the Product Team, internal stakeholders, and customers * Ensuring technology solutions meet high standards for reliability, security, and scalability * Maintaining technical documentation and procedures to ensure the effective development, maintenance, and support of software products * Researching and implementing new technologies that improve internal operations * Implementing requirements to satisfy information technology, information security, and compliance programs * Providing escalated technical support to customers and internal stakeholders as needed **Reports to** Engineering Manager, DevOps **Direct reports** None **Key Relationships** **Internal:** Applied AI, Customer Success, Development, Information Security, Product Management, Quality Assurance, System Architects **External:** Cloud and tooling vendors, compliance auditors, and customer technical stakeholders as needed for escalations and integrations **Role Purpose** The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and operates the cloud platform that runs Documo's document processing and fax products, including the infrastructure behind our AI and machine learning services. You will own how code gets from a pull request to production, how production stays healthy, and how the platform scales securely as our product catalog and AI workloads grow. You will bring 6\+ years of DevOps, site reliability, or platform engineering experience, use AI tools in your daily work, treat infrastructure as a product, and act as a technical lead who mentors other engineers. This role can be up to 10% customer\-facing, mainly escalations, connectivity and integration discussions, and security reviews. **Why join Documo?** * Competitive U.S. benefits: medical, dental, vision, and a 401(k) with a strong match. * Annual bonus program based on role and company performance. * Annual performance reviews with merit increases. * In\-person company kick\-off to connect, collaborate, and celebrate. * Equity opportunities to grow with us. * Flexible remote work that fits your life, plus flexible paid time off. * Competitive paid parental leave, mental health support, and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP). * Be part of a small, fast\-growing tech company with a supportive, inclusive, and fun culture. **We celebrate differences.** Documo welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, especially those underrepresented in tech. We do not discriminate based on ancestry, race, place of origin, political belief, religion, marital or family status, physical or mental ability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. Documo is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, New Verticals Agentic Foundations
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ Agentic Foundations, part of New Verticals ML, builds the core AI/ML intelligence that powers high\-quality, scalable agents at DoorDash, and proves it through flagship agent experiences such as the Ask grocery assistant. We operate as a closed loop: new models, evals, and representations make our agents better, and real\-world agent usage surfaces the gaps that drive our next foundations work. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join Agentic Foundations with a primary focus on Vertical Agent Development. You will own the continuous improvement of our flagship agents, starting with the Ask Assistant, using an eval\-driven loop to make them faster, more cost\-efficient, and more reliable for millions of customers. You will also help us bring this approach to new agentic experiences for Merchants and Dashers, turning promising ideas into production\-ready agents. This is a chance to work at the intersection of LLMs, agents, post\-training, and evals on problems that ship. You will partner closely with engineers working on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training of small language models (SLMs), so that what we learn from production agents feeds directly back into our foundations, and what we build there makes our agents better. You will report into the engineering lead on our New Verticals AI/ML team. We expect this role to be hybrid with some time in\-office and some time remote. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Raise the quality of our Consumer agents:** build and refine our eval harness\-optimization loop to pinpoint failure modes, then iterate on prompts, tools, skills, and context, and measure the impact on real customer tasks. * **Find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost:** run rigorous experiments, including fine\-tuning open\-weights models and deploying small language models (SLMs) where they can replace or augment larger LLMs. * **Launch new agents:** take agentic opportunities for Merchants and Dashers from early exploration to production. * **Turn foundations into product impact:** work with teammates on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training SLMs for steerable generative recommendation, and bring those capabilities into production agents. * **Shape the roadmap:** partner with engineering, product, and business leaders to define an ML\-driven strategy for our fast\-growing grocery and retail delivery business. **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * 3\+ years of industry ML experience, including hands\-on work building and shipping LLM\-based agents (tool use, context management, prompting, guardrails) and improving them with evals and data * Experience with post\-training or fine\-tuning of open\-weights models (e.g., SFT, preference optimization, or RL), ideally including small language models, and sound judgment on quality, latency, and cost trade\-offs * Strong foundation in NLP and machine learning, with proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow * M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience, plus a collaborative, growth\-minded approach and a drive for measurable impact **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning, you'll be conceptualizing, designing, implementing, and validating algorithmic improvements to the catalog system and our product knowledge graph at the heart of our fast\-growing grocery and retail delivery business. You will use our robust data and machine learning infrastructure to implement new ML solutions to make our product knowledge graph accurate, standardized, semantically rich, easily discoverable, and extensible. We're looking for someone with a command of production\-level machine learning and experience with solving end\-user problems who enjoys collaborating with multi\-disciplinary teams. We expect Senior Engineers to be able to own projects end\-to\-end and mentor their junior and mid level peers. This role is hybrid with some in\-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will...** ------------------------------------------------------------- * Develop advanced machine learning models to improve core parts of your teams scope. * Be responsible for the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle, including ideation, offline model training, online shadowing/deployment, experimentation, and post\-launch monitoring/measurement. * Work on creating novel ML \& AI solutions that push both our business and the industry forward. * Scale our systems and services to fuel the growth of our business. * Completely disrupt logistics by tackling bleeding\-edge, technical problems **We're excited about you because you have...** ----------------------------------------------- * M.S., or PhD. in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics or equivalent. * 5\+ years ML industry experience with a solid understanding of machine learning algorithms and fundamentals. * Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software * Experience building data/feature engineering pipelines at scale using Pyspark and Snowflake SQL. * Experience with building machine learning systems in production by using frameworks such as PyTorch, Keras, lightgbm, scikit\-learn, Spark ML, or related. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. jobs.description: **Company Mission** Duo Health is a new type of medical group designed around the needs of patients with chronic kidney disease and their physicians. Our unique Health Mobilization™ platform partners multidisciplinary care teams with community nephrologists and activates all the other clinicians, facilities and community organizations necessary to treat the whole patient on their own terms. Our team is comprised of leaders in value\-based health care, technology and behavioral science who share a vision for advancing health equity one relationship at a time. Our interprofessional care teams, which include physicians, nurses, social workers, and patient navigators, provide high\-touch and comprehensive care to a small panel of patients. Team collaboration is essential to our intensive, psycho\-social model of care which includes assessment, medication management, social management, and behavioral health management. **Why Join Us** This is a unique opportunity to help build the next generation of a rapidly growing healthcare technology platform. Beyond writing code, you'll help shape our engineering culture, influence architectural decisions, mentor teammates, and build systems that directly improve patient outcomes. We're investing heavily in cloud\-native technologies, platform engineering, automation, and Artificial Intelligence. We believe AI is a force multiplier for great engineers, enabling our teams to build better software faster. Our engineers are encouraged to leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and identify innovative ways AI can enhance both our products and our internal operations. If you're excited by complex technical challenges, modern software architecture, distributed systems, and helping define the future of healthcare technology, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant and lasting impact. **What You'll Do****Our engineers own what they build.** You'll be responsible for the complete lifecycle of your services—from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, optimization, and long\-term support. jobs.title: Principal Solutions Engineer - Data Center Power
jobs.description: *Full\-time, onsite \| Houston, Texas \| Travel to customer sites, partners and our Swiss HQ* **About EH Group** ------------------ EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform that provides onsite power solutions to data centers, defense and industry, and mobile power solutions to the aviation and maritime sectors. We offer fuel\-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems running on natural gas, biogas or hydrogen, with options for integrated carbon capture and heat recovery. Following a recently announced major investment round, EHG is expanding from its founding in Switzerland into the US, fueled by a GW\-scale, late\-stage pipeline of US data center customers. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to be our technical and site design expert in front of data center customers and partners. Three things sit in the job: site planning, technical design and technical proposal writing. Near enough every data center developer we meet wants what we have. What they want from us is a proposal, a technical design their engineers can put through diligence, and proof that the project is bankable. Nobody owns producing those today. That is the seat we are creating, and you will build the system that makes it repeatable. These deals are multi\-party and deeply technical: the customer, their EPC, the gas supplier, their financing partners and sometimes the utility. Our scope has to integrate into the customer's whole site plan. You will be the person who makes that fit, on paper and in the room. This is the first hire in a function we expect to grow. You will set the templates, the design standards and the proposal library that everyone after you uses, and you will help us work out how the function should scale. The role is based in Houston, Texas, alongside our US operations hub and manufacturing site, with travel to customer sites, to partners and to our Swiss HQ. **What you will own** --------------------- **Site planning** * Work with the customer and their EPC on where our systems go: layout, footprint, clearances, electrical and gas interconnection points, hydrogen and reformer siting, and constructability. * Integrate our scope into the customer's overall site plan alongside the other parties on the project. * Surface the site\-specific constraints that change the design or the price early, before they become a late surprise in diligence. * Build reference layouts for common data center configurations so every new opportunity starts from a template. **Technical design** * Supervise and own the CAD models and technical drawings for each opportunity: system arrangement, reformer integration, balance of plant and interfaces. * Map the customer's technical specifications onto our technology and our reformers, and produce the compliance view: what we meet, what we meet differently, and what needs a deviation. * Size and configure systems against the customer's load profile, redundancy requirements and availability targets. * Own the technical interfaces: electrical tie\-in, cooling and heat recovery, controls and monitoring, and the gas and hydrogen side alongside our VP of Fuel. * Bring customer requirements and recurring design constraints back into our product roadmap with our engineering team in Switzerland. **Technical proposal writing** * Write the technical proposals. This is a named part of the job: clear, well\-structured technical writing that a customer's engineering team, their EPC and their financing partners can all read. * Own responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical questionnaires, and the technical sections of term sheets and contracts. * Carry the customer's technical due diligence: assemble the package, answer the questions, manage the follow\-ups. * Build the proposal library and content system so the second proposal is faster than the first. * Supply the technical inputs behind customer financial models: performance assumptions, capex and opex build\-up, availability and degradation. These deals are unusually finance\-heavy, and the customer's CFO is often our primary stakeholder. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- *Illustrative milestones, to be confirmed together.* * Proposal and design production has a clear owner: you. * A working system in place: templates, reference layouts, a technical content library, and a compliance matrix approach that shortens every cycle. * Named contribution to deals moving from qualified pipeline to signed order, with a measurable drop in time from customer request to delivered proposal. * You are running technical due diligence sessions with customers on your own. * A clear view on how this function scales, including your first hires. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- **Must\-have** * An engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, chemical or civil) and 8\+ years of engineering practice. This is a role for an engineer, and we are firm on it. * Strong hands\-on CAD skills. You produce drawings yourself, in current tools, and you can walk us through recent work. * Data center or industrial power design and development experience. You understand what a data center needs from its power and how a large power project gets built. * A customer\-facing track record. You have been the technical person in the room with a paying customer, rather than an internal design engineer. * Strong technical writing. You have written technical proposals, RFP responses or design basis documents for an external audience. * Comfort coordinating across multiple external parties: customer, EPC, utility or gas supplier, and financing advisors. * Comfort being the first person in a function, working from a blank page, in a lean company. * Houston\-based, or willing to relocate to Houston. * Existing authorization to work in the United States. **Strongly preferred** * EPC background. It is the single most useful thing on a CV for this role: design, constructability and multi\-party coordination in one person. * Project development experience, so a customer's development view is familiar from the inside. * Distributed generation, gas engine, turbine, fuel cell or onsite power experience. * Direct data center exposure, hyperscale or colocation, and familiarity with how these buyers run technical diligence. * Applications engineering, solutions engineering or technical sales experience in a complex, long\-cycle capital sale. * Comfort with the financial layer: you have fed technical inputs into project financial models and you understand what makes a project bankable. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation with meaningful equity. * Relocation support to Houston, Texas, if needed. * The first seat in a function that will grow. You will set the standards rather than inherit them, at the exact point where our pipeline turns into signed orders. **How to apply** ---------------- Apply with your CV and a short upload: a writing sample (a technical proposal, RFP response or design basis document you wrote for an external reader). Redact client names and commercial terms; we do not need anything confidential. Please have both ready before you start the application. Only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. *EH Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Software Design Engineer II
jobs.description: Overview: **About ERMCO** Electric Research and Manufacturing Cooperative, Inc. (ERMCO) is the leading manufacturer of distribution transformers and engineered electrical solutions, serving electric utilities, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and industrial customers across North America. Headquartered in Dyersburg, Tenn., ERMCO delivers reliable, high\-quality products that power homes, businesses, and communities across North America. With commitments to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, ERMCO is at the forefront of supporting grid modernization and energy transition. Our vertically integrated operations, customer\-focused culture, and investment in people and technology make ERMCO the Most Valued Partner for delivering resilient, sustainable power infrastructure for the future. **Job Summary** The Software Design Engineer is an early\-career role responsible for developing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting software used in transformer and related component design processes. This position builds on foundational software development experience and applies it to engineering automation, design data workflows, ERP integration, and CAD\-related tools. The P2 Software Developer works with moderate supervision, contributes to defined development tasks, and collaborates with design engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, supply chain, and IT teams to support reliable software solutions aligned with business and design engineering needs. ***This role will be onsite in Dyersburg, TN. Relocation Assistance is available.*** Responsibilities: * Develop, update, test, troubleshoot, debug, deploy, and maintain software applications used to support transformer or component design processes. * Assist in translating engineering requirements, customer specifications, design rules, and process needs into functional software requirements. * Support basic calculations, data validation, simulations, reporting, and engineering data analysis within software tools and automation workflows. * Collaborate with design engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, supply chain, and IT teams to ensure software integrates effectively with engineering and production processes. * Maintain technical documentation, software notes, user instructions, test results, change records, and support materials under guidance from senior team members. * Participate in code reviews, design reviews, software validation, and continuous improvement activities to improve reliability, usability, and maintainability. * Support ERP and engineering system data updates related to design processes, automation workflows, and engineering deliverables. * Contribute to technology organization growth initiatives. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. * 1\-3 years of software development experience, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, automation, CAD, ERP, or technical business systems. * Working knowledge of programming concepts, database interaction, debugging practices, version control, and basic software lifecycle practices. * Ability to read and interpret drawings, customer specifications, engineering documentation, and basic design requirements. * Effective communication, organization, and teamwork skills with the ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines. * Basic understanding of engineering design processes and willingness to develop transformer or component design knowledge. * Ability to analyze complex legacy codebases and document business logic. **Preferred Qualifications*** Exposure to CAD systems, such as Autodesk Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, or similar CAD/PLM technologies, engineering automation tools, design configurators, ERP integrations, or product data workflows. * Demonstrated interest in supporting platform development, engineering data quality, and scalable tools for design decision support. * Good understanding of tools like Query Tool and MySQL used for complex data querying utilizing SQL. * Familiarity in programming languages such as VB .Net, C\#, and C\+\+ that includes embedded SQL queries, and creating, testing, and maintaining Dynamic Link Libraries (DLLs). **Let’s Build the Future Together**At ERMCO, your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your impact is real. Whether you’re building on early career experience or launching your professional journey, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow in a manufacturing environment that values innovation and collaboration. **Join ERMCO and TRANSFORM your career!** Job Locations: US\-TN\-Dyersburg

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineering Lead (Senior Manager)
jobs.description: Location: Atlanta Other locations: Anywhere in Country Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 13, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1751902 Location: Anywhere in Country At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity** We are seeking a senior leader for our AI Platform Engineering group, the team that builds and operates the foundational substrate powering EY’s AI\-native platform. This role is accountable for the infrastructure and cloud\-native platform layers of our AI runtime, from bare\-metal and GPU infrastructure through Kubernetes, cluster fabric, secure inference, and multi\-tenant scaling. You will set the technical direction for a team of AI Infrastructure and AI Systems Engineers, and be accountable for standing up and running EY AI environments across cloud, on\-prem, edge, client\-managed, and air\-gapped targets. This is a player\-coach role. You will direct the team’s work and own the delivery roadmap, while remaining a hands\-on individual contributor who personally designs, builds, and troubleshoots the most critical and complex parts of the platform. The role is ideal for a senior engineering leader who is as comfortable troubleshooting a cluster configuration as they are in leading an executive review, who can set a phased roadmap and hold delivery gates under pressure, who treats reliability and portability as non\-negotiable in regulated client contexts, and who understands that the substrate is a product in its own right, measured by the velocity, safety, and portability it unlocks for every team building above it. **Your key responsibilities** * **Lead and develop the AI Platform Infrastructure Engineering team:** direct the day\-to\-day and longer\-term work of AI Infrastructure and AI Systems Engineers, set priorities, allocate work, and remove blockers so the team delivers predictably; hire, mentor, and coach engineers, set engineering standards (design reviews, code reviews, runbooks), and grow technical depth and leadership capability across the team. * **Build hands\-on as a senior individual contributor:** personally design, implement, and debug the hardest and highest\-risk components of the platform — cluster bring\-up, GPU and networking enablement, multi\-tenancy, inference and routing — and lead by example on engineering quality. * **Own the infrastructure delivery roadmap:** sequence the build into phases that each put a usable capability into engineering teams’ hands, define and defend entry and exit gates, and report progress, risk, and trade\-offs to senior leadership. * **Own the infrastructure foundation and cloud\-native platform:** from Ubuntu/OS, BMC/bare\-metal, DPU architecture, and NVAIE (GPU/Network/DCGM) through compute, Kubernetes and scheduling, cluster fabric and networking, multi\-tenancy, and distributed compute — delivering foundational capabilities (Infrastructure Management, Kubernetes \& Scheduling, Cluster Fabric Management) as a provisioned, patched, production\-ready substrate for Agentic AI workflows and downstream runtime, data, and execution services. * **Stand up and operate EY Agentic AI environments:** across cloud (EKS/AKS/GKE), on\-prem AI Factory (RKE2/NVAIE), edge (K3s), client\-managed, and air\-gapped deployment modes, maintaining one consistent stack contract across all targets and keeping the substrate modular and swappable so components can be replaced without rewriting consumers or creating vendor lock\-in. * **Own secure execution, inference, and routing:** Ray Serve, vLLM/NIM/Triton, and NVIDIA Dynamo, with sandboxed execution (NVIDIA OpenShell) for isolated, safe model execution; and Envoy AI Gateway, semantic routing (vLLM\-SR), model and prompt selection, and streaming response handling — directing each request to the right model under the right constraints. * **Own operational excellence, resilience, and platform delivery:** define SLOs, on\-call and incident management practices, and lead post\-incident reviews; own backup, disaster recovery, and cross\-environment replication for high availability (Velero, CloudNativePG, Cilium ClusterMesh), patching, security hardening, and supply\-chain hygiene; and partner with DevOps Engineers on CI/CD/CV (ArgoCD) and infrastructure\-as\-code / GitOps (Helm/OpenTofu) so environments are reproducible and drift\-free. * **Own GPU capacity, platform economics, and vendor selection:** forecast demand, set quotas and cost attribution, and manage the infrastructure budget; evaluate commercial against open\-source options, run proofs of concept, manage strategic vendor relationships, and work with procurement on long\-lead hardware and licensing, making the commercial case for capacity to senior leadership. **Skills and attributes for success** * Deep, hands\-on expertise in  ing). * Background in platform or SRE leadership roles where success is measured by downstream team velocity, reliability, and portability. * Exposure to regulated delivery environments (financial services, tax, healthcare, risk). * Relevant certifications (e.g., CKA/CKS, NVIDIA AI Infrastructure, AWS/Azure/GCP professional\-level). **What we offer you** At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Econolite® is an innovator of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) solutions, products, and services. Our technology is helping save lives and making the Smart City a reality. If you want to be at the forefront of this intelligent technology revolution, we want to talk to you about being part of our team. Econolite is committed to employing the best talent that will make significant contributions to building a safer, connected world. Econolite’s ITS solutions ease traffic congestion, provide safer mobility, and improve quality of life. As the one\-stop\-shop leader for traffic management systems, sensor products, and services, Econolite is committed to the advancement of connected and autonomous vehicles, smart cities, and cybersecurity. We are looking for a Platform Engineer to join our team, specializing in Kubernetes\-based infrastructure. In this role, you will primarily deploy, operate, and support the Centracs Mobility product line in customer on\-premises environments running Kubernetes, and secondarily assist with the cloud DevOps that supports our hosted environments. You will work closely with development, support, and customer IT teams to deliver secure, reliable, and repeatable deployments. Some travel to customer sites is required for installations, upgrades, and troubleshooting. **DUTIES** * Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Kubernetes clusters in customer on\-premises environments, on customer\-provided hardware and virtualization platforms. * Package and deploy Centracs Mobility services using Helm and version\-controlled, repeatable configuration. * Build and maintain the tooling, runbooks, and documentation that make on\-premises installations and upgrades consistent and repeatable, including deployments into restricted or air\-gapped networks (private container registries, offline install packages). * Provide platform services on premises without relying on cloud\-managed services: ingress and load balancing, certificate management, persistent storage, secrets management, identity (Keycloak), and messaging (Kafka). * Provide platform capabilities for SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases, including provisioning, backup/restore, high availability, and upgrades. * Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting for on\-premises deployments; diagnose and resolve issues in customer environments, remotely or on site. * Work with customer IT and network teams on site prerequisites, including networking, DNS, firewall rules, remote access, and hardware sizing. * Apply security hardening and patching to clusters, nodes, and containers; remediate CVEs; and support security practices and certifications such as SOC 2\. * Assist with cloud DevOps: build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for containerized .NET (C\#) and Angular applications, and support cloud\-hosted Kubernetes environments. * Use AI tools to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, automation, and documentation, and review their output before applying it to production or customer environments. * Work closely with the technical and support teams to deliver and manage services with maximum uptime. * Contribute to other projects as needed, such as software development. **QUALIFICATIONS** The candidate will possess keen analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent communication skills, and a mindset of continual learning. Candidates must be self\-motivated individuals who proactively seek to grow their knowledge base and progress in their careers. * 2–6 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or systems engineering. * Strong hands\-on experience running Kubernetes outside of a managed cloud service (e.g., RKE2, k3s, kubeadm, or OpenShift), including installation, upgrades, and troubleshooting. * Strong background with Docker containers and Helm. * Strong understanding of networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, TLS/certificates, firewalls, VPNs, and network segmentation. * Linux and Windows Server administration, with scripting in Bash and PowerShell. * Azure DevOps, including pipeline development, or comparable CI/CD experience; Azure or AWS cloud experience. * Working knowledge of SQL Server and PostgreSQL administration. * Experience managing security policies and practices, such as SOC 2\. * Experience supporting enterprise\-grade production software, preferably delivered into customer\-managed environments. * Programming experience with a high\-level programming language, such as C\#. * Ability to communicate effectively with customer IT staff and to travel to customer sites as needed. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or an equivalent engineering field. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATONS** * Experience with air\-gapped or disconnected deployments. * Experience operating Kafka (e.g., Strimzi), Keycloak, and cert\-manager on Kubernetes. * Infrastructure as code and configuration management (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). * Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). * Virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V). * Traffic or Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) domain experience, or experience serving public\-sector customers. **PRE\-EMPLOYMENT** All candidates who accept employment will be subject to a background investigation and drug screening. For applicable roles, candidates who accept employment will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle/Driving Record screening. **COMPENSATION** The base pay range for this full\-time exempt position is $115,000\-$140,000 per year plus benefits. Pay ranges are determined by various factors, including role, experience, and location. The pay range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base pay rates for this position. Within the range, actual individual compensation is determined by various factors, including location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **BENEFITS** This role is eligible for benefits: weekly pay, weekly PTO accrual, paid holidays. Various medical plans, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, direct deposit. Basic life, LTD, 401k discretionary match. Other voluntary benefits include: identity theft protection. ***DISCLAIMER*** *The above statements are intended to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification.
