jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer - Loyalty & Customer Analytics
jobs.description: At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire\-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross\-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze. Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you. At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week. Let’s Get Loco! What’s in it for you! * STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth * Career growth opportunities * Competitive pay and bonus potential * Medical \+ Dental \+ Vision Insurance \+ HSA Savings Account * 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting * Paid Vacation \+ Sick Pay \+ 12 Paid Holidays * Employee Assistance Program * Free El Pollo Loco food \+ restaurant discounts * PerkSpot discounts program **POSITION PURPOSE:** The Senior Data Engineer owns El Pollo Loco's (EPL) loyalty and customer spend data, turning it into reliable, actionable insight for leadership. This role starts with the business problem: understanding what decision leadership needs to make, then independently designing and delivering the data solution that supports it. The engineer owns data domains end to end, from source ingestion and architecture through reporting and analysis, and ensures data integrity across internal systems and external partners. Working directly with business departments, internal technology teams, and external technology vendors, this role drives architectural improvements that directly shape how EPL leadership makes decisions. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Business Problem Framing: Partner with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and leadership to understand business questions, translate them into data requirements, and recommend the right solution approach without needing detailed direction. * Independent Solution Design: Own solutions from concept to production, including evaluating options, making architectural trade\-off decisions, and delivering working outcomes with minimal supervision. * Data Domain Ownership: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, ingestion flows, and analytical models for loyalty, customer, and transaction data. * Architecture \& Governance: Define and own data architecture for the domain, ensuring alignment with business needs, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness. * Vendor \& Partner Collaboration: Work directly with external technology vendors and data providers (loyalty, POS, digital ordering, and marketing platforms) to define integrations, resolve data issues, and hold partners accountable for data quality and delivery. * Data Contracts \& Integration: Establish data contracts with internal and external sources, integrate new data sources, and develop reusable transformation patterns. * Pipeline Reliability \& Optimization: Identify limitations in existing data processes, drive improvements, and establish best practices, including automated monitoring, alerting, and self\-healing processing. * AI/ML Integration: Apply AI/ML technologies, including large language models and agentic frameworks, to expand analytics capabilities and automate insight generation. * Innovation \& Scalability: Modernize ingestion frameworks and build secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions that support EPL's growth. QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or analytics engineering, including ownership of production data platforms. * Expert\-level SQL and strong experience with modern ETL/ELT practices and data processing. * Hands\-on experience with cloud data warehouse platforms (e.g., Snowflake or comparable). * Experience with data governance and data modeling to ensure data integrity as analytics and reports are developed across EPL. * Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous business problem and independently design, build, and deliver a solution. * Experience managing integrations and working relationships with third\-party technology vendors. * Experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks, and the ability to integrate AI into analytics workflows. * Experience with loyalty, customer, or transactional data in restaurant, retail, or consumer businesses is strongly preferred. **LEADERSHIP \& BUSINESS SKILLS:** * Technical leadership mindset with a long\-term architectural vision and a commitment to high\-quality delivery. * Comfortable operating with ambiguity and setting direction where none exists. * Strong judgment in balancing short\-term needs against long\-term business goals. * Communicates clearly in business terms with executives and non\-technical stakeholders. * Sense of urgency and strong attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment. **IMPACT:** This is a strategic role. The engineer will directly influence how EPL leadership makes decisions by ensuring customer and loyalty data is available, accurate, and actionable. **EDUCATION:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Our Company In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus\-marinated, fire\-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable. The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. At El Pollo Loco, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range. Individual pay decisions will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Software Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **We are designing the grid of the future!**ENER\-i is a cutting\-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. Backed by the collective expertise of EPE, ENER\-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud\-based, enterprise computing software. ENER\-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, GIS, network connectivity models, machine learning \& augmented intelligence. Our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry. Responsibilities: **Join us in leading the** **change!** The Software Power Systems Engineer will work as a core member of the ENER\-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. This involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. Such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi\-static time\-series (QSTS) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and DER interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of DER and non\-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and DERMS operational planning, and long\-term capacity and investment planning. The level of the role (Engineer III, Senior, Principal, or Senior Principal) will be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience. Principal\-level engineers are expected to set technical direction for the platform's powerflow analysis architecture and lead cross\-team initiatives. * The Software Power Systems Engineer will also engage with the ENER\-i product, engineering, and client delivery teams for tasks such as: * Distribution model conversion, validation, and onboarding (e.g., CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS) * Translating utility planning practices and criteria into technical specifications * Technical design reviews and architecture decisions for analysis engines * Validation of platform results against commercial tools and field data * Performance benchmarking and scale testing on utility\-sized models * Client technical workshops, demonstrations, and user training * Perform and deliver ENER\-i based distribution planning studies when needed **How you can make an impact:** * Design and implement production\-grade Python libraries and services for distribution analysis, power flow orchestration, and optimization within the ENER\-i platform. * Scale simulations across thousands of feeders and full\-year time\-series through parallelization, cloud batch processing, and performance tuning – including compiled languages (e.g., Rust, C\+\+) where it matters. * Build and maintain distribution data models and model converters that bring utility network models (CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS, GIS) into a common, validated representation. * Develop algorithms for automated mitigation, hosting capacity, DER valuation, and grid planning using optimization (LP/MILP), heuristics, and data\-driven methods. * Establish test automation, validation suites, and engineering benchmarks that keep platform results accurate and trustworthy. * Serve as a distribution subject matter expert to developers, product owners, and product managers; review requirements and user stories for engineering correctness. * Propose and prototype new ENER\-i modules and help shape the technical roadmap with product management. * Mentor engineers and developers, contribute to code and design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. * Represent EPE through publications, open\-source contributions, and industry working groups where appropriate. * Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications: **Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:** * Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a power systems focus, or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience. * 3\+ years (Engineer III) or 7\+ years (Principal) of combined experience in distribution system analysis and software development; national laboratory, research, utility, and vendor experience all count. * Expert understanding of three\-phase, unbalanced distribution systems, power flow formulations, and distribution planning practices. * Hands\-on experience with at least one distribution modeling tool (e.g., OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, WindMil, or GridLAB\-D), including its APIs or automation interfaces. * Strong Python software engineering skills beyond scripting: packaging, typing, automated testing, Git, code review, and CI/CD. OpenDSS experience is a plus. * A track record of building tools that other people use: libraries, applications, or open\-source projects with real users. * Experience applying numerical methods and optimization (e.g., Pyomo, JuMP, Gurobi, HiGHS) to power systems problems. * Experience working with large data sets (time\-series, AMI, SCADA) using tools such as pandas/Polars, SQL, or Parquet. * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly with respect to explaining complex technical matters. * Proven team player skills with ability to build and maintain internal and external relationships. * Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum). **Beneficial Experience:*** Proficiency in a compiled or high\-performance language such as Rust, C\+\+, Julia, or Java. * Contributions to open\-source power systems tools (e.g., OpenDSS/AltDSS, DiTTo, GridLAB\-D, PowerModelsDistribution, pandapower). * Experience with cloud\-native development, containers, and distributed or high\-performance computing (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience with DER integration topics such as hosting capacity, IEEE 1547, DERMS, flexible interconnection, non\-wires alternatives, and electrification load forecasting. * Breadth across transmission, controls, or T\&D co\-simulation. * Familiarity with GIS tools (preferably Esri) and utility network data models. * Experience leveraging machine learning and AI tools responsibly to improve engineering quality and productivity. * Publications or participation in IEEE PES or similar industry working groups. Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy. **How we support you:*** Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you * Generous PTO and paid holidays * MyShare Employee Ownership Program * Work with industry leaders * 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1\) ***Location***: This position is open to remote for highly qualified candidates***Travel***: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less) *EPE is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to empower the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We have built a highly efficient product\-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness. We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Test Engineer** to help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of software across Element's sequencing ecosystem. In this hands\-on role, you will independently own verification of complex features and workflows spanning instrument software, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data\-analysis interfaces. You will partner with cross\-functional teams to translate requirements, user needs, and product risks into clear test strategies and objective evidence. The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust tools for scientists and brings a strong background in software and systems testing, integration troubleshooting, and regulated product development. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Software Test Engineering and is expected to be a San Diego based, daily on\-site role. If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** * Independently design, document, and execute verification activities for complex software features and end\-to\-end workflows used with Element sequencing instruments * Translate user needs, product requirements, system architecture, and risk controls into traceable test strategies, plans, cases, protocols, and reports * Perform hands\-on functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing across instrument software, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data\-analysis interfaces * Configure and maintain representative test environments, including control of software, firmware, hardware, and test\-data configurations * Isolate and troubleshoot defects using logs, command\-line tools, database queries, and reproducible test evidence; clearly communicate severity, impact, and risk * Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, assay, chemistry, product, UX, and quality partners to evaluate coverage, resolve integration issues, and improve the end\-user experience * Create accurate, review\-ready test documentation in accordance with Element's software development lifecycle and applicable design\-control processes * Identify high\-value automation opportunities and contribute to maintainable automated tests and supporting tools as products and interfaces mature * Communicate test status, quality risks, and recommendations to project leads and stakeholders, and share technical knowledge with less\-experienced team members **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience * Typically 3–5 years of hands\-on software or systems test experience; experience with life\-science, medical\-device, or laboratory\-instrumentation products is strongly preferred * Demonstrated ability to derive test coverage from requirements and user stories and to produce clear, traceable test plans, cases, protocols, defect reports, and test reports * Experience testing interfaces among software, embedded systems, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data\-analysis applications * Proficiency with Linux and command\-line tools, log analysis, and SQL or NoSQL databases; scripting or test\-automation experience (for example, Python or TypeScript) is preferred * Experience working within a regulated software development lifecycle and quality system; working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, and ISO 13485 is preferred * Understanding of product risk management and root\-cause analysis; familiarity with ISO 14971 is preferred. * Knowledge of DNA sequencing workflows or genomics applications is preferred * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage priorities and work effectively across disciplines **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to perform computer\-based work and remain in a stationary position for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation * Ability to move between office and laboratory work areas and operate benchtop laboratory instrumentation, with or without reasonable accommodation * Ability to follow laboratory safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment **Location:** * San Diego (on\-site) **Travel:** * No anticipated travel **Job Type:** * Full\-time / Exempt **Base Compensation Pay Range:** * $118,000 \- $144,000 In addition to the base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, a discretionary annual bonus, no\-cost health insurance plans, a 401(k) with company match, and flexible paid time off. *Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience.* We foster an environment such that all people are afforded the freedom to pursue their passions without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Engineering and AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description: **\*\*No sponsorship/C2C is available for this position\*\*** **Engineering and AI Specialist** **Reports To:** Director of Technical Delivery **Location:** Remote **FLSA:** Exempt **Job Summary** The AI Operations Specialist builds and runs the internal AI tooling, automations, and pilots that make AI a practical, everyday part of how Elevate Digital's Engineering team delivers. Reporting to the Director of Technical Delivery, this role turns the AI operations roadmap into working software: maintaining agent pipelines and internal tools, testing new models and tools against real workflows, and keeping engineers unblocked as they adopt them. This is an execution\-focused role, not a standard\-setting one. Direction, governance, and org\-wide AI standards for Engineering remain owned by the Director of Technical Delivery; the AI Operations Specialist is the builder who makes that direction real, working alongside the Director on shared tooling projects rather than owning all of it independently. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Tooling \& Automation** * Build, maintain, and extend the AI tooling and agent pipelines Engineering relies on — including coding\-agent integrations, MCP servers, and internal bots or scripts — working alongside the Director of Technical Delivery on shared tooling priorities. * Keep existing automations reliable as models, APIs, and internal workflows change, monitoring for breakage and patching quickly. * Maintain a lightweight, current catalog of what tooling is live, what's experimental, and what's been retired. **Pilots \& Evaluation** * Run scoped pilots applying AI to specific internal workflows — ticket triage, documentation, code review assistance, onboarding, and similar — and report results back to the Director of Technical Delivery. * Hands\-on evaluation of new AI models, tools, and vendors as they emerge: what they're good for, what they cost, and whether they fit Elevate's delivery workflows. * Track basic usage, cost, and quality signals for AI tooling so adoption decisions rest on evidence rather than hype. **Enablement \& Support** * Support engineers adopting AI tooling day to day — answering questions, unblocking issues, and sharing practical techniques that actually work. * Produce lightweight documentation, guides, or walkthroughs so internal tools are usable by people other than the person who built them. * Surface friction, bugs, and gaps in existing tooling and pipelines back to the Director of Technical Delivery as input to the roadmap. **Required Competencies and Skills** * **Builder Mentality:** Genuine hands\-on drive to build and ship internal tools and automations — this role is defined by making things, not evaluating them from the sidelines. * **AI/LLM Practical Fluency:** Working knowledge of agentic workflows, prompt engineering, MCP, and RAG\-style patterns, gained through real building rather than credentials alone. * **Automation \& Scripting:** Comfortable writing scripts, integrations, and lightweight pipelines to connect tools and remove manual work. * **Judgment Under Ambiguity:** Able to size up a new tool or pilot quickly, form a point of view, and know when a decision needs to go to the Director of Technical Delivery rather than being made unilaterally. * **Documentation Habit:** Writes clear, lightweight documentation as a habit, not an afterthought, so tools and pilots are usable by others. * **Collaborative Execution:** Works well executing someone else's roadmap and priorities on shared tooling projects, without needing to own the strategy to stay motivated. **Experience and Education** * Solid grounding in programming fundamentals — able to read, reason about, and debug the code and systems they build, not just accept AI\-generated output at face value. This is not a "vibe coding" role. * Demonstrated experience building automations, scripts, or AI\-assisted tooling — through professional work, side projects, or hands\-on experimentation. What you've built and can explain matters more than where you learned to build it. * Practical, hands\-on experience with agentic coding tools, AI coding assistants, or LLM\-based pipelines, used deliberately rather than as a black box. * Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing technical territory where best practices are still being written. * Self\-taught and non\-traditional paths are welcome, provided they come with real engineering fundamentals. Some formal computer science background is preferred, but demonstrated ability to understand and reason about the code and systems being built matters more than the credential itself. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a plus but not required given equivalent, demonstrable fundamentals. **Values Alignment** The AI Operations Specialist embodies Elevate Digital's core pillars and the way we work: * **People Advantage:** You build tools that make engineers faster and better at their jobs, not tools that quietly replace their judgment. * **Client Growth:** You measure your work by whether it actually gets used and actually saves time — not by how sophisticated it looks. * **Services Transformation:** You're energized by building in undefined territory, comfortable that today's tool may be rebuilt or replaced next quarter as the landscape shifts. * **Responsible by Default:** You hold your own tooling to a high bar for reliability and security, especially anywhere it touches client work or sensitive data. **Travel Required** This is a remote role with no regular travel expectation. Occasional participation in team gatherings or planning sessions may be requested. **Other Duties** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice, as business needs evolve.

jobs.title: AVP - Design Validation & Learning, Biotherapeutics
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. For more than 25 years, Lilly's Biotechnology Discovery Research (BioTDR) organization has advanced novel antibody and peptide therapeutics from concept through clinical development to market in areas of high unmet medical need. This role is based at the Lilly Biotechnology Center in San Diego, where we are expanding our computational capabilities to build a generative design platform. By bringing together AI/ML, protein engineering, automation, structural biology, and high\-throughput experimentation, BioTDR is creating an integrated de novo design platform capable of generating, ranking, and optimizing novel therapeutic antibodies and other biotherapeutics with improved activity, safety, manufacturability, and target coverage. Designs are rapidly evaluated through experimental validation, creating a continuous learning cycle that strengthens both models and discovery outcomes. The program is supported by dedicated capacity on LillyPod, our wholly owned 1,016\-GPU NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra SuperPOD. Help us push the de novo protein design frontier beyond binders to molecules that can become medicines, faster. Ready to make an impact? Join us. Primary Responsibilities **Our Generative Design platform has three pillars:** Generative Foundation Models, Generative Protein Design \& Optimization, and Active Learning \& Design Validation. The AVP of Design Validation \& Learning will define and execute the scientific strategy that determines how Lilly evaluates, validates, and continuously improves its de novo biologics design capabilities. This leader will establish the experimental learning systems, validation standards, benchmarking frameworks, and data generation strategies that transform computational predictions into actionable scientific insights and increasingly powerful design capabilities. This is a founding leadership role. You will build and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning model evaluation, active learning, computational biology, statistical methodology, physics\-based modeling, and experimental learning. You will be accountable for ensuring that every experimental outcome strengthens the platform's ability to design better therapeutic molecules over time. Responsibilities * Define the scientific strategy for evaluation, validation, and learning. Establish how model performance, design quality, and therapeutic impact will be measured across the platform, ensuring computational progress translates into meaningful experimental outcomes. * Define and establish rigorous benchmarks and validation standards. Establish evaluation frameworks that test generalization, prospective design performance, biological relevance, experimental success, and failure modes. Create a culture in which models are challenged against rigorous experimental benchmarks and evidence\-based decision making is standard practice. * Establish a closed computational\-experimental learning system. Partner closely with experimental scientists to connect model development with laboratory testing. Use predefined experimental metrics to evaluate models, uncover failure modes, and continuously improve subsequent generations of models and molecular designs. * Set the role of physics\-based approaches in the design stack. Decide where simulation, molecular modeling, and energy\-based calculations improve model performance and design capability, and define how they should be integrated with ML\-based approaches. * Active learning and proprietary data strategy. Define the scientific strategy for which experiments should be performed next. Partner with DMTA, automation, protein engineering, and discovery leaders to create proprietary data assets that compound in value for model training, evaluation, and future design cycles. * Translate frontier AI research into therapeutic impact. Embed AI capabilities directly into active discovery programs, identify high\-value opportunities where computational design can change program outcomes, and establish rigorous measures of impact including novel molecular solutions, hit rates, design precision, experimental efficiency, and advancement of differentiated therapeutic candidates. * Establish platform\-wide success metrics. Define how model performance, design quality, experimenta against experimental measurements in a drug discovery, molecular design, or related scientific setting. * Proficiency in Python and applied statistics, including calibration, uncertainty quantification, experimental design, and quantitative evaluation methodologies. Additional Preferences * Experience partnering with experimental teams on assay or campaign design. * Experience building benchmarking frameworks, validation suites, or evaluation systems adopted across multiple teams, research organizations, or discovery programs. * Experience applying molecular dynamics, free\-energy methods, enhanced sampling, or related simulation approaches to protein design, evaluation, or molecular understanding. * Expertise in protein stability, aggregation, viscosity, expression, manufacturability, or developability prediction. * Experience designing large\-scale experimental datasets intended for model training, validation, or active learning. * Experience with active learning, Bayesian experimental design, or sequential experimentation under constrained experimental budgets. * Working knowledge of binding and biophysical measurements including SPR, BLI, thermostability, expression, and related assay technologies. * Proven track record of building effective cross\-functional partnerships across computational, experimental, automation, and therapeutic discovery organizations to deliver shared scientific goals. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex computational, statistical, and experimental concepts for scientific leaders, experimental researchers, and executive stakeholders. Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $267,000 \- $391,600 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer / Product Engineer ONSITE -Scottsdale, Az
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer \- LOCAL Candidates only **Public\-Posting Performance\-Based Hiring Profile** **Build the whole product. Own the outcome. Pivot fast without losing momentum.** **LOCATION** Scottsdale, Arizona \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site **SCHEDULE** Flexible start within the 7:00 a.m.\-6:00 p.m. work window **COMPENSATION** $100,000\-$130,000 base, depending on demonstrated capability **ROLE MIX** Approximately 50% front\-end / 50% back\-end development **CORE STACK** Python back end \| TypeScript front end \| AWS \| APIs \| Practical AI integrations **This is not a ticket\-taking developer role.** Envita is looking for a true full\-stack builder who can move comfortably between front\-end and back\-end development, take an incomplete request from a non\-technical stakeholder, clarify what actually needs to be built, and carry the solution through production. The role is approximately 50/50 front end and back end, with Python as the primary back\-end language. AI is an important part of the environment, especially practical AI and API integrations, but this is not a machine\-learning role and we do not want someone who relies on AI without understanding the code, architecture, risks, or output. **Position Purpose** ==================== The Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer will build secure, reliable, cost\-conscious products across Envita business units. The role requires strong full\-stack range, direct stakeholder communication, rapid learning, practical AI integration experience, and a high degree of self\-direction. A defining requirement is the ability to pivot immediately when business priorities change while preserving the state, visibility, and restart point of every other active project. **Why This Opportunity Stands Out** =================================== * End\-to\-end ownership from requirements and architecture through build, integration, deployment, testing, and production follow\-through. * True full\-stack scope with meaningful work on both the user\-facing front end and the Python back end. * Direct access to the people using what you build, including clinicians, pharmacy and laboratory operators, business leaders, and executives. * Practical AI work, including AI\-provider APIs and AI\-enabled product features, without requiring machine\-learning specialization. * Variety, autonomy, and visible business impact across multiple Envita entities rather than one narrow product lane. * A flexible daily start window designed to support an on\-site Scottsdale work environment. **What Exceptional Success Looks Like After the First Year** ============================================================ Envita leaders can bring this engineer an important business problem and trust that it will be clarified, translated into a practical technical solution, built across the full stack, deployed securely, and supported with clear status and documentation. The engineer is equally credible in front\-end and Python back\-end work, uses AI and external APIs intelligently, understands and can explain the code they ship, and is known for being able to change direction quickly when the business requires it without allowing lower\-priority projects to disappear or restart from zero. **SMART Key Performance Objectives** ==================================== These outcomes define success in the role. Demonstrated capability and comparable accomplishments matter more than years of experience, prior title, or exact framework overlap. **1\. Deliver the First Full\-Stack Product Fast** -------------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Take an assigned project from the initial stakeholder conversation through requirements clarification, front\-end and Python back\-end development, API integration as needed, testing, and production deployment. Target a meaningful demo by approximately day 21 and a production\-ready release by approximately day 45\. **Evidence of success:** The stakeholder confirms the solution solves the intended problem; the engineer can explain the architecture and code; appropriate testing, authentication, secrets handling, logging, and production controls are in place; and the solution operates reliably after launch. **2\. Pivot on a Dime Without Losing Momentum** ----------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Operate effectively across multiple active projects while being able to immediately redirect attention when leadership or business needs change. When one project becomes critical, shift the majority of effort to it without allowing other work to become invisible, confused, or difficult to restart. **Evidence of success:** Priority changes are acted on quickly; stakeholders are informed; paused work has a documented current state, next action, blocker, and restart point; the critical project accelerates; and previously active projects resume without unnecessary rework or loss of context. **3\. Own Requirements From Ambig modeling using Postgres or a comparable database, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and safe migrations. * REST/API design and integration experience, including authentication/authorization, validation, versioning, idempotency, structured errors, and reliability concerns. * Hands\-on AWS deployment ownership, including IAM/access control, secrets, networking fundamentals, logs/observability, and cost awareness. * Application\-security fundamentals, especially authentication vs. authorization, injection/XSS awareness, secret handling, transport security, least privilege, and sensitive data. * Unit and integration testing as a normal part of development, plus confidence standing up test coverage in existing or lightly documented systems. * Git fluency and the ability to navigate an unfamiliar repository and determine what the code actually does. * Meaningful practical AI experience, preferably integrating AI/LLM capabilities through APIs or building AI\-enabled product features. Machine\-learning model development is not required. * A recent, specific example of learning a new language, SDK, API, framework, or platform under deadline and successfully shipping with it. **What Separates Top Performers** ================================= * **Priority Agility:** Can change direction immediately when business priorities change, make the new priority successful, and preserve clean restart points for everything temporarily deprioritized. * **Full\-Stack Range:** Is genuinely comfortable delivering both user\-facing front\-end work and production Python back\-end services. * **AI Judgment:** Uses AI where it improves speed or quality, but never substitutes AI output for understanding, verification, security, or accountability. * **Requirements Discipline:** Asks clarifying questions before coding, confirms understanding, and avoids building the wrong thing quickly. * **Self\-Direction:** Creates structure when structure is light, keeps multiple projects visible, and escalates conflicts before they become surprises. * **Ship\-Quality Judgment:** Moves quickly while knowing which shortcuts are acceptable and which are not, especially around security, sensitive data, authentication, data integrity, and cost. * **Constructive Communication:** Explains choices and trade\-offs clearly and responds to changed priorities without defensiveness or loss of follow\-through. **The Environment** =================== This role is best suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, variety, speed, and incomplete problems. Requirements may arrive verbally. Priorities can change during the week or during the day. An engineer may be progressing several projects and then be asked to focus almost entirely on one urgent initiative. Success requires flexibility without chaos: make the pivot, communicate it, preserve the state of the other work, and keep commitments visible. There may not always be a mature product\-management process, complete design handoff, dedicated DevOps support, or perfect documentation waiting before work begins. **Culture and Working Style** ============================= * Patient and business impact comes before technology for technology's sake. * Integrity, humility, gratitude, learning agility, respectful collaboration, confidentiality, and accountability matter in how the work gets done. * Strong performers are comfortable receiving direct feedback, revisiting assumptions, and changing course when the evidence or business priority changes. * We value people who are curious, dependable, solution\-oriented, technically accountable, and willing to own the consequences of their decisions. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ Envita Medical Centers of America is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals as required by applicable law.

Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards. **Key Responsibilities** **Design and Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain React and Next.js features for assigned areas of the application, following the team’s established patterns and coding standards. * Build Server and Client Components, forms, and data\-heavy screens, such as grids and document viewers, using the team’s component library. * Integrate features with backend\-for\-frontend endpoints and platform APIs. * Write component and end\-to\-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. * Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. **Quality and Continuous Improvement** * Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA and Section 508, and fix accessibility defects. * Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner. * Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and tools and stay current with emerging front\-end and agentic UI technologies. **AI\-Enabled Delivery** * Utilize approved AI\-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use. * Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI\-assisted development patterns defined by the team and share improvements that benefit the team. * Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI\-enabled workflows and automation. **Governance and Compliance** * Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices. * Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, following the team’s standards for keeping PHI out of browser storage, logs, and telemetry. * Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling. * Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI\-assisted solutions. **Required Qualifications** * 2\+ years of professional software development experience building web applications with React and TypeScript. * Working knowledge of Next.js or another server rendered React framework. * Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern React patterns, such as hooks, state management, and component composition. * Familiarity with REST APIs and asynchronous data fetching, including streaming responses. * Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA) and semantic HTML. * Familiarity with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. * Familiarity with Git\-based version control (e.g., GitHub) and pull requests, and CI/CD using GitHub Actions. * Regular use of AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team. * Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with enterprise component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI. * Familiarity with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect. * Familiarity with Python or C\# and .NET. * Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. * Familiarity with FHIR R4\. * Healthcare domain experience. **Education** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $112,000\-123,000\. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to Team:** Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. Lodging Connectivity is the API\- and software\-driven backbone of our supply business, simplifying connectivity across lodging products through external\-facing APIs and platforms that enable partners to acquire, optimize, and maintain lodging supply. We are an AI\-forward team: we use AI across how we design, build, test, and operate software, and we are building AI\-enabled capabilities into our services. In this role, you will deliver traveler, partner, and company value with stable architecture, high quality, and operational excellence, and you will help set the bar for how our team uses AI responsibly and effectively. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and evolve reliable backend services, including system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of your daily engineering practice (design exploration, code generation, test authoring, refactoring, code review, debugging, and incident triage), and critically validate the output for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Design and ship AI/ML\-enabled capabilities in backend services, such as LLM\-powered features, agent and tool integrations, and retrieval or automation workflows, with attention to latency, cost, quality evaluation, and failure modes. * Define and promote team practices for responsible AI adoption: prompt and context management, evaluation and guardrails, data privacy, and compliance with EG security policies. * Implement high\-quality production code with an emphasis on automated testing, observability, performance, and operational excellence. * Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to translate customer and business requirements into robust backend solutions, reusable service integrations, and well\-structured data flows. * Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of services and features: development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution. * Use data, metrics, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize work, validate hypotheses, and measure the impact of both product changes and AI\-driven improvements to engineering productivity. Mentor engineers on effective, safe use of AI tooling and raise the team’s overall velocity and quality. * **Minimum Qualifications** **:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of professional experience building and operating production backend services in a team environment. * Demonstrated ownership of services or features across design, implementation, quality, deployment, and operational support. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling, applied in production systems. * Hands\-on, demonstrable proficiency with AI\-assisted development: you can describe specific workflows where AI tools measurably improved your speed or quality, and where they failed and how you caught it. Hands\-on experience integrating AI/ML or LLM capabilities into a production system (for example, calling model APIs, building tool or agent integrations, or operating ML\-backed services). * **Preferred Qualifications** **:** * Experience designing and evolving multi\-service backend architectures with well\-structured APIs, data models, and reliable data flows. * Demonstrated success improving high\-traffic or customer\-facing systems through performance tuning, resilience hardening, and reliability engineering. * Strong operational excellence: instrumentation, logging, metrics, alerting, on\-call participation, and incident response. * Experience with experimentation, feature flags, A/B testing, and analytics to guide technical and product decisions. * Experience with LLM application patterns (RAG, tool calling/MCP, agent orchestration), evaluation frameworks, and observability for AI systems (token cost, latency, quality drift). * Experience building AI guardrails: input/output validation, prompt\-injection mitigation, PII handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Experience driving AI tooling adoption across a team, including playbooks, shared prompts or agent configurations, and measuring impact. The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500\.00 to $258,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

The Battery Management Embedded Software Engineer owns the base software platform beneath the application layer for high\-voltage battery management controllers — the real\-time operating system, hardware abstraction, drivers, communication stacks, software update mechanism, and security foundation. Assignments may include string\-level or system\-level battery management controllers and may shift across the product architecture over the life of the program. or software update implementation experience. * Version control, code review, and continuous integration discipline. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability and willingness to jobs.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid **General Job Description** Powertrain Manufacturing Engineering (PTME) seeks a motivated professional to drive quality robustness across our engineering factory. The ideal candidate will leverage expertise in quality deliverables including PFMEAs, Control Plans, error\-proofing strategies, engineering standards, and new program launch requirements. They will lead efforts to improve and maximize equipment and process performance for existing manufacturing systems in the machining, assembly and test operations. They may support PTME launch teams through coaching, training, technical deep dives, and enhancements to engineering standards. Additionally, they will collaborate with global teams to resolve powertrain launch quality concerns and execute continuous improvement initiatives. **More Detailed Job Description** At Ford Motor Company, quality is at the heart of everything we build. As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer and Powertrain Quality Leader, you will drive the application and continuous improvement of quality systems across our powertrain manufacturing operations. The focus will be on machining, assembly and test systems within the Powertrain Manufacturing Staff Organization. Partnering with Product Design, Global and Plant Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Warranty teams, you will proactively reduce and eliminate data\-driven quality issues and manufacturing risks, enhance process robustness, and reinforce quality systems through robust PFMEAs, Control Plans, and standardized documentation. In this role, you will provide technical leadership, coach cross\-functional teams, audit quality processes, and champion operational excellence to deliver flawless product launches, maximize customer satisfaction, and significantly reduce warranty and manufacturing losses. **Responsibilities:** Work directly with PTME and Global Quality teams to improve manufacturing system performance, update standard documents, enhance FMA process robustness, and lead continuous improvement training initiatives. Key responsibilities include: * **FMA \& Quality Deliverables:** Assist in the development, review, and maintenance of Process FMA deliverables—including PFMEAs and Control Plans—to ensure alignment with corporate standards. * Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis: Support root cause analysis and permanent corrective action (PCA/PRA) processes using structured problem\-solving tools such as 3\-Legged 5\-Why (3L5Y), 8D, and A3\. * **Launch \& Warranty Support:** Conduct launch quality and warranty deep\-dive reviews; to help identify recurring failure modes, risk areas, lessons learned, potential systemic improvements and ultimately support warranty reduction workstreams. * **Lessons Learned \& Best Practices:** Collaborate with cross\-functional partners (Product Development, Plant Quality, and Global Engineering) to support the development and implementation of best practices, drive continuous improvement and issue resolution document and cascade Quality Operating System (QOS) lessons learned into forward\-model programs. * **Continuous Improvement Across Operations:** Support the update and enhancement of production quality tools/systems, training materials, and data analysis methods/reporting across manufacturing engineering, including DRIM maintenance. * **Plant Support \& Travel:** Approximately 25% Travel (Michigan, Windsor, Canada, Ohio) to Powertrain Manufacturing Plants as required (including occasional overnight stays) to support launch teams, deep dives, and plant quality initiatives. Note: Training will be provided for the above responsibilities and associated systems as needed. **Requirements:** * **Education \& Technical Experience:** Bachelor of Applied Science in Engineering degree (or equivalent) with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing engineering discipline. * **Plant \& Quality Background:** Proven manufacturing and quality experience in a plant manufacturing environment, including direct experience in APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), PFMEA development, and Control Plans. * **Problem Solving \& Analytics:** Strong leadership, analytical, and structured problem\-solving skills paired with an innovative, continuous improvement mindset. * **Communication \& Coaching:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to teach, coach, and effectively present technical materials to peers and various levels of PTME leadership. * Teamwork \& Flexibility: Strong interpersonal skills with a proven track record of collaborating effectively within diverse, dynamic, cross\-functional teams. * **Self\-Motivation \& Agility:** Fast learner with the self\-motivation and initiative to proactively acquire technical knowledge independently via online documents and cross\-functional networking to master complex data and processes. **Preferred Requirments:** * **Ford Quality Systems Expertise:** Demonstrated technical knowledge of Ford Quality Processes, such as Ford Quality Operating System (QOS), Process FMA (SCCAF/SCCP, FMEA, Control Plans), Bill of Process (BOP), Quality Launch Readiness Assessments, 3\-Legged 5\-Why Problem Solving, DMAIC, and Global 8D methodologies. * **Six Sigma Certification:** Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. * **Core Ford Systems Knowledge:** jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer, Advanced Product Development
jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form's Advanced Product Development team is responsible for architecting and designing the next generation of our iron\-air battery system — the cell, module, pack, and the support systems that keep them running reliably for decades in the field. We work ahead of our production programs, translating breakthrough electrochemistry and system requirements into mechanical designs that can scale to high\-volume manufacturing. We're hiring a Staff Mechanical Engineer to develop the mechanical design of subsystems within our next\-generation battery and support systems. You will take ownership of thermal, fluid, and/or structural subsystem design, applying first\-principles modeling and analysis, building first\-of\-a\-kind designs for experimentation and verification testing, and iterating toward our next energy storage product. You'll work closely with battery scientists, materials engineers, electrical and controls engineers, and manufacturing engineers, bringing in\-depth subsystem expertise to the toughest interdisciplinary trade\-offs. *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Own the mechanical design of one or more subsystems (thermal, fluid handling, or structural) within next\-generation energy storage systems, from concept through system verification * Contribute to high\-leverage trade\-offs across subsystem interfaces — performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability — exercising judgment with guidance from senior/principal engineers on the most ambiguous calls * Build first\-principles analytical models that inform subsystem design decisions * Plan and execute first\-of\-a\-kind prototype builds and test campaigns to validate subsystem\-level design choices * Partner with manufacturing engineering on design\-for\-manufacturing and design\-for\-cost for the components and assemblies you own * Represent mechanical engineering in cross\-functional design reviews with electrochemistry, controls, program management, and compliance * Engage with vendors on sourcing and early\-stage development of novel components * Drive workflows using AI to increase speed and efficiency of the team * Champion safety, especially when introducing new lab processes, prototype hardware, or test methods ### **What you'll bring:** * Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field; Bachelor's with 7–10 years, or advanced degree with equivalent experience, in mechanical design of complex electromechanical or fluid/thermal systems * Demonstrated ownership of subsystem\-level design — including trade\-offs across thermal, fluid, and structural interfaces * Strong first\-principles grounding in thermo\-fluid systems, with experience translating analytical models into design decisions * Experience taking components or subsystems from early\-stage concept through manufacturing * Growing technical leadership — comfortable guiding junior engineers or leading focused workstreams (may coordinate or lead the work of other engineers) * Comfort operating with ambiguity in an early\-stage environment ramping toward production, with urgency to hit demanding schedule targets * Strong ownership mentality; eager to roll up sleeves and get hands\-on with hardware when necessary * Experience in energy storage, batteries, or another safety\-critical, highly regulated hardware industry is a plus *\#LI\-Onsite* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.* *To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.* *If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* *Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.* Compensation Range: $147,959 \- $221,973

jobs.description: **About Us** At FurtherAI, we’re building the AI agents that run insurance — a trillion\-dollar industry still powered by manual work. We are a deeply technical company. Both founders are engineers, and engineers have an outsized say on product direction. Now, we’re looking for an exceptional AI Engineer to own how we evaluate and continuously improve the quality of AI agents across our platform. **Why Join Us** * **Outsized ambition:** We’re out to build the definitive AI company for insurance — and we’re moving faster than anyone in the space. * **Elite team:** Founders and engineers from the best companies and schools in the world — ex\-Apple AI Research, Brex, Coinbase, and Uber; 4 YC founders and 6 ex\-founders; grads of Stanford, Berkeley, IITs, and Cornell. * **Massive market impact:** Insurance is the backbone of global commerce. Our work reshapes how the industry operates. * **Founder’s mindset:** Own big pieces of the product from day one — ideal if you want to start your own company one day. **What You’ll Do** * **Own evaluations across FurtherAI:** Build the evaluation frameworks and infrastructure that measure the accuracy, quality, and reliability of our AI agents across workflows, Assistant, document processing, and computer use. * **Build high\-quality datasets:** Develop golden datasets, benchmarks, and regression suites, working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers and domain experts to capture real\-world insurance tasks and edge cases. * **Evaluate complex agent behavior:** Design evaluations for multi\-step agent trajectories, tool use, reasoning, and end\-to\-end task completion — not just individual LLM responses. * **Build automated grading systems:** Develop LLM\-as\-judge evaluations, deterministic graders, human evaluation workflows, and rubrics that accurately reflect real\-world quality. * **Make development evaluation\-driven:** Integrate offline and online evaluations into development and release processes so engineers can measure improvements, catch regressions, and ship confidently. * **Drive model evaluation and selection:** Continuously benchmark frontier and open\-weight models across accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability. Use results to inform model selection, upgrades, and production releases. * **Build continuous improvement loops:** Turn production failures, customer feedback, and agent traces into new evaluation cases and measurable improvements in agent quality. **Representative Projects** * Build an end\-to\-end evaluation framework for FurtherAI agents, measuring success across multi\-step workflows, tool calls, and complex insurance tasks. * Create a library of golden datasets and benchmarks for common insurance workflows, reusable across customer implementations and out\-of\-the\-box AI skills. * Build an automated benchmarking system that evaluates new frontier and open\-weight model releases and identifies the best models for different tasks. * Develop production evaluation pipelines that detect quality regressions, identify failure patterns, and turn them into actionable improvements. **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on experience building production AI/ML systems. * Experience building evaluation frameworks, LLM\-based applications, model benchmarking systems, or applied AI infrastructure. * Strong understanding of modern LLMs, agent architectures, evaluation methodologies, and model performance tradeoffs. * Strong Python engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, production\-grade systems. * Ability to independently own ambiguous technical problems, from research and experimentation through production. * Clear communicator — both in person and in writing. * Bonus: Experience with LLM\-as\-judge, human evaluation systems, agent trajectory evaluations, or large\-scale benchmarking. * Bonus: Experience with open\-weight models, fine\-tuning, post\-training, or model routing. * Bonus: Background in B2B SaaS and 0\-to\-1 experience. * Above all: drive, grit, and ownership. We’re looking for someone who wants to build something transformative. If you thrive in environments where the pace is fast, expectations are high, and the rewards are outsized, you’ll love it here. **You can look forward to the following benefits:** * Fully covered, best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision benefits * Competitive compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k) * Unlimited PTO * Outstanding in\-office culture in the heart of San Francisco, 5x per week * Lunch and dinner onsite * Team events, such as happy hours and off\-sites * Pre\-tax commuter benefits Compensation Range: $300K \- $350K
