jobs.title: Hempcrete Materials Research - (Piovesan)
jobs.description: **Posting Number** **Division** School of Engineering and Computing **Department** Col. of Engineering \& Business **Location** Erie, Pa **Position Summary** As a student research assistant on this Pennsylvania Manufacturing Innovation\-funded project, you will participate in the development and characterization of hempcrete and hemp\-based construction materials intended for use under demanding thermal and environmental conditions. The research will focus on understanding how the physical characteristics of hemp, material formulation, moisture absorption, and exposure to elevated temperatures affect hempcrete performance. Students will prepare experimental specimens, characterize hemp feedstocks, conduct controlled thermal and moisture testing, analyze experimental data, and assist in identifying material combinations that provide improved resistance to heat while maintaining desirable water\-absorption and insulation characteristics. This interdisciplinary project combines materials science, sustainable construction, thermal sciences, manufacturing, and experimental engineering. Students will gain hands\-on experience with sustainable building materials and may contribute to technical reports, conference presentations, peer\-reviewed publications, and potentially patentable innovations. **Career Readiness Learning Objectives** **Critical Thinking** – Student researchers will review scientific and technical literature, identify relevant material parameters, develop test methods, analyze experimental results, compare alternative hempcrete formulations, and determine which material characteristics most strongly influence thermal and moisture performance. **Communication** – Student researchers will develop technical writing and presentation skills by maintaining laboratory documentation, preparing figures and data summaries, contributing to project reports and manuscripts, and presenting results during project meetings and research events. **Teamwork** – Students will work as part of an interdisciplinary research team involving engineering, science, manufacturing, and sustainable\-materials applications. Students may also be expected to present findings from their work at **Celebrate Gannon** or another appropriate undergraduate research venue. **Key Responsibilities** **Hemp Feedstock Characterization** * Characterize hemp hurd and other hemp\-based raw materials used in hempcrete formulations. * Evaluate characteristics such as particle size, particle\-size distribution, bulk density, moisture content, morphology, and water absorption. * Investigate how hemp source, particle dimensions, processing, and preparation affect material performance. * Prepare and document hemp samples using controlled drying, conditioning, screening, or other preprocessing methods. * Assist in identifying hemp characteristics associated with improved thermal resistance and moisture\-management properties. **Hempcrete Formulation and Specimen Preparation** * Prepare hempcrete specimens using controlled combinations of hemp, binder, additives, and water. * Investigate the effects of hemp\-to\-binder ratio, water\-to\-binder ratio, material density, compaction, particle size, and other formulation parameters. * Fabricate specimens using standardized molds and repeatable laboratory procedures. * Measure specimen mass, dimensions, density, curing conditions, and other relevant physical properties. * Maintain accurate records of material batches and specimen preparation conditions. **High\-Temperature Testing** * Assist with controlled exposure of hempcrete specimens to elevated temperatures. * Study how temperature and exposure duration affect hempcrete structure and material properties. * Record specimen temperatures using thermocouples, infrared measurement systems, or other appropriate instrumentation. * Evaluate dimensional changes, mass loss, cracking, discoloration, degradation, and other observable effects following thermal exposure. * Compare the thermal response of different hempcrete formulations and hemp feedstocks. * Assist in determining which formulations retain desirable characteristics after high\-temperature exposure. **Moisture and Water\-Absorption Testing** * Measure water uptake and moisture absorption of hemp and hempcrete specimens. * Perform controlled immersion, humidity\-conditioning, drying, and gravimetric experiments. * Develop moisture\-absorption curves and compare absorption and drying behavior among different formulations. * Investigate relationships between hemp characteristics, material porosity, density, and water retention. * Evaluate formulations intended to provide increased water absorption or moisture\-buffering capacity while maintaining acceptable structural integrity. **Thermal and Physical Characterization** * Assist in measuring thermal conductivity, temperature gradients, heating and cooling response, or related thermal properties where appropriate. * Evaluate density, dimensional stabili ping experimental procedures and test fixtures as needed. **Experimental Design and Data Analysis** * Organize experimental datasets using spreadsheets or engineering\-analysis software. * Calculate material properties and summarize results using tables, plots, and statistical comparisons. * Assist in designing experiments to determine the effects of multiple material variables. * Identify trends linking hemp characteristics and hempcrete formulation to temperature resistance and water absorption. * Compare experimental findings with published research and relevant technical literature. **Laboratory and Safety Responsibilities** * Follow laboratory safety procedures when operating ovens, furnaces, heating equipment, cutting tools, mixers, instrumentation, and other laboratory equipment. * Use appropriate personal protective equipment. * Maintain clean and organized laboratory work areas. * Properly label, store, and document experimental materials and specimens. * Work under faculty supervision when conducting elevated\-temperature experiments. **Documentation and Reporting** * Maintain detailed laboratory notebooks and electronic experimental records. * Photograph and document specimens before and after testing. * Prepare graphs, tables, photographs, and technical summaries. * Participate in regular project meetings. * Contribute to progress reports, technical reports, conference presentations, manuscripts, and other project deliverables. * Present research findings internally and, when appropriate, at external research events. **Benefits** * Gain applied research experience in sustainable construction materials and advanced manufacturing. * Develop hands\-on experience with hempcrete and bio\-based composite materials. * Learn laboratory techniques for thermal, moisture, and materials characterization. * Gain experience in experimental design and engineering data analysis. * Develop skills applicable to careers in materials engineering, manufacturing, construction, sustainability, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, and product development. * Participate in interdisciplinary research involving engineering and science. * Potentially contribute to publications, presentations, technical reports, and intellectual\-property development. Prior experience with hempcrete is **not required**. **Required Qualifications** * Interest in sustainable materials, engineering, manufacturing, construction materials, or experimental research. * Willingness to perform hands\-on laboratory work. * Ability to follow written experimental and safety procedures. * Ability to accurately document experimental activities and results. * Willingness to work independently and as part of a research team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Coursework or experience in heat transfer, thermodynamics, materials science, chemistry, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, manufacturing, or related fields. * Familiarity with laboratory testing or experimental methods. * Experience with Microsoft Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar data\-analysis tools. * Familiarity with CAD, fabrication, or experimental fixture design. * Experience using temperature sensors, data\-acquisition equipment, laboratory ovens, or materials\-testing equipment. * Strong organizational and technical documentation skills. **Physical Demands** The position involves laboratory and materials\-processing activities. Students should be able to safely lift up to 50 pounds when necessary and sit or stand for extended periods. Work may involve handling dry hemp materials, binders, molds, laboratory equipment, and cured specimens. Appropriate personal protective equipment will be required for specific laboratory activities. Posting Detail Information **Number of Vacancies** 1 **Job Posting Open Date** 10/08/2026 **Job Posting Close Date** 12/08/2026 **Special Instructions to Applicants** If you have any questions about this position, please contact Dr. Davide Piovesan at piovesan001@gannon.edu.

Their work enables engineering, calibration, and verification teams to validate embedded\-platform software earlier and with greater confidence, supporting daily regression testing as well as complex, multi\-variant, multi\-domain virtual validation. Within the broader Virtualization and SIL Integration organization, the team collaborates closely with domain teams to deliver high\-fidelity virtual environments and advance GM’s software\-defined vehicle development process. **The Role:** As a **Staff Software Engineer** , you will define the architecture for GM’s next‑generation virtual development platform, including SIL orchestration, AI‑enhanced simulation, data flows, and cloud‑native compute. You’ll build on your strengths in automation, embedded systems, and debugging while expanding into cloud orchestration, IaC, ML workflows, and distributed simulation systems. **What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):** * Architect distributed simulation systems for vECUs, FMUs, and SIL/MIL workloads, ensuring scalable execution across heterogeneous environments. * Define AI ‑ enabled simulation patterns including scenario generation, model‑based inference, and data pipelines. * Design cloud ‑ native compute platforms optimized for large‑scale parallel, and elastically scalable simulation workloads. * Establish API and service architecture for orchestration and data management. * Guide CI/CD integration for simulation and AI components. * Mentor developers and influence technical direction across teams. Ensure security, observability, and reliability across the platform. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications):** * Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. * 10\+ years of relevant experience in software architecture, simulation, or distributed systems. * Expertise in backend and distributed systems. * Experience with virtualization and simulation (vECUs, FMUs, SIL). * Strong cloud architecture skills. * Experience with CLI\-based architecture and MCP\-based architecture for AI tools design. * Experience with ontology\-based system design and architecture. * AI/ML integration experience for simulation or data workflows. * Knowledge of data engineering and storage patterns. Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration. * **What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):** * Experience designing simulation platforms at enterprise scale. * Knowledge of automotive domain modeling and ontology. * Experience with event ‑ driven architectures for simulation workflows. * Experience with Agentic AI architecture and multi\-agent coordination. * Advanced knowledge of ontology technologies and ontology design patterns (Owl, RDF, SPARQL, Automated reasoning) Advanced ML workflow experience (feature stores, model serving, vector DBs). * **Company Vehicle** Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, though which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies. **Compensation** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. **Bonus Potential** An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. **Benefits** GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. \#LI\-DH2 \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is based remotely, but if the selected candidate lives within a specific mile radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week {or other frequency dictated by your manager}.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Relocation benefits are available for candidates who qualify under company policy.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Systems Administrator **Job Summary:** The Kansas City Royals are committed to creating a first\-class experience for our fans, employees, players, and partners. We offer a fast\-paced, collaborative environment where every team member contributes to the success of our organization, the experiences of our fans, and the impact we make throughout our community. We are seeking a motivated Systems Administrator to join our Enterprise Technology team. This role will focus on the administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Microsoft technology environment, while also supporting Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), virtualization, networking, backup, and other core technology services. Position Accountabilities/Responsibilities Microsoft Systems Administration * Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, licensing, and related collaboration services. * Administer Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including users, groups, permissions, authentication, MFA, Conditional Access, Group Policy, and identity lifecycle management. * Support Microsoft Intune and endpoint management, including device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, security policies, and device lifecycle management. * Support Microsoft Defender and Microsoft security services, including endpoint protection, identity security, email security, monitoring, and remediation. * Monitor, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve the Microsoft environment while supporting tenant configuration, service health, security, licensing, and adoption of new Microsoft technologies. Windows \& Infrastructure Administration * Administer and support Windows Server and virtual server environments, including VMware, Hyper\-V, and related infrastructure. * Support core infrastructure services including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file services, permissions, and authentication. * Administer and support the organization's IPTV system, including channel configuration, receivers, and content delivery. * Support and maintain infrastructure monitoring and alerting tools to monitor system health, availability, performance, and capacity. * Administer and monitor enterprise file storage and server backup/recovery systems, including backup jobs, retention, backup validation, restore testing, and data recovery. * Support Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud environments, as well as related infrastructure, connectivity, monitoring, and system integrations. Security, Compliance \& Lifecycle Management * Support system security and hardening, including vulnerability remediation, security configuration, MFA, Conditional Access, and endpoint security. * Perform server and endpoint patching, software updates, and routine maintenance. * Support technology lifecycle management, including hardware refreshes, operating system upgrades, software deployments, and system migrations. * Participate in backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities, including testing and recovery validation. Implementation \& Operations * Execute routine infrastructure and Microsoft 365 changes in accordance with established change management processes. * Assist with building, configuring, maintaining, and supporting development, test, and production environments. * Participate in technology projects involving Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Windows Server, Intune, security, cloud services, and infrastructure. * Participate in on\-call rotation and provide technical support during games, special events, and other critical organizational activities as needed. * Develop automation and administrative efficiencies using PowerShell and Microsoft management tools where appropriate. * Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Position Qualifications, Skills, and Experience Required * 2–4 years of experience in systems administration, Microsoft 365 administration, infrastructure support, cloud administration, or a related technology environment. * Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, and licensing. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including users, groups, authentication, MFA, permissions, Group Policy, and identity lifecycle management. * Experience with Exchange Online administration and troubleshooting, including mailboxes, distribution groups, shared mailboxes, permissions, and mail flow. * Experience with or working knowledge of Microsoft Intune and endpoint management. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft security technologies preferred. * Basic to intermediate experience administering Windows Server, including DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, Group Policy, file services, and system troubleshoo ucture and cloud environments. * Basic networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless connectivity, and network troubleshooting. * Experience with backup/recovery, endpoint management, monitoring, vulnerability management, patch management, or security tools preferred. * Experience supporting multiple locations or distributed technology environments preferred. Professional Capabilities * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues and follow them through resolution. * Ability to independently administer and troubleshoot Microsoft technologies while appropriately escalating complex issues. * Strong understanding of identity, access, security, and system administration principles. * Ability to learn new Microsoft technologies and adapt to changes in the Microsoft 365 and cloud ecosystem. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment, including during games and major events. * Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong customer service mindset and ability to collaborate across departments. * High degree of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and sound judgment. * Ability to work occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on organizational and event needs. Preferred Certifications * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Microsoft 365 Administrator * Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator * Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator * Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals * AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect * Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer * CompTIA Server\+, Network\+, or Security\+ * Other relevant Microsoft, cloud, or infrastructure certifications **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to lift items weighing as much as 50 pounds * Must be able to be productive utilizing a computer keyboard and telephone * Must be able to be productive in a work environment where the noise level can be high at times * Must be comfortable walking to navigate the facility to access the office, concourse, etc. * Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as required by deadlines and event scheduling The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This role is a Full\-Time, Exempt opportunity that is eligible for Company Benefits, 401K, and PTO. This role is expected to have a standard 40\-hour work week. We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, the Kansas City Royals will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, the Club also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions please inquire with Human Resources by email at humanresources@royals.com. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Lead Risk Data Scientist & ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Job Posting Description** **Ready to take your career global?** Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We are seeking a hands\-on **Lead Risk Data Scientist \& ML Engineer** to own the full lifecycle of fraud detection and risk models. This role combines deep data science expertise with practical AI/agentic workflow experience and the infrastructure knowledge needed to ship at scale. **What You’ll Own** In this role, you'll own the end\-to\-end delivery of detection models and AI\-assisted workflows that power fraud, credit, and AML risk operations. You'll drive model performance through the full lifecycle, from design and validation through production deployment and continuous optimization. You'll translate regulatory requirements and operational needs into detection strategies and technical execution plans, partner across Risk, Compliance, and Technology to ensure alignment, and lead project teams through complex, ambiguous detection challenges. This is a hands\-on role that combines deep technical leadership with pragmatic problem\-solving in a small, high\-impact team. **Model Development \& Deployment (End\-to\-End)** * Own the full lifecycle of ML models: design, development, validation, deployment, and serving in production * Lead model performance monitoring and continuous refinement using production data and investigation outcomes * Ensure models are explainable, auditable, and aligned with regulatory expectations * Design and oversee scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines supporting model development and serving **AI \& Agentic Workflows** * Design and deploy AI\-assisted analyst workflows using LLMs and agentic frameworks * Guide the development of agent\-based systems that augment human decision\-making in risk operations * Work at the pilot/proof\-of\-concept stage, establishing best practices for scale **Detection Strategy \& Performance** * Define and refine detection strategies based on emerging fraud patterns and regulatory requirements * Maintain and monitor key performance metrics (precision, recall, false positives, alert quality) * Influence tradeoff decisions between detection coverage, operational cost, and false positive rates **Governance \& Regulatory Alignment** * Define governance standards for model development, validation, documentation, and change management * Ensure compliance with regulatory expectations (BSA/AML, OFAC, FinCEN, SR 11\-7\) * Partner with Model Risk Management and Compliance to support validation and regulatory reviews **Cross\-Functional Partnership** * Serve as the primary technical partner to Fraud Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams * Translate regulatory and operational requirements into technical execution plans * Drive alignment across teams to enable effective detection capability implementation **Team Leadership \& Project Ownership** * Lead cross\-functional project teams through ML model and AI workflow development, from conception to deployment * Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and delivery accountability for project work * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to data scientists and engineers executing on risk initiatives * Build and strengthen team capabilities across detection modeling, data engineering, and AI/agentic systems **What you’ll bring:** **Experience** * 7\+ years in data science, machine learning or MLOps * Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining detection models (fraud, AML, or credit risk) in production environments * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted workflows, LLMs, and agentic frameworks (including pilot\-stage deployments) * Experience in regulated financial services or fintech environments preferred * Exposure to model risk management frameworks (SR 11\-7\) and regulatory interactions **Technical \& Domain Expertise** * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL * MLOps experience: Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD practices, model monitoring, retraining pipelines, infrastructure automation * Hands\-on experience with data science platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS SageMaker) * AWS ecosystem expertise: SageMaker, Glue, Lambda, EventBridge, and related services * Familiarity with LLM and agentic frameworks: foundational models (Claude, GPT, etc.), agent orchestration tools (AWS AgentCore, LangChain, etc.) * Understanding of fraud typologies, AML transaction monitoring methodologies, and detection system design **Leadership Profile** * Resourceful and versatile: thrives in a small, fast\-moving team; comfortable wearing multiple hats and delivering with constrained resources * Startup mentality: pragmatic problem\-solver who ships solutions; bias toward execution and measurable outcomes * Combines technical depth with collaborative leadership. Guides project teams through ambiguous problems and drives clarity, structure, and delivery * Collaborates effectively across Risk, Compliance, and Technology functions; comfortable operating in ambiguity and translating strategy into action **About the team** Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. **What makes a Globalpayer?** Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative –always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do. \#LI\-BJ1 **EEOC Statement** Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here. If you are made a conditional offer of employment and will be working in the United States, you will be required to undergo a drug test. In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies and requirements needed to successfully perform the position. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for individuals with qualified disabilities both during the hiring process, as well as to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, if hired. Washington Candidates: Click here for information on the Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Data Center Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Our Information Technology team builds, maintains, and continuously improves the infrastructure supporting our trading and business operations. We value technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and efficient service delivery. GTS is a collection of financial services companies spanning a wide array of asset classes and investment approaches, all powered by the combination of market expertise with innovative, proprietary technology. With roots as a quantitative trading firm continually building for the future, the GTS family of companies are able to leverage the latest in artificial intelligence systems and sophisticated pricing models to bring consistency, efficiency, and transparency to today’s financial markets. GTS’s electronic market maker GTS Securities accounts for 3\-5% of daily cash equities volume in the U.S. and is a leading Designated Market Maker (DMM) at the New York Stock Exchange, responsible for nearly $13 trillion of market capitalization. For more information on GTS, please visit www.gtsx.com. GTS is seeking a hands\-on Data Center Engineer to support the deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational reliability of our physical technology infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings strong server hardware, cabling, networking, and data center operations experience, along with the ability to respond effectively to time\-sensitive issues in a high\-availability environment. This role requires flexibility to work a nontraditional schedule, as much of our infrastructure maintenance and deployment activity takes place after the financial markets close. Typical working hours begin around 12:00 p.m. and extend until approximately 8:00–9:00 p.m., with daily variations based on operational needs. Occasional weekend work is also required. Responsibilities: * Serve as a primary technical contact for data center infrastructure issues, responding to incidents, service tickets, and hardware failures with urgency and precision. * Install, rack, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and replace servers, network equipment, components, and associated hardware. * Deploy, test, label, troubleshoot, and maintain copper, twinax, AOC, and fiber\-optic cabling, ensuring clean and organized installations. * Manage rack\-level power distribution, load balancing, and redundancy in accordance with operational best practices. * Diagnose hardware, connectivity, and basic Linux/networking issues, collaborating with engineering and IT teams to resolve complex problems. * Maintain accurate asset inventories, coordinate equipment shipping and receiving, and oversee hardware installations, replacements, and decommissioning. * Coordinate with vendors, colocation providers, and remote smart\-hands teams to support infrastructure operations. * Maintain organized, secure, and operationally ready data center environments, including racks, cabling, equipment, and work areas. * Follow, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures, technical documentation, ticketing workflows, and incident\-resolution processes. * Support infrastructure projects and operational activities across NY/NJ data center locations. Qualifications: * 5 \+ years of Data Center Experience, financial services or telecommunications preferred. * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. * Experience installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise servers and network hardware. * Server management (iDRAC, iLO, IPMI) and component swaps (drives, memory, PSUs, NICs). * Proficiency with copper, twinax, AOC, and fiber\-optic cabling, including termination, testing, labeling, and troubleshooting. Single\-mode and multi\-mode fiber, LC/MPO connectors, SFP/QSFP optics, fiber cleaning and inspection. * Working knowledge of rack\-level power distribution, redundancy, and equipment installation best practices. * Foundational networking knowledge and familiarity with common network troubleshooting commands and cable\-testing tools. (TCP/IP, VLANs, link troubleshooting, ping/traceroute/ethtool, Dark Fiber). * Working knowledge of Linux systems and basic command\-line operations. (logs, interfaces, hardware status). * Ability to diagnose issues involving both hardware and software and work effectively with specialized engineering teams. * Experience with ticketing systems, inventory management, technical documentation, and vendor coordination. * Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, communication, and ability to remain effective under pressure. * Valid driver's license, access to a vehicle, and willingness to travel throughout the NY/NJ tri\-state area. * Ability to safely lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Flexibility to work a later\-day schedule (typically 12:00 p.m.–8:00/9:00 p.m.), with varying hours and occasional weekend work based on operational requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting data center infrastructure within financial services, electronic trading, broker\-dealers, or other capital markets environments. *In accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $165,000\. Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits.* **Benefits:** Core Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage with generous employer contribution for employees and dependents. 401k match. Perks: Daily Meal Allowance, Equinox Corporate Membership Rate, Snacks, Office Game Room, Casual Dress. Hybrid Work Policy: 4 Days a Week in office, Fridays can be worked from home. *Please note: The use of AI tools during interviews is strictly prohibited, unless explicitly agreed upon.* All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Unsolicited resumes: We do not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with GTS.

such as RAG, prompt engineering, model APIs, or agentic workflows. * Relevant Java, AWS, Kubernetes, or cloud certifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Front End JavaScript / TypeScript Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ ### **About the Company** GoGoGrandparent’s (GoGo’s) mission is to help older adults live independently in their home for as long as possible. We do that by tailoring existing on demand apps to the needs of people living with mobility, visual, cognitive and dexterity impairments and letting older adults use them by making a phone call. After ordering, our service becomes a virtual caregiver that monitors the instrumental activities of daily living (mobility, meals, groceries, medication delivery \& home management) for tens of thousands of older adults around the United States. We’re profitable, have been around since 2016 \& haven’t raised any venture capital financing to date. The company was inspired by the cofounder’s grandmother, who still uses us to this day (she’s turning 95 in March)! Our engineering team is fully remote, tight\-knit, and moves fast. You’ll work closely with founders, ship meaningful features weekly, and have real ownership over architecture, reliability, and product direction. * **This is a fully remote position** **\*** **Must be able to work US timezones or 4\+ hours overlap with mainland US** ### **Job Summary** We have a Webflow designer who owns layout and CMS. He does not write JavaScript. You will own everything that makes our Webflow pages work: registration, payments, service checks, analytics, cookies, and talking to our APIs. You will also take the code from concatenated ES5/jQuery to TypeScript with a real build pipeline, without breaking production landing pages. You are not a backend hire. You are expected to read our Node/TypeScript/GraphQL/REST API well enough to decide which endpoint to call, what to send, what comes back, and what happens when it fails. We do not have complete, trustworthy API documentation for this. The source, and its tests, is the documentation. You need to be comfortable communicating and working directly with our marketing team and other company stakeholders. ### **What you will actually do** Product / integration * Wire Webflow forms and pages to existing REST and GraphQL endpoints: callers, loved ones, membership, Stripe payment, service\-area checks, grocery/home\-services leads, error logging. * Own multi\-step registration: validation, session persistence, step navigation, auth tokens, 401 handling, partner vs consumer flows. * Keep Stripe Elements, phone inputs, cookies, and tracking working across many landing\-page variants. * Coordinate with the Webflow person on DOM IDs, *required* attributes, and page structure. Our form reader is DOM\-driven; a wrong ID on a Webflow page is a production bug. * Take responsibility for our Playwright test coverage and add more tests as needed. Reading the backend (required, not optional) * Open the relevant route/controller in our backend (TypeScript, Express\-style routes, controllers, some GraphQL) and extract: HTTP method, path, auth, request body/query, success payload, error codes and shapes. * Use existing route tests as a second source of truth when the handler is messy. * Choose the right endpoint for the page (create vs patch, REST vs GraphQL, payment intent vs caller update). Calling the wrong one, or omitting a field the controller actually requires, is a failed task. * When the API cannot do what the page needs, write a clear request for backend (expected input/output, current behavior, what's missing). You will not be expected to own large backend changes. Engineering * Over time, migrate the codebase from JS IIFE modules to TypeScript. * Replace concat \+ Terser with a real bundler (esbuild/Vite/Rollup). * Untangle globals, jQuery, and implicit script order without a rewrite that takes the site down. ### **What the systems look like** Client * We use Webflow: a visual web design and development platform that lets you create, build, and host custom websites without writing manual production code, while also supporting custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for advanced functionality and customization. * Vanilla JS \+ jQuery, IIFEs, concatenated in a fixed file order. * Playwright tests already use TypeScript. App code does not. API * Large TypeScript Node service. Registration and billing are not a tiny CRUD layer; controllers have real business rules. * Auth is typically bearer tokens; some flows differ (partner vs consumer). * Error responses are not always uniform. You have to read the handler. ### **You Should Be Strong At** * JavaScript and TypeScript in the browser (DOM, events, fetch/XHR, cookies, localStorage, CORS). * Reading other people's TypeScript: routes, controllers, types, tests. You do not need to write production backend, but you cannot treat the API as a black box or wait for a spec. * Mapping a form to a real endpoint: required vs optional fields, nested payloads, auth headers, 4xx handling. Incremental migration: JS TS, globals* modules, without freezing feature work. * Build tooling: bundlers, source maps, minify, watch, CI. * Working with a designer who does not write JS: explicit contracts (element IDs, data attributes). * Playwright or similar for user flows. * Nice to Have: Stripe.js, Webflow custom code, analytics pixels, GraphQL, having changed a small backend endpoint yourself. ### **Seniority** Mid to Senior level. With over 125\+ condition\-specific online communities and 15 years of community leadership, Health Union’s authentic engagements fuel the company’s robust suite of endemic media, influencer marketing, market research, and data solutions, driving proven outcomes for patients, HCPs, and brands. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help build and evolve the data pipelines and platform capabilities that power our enterprise data environment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Enterprise Data Platforms and working closely with our data engineering pod leads and team members, you will design and build robust data pipelines, implement data models, and ensure the reliability, quality, and compliance of the data we deliver. You will be a hands\-on senior engineer who executes against the technical direction and roadmap set by our data leadership. Strong hands\-on expertise with Snowflake and core AWS data services is essential. Experience with dbt, Python, and advanced SQL is highly valued, along with solid performance\-tuning, optimization, and data\-validation skills. **What You Do:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using AWS, Snowflake, Python, and dbt, from ingestion through transformation and delivery. * Translate functional requirements into clear technical designs and well\-structured, high\-quality code, complete with unit testing and documentation. * Implement and evolve data models and transformation layers (dbt on Snowflake), following the standards and technical direction set by data leadership. * Optimize data workflows for performance, scalability, cost, and reliability. * Safeguard the accuracy and integrity of our data through meticulous analysis, rigorous testing, data profiling, and problem resolution. * Support data security, governance, and privacy practices to ensure appropriate use of data and compliance with company policies. * Partner with analytics, software engineering, product, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver sound, maintainable solutions. * Participate in code reviews and share knowledge with peers to help maintain a high bar for engineering quality. * Contribute to quarterly and sprint planning for Data Engineering activities, and communicate progress and trade\-offs clearly across project teams. * Automate and improve aspects of our data platform to enhance efficiency and output. * Stay current with technologies and best practices in the data engineering space, and bring ideas back to the team. **What You Bring:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience, with strong, recent production experience on Snowflake and core AWS data services as the primary platform, for example S3, Lambda, MWAA/Apache Airflow for orchestration, and streaming/ingestion services such as Kinesis or Snowpipe. Familiarity with a solid subset is what matters; depth over breadth. * Working knowledge of dbt for data modeling and transformation, Python, and advanced SQL (stored procedures, analytic functions), or the demonstrated ability to ramp quickly. * Strong command of modern data engineering and data warehousing concepts, including relational and non\-relational databases, data streams, and file stores, and of performance tuning, query optimization, data profiling, and validation. * Experience building and maintaining reliable, well\-tested data pipelines, with sound QA, testing, requirements\-gathering, and documentation practices. * Experience implementing CI/CD practices for data pipelines is a plus. * Understanding of data security, governance, and compliance principles as they apply to data platforms. * Openness to learning and adopting AI\-driven data platform practices and agentic workflows as this becomes a growing team focus; willingness to lean in matters more than extensive prior expertise. * Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, analytics, product, and business partners. * A self\-motivated, proactive mindset, strong logical reasoning, and a love for learning, with an eagerness to keep growing your skills and take on more as opportunities arise. * Experience in healthcare, ad tech, programmatic audiences, or related industries is a plus. We're a flat organization that allows everyone to have direct exposure to our leadership team. You enjoy working with others, are results\-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. **The Role** The Director of AI Platforms and Shared Services leads the strategy, system architecture, and hands\-on delivery of internal products that enable AI product engineering teams to build and operate AI applications and agents for business stakeholders. The director brings experience owning and evolving end\-to\-end systems and uses that perspective to address product team needs while partnering closely with Platform and Infrastructure teams to meet enterprise requirements. Success is measured by the usefulness and reliability of the internal products, reduced duplication across teams, and how easily engineers can move AI applications, agents, and models from experimentation into production. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Experience Required:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience spanning AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or cloud platform engineering, including significant ownership of production systems. * 3\+ years leading engineering teams, with continued hands\-on involvement in architecture, development, and technical problem solving. * Demonstrated experience designing, delivering, operating, and evolving end\-to\-end platforms or shared services used by multiple engineering teams. * Experience building production agent or AI systems, including evaluation, deployment, observability, and integration with enterprise systems. * Experience partnering with Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and product engineering teams to balance product needs with enterprise requirements. * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong system design skills, including distributed systems, service boundaries, application programming interfaces, design patterns, and tradeoffs across reliability, performance, security, and cost. * Strong Python development skills and experience building reusable libraries, services, and developer tools. * Experience with agent runtimes and orchestration, tool integration, memory and context management, retrieval, evaluation, and observability. * Experience with shared AI infrastructure, including inference services, embedding services, vector databases, and model deployment pipelines. * Understanding of AI and machine learning fundamentals and lifecycle capabilities, including registration, versioning, validation, deployment, monitoring, and explainability. * Experience with AWS and GCP, including deep production expertise in at least one. * Experience with Docker, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and continuous integration and continuous delivery. * Experience with agent interoperability protocols, feature stores, experimentation platforms, recommender systems, or forecasting systems preferred. The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all\-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary. **We welcome you:** Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better. The salary range for this position is $176,300 \- $235,000 The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Diagnostic Imaging \& Telemedicine** is seeking an analytics\-focused **Data Engineer** to serve as the technical owner and lead for the DI\&TM analytics data platform and semantic layer, a business\-critical data product supporting financial, clinical, operational, and strategic decision\-making. This role is accountable for defining and leading the technical direction, architecture, standards, and roadmap for the data foundation that enables analysts, operational leaders, business partners, applications, and AI\-enabled solutions to confidently access and use trusted data. The engineer treats the semantic layer as a strategic data product—establishing consistent definitions, relationships, business logic, data models, documentation, and reusable patterns that enable trusted metrics and datasets across multiple use cases. The role owns the technical evolution of this foundation and independently identifies opportunities to improve scalability, reliability, performance, automation, data quality, accessibility, and cost. The ideal candidate brings deep **expertise in data engineering and analytics engineering**, with specialized knowledge of database architecture, data modeling, modern transformation practices, and analytics platforms. The role requires the ability to interpret complex and ambiguous business and technical problems, evaluate trade\-offs, and recommend scalable solutions that may influence architecture and data practices beyond Diagnostic Imaging \& Telemedicine. The incumbent serves as a recognized technical expert and best\-practice resource for data modeling, dbt, Snowflake, SQL, and modern analytics engineering practices. This role provides technical leadership and mentorship to data analysts and engineers and establishes engineering standards and development practices across the group. Working with a high degree of autonomy, the role sets technical priorities in alignment with business objectives and operates independently except in the most complex or enterprise\-level situations. **This is a fully remote position with the opportunity to travel to our corporate headquarters.** **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * **Owns and leads the technical strategy and architecture for the DI\&T analytics data platform and semantic layer,** ensuring the data foundation can reliably support current and future financial, clinical, operational, and strategic business needs. * **Designs and develops scalable data models and curated datasets** that transform raw data into trusted, reusable data products for business, financial, clinical, and operational analytics. * **Defines and leads the architecture of the analytics semantic layer**, including standardized business logic, metrics, dimensions, relationships, and definitions that enable consistent and reliable reporting and analysis across Diagnostic Imaging and Telemedicine. * **Leads the development and evolution of reliable production data pipelines and transformation** processes integrating data from operational systems, data warehouses, integration hubs, data lakes, and other enterprise sources. * **Translates business and analytical requirements into scalable data solutions**, partnering closely with Business Analysts, Data Analysts, and operational stakeholders to understand needs and develop data products that are fit for purpose and reusable across multiple use cases. * **Solves complex cross\-system data problems where established patterns or precedents may not exist**, applying broad technical and business perspective to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and develop innovative solutions. * **Establishes and applies data modeling, engineering, and governance standards**, including naming conventions, documentation, data definitions, lineage, version control, testing, and development practices that improve the consistency and maintainability of the analytics environment. * **Ensures data quality, accuracy, reliability, and accessibility** by implementing validation, testing, monitoring, and error\-handling processes and proactively identifying and resolving data issues. * **Provides technical leadership and mentorship to data analysts, data engineers, and other technical team members,** raising the organization's capabilities in SQL, data modeling, Git, dbt, testing, documentation, and engineering practices. * **Serves as the recognized subject matter expert and best\-practice resource for data modeling, dbt, Snowflake, SQL, and analytics engineering** within Diagnostic Imaging \& Telemedicine and with partner teams across IDEXX. * **Monitors data pipeline and model performance**, identifies bottlenecks, failures, and gaps, and implements sustainable solutions that improve reliability and reduce manual intervention. * **Partners with technology and engineering teams to evolve the data architecture**, identifying opportunities to centralize fragmented data, automate manual workflows, improve system integration, a inability and can clearly articulate and defend architectural decisions. * Deep Snowflake or equivalent analytical platform experience, including analytics engineering, performance tuning, architecture, cost optimization, workload management, and data model design. * Advanced experience with dimensional, wide\-table, and hybrid modeling approaches, including designing models at the appropriate grain for scalable downstream analytics. * Expert SQL capabilities. This is a hands\-on technical role and requires continued development and review of production code. * Production data engineering experience, including building and maintaining pipelines, orchestration, monitoring, error handling, and operational support. Airflow or equivalent orchestration experience preferred. * Strong Git and CI/CD experience, including establishing and enforcing code review, branching, testing, deployment, and engineering discipline across a technical team. * Python or other scripting language experience preferred. * Experience applying AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude, Snowflake Cortex Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent technologies to improve engineering productivity and solution development. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical trade\-offs and make architecture decisions involving scalability, performance, cost, reliability, maintainability, and business value. * Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and system design across organizational boundaries while partnering with enterprise engineering and technology teams. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. * Strong understanding of data governance, data lineage, business definitions, naming conventions, metadata, and context engineering and their role in creating trusted and reusable data products. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and determine priorities with limited direction. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to address complex, ambiguous, and novel technical problems where established solutions may not exist. **What you can expect from us:** -------------------------------- * Salary of $140000 to $160000 * Opportunity for annual cash bonus * Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One * 5% matching 401k * Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and much more **Why IDEXX** ------------- We’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve, we follow our Purpose and Guiding Principles to help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, to ensure safe drinking water for billions, and to help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease. We have customers in over 175 countries and a global workforce of over 10,000 talented people. So, what does that mean for you? We enrich the livelihoods of our employees with a positive and respectful work culture that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you will be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement. **Let’s Pursue What Matters.** *IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.* *IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.* \#LI\-KS1

SQL, Python and PHP code for integrations, reports and internal web tools * Keep clear documentation for integrations and development ***Partnership and Governance*** * Partner with department leaders and teams to understand their business needs, then deliver the solution: configure an existing system, build an integration, or design a new tool on our internal web platform * Support validation, change control and audit needs for systems that hold quality and compliance data * Keep system documentation, runbooks and the system and integration inventory current **What Makes You a Great Fit** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 10\+ years in IT systems engineering, enterprise systems administration or a similar role, with at least 5 of those years hands\-on with cloud infrastructure * Strong Microsoft Azure experience: Azure SQL, VMs, networking, identity (Entra ID), and Azure Data Factory or a comparable integration and data pipeline tool * Experience administering an ERP system, ideally in a manufacturing or distribution business * A track record of building and supporting system integrations using REST APIs, SQL and at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell or similar) * Strong SQL skills, including writing queries, tuning performance and troubleshooting databases (Microsoft SQL Server / Azure SQL preferred) * Working knowledge of VMware, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Windows Server and Linux administration * Sound security habits: access control, secrets handling, backups and incident response * Clear communication with non\-technical users and leaders, and the ability to explain trade\-offs in plain language * The judgment to work independently and own outcomes, as a senior member of a small team * Curiosity and adaptability: a habit of learning new technology quickly, and a real interest in using AI to change how work gets done **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in an FDA\-regulated or cGMP manufacturing environment, including computer system validation and audit support * Hands\-on experience with LIMS, jobs.title: AI Principal Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The AI CoE Principal Software Engineer will report to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department. This role is the most senior individual contributor on the team and the technical owner of the enterprise AI engineering foundation, including the semantic router, model and harness hosting, the enterprise AI gateway, and the AI operations layer used across the business. The role is responsible for setting AI engineering architecture and standards and then building them, carrying a multi\-year capability roadmap from discovery through prototype, validation, and production scale. Primary duties include designing and building the shared AI platform and semantic routing layer; product inference and personalization, partnering with AI\-Ops on monitoring, evaluation, and governance guardrails; building secure, compliant AI integration patterns for a regulated financial services and health and benefits environments; leading agentic pipeline and multi\-agent orchestration work; delivering production AI services for CoE\-enabled business functions; developing reusable reference architectures for other engineering teams; managing AI unit economics; prototyping emerging AI capabilities; mentoring senior and lead engineers; and partnering with security, risk, compliance, and data governance. This role does not have direct reports. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Architect, build, and operate the shared enterprise AI platform, including core semantic data, model, harness, and hosting capability used across developer and in\-product personalization use cases. * Design and maintain intelligent request routing using semantic analysis and deterministic logic to direct requests to the best\-fit LLM, internal tool, or agentic pool, using cost, latency, and privacy as routing criteria. * Partner with AI\-Ops to enable metric\-based reporting, quality, performance, and drift monitoring across live systems, build model evaluation harnesses, and establish governance guardrails for safe AI use at scale. * Design and implement secure, compliant AI integration patterns appropriate for a regulated financial services environment. * Build and scale agentic pipelines and multi\-agent orchestration across the software development lifecycle, from pilot through measured engineering capacity across product teams. * Deliver production AI services supporting document intelligence and claims adjudication, conversational and voice self\-service, call intelligence, fraud and anomaly detection, and regulatory monitoring. * Develop reusable reference architectures and standard patterns so other engineering teams and embedded consultants can build AI solutions without rebuilding the foundation. * Evaluate unit economics for AI workloads, including cost per transaction, token and inference spend, latency budgets, and build\-versus\-buy and self\-host\-versus\-vendor decisions. * Identify and prototype emerging AI capabilities relevant to the business and technology roadmap, including fast, focused feasibility spikes with clear recommendations. * Lead hands\-on training sessions and pair directly with engineering teams on new development methods and prototype or pattern adoption. * Monitor the AI landscape and translate findings into roadmap recommendations on what to pilot, what to watch, and what to decline. * Set technical direction and standards for embedded AI consultants and the coaching network to scale AI delivery capacity beyond the CoE. * Mentor senior and lead engineers across business units, review AI designs, and serve as the escalation point for complex agentic and integration issues. * Partner with security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to support safe and compliant AI delivery. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science. * AI Practitioner Certifications are a plus * 12\+ years building and operating production software, including 4\+ years delivering production AI/ML systems and 2\+ years of LLM or agentic systems in production, with a track record as the most senior technical owner of an enterprise\-scale platform. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Architecting and operating production agentic workflows as state machines, including branching logic, retry and recovery paths, and precise control over multi\-step process flow. * Deep fluency with AI\-assisted development environments such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ONA, with a track record of driving adoption and measured impact across engineering teams. * Semantic routing and model orchestration, including embedding\-based intent analysis, deterministic fallback logic, and policy\-based model selection across multiple providers on cost, latency, and privacy criteria. * Observability and AI Ops for non\-deterministic systems, including distributed tracing, behavioral analysis, usage and quality metrics, drift detection,  and staff engineers, and communicating trade\-offs to executive stakeholders. * Ability to own a multi\-year capability roadmap, moving work from discovery through prototype, production validation, and scale against defined business metrics. * Ability to move fluidly between abstract system thinking and tactical, incremental delivery while managing stakeholders and delivering against a critical path. * Financial services, healthcare benefits, or other regulated industry experience preferred, with HSA/FSA, claims, custody, or payments domain exposure especially valuable. * Knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks preferred, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, model risk management, SOC 2, or HIPAA control environments. * Experience with rapid prototyping and feasibility assessment in an R\&D or innovation capacity preferred. * Experience facilitating technical learning sessions or pairing with engineers at varying skill levels preferred. * Multi\-agent system design experience preferred, including role assignment and coordination, agent\-to\-agent conversation patterns, and code execution loops for iterative problem solving. * API and integration experience across REST, event\-driven, and MCP patterns preferred, including integrating AI into systems of record and workflow platforms. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $152,700\-$205,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed \- we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application. *Our office locations are designed to bring people together, foster collaboration, and build meaningful connections. While some roles are based at one of our office locations, remote status and role locations are subject to change, and relocation is not provided.*

You'll own technical decisions across the stack and champion modern engineering practices including continuous delivery, automated testing, and infrastructure as code. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the design and implementation of full stack applications using .NET (C\#) and Blazor, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. * Actions, enabling teams to deploy frequently and safely with automated build, test, and release workflows. * Champion automated testing at all levels — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end — embedding jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Position Title: *Data Engineer* **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without sponsorship.** **Reporting Structure:** ======================== This position will be part of the Data Engineering group, reporting to the Director of Data Engineering. **About the role** John Burns Research and Consulting (JBREC) is a housing research and consulting firm. Builders, investors, and lenders use our data to make decisions about where and what to build. That data has to be right, consistent, and explainable. We are hiring a Data Engineer to help build our governed analytics layer in dbt. You will turn legacy SQL Server logic into tested, documented dbt models. You will also implement the metrics behind our client data feeds, dashboards, reports, and AI\-assisted analytics tools, and recommend how they should be structured. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. Most of your time will go to data modeling and metric implementation. The rest will go to keeping our newer pipelines reliable. **What you'll do:** **Build the governed model layer (about 50%)** * Build and maintain dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers, following team conventions for naming, grain, and documentation. * Migrate legacy SQL Server and T\-SQL logic into dbt. Reconcile new outputs against existing ones before cutover so client\-facing numbers don't move unexpectedly. * Write tests and data contracts that catch problems before clients or analysts do. * Document every model so its meaning, source, and owner are clear to anyone who reads it. **Implement metrics in the semantic layer (about 25%)** * Partner with research and data science to turn agreed business definitions into precise, testable implementations with explicit grain, dimensions, and calculation logic. * Recommend how metrics should be structured and implemented, and flag inconsistencies or ambiguities in existing definitions. * Maintain metrics in our semantic layer as the single source for client data feeds, dashboards, PDF reports, and natural\-language analytics tools. * Help retire legacy reporting by moving its metrics onto the governed layer one at a time. **Keep our newer pipelines reliable (about 25%)** * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines on our modern stack for third\-party vendor data and public data such as Census releases. * Own day\-to\-day reliability for those pipelines: monitoring, alerting, triage, and runbooks that let anyone on the team resolve issues. **Throughout** * Work in Git with code review and CI. Review teammates' code and expect yours to be reviewed. * Use AI coding tools effectively within our review and governance standards. **What you bring** * 3\+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, including at least 2 years building production dbt projects. * Strong SQL and dimensional modeling. You can explain why a model has the grain it has and what breaks if it changes. * Hands\-on experience with dbt testing, documentation, and project structure at scale (dozens to hundreds of models). * Experience migrating legacy SQL (stored procedures, views, T\-SQL) into a modern transformation layer, including validating that outputs match. * Working Python for ingestion, automation, and tooling. * Comfort with Git\-based workflows: branches, pull requests, code review, CI. * Clear writing. You document your work so others can use it without asking you. **Nice to have** * Experience with a semantic layer or metric framework (dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, Cube, LookML, or similar). * Experience supporting natural\-language or AI\-assisted analytics, where metric definitions must be unambiguous. * Familiarity with Azure data services and SQL Server. * Experience with housing, real estate, economic, or Census data (ACS, PUMS, building permits). **How we work** You'll join the Data Engineering team within JBREC's technology organization, which also includes Software Engineering, Data Science, and IT. We treat governance as code: definitions, tests, and documentation live in the repository and go through review, rather than in separate catalog tools. You'll work closely with our research team, who are the experts on what the numbers mean. **Each full\-time employee receives:** * $12,500 towards our comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, and flexible spending accounts including gym memberships and vacation assistance. * Company contributes 5% of their salary and profit sharing to their 401(k), even if they do not contribute. * 30 days of Paid Time Off including 3 weeks of personal time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays, and 5 paid days for our Winter Break when the company shuts down to rejuvenate. Compensation and title will be based on skills, experience, and abilities, which can vary by person. **We cannot hire anyone who requires sponsorship to work in the United States.** Disclaimer: Nothing in this job description restricts the company’s right to assign responsibilities to this job at any time as critical features of this job are subject to change at any time.

documentation. **Qualifications \& Skills** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong knowledge of cloud networking, private endpoints, DNS, identity, RBAC, managed identities, secrets, and secure service\-to\-service connectivity. * Experience with containerized and managed application platforms such as Azure Container Apps, App Services, Functions, Docker, or Kubernetes. * Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, deployment controls, monitoring, alerting, and operational support for production services. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Ability to diagnose complex infrastructure, networking, authentication, certificate, deployment, and runtime issues. * Clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and product teams. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, or similar managed AI services. * Experience designing or operating API gateways using Azure API Management, including policies for authentication, routing, throttling, retries, observability, and usage controls. * Experience developing reusable Terraform modules and working with Terragrunt, remote state, module versioning, and environment promotion patterns. * Experience with enterprise landing zones, hub\-and\-spoke networking, private cloud services, policy enforcement, and multi\-subscription or multi\-account environments. * Experience operating AI or ML platforms, including model endpoints, capacity, quotas, evaluation services, vector search, RAG infrastructure, or agent runtimes. * Working knowledge of cloud cost management, service reliability, incident management, and platform product thinking. **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS platform engineering, including Bedrock, SageMaker, API Gateway, IAM, Lambda, S3, VPC networking, Terraform, or Terragrunt. * Experience with multi\-cloud AI gateway,
