jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Software Engineer Kipsu is a growth stage Minneapolis\-based technology company that has grown to over 100 employees. At Kipsu, we help service professionals Meet the Moment \- from partnering with some of the largest hospitality brands in the world to working with clients in the multifamily and healthcare industries. Our best\-in\-class technology enables organizations around the globe to better serve their customers through streamlined messaging, data\-driven performance metrics, sentiment analysis and workflow management. As one of the Twin Cities’ leading tech companies, Kipsu has cultivated a reputation for a strong company culture and is consistently recognized by the Star Tribune as a Top Workplace. THE OPPORTUNITY Kipsu is hiring a back\-end\-focused, but full\-stack capable, Software Engineer to join one of our cross\-functional delivery teams in Minneapolis. You'll be part of our Services practice, the engineers who build the server\-side applications, APIs, and data layer behind our platforms. The team is currently building Kipsu's next\-generation identity and access management system: the services that handle sign\-in, enterprise single sign\-on, and permissions for every Kipsu user. Team focus will shift over time as priorities change, so we're looking for someone who enjoys learning new parts of a system as much as going deep on one. You'll work across our technology stack: Typescript, React, PHP, Kotlin, and more – ship features end to end, and help the team make sound technical decisions as we modernize the platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Build complete features independently, from request handling and business logic through data persistence. * Design and build well\-structured REST APIs with clear resource models, consistent error handling, input validation, and documentation other teams can integrate against. * Write efficient SQL, manage schema migrations safely, and use transactions and Redis caching where they fit. * Apply secure design patterns as a matter of course, especially authentication, authorization, and input validation, which are central to identity work. * Author technical designs for features and moderately complex work, covering integration points, testing, observability, and deployment. * Instrument your code with structured logging and meaningful metrics, and design for failure when a dependency is slow or unavailable. * Investigate and resolve bugs and production issues independently, finding root cause rather than patching symptoms. * Write unit tests that cover edge cases and failure paths, and add coverage to existing code as you work in it. * Review teammates' pull requests promptly and give feedback that improves the code. * Work within our CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments, and troubleshoot build and deployment issues when they come up. We encourage the use of AI coding assistants and agents throughout your day\-to\-day work. You will stay accountable for everything you ship, so you must review, test, and understand what a tool produces. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR What you bring * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the back end. * Hands\-on experience full\-stack experience in application development. You don't need to know our exact stack, but you need to have shipped code to production. * Working experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar): writing joins and aggregations, reasoning about query performance, and making schema changes. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including HTTP methods, status codes, and error handling. * A habit of writing unit tests and debugging systematically. * Familiarity with Git, pull\-request\-based code review, and CI/CD workflows. * Clear written and verbal communication. You raise blockers early, ask good questions in planning, and follow through on commitments. * Curiosity and adaptability. You pick up new languages, codebases, and domains quickly, and you're comfortable when team priorities change. Nice to have * Production experience with PHP and/or Kotlin (or another JVM language), TypeScript, React, React Native, Node * Experience with identity and access management: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, enterprise SSO, or role\-based authorization. * Experience working in a large, long\-lived codebase while new services are carved out of a monolith. * Exposure to messaging and asynchronous patterns (queues, pub/sub, event\-driven workflows). * Experience with Redis or other caching layers, including cache invalidation trade\-offs. * Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, or infrastructure\-as\-code such as Terraform. * Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. * Experience building integrations with external partner systems, or working in B2B SaaS. How you work * You own outcomes. You break work into small increments, ship working software often, and adjust when priorities change. * You communicate proactively. You share progress, blockers, and timeline risks without being asked, and you give reasonable estimates. * You collaborate across functions. You work well with product, QA, support, and other engineering teams, and you listen before you respond. * You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why the team is building what it's building and bring observations from your work back to the practice. * You're open\-minded and eager to grow. You take feedback well, seek out unfamiliar parts of the system, and help raise the bar for the team. WHAT MAKES KIPSU DIFFERENT * We’re a solid, stable company, and we enthusiastically embrace our founding startup spirit– everyone pitching in and working to the same goals. * Our culture– We have a team of highly motivated colleagues who are all in it together. We all succeed as one, and we all learn from our mistakes holding our interdependence in high regard. * Our unique philosophy– we bootstrapped this company ourselves and are in it for the long\-term. There is a distinct sense of purpose and ownership at Kipsu as we do things on our own terms. * Remarkable growth– with nearly a decade of advancement, we continue to accelerate. It’s an exciting time to be here. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE * Unity– Everyone here is committed to the same mission. Our core values are not platitudes but our pact. We believe in the best in each other while always reaching to be better. * Transparency– Our leadership gets into the details. We all gather for weekly space to discover how each team is doing so that we have a full understanding of the business and think like a CEO. * Trust– Our team members are given the trust and license to excel at their jobs, and are supported along the way to continuously grow. * Mentorship \- We all have more to learn and something to teach. The lessons are beyond technical. We celebrate our busy hive of shared growth. * Respect– Our success and future as an industry leader depend on actionable commitment to cultivating a diverse and equitable team. Everyone here has a voice that is heard and respected. We seek open and honest conversation on our journey to be active stewards of our shared communities. * Purpose– Everyone here is closely connected to the result of their work. Every day our team gets to see the impact of what they do enhancing the value of our customers’ work in their own professions. Our goals are explicitly tethered to our mission of building relationships. We are proud to offer a competitive suite of benefits including: health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401K with a company match, unlimited/responsible vacation time, life insurance, flex spending account, and commuter benefits. The pay range for this role is $80,000\-$90,000/year depending on experience. One last thing – At Kipsu, we believe that our values, success, and future as a leader in our industry require a vibrant and diverse workforce. This is one of the many challenges we seek to solve, and we are intentional and active in recruiting talent of all identities and building an environment that is inclusive of all backgrounds. We need your contribution to our team. Please consider rolling up your sleeves and joining us on our journey.

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about using data, mapping, and technology to shape the built and natural environments, we invite you to join LaBella’s Data Intelligence Group. Our employee\-owned, multidisciplinary firm brings together engineers, architects, surveyors, environmental scientists, and technologists to deliver innovative, high\-quality solutions for public and private clients. LaBella is consistently recognized for its culture, growth, ethics, and community impact. We invest in our people, embrace emerging technologies, and collaborate across disciplines to solve complex challenges. LaBella is seeking a Web Developer to create, enhance, and support applications and related technology solutions for municipal, utility, environmental, infrastructure, and multidisciplinary projects. The Developer will report to the GIS Discipline Lead and work closely with the Senior Developer and Principal GIS staff, Project managers, engineers, planners, field staff, and other technical teams. The role will support the development of new applications, modernization of existing systems, database\-driven workflows, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, and ongoing application maintenance and support. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** Web Development * Develop, enhance, test, and maintain web\-based and data\-driven applications under the direction of the Senior Developer. * Develop custom GIS applications and tools using Esri technologies such as ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. * Develop and maintain web applications and integrations using .NET Core, C\#, Entity Framework, JavaScript, and related web technologies. * Translate defined business and technical requirements into reliable, maintainable application features and workflows. * Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and maintenance of production applications. * Develop and maintain applications in a cloud\-based environment, where required. SQL Server Integration * Develop and maintain application databases and data structures using Microsoft SQL Server. * Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and other database objects that support web applications. * Integrate web applications with relational databases. * Support data migration, validation, troubleshooting, and modernization of legacy database\-driven applications. * Supports data migration, validation and troubleshooting of relational databases in a cloud environment, where needed. Project \& Client Support * Work with the Senior Developer, project managers, and project teams to understand business needs and implement practical technical solutions. * Communicate technical concepts, progress, issues, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical team members. * Assist with technical scoping, level\-of\-effort estimates, documentation, testing plans, and implementation activities. * Provide ongoing application support, troubleshooting, bug fixes, upgrades, and enhancements for long\-term client programs. * Document applications, databases, workflows, dependencies, and support procedures to promote maintainability and team continuity. Development Practices \& Collaboration * Follow established development standards, source\-control practices, testing procedures, documentation requirements, and QA/QC processes. * Develop reusable components and solutions that can be applied efficiently across multiple projects and clients. * Collaborate with data analysts, developers, and multidisciplinary project teams to integrate business requirements. * Continue developing technical skills in web development, databases, and related technologies with guidance from senior staff. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools, including vibe coding where appropriate, to improve efficiency and reduce development time. All AI\-generated content and code will be reviewed and validated for accuracy, quality, and suitability. **Salary Range:** $105,000\.00 \- $128,000\.00 per year *The specific salary offered may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate's relevant experience, education, and work location.* **Requirements** Required Education \&Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * Minimum of 5 years of professional software, web application, or database development experience. * Demonstrated experience developing web applications using .NET Core, C\#, Entity Framework, and JavaScript. * Professional experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, including writing SQL queries and Views and working with relational database structures. * Experience integrating web applications with relational databases, APIs, or other business systems. * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web application development concepts. * Ability to troubleshoot software and database issues, test solutions, and document technical work. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail, with an interest in building maintainable, user\-focused solutions. * Ability to work collaboratively with senior developers, project managers, and multidisciplinary teams. * Excellent written and verbal communication, documentation, and time\-management skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project deadlines in a consulting environment. Additional Skills (Not Required) * Experience developing GIS or location\-based web applications using Esri technologies. * Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, enterprise geodatabases, or the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. * Experience with Python, REST APIs, source control, automated testing, deployment workflows, or application modernization. * Experience supporting utility, municipal, environmental, infrastructure, or asset\-management clients. * Experience with developing and management of cloud deployment such as Amazon, Azure, etc. * Experience with vibe coding for rapid development where appropriate. Physical Requirements: * Ability to sit for extended periods and work at a computer. * Ability to communicate effectively in virtual and in\-person meetings. Ability to travel occasionally to client or project locations as needed. * **Benefits** Body, mind, and wallet—LaBella’s benefits support a holistic approach to your health and wellness, creating the foundation for physical, mental, and financial well\-being. Our benefit offerings cover the must\-haves (healthcare and retirement), the just\-in\-cases (insurances and employee assistance programs), and the cherry\-on\-tops (fitness reimbursements, year\-end incentive pay, and tuition assistance). Visit our website for more details on benefits listed below. * Flexible Work Schedule * Health/Dental Insurance * 401k Plan with Employer Match * Paid Parental Leave * Short \& Long Term Disability * Profit Sharing * Paid Time Off * Leadership Development Program * Fitness Reimbursement * Tuition Reimbursement * Referral Bonus Program * Wellness Program * Team Building Events * Community Service Events LaBella is committed to facilitating a culture where diversity, equity, and inclusion are respected, valued, and celebrated by implementing thoughtful, practical, and innovative strategies that support our employees and serve the communities in which we reside. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, characteristic or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local laws. LaBella Associates does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiting professionals or agencies, nor do we accept resumes from any source that does not reference a specific, open position. LaBella Associates will not be responsible for any fees arising from the use of resume submitted by recruiting professionals or agencies that do not have a current placement fee agreement with LaBella Associates. All initial communication with recruiting professionals or agencies must go through human resources.

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI R&D Lead
jobs.description: About Leading Edge Skills Leading Edge Skills LLC (LES) is an established California\-based organization and federal contractor delivering **leadership development, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data analytics, technology training, and consulting** to defense agencies, civilian government organizations, and commercial clients. Our federal portfolio includes multi\-year programs with the **U.S. Navy's NAVSEA/NSWCDD, NAVSUP/Navy Supply Corps School, Naval Surface Warfare Center Port Hueneme Division, and the U.S. Army**. These engagements encompass leadership and advanced management development, AI and emerging technology applications, mission\- and capability\-based test and evaluation, digital engineering, modeling and simulation, cybersecurity education, and professional workforce development. LES has delivered **60\+ leadership development cohorts** under an ongoing Navy program. Our defense program footprint extends across **Dahlgren, Virginia Beach, Newport, Port Hueneme, and the San Diego region**, supporting scientists, engineers, military personnel, technical professionals, and senior leaders. Our broader experience includes cybersecurity workforce development for the California Department of Rehabilitation. **Our next strategic direction is technology research and development.** Building on our established defense contracting experience, LES is developing capabilities in applied AI, autonomous systems, cybersecurity innovation, intelligent decision\-support, and advanced simulation. We intend to pursue long\-term R\&D, SBIR/STTR, prototype development, and technology commercialization opportunities with DoD agencies and other federal organizations. We seek technically accomplished innovators who can bring original ideas, demonstrated engineering expertise, and a commitment to developing practical technologies that address defense mission challenges. Position Overview LES is seeking an accomplished **Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI R\&D Lead** to help conceptualize, architect, develop, and validate innovative AI technologies for defense and government applications. We are particularly interested in engineers, researchers, and technical innovators who have personally designed and built functional AI systems, including agentic AI platforms, multi\-agent applications, intelligent decision\-support tools, autonomous workflows, and advanced analytical solutions. The successful candidate will contribute to emerging technology research, technical feasibility assessments, software architecture, prototype development, and selected federal R\&D pursuits. This is a hands\-on technical position for someone capable of **personally engineering and demonstrating technology**, not simply advising on AI adoption or delivering instructional programs. We value candidates with an entrepreneurial mindset who can recognize emerging technological opportunities and help transform promising ideas into defensible research concepts and commercially viable products. Initial Engagement and Expected Deliverables Initial projects may include: * Assessing a specific defense R\&D opportunity and its technical requirements. * Proposing an innovative solution and explaining its technical differentiation. * Developing a system architecture and feasibility research plan. * Identifying prototype requirements, development resources, and research risks. * Producing a functional proof of concept when included in an authorized paid scope. * Establishing measurable testing and validation criteria. * Contributing technical material to research proposals and development roadmaps. How to Apply Please submit: * Your current resume or technical professional profile. * Descriptions of **two AI systems, applications, or prototypes you personally developed**, including your specific contributions. * Relevant GitHub repositories, publications, patents, product demonstrations, or other nonconfidential technical work samples, where available. * A brief explanation of your research interests and why you are interested in defense technology innovation. * **Attitude required:** * Honesty, humility, and integrity * Inclusive and respectful * Strong work ethic * Passion for learning * Comfortable with autonomy * Eager to add new skills and grow professionally * **Skills that are preferred, but not required:** * Curiosity * Assertiveness * A love of IT and/or technology Job Types: Part\-time, Contract Pay: $100\.00 \- $150\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Position:** Product Engineer, AI \& Automation **Department:** Digital Experience **Role Overview:** The Operational Efficiency team works with departments across the organization to reduce manual effort in daily operations. This role is the team's primary builder. You will take processes that are currently slow, repetitive, or error\-prone and turn them into working automations, applying AI capabilities where they fit the problem. Most of your time will be spent building: writing code, connecting systems, designing and testing agents, and maintaining what you have already shipped. Requirements will reach you as problems rather than finished specifications, so you will work directly with the teams whose processes you are automating to understand how the work is performed before deciding what to build. We are looking for someone with five or more years of experience who has delivered automations that people depend on daily and who has supported them over time. **What you’ll get to do:** *Build* * Design and build automations across operational workflows, including data movement, document handling, reporting, intake and routing, and notifications. * Connect existing systems using REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and integration platforms, working within the organization's current technology stack wherever possible. * Build components that use large language models where they are the right tool for the problem, including extraction from unstructured documents, classification, routing, summarization, and drafting. Design the prompts, test them against representative data, and define the accuracy required before launching. * Determine where human review is required, set confidence thresholds that route uncertain cases to staff, and define what happens when the model produces incorrect output. * Handle supporting work with the same care as the build itself, including data validation, idempotency, credential management, environment separation, and documentation sufficient for another engineer to take over. *Define and scope* * Work with department leads to document current\-state processes and identify automation candidates, quantifying the time and cost each process consumes today. * Assess feasibility and recommend alternatives when a process change or a configuration change in an existing system would solve the problem more effectively than a new automation. * Translate operational needs into technical requirements and divide work into phases that deliver value early. * Set clear expectations with stakeholders on accuracy, exception handling, and scope. This matters especially for AI\-assisted steps, where acceptable error rates should be agreed in advance. *Own and maintain* * Own each automation through its full lifecycle, including monitoring, response when upstream systems change, iteration as processes evolve, and retirement once it is no longer needed. * Build in monitoring and alerting so that failures surface quickly instead of going unnoticed. * Maintain documentation and runbooks so that support does not depend on a single person. * Track and report impact, including hours returned, error rates, cycle time, and usage. *Support and enable others* * Train and support staff who want to build simple automations on their own, extending the reach of the team. * Contribute to the team's standards and patterns, including guidelines on what organizational data may be sent to external AI services. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of professional experience building automations, integrations, or internal tools. * Strong Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript skills, with experience writing code that other engineers have maintained. * Substantial experience with REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, and system\-to\-system integration. * Hands\-on experience building with large language models, including prompt design, structured output, and methods for evaluating output quality. * Working knowledge of SQL and experience with inconsistent or incomplete operational data. * Proven ability to work with non\-technical stakeholders, including gathering requirements, managing expectations, and supporting adoption. * Good judgment about which processes are appropriate for candidates for automation, and which are not. *Preferred* * Experience with integration or workflow platforms such as Workato, Make, n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, Airflow, or Temporal. * Experience with document processing, OCR, or extraction from unstructured sources. * Experience in a comparable operational environment where automations touch finance, HR, or customer\-facing workflows. * Familiarity with data governance and access controls in environments that handle sensitive records. **What is Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts?** Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc. (LCPA) is a cultural and civic cornerstone of New York City. We believe the arts play an important role in our lives: they nourish our hearts and minds, teach us valuable lessons and critical skills, and help us create community. We are resolved not to lose sight of what connects us, and we hope you will consider joining our talented, diverse team. **We are:** 1\. The manager of the 16\-acre Lincoln Center campus * We are one of eleven amazing resident arts organizations 2\. A leading Arts Presenter. * We curate numerous programs and performances, showcasing music, dance, and more 3\. An Education Hub. * We have reached 20 million students, educators, principals, and community members **Who are our people?** LCPA is a team of dreamers, collaborators, and entrepreneurs who use unique platforms in the heart of New York City and beyond to advocate for the transformative impact of artistic experiences. Lincoln Center People imagine and create in concert with this mission by founding President John D. Rockefeller III \- "The arts are not for the privileged few, but for the many. Their place is not on the periphery of daily life, but at its center." We welcome applicants from all sectors who agilely solve problems, show up as they are, and can't stop innovating. **What’s the news?** *Recent and Upcoming Programming* * **Lincoln Center Reveals 25/26 Season Featuring Jeanine Tesori as Visionary Artist** * **Kyle Abraham's 20 Years of Urgency at Lincoln Center Rose Theatre** *Campus Happenings* * **Lincoln Center Gets $50 Million Gift to Promote Contemporary Dance** * **The new JFK terminal will show iconic artworks from MoMA, the Met and Lincoln Center** *Legacies of San Juan Hill* * **WNYC: Lincoln Center Celebrates 'Legacies of San Juan Hill** * **Lincoln Center Launches San Juan Hill Project Digital Hub To Remember the Lost Urban Neighborhood** **Who is our President and CEO?** Dr. Mariko Silver **Join us!** It is the policy of Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc., to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, marital or civil partnership/union status, familial or caregiver status, alienage or citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, military or veteran status, genetic information, predisposition, or carrier status, unemployment status, domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking victim status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. LCPA is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. *If you require reasonable accommodation in locating open positions, completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to Abigail Worsnip at (212\) 875–5324\.*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI Evaluation
jobs.description: **About Litmus** ---------------- AI agents are starting to do real work across the economy, and the companies deploying them have no reliable way to know whether they can trust them. Litmus is building the system that lets every enterprise measure how its agents perform, understand why they fail, and make them better, starting with evaluation and building toward agents that improve on their own. Litmus was founded in August 2026 by Sidharth Srinivasan, who built and led AI evaluation at Box after Box's CEO recruited him out of Stanford CS. We've raised $5M from Pear, BoxGroup, Workbench, and Emergence, alongside the CEO of Box, the co\-founder of Dropbox, and senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. **The role** ------------ **Figure out what "good" means for AI agents doing real work, and prove it.** You'll design how we measure agents in domains where there's no answer key, and make sure the numbers can be trusted. It's research\-leaning, hands\-on work that ships to customers. You'll work on: * Verifiers and graders for knowledge work with no ground truth * Making simulated environments and tasks faithful to the real world * Knowing when you've tested enough, and when a score means something * Turning what works for one customer into something the product does automatically Why it's exciting: * Nobody has written the playbook for measuring agents in real work yet. You'll write it. * Real agents in high\-stakes domains, not academic benchmarks. * Measurement, not capability: whether agents are actually useful, and how anyone would know. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You've built evals, benchmarks, verifiers, reward models, RL environments, or synthetic data pipelines for LLMs or agents * You think like a researcher about whether a number means anything, and you write production code to find out * You've chosen risk before: founder, founding engineer, early employee, or a small, high\-output team * You typically have 2–6 years of experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in non\-code domains like legal, finance, healthcare, or enterprise work * Post\-training experience (SFT, RLHF, RLVR) * Statistics for evaluation, benchmark design, or published eval research **Probably not a fit** ---------------------- * Eval dashboards or observability tooling with no hands\-on eval design * Model training with little interest in evaluation **What we offer** ----------------- * Founding equity and competitive cash * One of the first hires, working directly with the founder and customers from day one * A say in how agent quality gets measured across the industry * A beautiful office in FiDi * Breakfast, lunch, and dinner * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equinox membership or a fitness stipend * Essentially unlimited budget for AI tools and tokens * Relocation support if you're moving to San Francisco

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Platform & Infra
jobs.description: **About Litmus** ---------------- AI agents are starting to do real work across the economy, and the companies deploying them have no reliable way to know whether they can trust them. Litmus is building the system that lets every enterprise measure how its agents perform, understand why they fail, and make them better, starting with evaluation and building toward agents that improve on their own. Litmus was founded in August 2026 by Sidharth Srinivasan, who built and led AI evaluation at Box after Box's CEO recruited him out of Stanford CS. We've raised $5M from Pear, BoxGroup, Workbench, and Emergence, alongside the CEO of Box, the co\-founder of Dropbox, and senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. **The role** ------------ **Build the infrastructure that simulates the real world for AI agents.** Every evaluation we run happens inside a simulated world. experience developing enterprise backend systems using Java, Kotlin, or comparable JVM languages with Spring Boot. * **Distributed \& Cloud Systems:** Proven track record of designing, deploying, and As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high\-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers. Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported. **Global Total Rewards** We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK: * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region. * **Time Away:** Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best. * **Growth \& Development:** Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms. *Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain's Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.*

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Moxie, we empower ambitious aesthetic entrepreneurs to build profitable, independent practices—without burnout, overwhelm, or guesswork. In just a few years, we've grown from an idea to a global, remote\-first team now supporting 700\+ practices nationwide. Our purpose is simple: to unlock sustainable success for aesthetic entrepreneurs, at every stage of their journey. **Staff Data Engineer** We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to own Moxie's data infrastructure end to end: the pipelines (Prefect, Airbyte, Snowflake Openflow), the warehouse (Snowflake), and the modeling layer (dbt, Omni) that every number Moxie publishes depends on. Data and intelligence are Moxie's moat, and they are also where the gap between what we can do today and our full potential is widest. This is a highly visible seat on a small, ambitious team, and you close that gap. Day to day, you'll partner with Engineering on production schema changes (Postgres to Snowflake), work with Finance to model accounting logic, build and maintain pipelines, and keep business\-critical data available for internal teams and the practices we serve. Practice Intelligence and Practice 360 are built on this foundation, and you'll be the person who makes it solid. **Our Objectives for the Role** * Make every number Moxie publishes defensible: within six months the data stack is owned, alerted, lineage\-mapped, and documented end to end, and "is the number right?" has a yes\-answer for every priority metric flowing into Practice 360 decks, MBRs, Practice Intelligence reports, and Moxie Suite embedded reports * Own the dbt and orchestration layers, maintaining and evolving Moxie's dbt models (including financial reporting logic such as cash vs. accrual basis and incentive calculations and their downstream effect on metrics like AOV) and taking over the Prefect and Snowflake Openflow orchestration layer along with the observability platform that monitors it * Deliver one high\-impact project in your first quarter by scoping and shipping either the accrual basis accounting data model (so dbt and Omni support both cash and accrual reporting as we move upmarket) or modelling historical EMR data to work with existing practice KPIs so owners can understand the performance of their business before/after joining Moxie; neither exists today * Turn ad\-hoc work into owned process by establishing the SOPs and KPIs the stack has been missing: a monthly Vanta security review, a scoping and execution process for production schema changes, a triage workflow from job and test failures to resolution, and monthly infrastructure KPIs for performance and cost * Deepen the moat: by month nine you're proactively optimizing the stack (for example, Omni data refreshed every 15 minutes at predictable cost) and building the pipelines and models that move Practice Intelligence from descriptive to predictive to prescriptive, including safeguards for LLM\-generated content in data products **We're Looking For** * 5\-10 years of data engineering experience, with at least one stretch as an early data hire who took a system from "basics" to business\-critical * Deep dbt and SQL modeling skill applied to business logic: you've owned a dbt project of real complexity and can model financial concepts like cash vs. accrual accounting, incentive logic, and revenue definitions, and explain how a change upstream ripples through every downstream metric * Python and software engineering fundamentals strong enough to own orchestration: you've run production pipelines on Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, or similar, handled schema evolution from an operational database into a warehouse, and set up alerting and observability so failures are caught before stakeholders notice * A track record of leading end\-to\-end delivery: you gather requirements from non\-technical partners (Finance, Product, Sales), scope the work, make the architectural call, ship it, and can articulate the tradeoffs you chose and the business value that resulted * An ownership mindset about uptime, reliability, and cost; you treat data infrastructure as a living system that needs a steward, and SLAs, runbooks, KPIs, and cost optimization are things you build rather than wait to be asked for * Fluency with AI tooling in daily work (Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, or similar) and a point of view on where LLMs belong in a data stack and where they need guardrails * Someone who sees a data team as a driver of business outcomes, not a ticketing service; if "taking tickets from a queue" describes your ideal job, this won't be a fit **Why Join Us?** * You set the standard, not inherit one: as the second internal data hire on a small, ambitious team, your data patterns, conventions, and engineering philosophy become Moxie's * A data architecture competitors can't match: Moxie's vertical model captures clinical events (Service Menu Item x Service Type x Service Product) tied to appointments, providers, and patients, and every additional service we sell makes the dataset richer * A modern stack with room to grow (Snowflake, dbt, Omni, Airbyte, Prefect, GitHub) with AI tooling built into the workflow, and a tight Product and Engineering partnership so you see how the data you model changes what practices can do * A highly visible IC role executing C\-Suite level initiatives, with real input on the data roadmap and your own career trajectory At Moxie, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, trusted, and included. Our team lives by our values: **act as owners, give more than we take, move with speed and care, and simplify and learn every day.** We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require any accommodations to fully participate in the interview process, please let us know, we’re happy to assist. Compensation Range: $78,000 \- $209,000

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Back-end)
jobs.description: Mad Mobile is a retail and restaurant company that, leverages AI\-powered tools and frameworks to accelerate software development. We are headquartered in Tampa, FL, dedicated to transforming the way businesses operate in a digital world. We specialize in building innovative software solutions for restaurants and enterprise retailers, empowering them with tools to enhance customer experience, streamline operations, and drive growth. From mobile ordering and payments to advanced point\-of\-sale systems, our cutting\-edge technology helps industry leaders stay ahead in an ever\-evolving market. Join us in shaping the future of retail and hospitality through intelligent, scalable solutions. **LOCATION: Must be based in the area or willing to relocate to Tampa, FL. This is an in\-office role.** **NOTE: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States (U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, or valid EAD holders). Sponsorship is not available for this role.** **About the Role:** We are seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer with a strong focus on **backend** systems to help modernize and evolve our platforms. This role is ideal for engineers who are excited to take on complex backend challenges, from transitioning legacy Spring MVC applications into Spring Boot microservices, to designing scalable event\-driven systems powered by Redis, RabbitMQ, and cloud\-native architectures. Additionally, leveraging AI\-powered tools and frameworks will be crucial in optimizing development processes, automating tasks, and enhancing software capabilities. **We are looking for someone who has:** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * A minimum of 5\+ years of experience in software development and architecture, with a deep understanding of building and deploying applications with cutting\-edge technologies \& AI tools. * Deep expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security). * Hands\-on experience with Redis and message brokers such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar. * Familiarity with AWS cloud services (ECS, EC2, ECR, RDS, S3\). * Experience in integrating and leveraging AI\-driven development tools to enhance efficiency, such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI APIs, TensorFlow, Cursor or other machine learning frameworks. * Strong focus on producing clear technical documentation (system designs, API contracts, operational guides). * A passion for problem\-solving and continuous improvement of applications. **Key skills needed to be successful in the role:** * Expertise in Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, reliable backend services. * Practical experience with Redis (caching, pub/sub) and messaging systems (RabbitMQ or equivalents). * Proficiency with relational databases (SQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB). * Deployment and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. * Cloud infrastructure knowledge, especially with AWS ECS, EC2, and ECR. * Familiarity with RESTful APIs and technologies (ReactJS, TypeScript, NodeJS). You’ll work closely with a dedicated team, shape the employee experience, and help build a culture that fuels Mad Mobile’s success. **What about the benefits you ask?** At Mad Mobile, we're committed to taking care of our employees right from the start. That's why there's no waiting period for our plans – they kick in from day one. jobs.title: New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer — Automotive Manufacturing
jobs.description: **Can you turn a quote into a stable, efficient production line?** ------------------------------------------------------------------ At Magna Engineered Glass, we’re looking for an NPI Engineer who asks great questions, sweats the details, and leads from the front—on the floor and in cross\-functional rooms. ### **Your impact areas** #### **Launch new programs** * Build process flows and define manufacturing operations for new part quotations through ramp\-up. * Lead or support PFMEA workshops with cross\-functional teams to de\-risk launch. * Specify, procure, and deploy new equipment; own buy\-off, runoffs, and production rollout. * Create Standardized Work and Job Element Sheets; train teams on newly rolled\-out processes. #### **Optimize current production** * Research and drive approved continuous improvement and development projects. * Maintain plant layout drawings with input from operations, quality, and maintenance. * Develop in\-process prints and production tools, including GD\&T stack\-ups and CAD updates; manage signoffs. * Benchmark processes and parts across sister sites, suppliers, customers, and competitors. #### **Technical leadership \& communication** * Provide technical input to Sales and customers to influence product design for manufacturability and cost. * Report major engineering developments and corrective actions to management; maintain accurate records and standards. * Promote MAFACT, lean manufacturing, standardized work, and ongoing CI across teams. #### **Compliance, safety, and stewardship** * Ensure adherence to IATF 16949, ISO 14001, MIOSHA/OSHA (including Lockout/Tagout), and company policies. * Proactively consider environmental aspects of production in every change and process improvement. * Submit and support CI and safety suggestions; preferred experience in injection molding, bonding, soldering, assembly, and/or stamping. * Experience developing Manufacturing Process Prints, Standard Work Instructions, and Job Element Sheets. * Hands\-on troubleshooting with mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems. * Fluent with GD\&T and tolerance analysis. * Problem\-solving strength: 5 Why, root cause analysis, data\-driven decisions, and creative solutions. * Comfort interpreting written/oral instructions, drawings, diagrams, and schedules; able to tackle non\-standard problems. * Microsoft Word/Excel/Outlook/PowerPoint, SolidWorks, and spreadsheet creation proficiency. * Organized, deadline\-driven; able to manage multiple projects, including extended hours when needed. * Proactive, improvement\-minded; Ready to champion launches that hit quality, cost, and timing while building a safer, leaner operation? Join us.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Operator Tools
jobs.description: We are looking for a **Director of Engineering** to lead our Operator Tools division, the group that builds the AI\-driven features restaurant operators use every day. These tools show operators how their restaurants are performing, surface opportunities to save costs, and give them what they need to improve how they run their business. You will manage a group of engineering managers and also lead one of the division's teams directly. You'll own delivery, quality, and technical direction across Operator Tools, and you'll be a senior partner to product and design leadership in deciding what we build and how. This is a chance to shape how AI changes restaurant operations for thousands of independent restaurants across the US and Canada. MarginEdge is a SaaS platform for independent restaurants that simplifies complex operations and delivers actionable insights. Our system runs on AWS. Our services are built with Java/Spring Boot, and our front ends use React and React Native. For data, we use both NoSQL (DynamoDB) and relational (Postgres) databases. We also have a growing portfolio of IoT hardware products and integrations, like our SmartScale, that simplify kitchen tasks and collect real\-time data in restaurants. That data feeds the insights Operator Tools delivers. **MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology** As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real\-time data. Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture\-backed and serve 12,000\+ restaurants across the US and Canada. We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them. We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees. **What type of responsibilities will I have?** * Set the vision and engineering strategy for Operator Tools. Work with product and design leadership on a roadmap that brings cutting\-edge AI capabilities into practical, reliable features operators trust. Turn business goals into clear priorities, and make sound calls on where to invest, what to build, and what to leave out. * Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineering managers while also managing a team of engineers directly. Hire strong leaders, develop them, and build depth on the bench. Create a high\-performance culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across the division. * Build an organization that stays at the cutting edge of what's possible. Keep a close eye on the latest advances in AI, and look for ways to use them in our products and to improve how your teams work. Hold a high bar on quality, security, and technical judgment throughout. * Own delivery and operational excellence for every system in Operator Tools. Put planning and execution practices in place that work across multiple teams, manage dependencies with the rest of the organization, and make sure your teams ship high\-quality software on predictable timelines. * Guide technical strategy and architecture for the division. Help teams balance moving fast against the long\-term health of the platform, and work with other engineering leaders to keep the approach consistent across MarginEdge. * Stay close to customers and the business. Use customer feedback, product analytics, and operational data to measure impact and find recurring pain points, and push for the investment needed to fix them. Clearly report progress, risks, and outcomes to executive leadership. **What qualifications or skills are required?** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 6\+ years in engineering leadership and at least 3 years managing managers. * A proven track record of building and scaling multi\-team engineering organizations with a strong focus on delivery, quality, and culture. * Experience shipping AI/ML or LLM\-powered features to production, with a practical understanding of what it takes to make them reliable, measurable, and cost\-effective. * A strong software development background in Java and/or JavaScript (React), with the technical depth to evaluate architecture and challenge technical decisions. * Experience partnering with product and design leadership in a product\-driven environment, including shaping roadmaps together and prioritizing against business outcomes. * The ability t gh growth. * Experience with data platforms, analytics products, or real\-time insights and reporting. * Experience with IoT device management or hardware\-integrated products. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code to speed up software development. **Compensation:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$185,000–$230,000** annually. Where a candidate falls within that range depends on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus opportunities and our comprehensive benefits package. **What’s it like to work for MarginEdge?** Imagine the fun of a great restaurant \- surrounded by a team of people (including some that you help to manage!) who care about hospitality, care about quality, and care about each other \- then subtract the long nights, weekends, drunk customers at the bar...et voila, MarginEdge! We work hard, we work fast and we fuel our work with a commitment of transparency from leadership, straight talk and trust between teams. We believe that the best people do their best work when they feel empowered \- so whether you are remote or in our office (likely eating a catered lunch from our clients in our baller, brand new penthouse HQ in Ballston) you get to work with your manager to call your shot on what works best for you. Did we mention it has a full commercial kitchen and is walking distance (covered walking, that is) from the metro? **Benefits (Shut the Front Door, They are Amazing)** In order to fuel this rocket ship, we need to build a team as passionate about our work and product as we are. We believe that top talent (that’s you!) should feel deeply connected to their work, appreciated for the time they give to building our organization and have the balance necessary to give their best during work hours and all those after\-hours too. We do this by offering a suite of kick ass benefits not only to be competitive and catch the eye of super smart people (that’s you again!) but also provide the foundation for a career you love and a life outside of work you love just as much. * Unlimited Paid Time Off (and we mean it, we encourage your healthy work life balance!) * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Short/Long\-Term Disability Insurance (preventative care for the win) * Health Savings Account with employer match (dependent upon your medical plan selection) * Commuter benefits with employer contribution (excluding limos and helos \- for now) * Generous Life Insurance Plan * Short\- and Long\-term Disability * Company\-Paid Holidays * 401(k) and matching * Stock Options to buy into everything we are doing to support this industry * 12\-week fully Paid Parental Leave * Lunch catered twice a week at our HQ in Arlington (we exclusively cater from our clients, too! * A wellness program that sponsors healthy activities such as step challenges and provides discounts to gyms and fitness classes. ***Check out our 100% “Recommend to a Friend” rating from anonymous employee reviews on*** ***Glassdoor******.*** ***Oh, and our recognition in the Washington Post as a*** ***top small businesses*** ***to work for in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025!*** ***And most important, what our customers think about our work on*** ***Capterra*** ***and*** ***G2 Crowd.*** **Our Fine Print is Bold:** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran, marital, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. You be you. While we are proudest of our commitment to exceptional culture and creating a truly excellent work environment, we see our benefits as an extension of that belief. Our benefits package is designed to be exceptionally competitive and a reflection of our commitment to a best\-in\-class workplace for all.

jobs.title: Sr./Staff Process Engineer - Detailed Engineering and Plant Design
jobs.description: **About Mariana Minerals** ========================== Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making. **The Role** We are hiring a Senior / Staff Process Engineer to execute detailed engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, line and instrument and valve lists, control narratives, hydraulic models, equipment and bulk specifications, and the procurement packages behind them. Mariana executes process engineering in\-house, you will produce these deliverables yourself, own their technical content and revision history, and carry them through procurement, construction, and commissioning. **What You’ll Do** * Own the process design basis for your assigned areas. Design cases and margins, turndown, utility and reagent demands, and the first principles and assumptions basis behind them * Develop PFDs, heat and material balances, and P\&IDs. Manage the metadata behind smart drafting and modeling software such as Plant 3D * Develop P\&IDs from concept through IFC. Including, but not limited to, equipment, instrumentation and control loops, isolation and relief philosophy, drains and vents, sample and utility stations, sloping and tracing notes, and tie\-ins * Manage and develop automated workflows for the process data behind the line, instrument, and valve lists. E.g. line numbers and sizes, service conditions, design and test pressures and temperatures, pipe class selection, insulation and heat tracing, and instrument process data * Build and maintain the hydraulic models. Line sizing and pressure drop, pump and blower curves and duty points, NPSH margin, control valve and orifice sizing, slurry and two\-phase lines, and gravity, launder, and vent flow. Evaluate automation opportunities to link this to heat and material balances and Plant 3D datamanger * Size and specify process equipment such as pumps, control valves, relief devices, heat exchangers, tanks and agitators, filters, thickeners, mixer\-settlers, crystallizers, and solid–liquid separation * Write the control narratives and functional descriptions with support from the controls engineering team * Represent process in PHAs and HAZOP. * Coordinate across detailed engineering disciplines. Such as equipment lists and loads to mechanical, motor and instrument lists to electrical and controls, and layout, access, and maintenance clearances with piping and civil\-structural * Support construction and commissioning. RFI and field change resolution, P\&ID walkdowns and field verification, loop checks and functional testing, water and first\-feed startup, and as\-built closeout **Desired Qualifications** * 8\+ years of process engineering delivering detailed design for industrial process facilities — in an EPC/EPCM, owner’s engineer, or in\-house capital projects environment * Detailed\-engineering cycle on at least one greenfield or major brownfield project * BS in Chemical, Metallurgical, or Process Engineering. PE preferred **Preferred, but not required** * Lithium — direct lithium extraction, spodumene leaching, crystallization, and battery\-grade product specifications * Copper — heap and tank leaching, solvent extraction and electrowinning, tankhouse and electrolyte circuits * Slurry and solids handling — thickeners, filters, pulp and tailings piping, and settling and erosion design * Data\-centric P\&ID platforms — SmartPlant P\&ID, AVEVA P\&ID, or Plant 3D P\&ID — where the drawing is a database, not a picture **Our culture is built on four principles:** -------------------------------------------- **Everyone Gets Home Safe.** We never put speed or cost ahead of people. **Extreme Ownership.** We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. **Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate.** We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. **Share Your Legos.** We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. **Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!**

Design \& Architecture * Contribute to architecture decisions and system design discussions. * Apply architectural patterns that support scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Guide technical implementation across distributed and cloud\-based systems. * Support integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into business products. jobs.title: Jobs for you
jobs.description: **Why Mayo Clinic** Mayo Clinic is top\-ranked in more specialties than any other care provider according to U.S. News \& World Report. The data they work with are required to support a different analyses and applications that serve both internal and external partners. As the position requires strong data, technical, and functional skills, the right candidate must be able to understand business requirements, translate them into information needs, and implement those requirements using available data. The hire will be responsible for creating new data architecture, optimizing existing databases, designing data collection and flows for cross functional teams. The ideal candidate is an data engineer who has extensive experience working with clinical data and collaborating across diverse teams to ensure the data provided is accurate, the data pipelines reliable, and the resulting databases are fit for a variety of purposes. The Principal Data Engineer will work with informaticists, clinicians, software engineers, and data scientists to serve as a subject matter expert in data engineering best practices and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects. The position will also be responsible for the management of data related projects and oversee the tasks of other team members when relevant. **Core job duties:** * Expert in data modeling concepts, * Responsible for designing, implementing, documenting and testing databases containing clinical data. * Leverage SQL, Python and other programming languages * Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non\-functional business requirements. * Build ETL pipelines from varying data sources and technologies using cloud technologies such as Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure and implemented with Apache Airflow or similar products * Problem solving with the initiative to think critically to identify improvement opportunities. * Provide direction on best practices for data transformation, structure, and workflows. * Ability to effectively participate in multiple, concurrent projects * Research new and existing data sources in order to contribute to new development, improve data management processes, and make recommendations for data quality initiatives. * Perform periodic data quality reviews for internal and external data. **Qualifications** A Master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, health science, or other analytical/quantitative and a minimum of five years of professional or research experience in data science The successful candidate will need to have both technical and business background/experience along with strong leadership skills. Good written and oral communication skills are required. Deep expertise in the use of scientific computing and data management packages. Ability to prioritize, organize, and delegate various tasks on projects. Demonstrated initiative in administration, education (seminars, training), software development, and technical reports. Demonstrated success in project management and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to develop predictive and prescriptive models on large\-scale datasets to address various business problems through leveraging advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, or data mining techniques. Demonstrated ability to provide consultative services at an institutional or enterprise level to departments/divisions and committees from any Mayo entity requesting assistance is preferred. Demonstrated application of several problem\-solving methodologies, planning techniques, continuous improvement methods, project management methods, and analytical tools and methodologies (e.g. machine learning, statistical packages, modeling, etc.) required. Incumbent must have ability to independently manage a varied workload of projects with multiple priorities and stay current on healthcare trends and enterprise changes. Excellent interpersonal skills to include presentation, negotiation, persuasion, and written communications skills are required. Exceptional time management is required. In addition, requires excellent analytical skills, consulting skills, ability to identify and recommend solutions, advanced computer application skills and a commitment to customer service. Experience with data modeling and date exploration tools. **Preferred Experience** Advanced degree (Ph.D, M.Sc) in Computer Science, Engineering or quantitative field from an accredited University or College with 5\+ years of experience; OR a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or quantitative field from an accredited University or College with 10\+ years of experience. Requirements * Demonstrated ability to analyze and profile data as a means to address various business problems through leveraging advanced data modeling, source system databases, or data mining techniques. * Demonstrated application of several problem\-solving methodologies, planning techniques, continuous improvement methods, and analytical tools and methodologies (e.g. data analysis, data profiling, modeling, etc.). * Incumbent must have ability to manage a varied workload of projects with multiple priorities and stay current on healthcare trends and enterprise changes. * Interpersonal skills and time management skills are required. * Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify and recommend solutions, advanced computer application skills and a commitment to customer service. * Experience with data analysis, quality, and profiling. * Proficient in SQL and one other programming language commonly used in data engineering (Python, Scala, etc). * Experience in working with one or more cloud technologies: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Projects, or Microsoft Azure **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** $148,100 \- $214,700 / year **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** Monday – Friday; 10%\+ travel may be required This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/ we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Also, Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F\-1 STEM OPT extension program. **Weekend Schedule** Not Applicable **International Assignment** No **Site Description** Just as our reputation has spread beyond our Minnesota roots, so have our locations. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Learn more about what each unique Mayo Clinic campus has to offer, and where your best fit is. **Equal Opportunity** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Learn more about the "EOE is the Law". Mayo Clinic participates in E\-Verify and may provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. **Recruiter** Julie Melton

jobs.description: Job Description At our company, our Engineers support internal and external manufacturing operations to remain operational, continuously improve and innovate. The Senior Specialist, Vaccines Technology Operations position is responsible for providing technical leadership or support to the primary filling, inspection, and/or packaging operations within the vaccine manufacturing facility at the Wilson, NC Site. This position will be an individual contributor (with potential to have people management responsibilities), and member of the Technical Operations team within our product POD Integrated Process Team (IPT). This is an engineering role focused on commercial ramp up of the vaccine manufacturing facility as well as providing future routine operational support. This role will act as the technical subject matter expert for all aspects of validation and ongoing technical support for their area of assignment. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud, including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI\-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain\-specific agents and services that are transforming Azure customer support from reactive, human\-dependent workflows toward AI\-first systems capable of resolving customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to help build the next generation of production agentic AI services that resolve customer issues faster, reduce avoidable support demand, and improve the reliability and scalability of AI\-first support experiences. You will take product specifications and turn them into production\-ready, scalable AI services — working with LLM orchestration, multi\-agent coordination, and RAG\-based systems. You will ship production services that directly impact Azure customers. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help our team provide our customers with the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** Key Responsibilities * Translate product specifications into AI service architectures — decompose business intent into agent workflows, data source integrations, and scalable service designs. * Build agentic AI workflows solutions including prompt engineering, model selection, cost/token optimization, and RAG pipeline design. * Build evaluation systems including rubrics, golden datasets, and judge agents to validate agent correctness and safety before production deployment. * Write production\-quality C\# and Python with test\-driven development, ensuring services meet reliability, performance, and security standards. * Deploy services using CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and staged rollouts with full production observability (tracing, logging, metrics). * Implement secure service patterns including RBAC, Managed Identities, and secrets management. * Integrate agents with Azure data sources and cloud\-native services to ground agent responses in real\-time signals. * Apply Responsible AI practices across all agent development, ensuring outputs are safe, fair, and compliant. * Execute reliably within sprint and co\-development commitments across ACES and partner engineering teams. * jobs.title: Principal Engineer Team Lead, Simulation Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** Motional is at the forefront of the driverless revolution. An autonomous driving company backed by Hyundai Motor Group, we are making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We are seeking a Principal Engineer Team Lead to join and lead our Simulation Infrastructure team within the Testing Services organization. In this role, you will be the technical and team leader responsible for designing, building, scaling, and optimizing the cloud and software infrastructure that powers our Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) simulation framework and offboard validation pipeline. You will lead a high\-performing team of engineers responsible for processing millions of simulation runs per month, optimizing cloud compute resources, building robust scenario library infrastructure, and integrating simulation capabilities directly into Motional's software release gating lifecycle. Your work will directly accelerate autonomy development, improve build health, and ensure safe software releases across our robotaxi fleet. **What You'll Be Doing:** **Team Leadership \& Strategy** * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of simulation infrastructure engineers across multiple locations. * Define and execute the multi\-year technical roadmap for Simulation Infrastructure, aligning team goals with broader Autonomy and Testing Services objectives. * Partner cross\-functionally with Release, SIL Runtime, Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL), and Autonomy development teams to expand test coverage and streamline offboard validation. **Cloud Scale, Execution \& Cost Optimization** * Architect and maintain high\-throughput, multi\-cluster (with blue/green CI deployments), cloud load balancing, resim/orchestration pipelines, and job prioritization for cloud simulation. * Oversee EC2 sizing and spot queue enablement with automated failover to optimize AWS Cloud expenditures while maximizing compute throughput and queue observability. * Develop extensible, plug\-and\-play simulation engine abstractions and interfaces to support modular simulation architectures. * Ensure ecosystem compatibility and seamless integration across internal tools and frameworks. **Sim Definitions, Pipeline Automation \& Tooling** * Build and maintain System Under Test (SUT) definitions along with tooling to support SUT workflows across different simulation modalities. * Develop infrastructure supporting both local and remote/cloud execution and scaling, including map and scenario infrastructure plumbing. * Support and maintain data generation pipelines, synthetic data workflows, and automated log\-to\-synthetic pipelines. * Establish comprehensive cost, throughput, and queue observability, building real\-time metrics dashboards for simulation execution, cluster health, and cloud resource efficiency. * Lead postmortems, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives for simulation test stability and infrastructure reliability. **What We're Looking For:** * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a closely related engineering field. * **Experience:** 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience (or 5\+ years with a Master's degree) in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex cloud infrastructure. * **Technical Leadership:** 4\+ years of experience leading engineering teams, defining technical roadmaps, and mentoring junior/senior engineers. * **Programming Proficiency:** Strong production\-level engineering skills in Python and C\+\+ in Linux environments. * **Cloud \& Infrastructure Expertise:** Deep experience with AWS Cloud scaling, EC2 configuration, spot instances, cluster load balancing, and cloud cost management. * **CI/CD \& DevOps:** Hands\-on experience with GitLab CI/CD pipeline design, Docker containerization, and automated deployment architectures. * **Data \& Observability:** Proficiency interfacing with databases (SQL, Postgres, Trino) and building observability dashboards (Grafana, Looker). * **Simulation Domain Knowledge:** Experience with autonomous driving simulation platforms (e.g., log sim, synthetic simulation, open and closed loop simulation, Neural Generation, World Foundation Models, OpenScenario/OSC2, YAML scenarios). * **Workflow Orchestration:** Experience with workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Apache Airflow). **Bonus Points (Not Required):** * Familiarity with Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) bench integration, vehicle CAN protocols, or sensor simulation (Camera, LiDAR). * Experience with Physics Based Vehicle Dynamics Modeling and industry standard tools. **Working Conditions:** * **Hybrid Role:** Flexible working locations requiring occasional on\-site collaboration at our Las Vegas, NV, Pittsburgh, PA offices. * **Travel:** Up to 10% travel for cross\-site engineering alignment and team leadership. \#LI\-AE1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*
