development tools. * Communicate project status, risks, and technical decisions effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and QA teams to ensure successful product releases. * Identify, assess, and mitigate risks, including security risks, throughout the software development lifecycle. * Provide feedback and resolutions to escalated support issues. * Research and evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve system performance and developer productivity. ### **Minimum Requirements:**  timization, and platform improvements that benefit all future deployments. * Contribute to reusable implementation assets: deployment playbooks, configuration templates, and integration patterns. services, managed databases, blob storage, and identity providers. * Experience with containerized deployments: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, container registries, and CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment. * Familiarity with LLM concepts: prompt engineering, model selection and routing, confidence scoring, token economics, and the dis  in customer\-facing, consultative environments. * production context — building APIs, scripting automation, integrating with cloud services, or developing data processing pipelines. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in a hands\-on engineering capacity. * Experience implementing, configuring, or extending enterprise platforms or products within customer environments. * Experience delivering technology solutions in one or more of the following domains: insurance (underwriting, claims, policy administration, TPA operations), manufacturing (quality, supply chain, compliance, production operations), or jobs.description: **Senior Product Manager, Provider and RWD Health Systems Applications** ======================================================================== Natera's RWD platform at the clinic connects an ecosystem of real\-world evidence, molecular data, and clinical insights to deliver actionable information to physicians. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help build and scale physician\-facing RWD applications. We seek to unlock the full potential of real\-world data to improve treatment outcomes and make molecular results actionable in everyday treatment decisions. In this role, you'll own a physician\-facing RWD application for a patient's molecular and clinical journey and workflow integrations behind it, partnering with cross\-functional product teams, engineering, AI/ML teams, and clinical teams to deliver intuitive tools centered on enriched patient insights. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Advance Data Integration and Intelligence** * Collaborate with clinical product management, EMR, user experience product management, marketing, medical and a broad cross functional team to drive product strategy and roadmap, * Drive integration of genomic tests into the platform (Signatera/ctDNA, hereditary risk, tumor/normal and NGS profiling, liquid CGP, etc.) as part of a unified oncology digitized experience. * Work closely with AI/ML teams to build applications for patient\-level insights and clinic\-level insights, including cohort comparison, clinical trial matching, and cohort analytics back to individual patient care. * Partner with legal, privacy, and security so HIPAA obligations, PHI handling, and data\-governance requirements are designed into the product. **Elevate the User Experience** * Own the single\- and multi\-patient views that bring a patient's molecular results and clinical events together in one physician\-facing application. * Integrate AI\-powered clinical trial matching that connects patients and physicians to the most relevant investigational therapies based on molecular, clinical, and patient criteria. * Help reduce friction points at both the provider and patient level to enroll in clinical trials. * Partner across Natera to enable EMR/EHR integration and mobile access, ensuring seamless experiences for providers. * Contribute to an analytics framework that captures user analytics and informs continuous product development. **Enhance the Utility of Genomic Testing** * Support delivery of a physician\-facing platform that highlights therapies, tracks treatment response, and monitors disease progression in real time. * Ship tools and functionality to aid physician collaboration. * Connect molecular and clinical findings to relevant treatment pathways and outcomes data to make testing more actionable at the point of care. * Partner with Product Marketing, MSL, Sales, and Clinical Operations on enablement, training, and adoption. **Launch the De\-Identified Aggregated Research Platform for Health Systems** * Partner with the Health Systems BU to define, build, and launch a de\-identified, aggregated research platform that turns clinic data into a health\-system\-wide resource for precision medicine and research. **Engage Key Stakeholders** * Engage with physicians, KOLs, and academic collaborators to translate clinical needs into features. * Help track KPIs centered on the physician experience with RWD at the clinic. * Support representation of RWD at the clinic at conferences, industry forums, and customer discussions as needed. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** * 5\+ years of product management or related experience, including experience in healthcare, engineering, genomics, or AI/ML. * Deep understanding of the oncology domain with direct experience building requirements and collaborating with physicians. * Experience building clinician\-facing software that fits into real clinical workflows. * Experience delivering AI/LLM\-derived clinical data into provider\-facing products, including human\-in\-the\-loop review, confidence labeling, and data transparency. * Backlog ownership: writing and grooming user stories in Jira and driving PM perspective in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retros). * Hands\-on with data: comfortable writing SQL (or equivalent) to check status, investigate issues, and measure outcomes, and in the habit of asking 'is this correct, and are we ready to ship?' * Track record of setting product KPIs and moving them, with specifics on adoption, engagement, and quality. * Fluency in oncology / genomics clinical concepts (staging, lines of therapy, biomarkers, MRD/ctDNA). * Commitment to user\-centered design thinking, with a track record of translating user needs into intuitive and impactful product experiences. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with clinical, technical, and commercial audiences. **Preferred:** * Using AI tools day to day to prototype and draft specs. * EHR integration experience (SMART on FHIR, HL7/FHIR, Epic or other EHR app ecosystems). * Strong technical fluency; comfortable working with engineers, scientists, and data teams, and reasoning about what AI/ML and LLMs can and can't reliably do. * Familiarity with PHI\-handling applications, HIPAA, or regulated clinical software. * Familiarity with FDA clinical decision support or SaMD considerations. **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. **WHAT WE OFFER** Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Operations & Architecture
jobs.description: WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** -------------------- The National Basketball Association (NBA) is seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and technically credible Vice President, Cybersecurity Operations \& Architecture to lead the design, operation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity capabilities across the organization’s global technology ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role serves as the senior leader accountable for integrating enterprise security architecture with day\-to\-day cyber defense, incident response, threat detection, and infrastructure protection. The Vice President will establish security architecture strategy, standards, roadmaps, and reference architectures while ensuring those designs translate into sustainable operational controls, measurable detection coverage, effective response capabilities, and resilient technology services. The role will partner extensively with Cybersecurity, Enterprise Technology, Infrastructure, Engineering, Digital Products, Data \& Analytics, Media Operations, Basketball Operations, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, NBA teams, arena operators, and external technology partners. A core responsibility is setting NBA arena cybersecurity standards and making certain they are adhered to. This includes defining practical and enforceable requirements, guiding assessments and remediation, and addressing the security of arena IT, cloud\-connected services, operational technology, building and display control systems, game and event technologies, broadcast dependencies, and third\-party integrations. **Major Responsibilities** -------------------------- **Cybersecurity Strategy, Leadership \& Operating Model** --------------------------------------------------------- * Develop and execute an integrated, multi\-year cybersecurity operations and architecture strategy aligned with business priorities, technology roadmaps, risk tolerance, and the evolving threat landscape. * Lead and mature the Cybersecurity Operations and Cybersecurity Architecture functions, establishing clear accountability, decision rights, service models, performance expectations, and escalation paths. * Serve as a trusted advisor to the CISO and senior technology leadership on cyber risk, resilience, major technology investments, crisis readiness, and strategic security priorities. * Translate cybersecurity strategy into funded roadmaps, measurable outcomes, workforce plans, vendor strategies, and prioritized improvement initiatives. Promote a shared\-ownership model in which cybersecurity is embedded into technology planning, engineering, operational processes, and business initiatives. * **Enterprise Security Architecture Leadership** ----------------------------------------------- * Establish and maintain the NBA’s enterprise cybersecurity architecture strategy, roadmap, standards, design patterns, and reference architectures in partnership with cybersecurity, infrastructure, engineering, data, product, and business technology leaders. * Lead security architecture reviews for major technology initiatives and provide pragmatic guidance that balances cybersecurity risk, operational realities, resiliency, performance, cost, and business objectives. * Develop and maintain reference architectures for cloud services, applications, infrastructure, identity, data platforms, media operations, arena technologies, operational technology, on\-premises data centers, and third\-party integrations. * Ensure security requirements are incorporated early in technology planning, procurement, design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management. * Provide architectural leadership for identity and access management, network segmentation, zero trust, encryption, logging, monitoring, cyber resiliency, data protection, and secure connectivity. Represent cybersecurity in enterprise architecture, governance, design review, and technology investment forums. * **Security Operations, Detection \& Incident Response** ------------------------------------------------------- * Lead enterprise security operations, including continuous monitoring, threat detection, threat hunting, incident triage, containment, investigation, recovery coordination, and post\-incident improvement. * Define the strategy and operating model for security information and event management, detection engineering, automation, orchestration, case management, and operational metrics. * Improve visibility across cloud, hybrid, on\-premises, endpoint, identity, application, regional office, data center, arena, game, event, and broadcast environments. * Establish clear incident response roles, severity criteria, escalation protocols, executive communications, evidence handling expectations, and coordination with Legal, Privacy, Communications, business continuity, and ext Exceptional leadership, collaboration, stakeholder management, negotiation, and executive communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across complex, matrixed organizations and diverse external stakeholder groups. * Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to balance risk, operational needs, user experience, innovation, resilience, and cost. Ability to remain composed, decisive, and clear during high\-pressure incidents and high\-visibility events. * **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS or Azure security certifications, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- The Vice President, Cybersecurity Operations \& Architecture serves as the strategic and operational bridge between secure design, effective cyber defense, business enablement, and resilience. By unifying architecture with operations, this leader will help ensure that security standards are practical, measurable, and sustainable, and that operational lessons continuously improve future designs. The role is especially important to protecting enterprise platforms, global offices, digital products, sensitive data, games, broadcasts, events, and arena technology, while enabling the NBA to innovate and operate with confidence. **Salary Range:** $360,000\-$415,000 **Job Posting Title:** Vice President Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company\-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; fertility and family\-forming assistance; wellbeing allowance; educational assistance; mental health coaching/therapy; tax advantaged accounts such as HSA and healthcare/dependent care FSAs; a 401(k) retirement plan; and time off benefits that include vacation, sick time, and personal days. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. **About the NBA** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in more than 50 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2025\-26 season featured a record 135 international players from a record\-tying 43 countries. The NBA's digital assets include NBA TV, NBA.com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2\.5 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. The NBA's Tap to Watch provides seamless access to local, national and global live game telecasts via the NBA App, NBA.com, third\-party digital platforms and NBA partner platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA's global social impact platform, drives change on issues facing fans and communities in the areas of health and wellness, civic engagement, social justice and inclusion, and sustainability.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Senior Developers
jobs.description: Natoli Engineering is hiring two senior full\-stack developers to design, build and run our software portfolio. For more than 50 years, Natoli has made tablet compression tooling, tablet presses and related equipment for manufacturers worldwide from its headquarters in St. Charles, Missouri. Our software includes instrumentation and control software for our presses, tooling management and inspection tools, customer portals such as TabletCAD and our online store, internal business systems, and natoli.com. This is a hands\-on, senior individual\-contributor role. You will write production code most days and take work from first conversation with a stakeholder through requirements, design, testing, deployment and support. The two developers share ownership of the portfolio and report to the Head of IT; neither role leads or manages a team. AI is central to how we will build software. We want developers who already use AI coding assistants and agents every day, know how to build AI into development tools and practices, and know where AI output needs a careful human check. You should also have shipped and maintained real enterprise software, care about quality and documentation, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical people. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Portfolio ownership and technical direction** * Share ownership of Natoli's software portfolio with the other senior developer: software sold with our equipment, customer portals, internal business systems and natoli.com. Divide the work and back each other up. * Shape the technical roadmap and architecture for each application, and agree priorities with the Head of IT: new features, customer commitments, security fixes and technical debt. * Help set and follow engineering standards: coding conventions, branching strategy, code review and definition of done. * Review code from peers and contractors, and pair on the hardest problems. * Recommend build\-vs\-buy decisions and evaluate frameworks, libraries, vendors and tools. ### **AI\-enabled development** * Use AI coding assistants and agents \[such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor] every day across the SDLC: design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review and documentation. * Review, test and take responsibility for every line of AI\-generated code before it ships. * Build AI into Natoli's development tools and practices: AI\-assisted pull request review, test generation inside a TDD workflow, documentation generation, and AI steps in CI/CD pipelines. * Maintain the shared context that makes AI tools effective here: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, coding conventions, and connectors (such as MCP servers) to internal systems and documentation. * Work with the Head of IT on AI guardrails: approved tools, what code and data may go to which AI service, security review of AI output, and licensing and IP. * Add AI features to Natoli products and internal apps where they earn their place, such as search and assistants over technical documentation, using LLM APIs, retrieval and evaluation. * Measure the effect of AI on cycle time, defect rates and review effort, and evaluate new models and tools as they appear. * Share what works with colleagues across IT through demos, short guides and pairing. ### **Requirements and SDLC** * Gather requirements from customers, sales, support and internal users, and turn them into user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specs. * Own the full SDLC: discovery, design, build, test, release, maintenance and retirement. * Work in an agile cadence (Scrum or Kanban as each product needs) and help run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. * Estimate effort, track delivery and report status, risks and trade\-offs to the Head of IT. * Plan releases and versioning for customer\-facing products, including release notes and upgrade paths. ### **Architecture, data and performance** * Design secure, scalable, maintainable systems: front ends, APIs, services and integrations with third\-party systems (ERP, CRM, payments, identity). * Design relational schemas: normalization, keys and constraints, indexing, and safe, versioned migrations. * Choose the right data store for each job (relational, document, key\-value, search) and tune queries for performance. * Design caching at every layer (CDN, HTTP, application, distributed caches such as Redis), including invalidation strategy. * Design multi\-tenant patterns for SaaS products, including tenant data isolation. ### **Quality and testing** * Practice and champion test\-driven development (TDD). * Maintain a layered automated test suite: unit, integration, contract and end\-to\-end tests. * Build quality gates into the pipeline: test coverage, static analysis, linting and dependency and security scanning. * Triage production incidents, find root causes and write blameless post\-incident reviews. ### **CI/CD, cloud and operations** * Build and mainta skills, which are still scarce. Local pay data for AI skills is thin, so revisit the band after the first round of applicants. * Budget for both hires: $270,000–$330,000 combined base, plus bonus and benefits. * Hire both into the same band and set each offer by skills and experience, so the two peers are paid fairly relative to each other. * Pay toward the top of the band for FDA\-regulated software experience (21 CFR Part 11\), commercial software experience, or a stack that is hard to hire for locally. * Expected total cash per hire: about $142,000–$182,000\. * Other levers if base is tight: a $5,000–$15,000 signing bonus, extra PTO, a $2,000–$5,000 yearly training budget, and paid AI tool subscriptions. ### **Market benchmarks** Payscale, Built In and Orbyt pages listed under Sources · St. Louis base pay · checked October 2026 Each source reports a different spread, so compare the dots rather than the line lengths. Orbyt's modeled figures run highest; self\-reported Payscale and Built In data run lower. **Benefits, work arrangement and EEO statement** ------------------------------------------------ Fill in the brackets with your actual plan details. * Medical, dental and vision insurance, with \[X]% of premiums paid by Natoli * 401(k) with a \[X]% company match * \[N] days of paid time off plus \[N] paid holidays * Annual bonus program (5–10% target for this role) * $\[X] yearly professional development budget for courses, certifications and conferences * Company\-paid AI development tools and model access * Hybrid schedule: \[3] days a week at our St. Charles, MO headquarters, the rest remote * \[Paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, home\-office equipment] **Work authorization:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. \[Visa sponsorship is / is not available for this role.] **Equal opportunity:** Natoli Engineering Company, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process on request. **Notes for the hiring manager** -------------------------------- * **Keep the title at senior individual contributor.** Avoid "Lead" or "Manager"; both attract candidates who expect direct reports and a higher band. * **Hire for complementary strengths.** Both hires must meet the same bar, but one could lean toward back\-end, data and equipment integration, the other toward front\-end, customer portals and natoli.com. * **Explain the two\-person structure.** Tell candidates how the two developers will split ownership and how decisions get made with the Head of IT, since neither one leads. * **Test AI skills directly.** Add a live exercise: a small task in a sample codebase using the candidate's own AI tools, then ask how they checked the output. Keep a system\-design session, a real pull\-request review and a requirements role\-play with a non\-technical stakeholder. * **Trim the must\-haves.** The required list has 15 items; move anything you would waive for a great hire into Preferred. * **Fill every bracket.** Your real stack and tools help candidates self\-select and cut screening time. * **Post the range.** Missouri does not require salary ranges in job posts. Illinois does for employers with 15\+ employees when the job may be done partly in Illinois, which can apply to hybrid hires living in the Metro East. Confirm with HR or counsel. **Sources** ----------- * Natoli Engineering home page (products, software and locations) * Payscale: Lead Software Engineer, experienced, St. Louis (19 profiles; updated March 2025\) * Built In: Lead Software Engineer, St. Louis (anonymous employee submissions) * Orbyt: Full Stack Developer salaries, St. Louis (modeled estimates, updated August 2026; also reports BLS OEWS May 2025 figures for software developers)

jobs.title: DC Facilities Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nebius:** Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D. **DC Facilities Engineer** **Level of Responsibility:** Independently operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and takes end\-to\-end ownership of critical power, critical cooling, liquid cooling, and DCIM/BMS infrastructure systems; participates in incident management and commissioning activities; and mentors Associate DC Facilities Engineers. **Role profile:** This is a critical role within Nebius data center operations. A fully proficient infrastructure engineer who independently manages and troubleshoots critical power and critical cooling systems across the site and takes ownership of assigned engineering tasks from start to finish. Participates in incident management activities, supports site commissioning and build reviews, and contributes to ensuring all engineering work meets Nebius SLAs and standards. Enforces safe working practices, collaborates with facilities, network, and technician teams, and mentors Associate DC Facilities Engineers toward independent operation. **Core responsibilities** * Monitor and contribute to the tracking of critical environment maintenance and repair for assigned service lines to Nebius SLAs; identify and escalate developing faults before they impact service uptime. * ndependently operate, monitor, and troubleshoot critical power distribution infrastructure including UPS systems, PDUs, RPPs, and in\- rack busbar power systems. * Manage and maintain critical cooling infrastructure including CRAHs, CRACs, CDUs, and RDHx; perform capacity checks and leakage inspections. * Participate in incident management for infrastructure\-impacting events; support root\-cause analyses, document findings, and contribute to CAPA execution under the direction of the Senior DC Facilities Engineer. * Operate and administer DCIM and BMS platforms; build and maintain dashboards, alerts, capacity reports, and infrastructure records. * Support deployment and commissioning of GB\-scale liquid\-cooled rack infrastructure including direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems, manifolds, and CDU connections. * Perform and own preventive maintenance tasks for all critical power and critical cooling systems; maintain accurate maintenance logs and compliance records. * Participate in site reviews, design reviews, and commissioning activities; prepare and review technical reports to document findings.and communicate results. * Enforce Nebius critical power and critical cooling safety procedures; act as safety lead for engineering work orders on live. infrastructure. * Collaborate with facilities, network, and technician teams on infrastructure changes, capacity expansions, and major deployments. * Support adherence to Nebius standards and policies through documentation review and active participation in commissioning and design activities. * Contribute to vendor and contractor coordination by supporting scheduling, site access, and execution of work per Nebius expectations and safe\-working practices. * Actively mentors and trains Associate Associate DC Facilities Engineers; guides them through systems operation, safe working practices, and structured skill development toward independent operation. **Expected capabilities / expectations** * Working proficiency across all critical power systems: UPS, PDU, RPP, in\-rack busbar, and generator interfacing. * Hands\-on experience with critical cooling systems: CRAH/CRAC, CDU, RDHx, and water\-side infrastructure including leak detection. * Competent DCIM/BMS administration: alert management, capacity modeling, and dashboard reporting. * Developing knowledge of GB rack liquid cooling technology, DLC manifolds, and heat rejection infrastructure. U.S. Data Center Career Framework \- Technical Career Framework * Ability to participate in and support incident management activities including RCA and CAPA documentation. * Strong documentation discipline: change records, maintenance logs, capacity data, and incident write\-ups. * Clear and confident communication with facilities, network, and vendor teams during changes and incidents. **Core Physical Requirements** * Ability to stand and remain on your feet for extended periods, typically four or more consecutive hours during active shift operations. * Ability to safely lift, carry, and position equipment weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted, and heavier loads with appropriate team\-lift protocols or mechanical aids. * Comfortable working at heights including ascending and descending ladders, raised platform equipment, and elevated data center infrastructure. * Ability to work in confined spaces such as under raised floors, within enclosed rack enclosures, and in cable management pathways. * Comfortable working in environments with variable temperatures, including cold aisle containment zones and active cooling infrastructure. * Manual dexterity sufficient to handle small form\-factor components, precision cabling, and fine connector installations. * Visual acuity sufficient to read equipment labels, small\-form\-factor interface indicators, and detailed wiring diagrams in variable * lighting conditions. * Ability to push or pull equipment carts, server sleds, and wheeled infrastructure weighing up to 500 pounds on level surfaces. **On\-Call Requirement** * This role includes on\-call participation to respond to after\-hours critical power and critical cooling events, infrastructure alarms, and urgent maintenance requiring prompt engineering response. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Competitive compensation * Career growth and learning opportunities * Flexibility and ownership * Collaborative and innovative culture * Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects * International environment and talented teams **What's it like to work at Nebius:** Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI **Equal Opportunity Statement:** Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: At Nespresso, we place people and specialty coffee at the heart of what we do. As part of our team, you'll be empowered to inspire, care, act, and innovate to reach your full potential and reimagine what coffee can be. As a certified B Corporation, we're committed to driving our triple bottom line – People, Profit, and Planet – by delivering an exceptional coffee experience that elevates our community, suppliers, farmers, and each other, channeling our growth\-minded spirit to set new standards in global coffee culture. Quality, sustainability, diversity, and inclusion are core to who we are and critical to our vision of driving positive change. Throughout our factories, boutiques, and office locations, Nespresso careers are brimming with best\-in\-class opportunities for your development and growth. Join us! **POSITION OVERVIEW:** This Full Stack Engineer will manage local standalone applications for market initiatives which will in turn improve performance of the Nespresso US eCommerce responsive site. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations. Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking a hands\-on **Staff Software Engineer** to take ownership of our core card **authorization platform.** This high\-throughput, low\-latency platform processes real\-time debit and prepaid transactions over **ISO 8583** for major networks including Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, and Fiserv. Because every request operates under strict latency budgets, high availability, and PCI DSS compliance, every millisecond counts—and every failure carries direct financial impact. In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers, drive the architectural evolution of our network connectivity and authorization services, and continue to write production\-grade code. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for platform upgrades, network certifications, and production incident management. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Technical Leadership \& Team Management** ------------------------------------------- * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5–8 software engineers. * Set coding standards, conduct architectural design reviews, perform code reviews, and foster technical excellence. * Serve as the technical owner and primary point of contact for production health, network certifications, and platform upgrades. **Core Architecture \& Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain high\-throughput, low\-latency Java/Spring Boot microservices covering authorizations, financial transactions, advices, reversals, and stand\-in processing. * Manage long\-lived client/server TCP connections to card networks, ensuring robust handling of sign\-on/sign\-off, echo tests, request/response matching, and automatic failovers. * Architect distributed transaction boundaries ensuring data consistency across Oracle, Kafka, JMS, and downstream services through idempotency, compensation/saga patterns, and reversal handling. * Implement resilient concurrency models: tune thread pools and executors, control backpressure, execute row\-level/distributed locking, and eliminate race conditions on balances and card states. * Build fault\-tolerant systems using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limiters, retries, and graceful degradation). **Platform Modernization \& Security** -------------------------------------- * Drive platform modernization initiatives, including Spring Boot 2\.7 3\.5 / Jakarta EE migration, removing legacy RMI/JMX remoting, and containerizing microservices for Kubernetes deployment. * Collaborate with Security and HSM teams to integrate EMV cryptogram processing (ARQC), CVV/dCVV/CVC3 validation, and HSM key management. * Maintain strict PCI DSS compliance across all services (PAN masking, sensitive authentication data protection, secure logging, and secrets management). **Operations \& Stakeholder Engagement** ---------------------------------------- * Define SLIs/SLOs and create comprehensive dashboards and alerts using Dynatrace and Splunk. * Lead incident response efforts, drive root\-cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent remediations. * Partner with Product, Network/Scheme partners, QA, and Operations to navigate card network mandates, network certifications, and release schedules. **Requirements \& Qualifications** ---------------------------------- **Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** ----------------------------------- * **Experience \& Leadership:** 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading engineering teams or driving technical architecture. * **Core Java Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in Java (11/17\+), deep understanding of java.util.concurrent, JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and memory analysis. * **Spring Framework:** Extensively hands\-on with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices (Config, OpenFeign, Actuator, Security). * **Distributed Transactions \& Systems:** Proven expertise in transaction management trade\-offs (2PC/XA vs. Saga pattern, outbox pattern, idempotent consumers/producers, and delivery semantics). * **Database \& RDBMS:** Deep relational database skills (Oracle preferred), including JDBC transaction isolation, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, deadlock analysis, and SQL query tuning. * **Messaging \& Event Streaming:** Real\-world experience with event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (Avro, Schema Registry) and/or JMS (ActiveMQ). * **System Resilience:** Hands\-on experience implementing resilience frameworks (Resilience4j or similar) for high\-availability systems running thousands of TPS. * **DevOps \& Quality:** Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/Jenkins), Gradle, static code/security analysis (SonarQube, SAST, Trivy), and test automation frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito). * **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical trade\-offs for engineers, product leads, and executive leadership. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** ------------------------- * **jPOS Framework:** Experience with **ISOMsg,** custom packagers, channels (PostChannel, BaseChannel), **ISOMUX/QMUX, ISOServer,** and Q2 configuration. * **ISO 8583 Specifications:** Hands\-on experience with Visa Base I, Mastercard MIP/Debit, Pulse, or Fiserv STAR/Accel specifications (messages 0100/0110, 0200/0210, 0400/0420, 0800 network management, DE55 EMV TLV data). * **Observability Tools:** Advanced usage of Dynatrace (PurePath, Smartscape, DQL) and Splunk (SPL query generation, alerting, dashboards). * **Advanced Concurrency:** In\-depth familiarity with ReentrantLock, StampedLock, distributed locks (ShedLock, Redisson), Java 21 Virtual Threads, and Micrometer metrics integration. * **Card Payments Domain:** Understanding of EMV chip/contactless flows, stand\-in processing, settlement, chargebacks, HSM integration (Atalla, Thales payShield), and key management (KEK, ZPK, key blocks). * **Infrastructure \& Rules:** Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (MSK, IAM), and business rules engines (Drools, Jess). **Education** ------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). * Direct experience in the Payments, Fintech, or Banking domain is strongly preferred. * **10–15 years** of professional experience in designing, coding, developing, and scaling high\-throughput, enterprise\-grade Java/J2EE applications. * **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in a technical lead or architectural capacity—driving system design, leading 5–8 engineers, and setting coding/quality standards. * **Proven track record** of architecting low\-latency, mission\-critical distributed systems operating under strict SLAs and high concurrency.

jobs.description: **Normal Computing \| Build with Us** ------------------------------------- Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), London, Copenhagen, and Seoul. **The Role** ------------ As an early\-career Product Manager, you'll work with the Product Lead and the engineering teams to help build the AI systems and autoresearch platform our ASIC team needs to tapeout unconventional, physics\-based architecture. We are rethinking the chip design system from the ground up, automating the process of research: exploring the full design space, generating candidate architectures, evaluating them at appropriate levels of fidelity, and feeding learnings from experiments run in hardware labs and deployed silicon into the next generation chip. Domains of exploration include RTL optimization, design verification, and continual learning from experiment results. You'll help decide what we build, then be accountable for delivering on the incremental milestones to tapeout. On any given day, you might sit with a chip architect benchmarking novel architectures, shadow a verification debug session and come back with a proposal for what to automate, scope out the requirements and success criteria for a custom EDA tool, or prototype an experiment dashboard. This is a building role. You'll write specs, run experiments, and use coding agents to prototype and land fixes yourself. When you have an idea, we would rather you spend an afternoon prototyping a rough version than a week describing it. No semiconductor background is required to start. In your first few months the bar is understanding how the team works, asking the questions that move a design discussion forward, and earning trust by following through on deliverables. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **AI tooling scope:** Investigate where the ASIC team's time actually goes, decide what we build, then be accountable for whether it gets used. * **Specs and prototypes:** Write the requirements docs and user journeys that engineering builds from. Where a working prototype communicates faster than a document, build the prototype instead. * **Prototype to production:** Work with engineers to turn a promising prototype into something the ASIC team can rely on. * **Shipping small changes:** Work in the codebase with coding agents, open PRs for bug fixes or UI changes, learn from code reviews from engineers, and develop judgment about which changes are yours to make. **What Makes You a Great Fit** ------------------------------ * A degree in CS, EE, physics, math, or similar, or the equivalent taught to yourself. * 1\-3 years of experience in product management, engineering, research, technical program management, or a related technical role. * You can point to something that was your idea and that you made real. * Fluency with coding agents. Much of what you work on will be underspecified. You should be able to take a vague problem, frame it, and come back with a proposal. * Interest in how chips are designed. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Coursework, research, or internship experience in chip architectures, digital design, verification, or hardware performance modeling. * Exposure to SystemVerilog. * Familiarity with the mechanisms underlying LLM inference ***Equal Employment Opportunity Statement*** *Normal Computing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: IT STATEWIDE ASSOCIATE ENGINEER 1-4 (DCO/OTS)
jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This position is located in the Data Center Operations Section. Req. 227096 The Office of Technology Services aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State's investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. This is a high level technical support position requiring the ability to provide technical leadership in the implementation and management of complex database systems. The incumbent will possess advanced, specialized skills in database platforms and software. The nature of the work is highly complex and requires a deep understanding of people, processes and technology within the context of a large enterprise and government environment. The incumbent is required to have in\-depth database planning, design, and analysis skills. The incumbent may be required to coordinate and serve as liaison with multiple vendors for in\-house and outsourced database related initiatives. The Division of Administration is the state government’s management arm and the hub of its financial operations. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Two years of experience in information technology; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field; OR An associate's degree in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any area. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any area. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. NOTE: Any college hours or degree must be from an accredited college or university. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: * Performs day\-to\-day administration, maintenance, and support of database systems serving multiple state agencies and critical business applications. I * nstalls, configures, upgrades, patches, monitors, and maintains database platforms in on\-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments. * Performs database backup and recovery, performance monitoring and tuning, capacity management, security configuration, and high availability and disaster recovery support. * Coordinates database maintenance activities, including after\-hours work when required to meet business availability requirements. * Works with vendors and internal technical teams to troubleshoot database software and configuration issues and implement appropriate solutions. * Provides technical support and guidance to application developers, system administrators, technical support personnel, and end users regarding database configuration, performance, connectivity, availability, and functionality. * Develops and maintains technical documentation, procedures, configuration standards, and operational runbooks. * Performs problem determination and resolution for database\-related incidents and service requests reported by application users and technical staff. * Provides Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support based on the complexity of the issue and established support procedures. * Investigates database availability, performance, connectivity, backup and recovery, security, and application\-related issues using database monitoring, diagnostic, logging, and performance analysis tools. * Coordinates with application, infrastructure, network, security, cloud, and vendor teams to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes. Documents resolutions and follows up with users and technical teams as necessary. * Provides database administration and technical support for assigned projects and initiatives. * Participates in the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of database solutions, including new database installations, upgrades, migrations, high availability configurations, disaster recovery solutions, and cloud database implementations. * Assists with evaluating and implementing database tools and technologies. * Uses scripting and automation to improve routine database administration tasks and operational efficiency. * Works with senior database administrators and other technical teams on complex projects and technical issues. * Participates in knowledge\-sharing and training activities and develops familiarity with database technologies, cloud services, automation, security practices, and enterprise database standards. * Provides technical advice and assistance to management, application teams, system administrators, and other technical personnel regarding database administration, capacity planning, performance, availability, security, backup and recovery, and emerging database technologies. * Assists with technology evaluations, product research, and technical planning activities. * Keeps current with database technology, cloud services, automation tools, security practices, vendor recommendations, technical documentation, and industry trends relevant to the State's database environment. * Performs other duties as assigned to provide reliable, secure, and effective database services. Position\-Specific Details: **Appointment Type:** This vacancy will be filled by promotion of a current permanent status Office of Technology Services employee. A permanent status employee may be required to serve a new probationary period in lieu of promotion. **Career Progression:** This position may be filled as an IT Statewide Associate Engineer 1, 2,3 or 4, depending on the level of experience of the selected applicant. **Compensation:**The Salary range listed on the job posting reflects the pay grade minimum and maximum for the IT Statewide Associate Engineer 1 job title. The salary range pay grade minimum and maximum for the other levels of the career progression group can be viewed using the links below: IT Statewide Associate Engineer 2 IT Statewide Associate Engineer 3 IT Statewide Associate Engineer 4 Louisiana is a "State as a Model Employer" for People with Disabilities. How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. \*Information to support your eligibility for the position must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections. Applications may be rejected if incomplete. The transcripts can be added as an attachment to your online application. The selected candidate will be required to submit original documentation upon hire. Prior to a new hire, a background check, including criminal record history, will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment, but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. A criminal history check may be conducted on employees changing positions, including promotions, demotions, details, reassignments, and transfers. Also, prospective employees may be subject to pre\-employment drug testing. New hires will be subject to employment eligibility verification via the federal government's E\-Verify system. **For further information about this posting, please contact:** Erica R. Gay HR Specialist Division of Administration/Office of Human Resources Email:Erica.Gay@la.gov

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Oakwood.** Oakwood Systems Group is a Microsoft Solutions Partner helping organizations modernize applications, data platforms, cloud environments, and business workflows. Our AI work focuses on moving clients beyond experimentation by designing and delivering secure, production\-ready AI applications, agents, copilots, and automation that create measurable business value. **The Role.** We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on AI Engineer who can turn ambiguous business problems into reliable AI solutions. This role is for an engineer with a strong software, data, or machine\-learning foundation who has already shipped production systems and is comfortable owning work from discovery and technical design through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and operational handoff. You will work directly with clients and Oakwood delivery teams to build practical AI capabilities on the Microsoft cloud, with particular emphasis on generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, enterprise integration, and responsible production operations. **What You Will Do:** ===================== * Design, build, and deploy production of AI applications, copilots, and agents using Microsoft Azure and modern AI frameworks. * Build RAG and enterprise knowledge solutions using embeddings, vector search, document processing, metadata, and retrieval strategies that produce grounded, source\-aware answers. * Design agentic workflows that use tools, APIs, structured outputs, memory/state, human approval, and multi\-step orchestration to automate real business processes safely. * Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications and data sources through REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, databases, SaaS platforms, and custom services. * Develop maintainable backend services and APIs, primarily in Python, with appropriate testing, error handling, logging, security, and performance considerations. * Establish evaluation approaches for AI quality, groundedness, reliability, safety, latency, and cost; use those results to improve prompts, retrieval, orchestration, and model selection. * Implement production engineering practices including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, secrets management, observability, and environment promotion. * Apply enterprise security and governance practices, including identity, role\-based access, data boundaries, auditability, responsible AI controls, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns where appropriate. * Work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to understand workflows, clarify requirements, prototype solutions, explain tradeoffs, and translate AI possibilities into deployable designs. * Contribute architecture reviews, code reviews, estimation, technical discovery, and solution design for new client opportunities. * Create reusable patterns, accelerators, reference implementations, and delivery of assets that improve the speed and consistency of future Oakwood AI engagements. * Document solutions clearly and support knowledge transfer so client teams can understand, operate, and extend what we deliver. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers and help establish pragmatic engineering standards for production of AI delivery. **Required Qualifications:** ============================ * 5\+ years of professional engineering experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, applied AI, backend development, or a closely related discipline, with meaningful ownership of production systems. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building generative AI / LLM\-powered applications or AI\-enabled software, with at least one solution taken beyond prototype into a production or production\-like environment. * Strong Python programming skills and experience building production services, APIs, integrations, or data/AI pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with LLM application patterns such as prompt design, RAG, embeddings, vector search, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent orchestration. * Experience evaluating AI systems using measurable criteria rather than subjective demos alone, including quality, reliability, safety, latency, and/or cost. * Experience with cloud\-based applications and AI services; strong Azure experience is preferred, and candidates should be able to work effectively in a Microsoft\-centric environment. * Working knowledge of SQL and enterprise data integration, including the ability to reason about data quality, access, lineage, and how data architecture affects AI outcomes. * Experience with modern software engineering practices: Git, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, APIs, logging/monitoring, and secure configuration/secrets management. * Ability to troubleshoot production of AI behavior, including retrieval failures, hallucinations, tool\-calling errors, prompt regressions, latency, cost, and unexpected edge cases. * Strong client\-facing communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts, architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to both engineers and business stakeholders. * Ability to work independently in a consulting environment, manage competing priorities, and move from incomplete requirements to a well\-structured implementation plan. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** ============================= * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or related Microsoft AI services. * Experience with one or more orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI, or custom agent frameworks. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent\-to\-tool integration patterns, or reusable enterprise tool registries. * Experience with Azure application services such as Functions, Container Apps, App Service, AKS, API Management, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Entra ID. * Experience with MLOps / LLMOps practices including evaluation pipelines, model or prompt versioning, tracing, monitoring, feedback loops, and production incident response. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or other modern data platforms used to prepare governed enterprise data for AI. * Experience with classical machine learning, NLP, deep learning, fine\-tuning, multimodal models, or model serving where the use case requires more than foundation\-model APIs. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor while applying disciplined engineering review for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Prior consulting, professional services, systems integration, or Microsoft partner experience. * Relevant Microsoft or cloud certifications, such as Azure AI Engineer, Azure Developer, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent. **What Success Looks Like:** ============================ * AI solutions move from discovery and prototype to secure, supportable production deployments with clear acceptance criteria. * Clients can see and articulate the business value of the systems delivered, not just the technical novelty. * AI quality is measured and improved through repeatable evaluation, observability, and feedback rather than one\-time demonstrations. * Solutions integrate cleanly with client applications, data, identity, and operating processes and can be maintained after handoff. * Reusable engineering patterns and delivery assets reduce effort and risk across future engagements. * You are viewed by clients and teammates as a trusted engineer who can combine technical depth, sound judgment, and practical delivery. **Why Oakwood** =============== Oakwood combines deep Microsoft expertise with hands\-on application, data, cloud, and AI engineering. We hold Microsoft Solutions Partner designations across key solution areas and an Advanced Specialization for AI Applications on Microsoft Azure. AI Engineers at Oakwood have the opportunity to work directly with clients, build real production solutions, shape reusable delivery patterns, and help organizations turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into durable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Head of Data Platform & AI
jobs.description: ### **About the Company:** Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that's both high\-quality and accessible. With in\-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence\-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness. ### **Job Summary:** Octave is looking for a Head of Data Platform \& AI to lead the technical vision and execution across our data platform and emerging AI, machine learning, and Data Science capabilities. This role will own and evolve Octave's data and AI/ML technical foundation, set the technical/strategic direction for AI/ML in close partnership with Product and cross\-functional business leaders, and build the team required to execute that vision as Octave grows. This is a leadership role for a builder. While you will set strategy, lead the team, and operate as a senior cross\-functional partner, you will remain close to the technology and be expected to contribute directly to architecture, prototypes, technical evaluation, and difficult engineering problems. You will initially lead a Data Platform team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business leaders across Octave. ### **Management Responsibilities:** * Develops, coordinates, and implements systems, policies, procedures, and productivity standards. * Provide leadership and guidance to the team, ensuring the achievement of goals and objectives. * Foster a positive and collaborative work environment. * Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of projects and initiatives within the team. * Establish and monitor operational processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity. * Streamline operational processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall organizational performance. * Implement best practices, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and develop strategies to achieve operational excellence. * Ensures a safe, secure, and compliant work environment. * Accomplishes staff results by communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results. * Build and manage a high\-performing team, including hiring, training, and development. * Provide leadership to the team, including setting goals, providing guidance, and ensuring the team's overall success. * Set performance expectations and goals for team members. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and address performance issues. * Identify skill gaps within the team and develop strategies for filling those gaps. Support employee development through training, mentoring, and coaching. Identify high\-potential employees and create succession plans. * Raise the bar for how the team uses LLM and agentic tools to improve engineering productivity, accelerate experimentation, and increase the leverage of the team. ### **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Define Octave's Data \& AI Technical Vision * + Develop and own the technical strategy and roadmap for Octave's data platform and AI/ML capabilities, while shaping company\-level direction and investment priorities by bringing a data and AI perspective to decisions about where Octave competes and how it grows. + Own company\-level KPIs spanning Octave's AI/ML and Data Platform areas — defining the measures that matter, holding accountability for outcomes against them, and reporting on progress to the executive team. + Partner closely with Product and cross\-functional leaders to identify where AI, machine learning, and Data Science can create meaningful customer and business value, and own the technical strategy and capabilities required to bring those opportunities to life. + Serve as Octave's senior technical leader and thought partner on data, AI, ML, and Data Science. + Help Product, Engineering, and business leaders evaluate opportunities, understand technical feasibility and tradeoffs, and shape Octave's approach to emerging capabilities. + Develop a clear point of view on where traditional machine learning, predictive modeling, generative AI, LLM\-based systems, and other approaches are appropriate. + Establish principles for when Octave should build capabilities internally, leverage third\-party platforms or models, or partner externally. + Balance near\-term delivery with the foundational investments required to support Octave's longer\-term strategy. * Lead AI/ML and Data Science Technical Strategy * + Establish the technical capabilities required to develop, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production AI and machine\-learning systems. + Work with Product and business leaders to translate promising AI/ML opportunities into well\-defined technical initiatives. + Ensure AI/ML initiatives are grounded in clear cu bject to the terms of the applicable Equity Incentive Plan. * **Remote Work Stipend:** New full\-time employees receive a $300 equipment reimbursement to support a home office setup. * **Internet \& Phone Reimbursement:** Full\-time employees are eligible for a monthly reimbursement of up to $75 for internet and cell phone related expenses. *Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Octave will not discharge or in any other manner coerce, intimidate, threaten, discriminate or retaliate against employees or applicants because they have: (i) inquired about, discussed, compared, or disclosed their own wages, benefits, or other compensation, or the wages, benefits, or other compensation of another employee or applicant; (ii) asked Octave to provide a reason for the employee's wages or lack of opportunity for advancement; or (iii) aided or encouraged others in exercising their rights to discuss wages, compensation, or benefits, or to seek pay equity.* *However, except as otherwise provided by law, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) in compliance with the company's legal duty to furnish information under applicable law .* ### **Comprehensive Benefits:** At Octave, we believe in supporting the "human being first". Here's a snapshot of the benefits available to eligible employees: * **Health \& Wellness:** Choose what works best for you with one High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) and two PPO medical plan options, plus comprehensive Dental and Vision coverage. * **Medical Support:** Enjoy access to a company\-sponsored membership with One Medical for convenient, modern care. * **Retirement**: Plan for your future with a 401(k) that offers both traditional and Roth options. * **Paid Time Off:** Time to recharge matters. Take advantage of a generous time off policy, up to 12 paid company holidays, and accrued sick time. * **Financial Protection:** We've got you covered with company\-paid Life, AD\&D, and Disability insurance, plus optional extras like Pet, Legal, and Worksite plans (Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, and Accident). * **Parental Leave (Bonding Time)**: Growing your family? Full\-time employees can take paid bonding leave after 6 months, whether it's a new baby, adoption, or foster placement. Time off increases with tenure. * **Growth:** Keep learning and leveling up with professional development reimbursement for role\-related growth opportunities. ### **How We Use Technology in Hiring:** As part of our hiring process, we may use technology tools, including AI\-supported systems, to assist with reviewing applications or documenting interviews. These tools are designed to support our team, not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are always made by our team. This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost\-effective manufacturing. **We offer:** Aside from a dynamic global culture and leading market position, we are proud to offer our employees development opportunities, competitive salary and **a robust benefit program ALL** **available on first day of employment**! The perks and benefits of working at Oerlikon include the following: * Comprehensive medical and prescription drug plan with low premiums, company sponsored HSA contributions and without cumbersome waiting periods to keep you going strong. * Excellent Dental and Vision coverage. * Employee Assistance, Financial and Wellness programs to help improve all aspects of your life journey. * 401(k) retirement savings plan with significant company match and financial planning and education options to help you achieve your retirement goals * Tuition reimbursement and internal education resources to satisfy your love of learning so you can continue to grow with us! * Generous paid time off to support your physical and mental wellbeing. * 12 paid company holidays to occasionally extend your weekends or time off. * 100% company paid life insurance and disability insurance * Employee Referral Bonus program because why not to bring your friends to work everyday! **Your Responsibilities:** * Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. * Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. and/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. * Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Purpose of the Position The official title for this role is Technical Alignment Manager (TAM). The TAM is responsible for understanding the client’s environment, what they do, how they use their technology to enable their business, and, from a technical perspective, maintaining that relationship with them. Establishing a technical relationship with the clients allows the TAM to communicate from a hands\-on level. They dig deep into a client’s operations to figure out how they work and apply technology solutions that help them work better, smarter, faster, and more efficiently while also helping reduce costs. A person in this position will continually analyze a client’s technology against the applicable company Standard(s), and/or compliance requirements, uncovering technical gaps and risks. Because they have an in\-depth knowledge of their assigned client’s IT environment, the TAM can recommend enhancements to their systems that will uphold best practices regarding cybersecurity, overall system performance, user experience, and more. The TAM’s combined knowledge of the industry and client infrastructure makes it possible for them to identify and proactively address technical risks and issues before they become bigger problems. A TAM is the technical lead for proactive service, maintenance, and planning— driving down the need for, cost, and time sink inherent in reactive support. A successful person in this position will be highly technical, a natural troubleshooter, client\-focused, and have a proactive mindset. They must be a detail\-oriented self\-starter who takes ownership for their responsibilities, meets deadlines, and communicates effectively with teammates, clients, and vendors.
