jobs.title: Outcome Engineer - Orlando FL
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Orlando, Florida **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Senior Outcome Engineer$180K – $220K • Offers Equity * Staff Outcome Engineer$205K – $255K • Offers Equity * Principal Outcome Engineer$240K – $290K • Offers Equity * **Equity**: Share in the company's success. * **Flexible Work Environment**: Remote\-first organization\* with flexible work hours and unlimited PTO. *(\*note that some roles are in\-person, on\-site with customers)* * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: Health, dental, vision, and life insurance. * **Retirement Plan**: 401(k) plan with company match to secure your future. * **Parental Leave**: 8 weeks at 100% regardless of state. * **Company Retreats**: Annual company summit trips. * **Home Office Budget**: $1,000 per year for home office improvements. ***Consequential Work. Dedicated People.*** ------------------------------------------- **About Onebrief** ------------------ Onebrief builds collaboration and AI\-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. **We are also defining the future of software development. We believe the era of "human bandwidth" as the primary constraint on software delivery is ending. We are building a dedicated team to transition our organization from Software Engineering to Outcome Engineering.** **About The Role** ------------------ You’re a world\-class software engineer who excelled at the “old version” of software development, and are reinventing yourself right here, right now. You see the promise and pitfalls of a world unconstrained by human bandwidth, and are ready to fully embrace the super\-powered creation that AI unlocks. As an Outcome Engineer at Onebrief, you’ll join the team inventing our **AI Engineering Platform**. This is neither just prompt building nor model development. You will be part of a team building the factory that builds the software. You will help move us from a world of managed backlogs to a world of infinite execution, creating the foundation of what product development becomes in an agentic world. We are looking for pioneers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Architect Multi\-Agent Systems:** Design the orchestration layers that enable multiple specialized agents to collaborate, debate, and execute complex tasks reliably. You will move us from simple prompts to robust, stateful agentic workflows. * **Implement Automated Governance:** Create the "guardrails" and policy engines that allow autonomous systems to operate safely at speed. You will build the infrastructure that replaces manual review with programmatic constraints. * **Engineer Context and Memory:** Build the semantic infrastructure (knowledge graphs, vector stores) that provides agents with deep, structural understanding of our codebase and business intent. You will solve the "blank slate" problem for autonomous workers. * **Build Rigorous Evaluation Frameworks:** Develop the testing harness that defines success. You will move us beyond "vibes" to deterministic validation of agentic outputs using formal specifications and automated metrics. * **Design Self\-Healing Loops:** Connect observability data directly to agent actions, enabling systems that not only detect failures but autonomously analyze and remediate them. * **Prototype and Deploy:** We prove success by shipping. You will rapidly prototype new agentic tools and deploy them to production for both our internal teams and customers. This is a creation role; we learn by building. * **Experiment and Learn:** This is a new field. You will be experimenting with new models, new orchestration techniques, and new ways of validating agent behavior every day. **What We Look For** -------------------- We are casting a wide net. While strong software engineering skills are valuable, we believe the best Outcome Engineers might come from diverse backgrounds, that interdisciplinary backgrounds and an embrace of ego\-free collaboration is key to inventing the future. * **Software Engineer:** You are a coder who is ready to automate your own job. You see code as a liability and outcomes as the asset. You love building products, tools, platforms, and force multipliers. * **AI Researcher:** You understand the models at a deep level but want to apply them to messy, real\-world production systems. You care about emergent behavior and multi\-agent coordination. You have strong opinions about world models. * **Game Engineer:** You have experience building complex simulations or games. You understand how to define rules, entities, and validation logic for autonomous agents. * **Product Manager:** You are obsessive about products. You excel at translating ambiguous user needs into rigorous deliverables, managing complexity, and unknown unknowns. * **Platform/SRE Engineer:** You view infrastructure as a product. You are expert in observability, reliability, and automation. You want to apply o11y to the new world of probabilistic AI systems. * **Designers:** You're not afraid to create with technology. You care deeply about building agentics systems that make more humane products and decisions. * **Agentic Pioneer:** Regardless of your title, you have already built your own agents. You've hit the limits of frameworks like LangChain or AutoGen and have strong opinions on how to orchestrate reliable reasoning. **The Non\-Negotiables: How We Work** ------------------------------------- While we are open to many backgrounds, there are a few baselines for success in this team: * **You Must Be a Product Builder:** Whether your background is code, design, or leadership, you must have a history of shipping. We don't just theorize; we deploy. You need to understand the visceral difference between a prototype and a product that users rely on. * **You Must Be an Active Agentic Builder:** This isn't something you read about on Twitter. You built with an agent last week. You're building with one right now. You know the frustration of a prompt that worked yesterday failing today. * **You Must Love Intense Collaboration:** We are all\-remote but high\-bandwidth. We leave video links open while we eat lunch. Our pets and kids know our coworkers. If you prefer to go dark for three weeks and emerge with a PR, this is not the team for you. We think, debate, and build together, often synchronously. * **You Respect Expertise, But Don't Gatekeep:** We are bringing together radically different disciplines. We value deep expertise, but we value the willingness to share it and empower others even more. No silos. * **You Must Write to Think:** In a distributed, asynchronous, fast\-moving environment, clarity of thought is demonstrated through clarity of writing. You share bad ideas to get to good ones. You document your experiments, your architectural decisions, and your failures. **Core Tech We Use (and You Will Build)** ----------------------------------------- * **Agentic Stack:** Large Language Models, Vector Databases, the usual suspects. * **Foundational Stack:** Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS. **Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies** Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief. Compensation Range: $180K \- $290K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **About the Role** ------------------ Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next\-generation physical\-world sensing and AI\-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add\-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products. As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third\-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi\-product suite. You will also set patterns the rest of the team builds on. AI\-native tooling is expected to be embedded in your workflow. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * Design and build the sensing\-platform connector/adapter layer that maps LiDAR\- and imagery\-derived asset detections into OpenGov Products * Architect the automated detection\-to\-case pipeline that turns a sensing detection into a properly routed record in the right product's workflow engine, complete with photo evidence, GPS coordinates, and a severity score. * Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer\-vision and LiDAR\-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd\-capture). * Design the data model and storage layer for a continuously updated spatial data that all five Community Operations products read from and contribute to. * Own the technical design for a tiered sensing\-ingestion model (satellite, fleet\-vehicle camera, full LiDAR survey) supporting different refresh cadences, accuracy levels, and price points. * Partner with engineering and product leads across OpenGov products to sequence the sensing layer's roadmap against each product's asset taxonomy and compliance requirements. * Write clear technical design docs that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit. * Establish testing, monitoring, and data\-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety\-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation. **Qualifications \& Preferred Experience** ------------------------------------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross\-system integrations end\-to\-end in a production SaaS environment. * Experience building or integrating computer\-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data\-processing pipelines; comfort with point\-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus. * Strong data\-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one\-off custom logic. * Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred. * Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build\-vs\-integrate calls. * Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan. * A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public\-sector systems) is a strong plus. * Proficient in AI\-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness. * Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **How This Level Is Differentiated** ------------------------------------ The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones: * Owns a technical domain end\-to\-end with full accountability for outcomes, from architecture through production operation. * Operates with strategic awareness across multiple downstream product teams; makes strong technical calls with incomplete vendor and data information. * Sets technical direction and milestones for the sensing\-integration roadmap; influences cross\-functional partners without formal authority. * Establishes patterns, like the connector/adapter approach, that other engineers and products reuse, elevating the work of the broader team. * Expected to embed AI\-native tooling in their own workflow and model its effective use for teammates joining the team. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $205K \- $227K

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **AI Solutions Developer** ========================== Full\-time · Remote (US) P3 Adaptive is an AI and data consultancy built on Microsoft technologies: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365, and Azure. We're hiring a software engineer to build AI applications across client engagements, our own products, and reusable tools for our consultants. In this role, you'll partner with clients and the consultants who know their data, work through the problem together, and build the software that solves it, whether that's an agent that answers questions about company data or an app that takes a repetitive task off someone's plate. **Why this job is different** ============================= **You'll know why you're building it.** Every project starts with a client problem we think we can solve or a tool our own team needs. Each solution is built for that client's situation. If it stops making sense, we change course. **We're honest with clients.** We don't sell anyone the wrong thing. Ever. When something isn't a good fit, we say so. **Direct client contact.** You'll be on the call with clients from the first conversation through go\-live. Nobody in between translating requirements. Real conversations with real people about real problems. **AI is how we work.** You'll use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex every day. They'll write a lot of the code. You pick the right tool for the job, decide what gets built, check that it works, and own what ships. **Remote, with a life.** We're fully remote in the US and overlap for a few core hours on weekdays. Working faster doesn't mean working more. We mean it about having a life outside work. **What you'll actually do** --------------------------- **The consulting work:** * Leading client conversations to understand the business problem behind the request, then translating it into what to build. * Keeping projects on track: raising risks early, keeping each milestone demonstrable, and flagging scope changes the moment you see them. * Training client teams so they can own and run what you build. * Spotting the next problem worth solving for a client and bringing it to your account team. * Demonstrating solutions to colleagues and clients. You'll explain how they work, answer questions about their limitations, and discuss what's needed to put them into use. **The engineering work:** * Building and maintaining AI applications and agents, taking features from a prototype through testing and deployment. * Connecting applications to Power BI semantic models, Fabric data, and other business systems through APIs, with appropriate sign\-in and access permissions. * Investigating bugs and performance problems, checking AI responses against the underlying data, and improving application reliability. * Creating examples, templates, and documentation so other people can use and maintain what you build. * Trying new AI tools on practical problems and sharing what's worth using and why. We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out and brings ideas of their own. You'll have support and code review from the team, with responsibility for the work you take on. Independent experimentation matters here, and so does knowing when to ask a question or work through a problem with someone else. **What you need** ----------------- **Consulting Skills** * You care as much about business impact as technical polish. * You can translate a client's frustration into a technical and human solve. * You're comfortable presenting to a C\-suite or a front\-line manager, with the professional presence clients trust with their business. * Clear communication. You can explain a technical decision to another developer and describe what an application does to someone who doesn't write code. **Engineering Skills** * Three or more years of software development experience, including maintaining applications after launch. * Experience building web applications with React and TypeScript, including connecting interfaces to APIs and working with application data. * Hands\-on experience developing software with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You can provide useful context, guide the work, review changes, and verify the results. * Solid programming fundamentals. You're comfortable using Git, reading unfamiliar code, and tracing problems through an application. * An understanding of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric concepts, including how data is organized and modeled for reporting and analysis. Hands\-on experience with these products is welcome but isn't required. * Familiarity with the Microsoft ecosystem and the basics of cloud services, authentication, and permissions. **Nice to have** Experience with Next.js, Python, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, or MCP would be useful. Previous consulting work or experience building tools for other developers would also help. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Base salary:** $125\-150k * **Full benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, life, 401k * **Remote work:** US\-based team. Your home office wherever makes you happiest * **Professional growth:** Time built in to try new tools on real problems and share what you find. People here want to see you grow, and they'll jump in when you're stuck **Our values** -------------- We hire for the same five values in every role at P3: * **Reliable.** You do what you said you'd do, and what you ship keeps working. * **Adaptable.** The tools change every month. You change with them, and you change course when a project stops making sense. * **Proactive.** You flag a problem the moment you see it, and you fix the small things before anyone has to ask. * **Invested.** You care whether the client's business actually gets better. * **Direct.** You say plainly what works, what doesn't, and what you don't know yet. **About P3 Adaptive** --------------------- We've been modernizing organizations' relationship with data since 2010\. We pair deep technical skill with business sense, and we skip the deck theater and the jargon. Our teams are small, senior, and hands\-on, and work doesn't pass through a chain of handoffs. We're building on top of the AI wave. If you want to build the AI that changes how companies use their data, we're ready to meet you. *P3 Adaptive is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Period.* *This position is open to people authorized to work in the United States. We don't sponsor work visas.*

jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry \- from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI\-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park \& Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com. As a remote\-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day. **The Role** ------------ We work on several systems: our ACME operations management suite, embeddable scheduling and booking widgets, B2B and B2C sales and support tooling, and custom solutions for enterprise operators. The work is technically varied and the stakes are real: operators depend on this software to run their businesses. We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with strong technical depth who is also highly effective with AI\-assisted development. You reason independently about complex systems, find the problems that aren't obvious from the requirements, and use AI as a tool to build faster while owning every decision it informs. That means you know how to break down ambiguous problems, delegate to agents, review their work critically, and course\-correct when things go sideways. You'll join the platform team, working deep in our existing systems, including ACME Core, to make other teams faster and safer, using AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier for your engineering judgment, not a replacement for it. The platform team works closely with DevOps, who own our infrastructure, so this is a backend\-focused role rather than an infrastructure one. Over the past few months, we've seen a step\-function improvement in the reliability and capabilities of long\-running AI agents. We're adapting our engineering practice to match, and we want strong backend engineers who are already building this way and excited to push it further. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work as part of the platform team, improving the backend systems, tooling, and practices that other teams build on. Feature development is still part of the role where it fits. * Identify automation opportunities across the engineering workflow (repetitive manual work, slow or fragile processes, recurring operational toil) and build the solutions, using AI agents where they help. * Enable other teams: build and maintain shared services, libraries, and APIs, make the right way the easy way, and unblock engineers who depend on the platform through guidance, documentation, and code review. * Own security fixes and dependency updates across our backend systems: triage vulnerabilities, plan and ship upgrades safely in an existing codebase, and make sure they don't break the teams and services that depend on them. * Identify and diagnose performance bottlenecks, and recognize scalability limits before they become production problems. * Reason about concurrency, failure modes, and reliability across APIs and integrations. * Own your services in production: monitoring, debugging, performance, and reliability. When something breaks, you get to root cause and fix it properly. * Contribute to our AI\-first engineering culture, share patterns, document what works, and help the team level up on how we build with AI. * Use AI tools fluently \- Claude Code, Augment or equivalent, to compress implementation time, then critically review everything that comes out of them. AI makes a strong engineer faster; it does not replace technical judgment. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * 5\+ years of professional backend development using Java, with a meaningful track record of shipping and operating production systems. * Strong system design: you make sound architectural decisions, think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail, and you know when a simple solution is enough. * Strong backend fundamentals: API design, integrations, concurrency, failure modes, and service reliability. * Deep understanding of database behavior: data modeling, query design, indexing, and the performance implications of your choices. * Proven ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and debug complex production issues to root cause, including problems that aren't obvious from the requirements. * Comfortable working in an existing, evolving codebase: you can get up to speed quickly, make safe incremental changes, and leave things better than you found them, without defaulting to rewrites. * Hands\-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow, as a force multiplier on top of strong fundamentals. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code: catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written. * Clear communicator: you can articulate why you made a technical choice, flag when a spec has holes, and disagree constructively. * Interest in Elixir or functional programming languages as we expand our stack **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience building B2B SaaS products, ideally with complex multi\-tenant data models or transactional workflows. * Experience on small, high\-output teams where you've had to make architectural calls without a committee. * Familiarity with frontend development and JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular or modern JS frameworks), enough to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers and understand how your APIs are consumed. * Experience on a platform, internal tooling, or developer\-enablement team, including security patching and dependency upgrades in a large existing codebase. * Background in the travel, hospitality, or experiences industry. **What We Value** ----------------- A few things that define how we build: * Depth first. We value engineers who understand how systems actually behave: databases, concurrency, failure modes, and performance. AI amplifies that understanding; it doesn't replace it. * Judgment over speed. AI compresses implementation time. What differentiates engineers now isn't typing speed or memorized syntax, it's the ability to make the right calls on what to build, how to build it, and when it's not ready to ship. * Ownership. You built it? You own it. That includes AI\-generated code. You know when to use agents and when to do it yourself. * Directness. We want people who ask hard questions, surface problems early, and are willing to push back on a bad spec rather than build it and hope for the best. * Quality as a habit. jobs.title: Product Builder
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Product Builder owns a feature from technical kickoff through merged, released code. Working from a validated problem, prototype, and specification produced by Product and Design, the Product Builder designs the system, plans the implementation, and directs AI coding agents to produce the code \- then carries accountability for its correctness, security, and long\-term maintainability. This role is defined by ownership of a complete feature. Product Builders produce architecture, contracts, program design, and verified working software. The primary means of producing code is the direction and review of AI agents, which makes judgment, system design decisions, and rigorous review the central skills of the role. Product Builders work on an applications platform maintained by the Application Platform Architect, and against data contracts and standards owned by the Data Platform Architect. **What You Own** * Feature architecture. System design, component and feature contracts, data model, endpoint and API design, and the constraints and requirements the feature must satisfy. * Program design. Test approaches and seams, program layout and call stacks, component trees and dependencies — defined before implementation begins, because agents build from the plan you write. There can be crossover here with the Application Platform Architect making for collaborative opportunities with that role. * Vertical slices. Implementation order, the multi\-repository coordination map, and incremental pull requests linked to their tracked issues. You decide how the work is sequenced and how the agent is orchestrated to build it. * Agent orchestration. Translating architecture and program design into effective agent tasking; evaluating agent output critically; recognizing when generated code is plausible but wrong, subtly unsafe, or architecturally inconsistent. Keeping your agent orchestration flow up to date, effective and efficient for the product(s) you work on and own. * Pull request quality. Agentic code review, CI/CD checks, unit tests, and security and SAST scans. Human review of the evolving codebase and validation that the implementation matches the intended architecture. * Release readiness. Shared accountability with Product, Design, and Leadership that a feature is ready to go to the field. **What You Participate In** * Technical kickoff. You join the walkthrough of problem, outcomes, prototype, and constraints, and you are expected to surface technical risk early \- before architecture begins \- rather than discovering it mid\-implementation. Collaboration with the Product team is essential throughout product building and starts here. * Cross\-functional review. You work directly with Design on QA against the prototype, with Product on AI evaluation results and scope drift, and with the platform architects when a feature requires a capability or data contract that does not yet exist. **What You Do Not Own** Problem framing, success metrics, research, prioritization, and the product specification are owned by Product, Design, and Leadership. The shared repositories, CI/CD pipeline, and data platform are owned by the platform architects. Product Builders influence all of these and are expected to push back when something is wrong \- but the decisions rest elsewhere. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Experience building and shipping production software * Demonstrated ability to design a system \- not just implement one \- including data modeling, API design, and defining contracts between components * Strong code review skills, with the judgment to identify correctness, security, and maintainability problems in code you did not write * Working knowledge of automated testing strategy: what to test, where the seams are, and what adequate coverage looks like * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows, and secure development practices including static analysis and dependency scanning * Ability to decompose a feature into incremental, independently reviewable slices * Clear written and verbal communication with non\-engineering partners, including Product, Design, and clinical stakeholders * Ability to work with protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and internal data governance requirements **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience directing AI coding agents or working extensively with AI\-assisted development tooling * Experience in healthcare technology, particularly home health, hospice, or post\-acute care * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR * Experience integrating with third\-party clinical or operational platforms * Experience working in a monorepo with shared CI/CD infrastructure * Exposure to evaluating AI\-driven product features, including defining evaluation criteria and test cases **Core Competencies** --------------------- Systems thinking. You reason about how a change propagates through a system, not just whether a function returns the right value. Verification discipline. You treat generated code as a proposal requiring proof, not as an answer. You are comfortable saying an implementation is wrong even when tests pass. Ownership. You carry a feature to shipped and correct, including the unglamorous parts — error states, offline behavior, edge cases, and rollback. Collaboration across disciplines. You engage seriously with clinical and product context rather than treating requirements as a queue. **Why Join Us?** Something else that sets us apart from other companies is the quality of our most valuable resources – our people! We are dedicated to living out our culture as defined by our core values, “**CAPLICO**”: * Customer Second – We prioritize and support our team so they can deliver exceptional care. * Accountability – Own your work and outcomes. * Passion for Learning – Grow continuously with curiosity and culture. * Love One Another – Build authentic, respectful, and trusting relationships. * Intelligent Risk Taking – Innovate and challenge the status quo. * Celebrate – Recognize the small wins, they add up! * Ownership – Be the CEO of your role. **Additional Benefits:** * True Work\-Life balance – We believe in taking care of yourself before you take care of others! * Full benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match) * Paid time off, holiday pay, and professional development Your voice matters! \- Work with other passionate and high\-achieving leaders who care deeply about patient outcomes and team success. * **About Pennant Services** We support over 250 home health, hospice, senior living, and home care operations across 19 states. Our Service Center model empowers local leadership while providing centralized clinical, legal, HR, IT, and compliance support to help ensure high\-quality care. www.pennantgroup.com The employer for this position is stated in the job posting. The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company of independent operating subsidiaries that provide healthcare services through home health and hospice agencies and senior living communities located throughout the US. Each of these businesses is operated by a separate, independent operating subsidiary that has its own management, employees and assets. More information about The Pennant Group, Inc. is available at http://www.pennantgroup.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country. Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization. We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber. **Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.** **Role Overview** ================= We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer to build PermitFlow's core product AI Assistant, infrastructure, and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up\-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel. Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow. The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long\-running tasks. * Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context\-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer\-specific conventions. * Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible. * Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence. * Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on. * Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale * Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc) * You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy. * You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production\-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit. * You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with recent time spent building LLM\-powered products. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company * 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA * 401(k) savings plan * Unlimited PTO and paid family leave * Home office \& equipment stipend * Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided * Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking) *PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.* *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Perception
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Pickle Robot, we're on a mission to automate global supply chains with Physical AI. Our robots work alongside warehouse teams to unload trucks and containers — one of the toughest, most understaffed jobs in logistics — making the work safer, faster, and more efficient for the people doing it. Loading trucks comes next, followed by the Dill Autonomy Engine: generalized autonomy that will eventually orchestrate robots across entire logistics processes. We're looking for a rigorous and self\-directed Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own machine learning problems end\-to\-end on the systems that decide how our robots grasp packages. This role will focus on problem formulation, building the data engines that feed our models, training and experimentation, and the evaluation rigor that tells us whether a model is genuinely better. Our platform and robotics engineers own runtime integration and edge deployment, so you can stay focused on the modeling loop. ### **What You'll Do** * Own ML Problem Formulation: You will turn ambiguous picking performance goals into well\-posed ML problems, deciding what the model predicts, how labels and rewards are defined, what loss to optimize, and what "better" actually means. This is the core of the role. * Build the Data Engine: You will own dataset strategy end\-to\-end, from large\-scale synthetic scene generation and distributed cloud dataset jobs to scene diversity filtering and self\-supervised label generation. You will identify when the data, rather than the model, is the bottleneck, and fix it. * Train and Iterate on Large Vision Models: You will fine\-tune large backbones with multiple task\-specific heads, run disciplined experiments, and know both which experiment to run next and when to stop. * Own Evaluation and Verification: You will define offline metrics that predict on\-robot outcomes and online metrics that help you improve performance on edge cases. * Drive Technical Excellence: As a senior member of the team, you will conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and contribute to the perception and grasping roadmap. * Hand Off Cleanly to Production: You will produce deployable models with sane latency budgets, exportable graphs, and reproducible artifacts, partnering with the engineers who own runtime integration and inference optimization rather than owning that yourself. ### **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ Years of Experience in Machine Learning and Computer Vision, including models you personally carried from problem statement to measured outcome. * A track record of framing problems. You can translate high\-level product requirements into specific engineering tasks and explain technical trade\-offs to non\-expert stakeholders. * Hands\-on Experience Building Datasets at Scale: generation or collection, curation, automated quality assurance, coverage and bias analysis, and active learning to systematically close edge cases. * Rigorous Evaluation Habits: baselines, ablations, metric design, and a clear sense of when a result is real. * Expert\-level Python and PyTorch skills. * Comfortable with cloud training infrastructure (GCP or AWS), Docker, and experiment tracking tools. * **Professional experience with at least one of the following:** + Developing and training multi\-task models + Developing and training multi\-modal models + Developing and training multi–view models + Self\-supervised, outcome\-based, or reward\-driven learning. ### **Pay at Pickle** At Pickle Robot Company, we believe transparency builds trust. The salary range listed here is provided in accordance with Massachusetts law and reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to offer for this role. We often consider candidates at different levels of seniority, and final compensation will reflect the level at which a candidate is hired, along with factors like experience and location. ### **Pickle Perks** Pickle provides best\-in\-class benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited vacation; paid federal and state holidays; 401(k) contributions of 5% of your salary; company\-covered travel expenses; and other perks to make your working life more fun, comfortable, and productive. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Intermediate Software Developer (Frontend) - Pine Hosting (Remote)
jobs.description: **About Pine Hosting** Pine Hosting runs game servers for players and communities: Minecraft, Rust, ARK, Palworld, Project Zomboid, FiveM, Hytale and many more. We don't resell someone else's control panel. We build and maintain our own. At the center is the Pine Game Panel, our own fork of Pterodactyl that we have built far beyond the original. It handles one\-click modpack and plugin installs, a template shop, Minecraft version switching, Steam Workshop collections, DDoS protection management, subdomains and AI\-assisted log analysis. Around it sit our Astro website, our WHMCS billing platform, Discord bots and a set of internal tools. **The role** We're hiring an intermediate software developer whose main focus is the frontend. You'll own the user interfaces our customers touch every day. That means features in the React panel, pages on the Astro website, and the PHP and HTML templates behind our billing and other systems. This isn't a junior role. You should be able to take a feature from an issue to a reviewed pull request with little hand\-holding. You should also be able to read code you didn't write and know when to ask a question. Backend experience is a real plus but not required. If you're strong on the frontend and want to grow into full\-stack work, we'll train you on our PHP/Laravel backend and the systems around it. **What you'll work on** Most of your time goes to the first two areas. The rest grows as you do. * **Pine Game Panel** (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, styled\-components, easy\-peasy, React Router; Laravel API): build and polish customer features such as the file manager, console, backups, schedules, mod and plugin installers, template shop and game\-specific settings screens * **Website** (Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4\): product and game pages, pricing, tools and blog; keep it fast, accessible and SEO\-friendly * **Billing and client area** (WHMCS: PHP, Smarty templates, HTML/CSS/JS): customize the client area, order flow and email templates; write hooks * **Internal tools** (React \+ Vite; ASP.NET Core): admin dashboards for staff, such as product data, sponsorships and hardware planning * **Panel backend, as you grow** (PHP 8\.2\+, Laravel 12, MySQL, Redis, queues): API endpoints, services, background jobs, tests On the panel, there is also modernization work ahead. Planned items include moving off twin.macro to plain Tailwind, upgrading React and Tailwind, and reworking layouts to be truly responsive. If you enjoy leaving a codebase better than you found it, there's plenty to do. **What we're looking for** * Around 2–4 years of professional or equivalent real\-world frontend experience, with shipped work you can show us * Strong React and TypeScript: hooks, component design, state management, and talking to REST APIs * Solid HTML and CSS fundamentals, with Tailwind CSS experience; responsive layouts, accessibility and cross\-browser quirks shouldn't scare you * Comfort with plain PHP and server\-rendered HTML templates, since not everything we run is a single\-page app * Day\-to\-day Git: branches, pull requests, rebasing, and taking code review well * Debugging skills: browser dev tools, network inspection, and reading a stack trace in a language you're less familiar with * Clear written communication in English; much of our work is async through issues and PR reviews **Bonus points** None of these are required. Each one helps, and backend experience helps most. * Backend / full\-stack: Laravel or another PHP framework, MySQL, Redis, queues and background jobs, writing tests (PHPUnit, Jest, Playwright) * Astro or other static and hybrid site frameworks, plus web performance and SEO work * WHMCS or other billing and client\-area customization * Real\-time UIs: WebSockets and streaming data, such as live consoles and resource graphs * Other languages in our stack: Go (our Wings daemon), C\#/.NET (internal tools), Node.js (Discord bots) * Infrastructure basics: Linux, Docker, nginx, CI pipelines * Game servers: you've run or modded Minecraft, Rust or similar, so you know what our customers are trying to do **How we work** * Work starts from an issue, goes onto a feature branch, and lands through a pull request that a senior developer reviews * Merged changes deploy automatically to a staging environment, so you test against the real thing before a versioned production release * Small team, real ownership: what you build is in front of customers within days, not quarters * Mentoring toward full\-stack work, with code review that explains the why **Details** * Type: Full\-time * Location: Remote **How to apply** When you apply, send links to work you've built, such as a portfolio, GitHub, live sites or a project write\-up. Tell us about a frontend problem you solved that you're proud of. Shipped work matters more to us than a list of buzzwords. Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent Pay: Up to $4,000\.00 per month Application Question(s): * Share your Steam profile. What games have you put the most hours into, and have you ever run a server or developed plugins/mods? * Do you have experience using AI coding agents like Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex inside Cursor or Zed? Tell us how you use them in your development workflow. * Tell us about a project you're most proud of, whether personal, open\-source, or professional. What did you build, what was your role, and what challenges did you overcome? Please share links to your GitHub profile and any portfolio or live projects. Experience: * Developer: 2 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a proven, hands\-on AI Agent builder who specializes in B2B lead generation. You must have personally architected, built, deployed, and operated AI agents that generate measurable B2B prospecting results. **We're seeking an AI engineer who can build the intelligence behind the system** AI agents that use tools, make decisions, coordinate workflows, and turn enterprise buying signals into qualified sales meetings. If you are an expert at building AI agents for B2B lead generation and can prove they work, we want to meet you. **About PlanITROI** 25 years of success. Global industry recognition. Founder\-led. No corporate red tape. An ambitious future powered by AI and Robotics! For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped enterprise organizations maximize the financial value of retired technology through IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide, is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor, and has built our business around reuse\-as\-intended\-use, prioritizing reuse over recycling. **Our mission:** Maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients, reduces unnecessary electronic waste, and gives technology a second life as affordable technology. **Why you'll love working here** **Founder\-led. Move fast. Get things done.** Work directly with entrepreneurial leadership. No layers of corporate bureaucracy or endless approval cycles. Great ideas get heard, tested, and implemented. **Built like an AI startup, backed by an established company.** Bring your engineering ideas to a business with 25 years of enterprise relationships, operating experience, and real market opportunities. **Engineer something big.** Build AI agents capable of researching 5,000\+ enterprise accounts, identifying buying signals, reaching 250,000\+ potential right contacts, and generating qualified meetings at scale. **See measurable results.** Your agents will directly influence enterprise revenue and help more technology get repaired, reused, and returned to productive use. **Work with people who value builders.** We believe in optimism, discipline, humility, ownership, continuous improvement, and recognizing teammates who help others succeed. **Your mission: Build an intelligent AI\-powered lead generation engine** Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve an interconnected system of specialized AI agents that identifies enterprise buying opportunities and converts them into qualified meetings. You will own the technical outbound engine end to end, from buying\-signal detection and account intelligence to contact discovery, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. Our target market (ICP) includes enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 1,000,000\+ employees, 80%\+ mostly knowledge workers with complex buying committees, and existing technology providers. Your challenge is to find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and create a compelling reason to engage in PlanITROI. *This role reports to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer. You'll work directly with them and the VP of Marketing, with no layers in between.* **Your goal:** Qualified enterprise meetings generated and MSA's signed! **What you will build and own** * **AI Intent Signal Detection Agents.** Identify, ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals, including technology refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, technology initiatives, and social activity. Trigger the right next action. * **AI Buying Committee Intelligence Agents.** Identify high\-value ICP accounts, research enterprise organizations, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts for each entry point, validate contact information, and continuously track changes. * **AI Personalization \& Challenger Messaging Agents.** Combine account intelligence, buying signals, persona\-specific pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context to create relevant, personalized outreach at scale. * **AI Multichannel Orchestration Agents.** Coordinate email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR/BDR follow\-up. Manage sequencing, timing, channel rules, routing, and next\-best actions. * **AI Objection Handling \& Follow\-Up Agents.** Recognize and respond intelligently to objections such as "We already have a provider." Maintain conversational context, determine appropriate follow\-up, and escalate to humans when needed. * **AI Performance \& Optimization Agents.** Measure results across signals, personas, channels, and campaigns. Identify winning and losing hypotheses, recommend experiments, and improve qualified meeting conversion. *These are functional capabilities, not a requirement to deploy six separate agents. You will desi  agents that run on top of them is. We are seeking proven hands\-on expertise in: * **AI agent engineering:** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, agent memory, state management, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * **Agent frameworks:** LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable frameworks. * **Software development:** Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, custom integrations, and automation architecture. * **GTM integrations:** Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense, Bombora\-type intent sources, and AI calling/voicemail platforms. * **Enterprise prospecting:** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying\-committee identification, contact resolution, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. * **Production operations:** Agent monitoring, debugging, data quality, CRM synchronization, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, error handling, and auditability. * **Scale:** Engineering reliable systems capable of very high outbound volumes, reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail, while protecting platform limits, accuracy, compliance, and deliverability. * This role opreates on Eastern Time Zone You must understand both the technical engineering and the B2B prospecting strategy required to turn agents into a functioning revenue system. **What success looks like** * **Qualified meetings generated:** Your primary business outcome. Meetings must satisfy defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion:** How effectively your agents convert meaningful buying signals into conversations and qualified meetings. * **Contact Precision:** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Agent deployment velocity:** How quickly you turn a campaign idea into a reliable, working agent and live test. * **Multichannel conversion:** Positive responses, conversations, qualified meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability:** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, compliance, and scalability. * **Learning rate:** How quickly do you identify what isn't working, fix root causes, and scale what produces results. **Our hiring process: Show me, don't tell me** We hire proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished presentations about what agents might do. The process has three stages: * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build a project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show: * Your agent architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, data integrations, and orchestration. * How your agents identify opportunities and execute prospecting workflows. * How do your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human intervention? * Real performance data: qualified meetings, pipelines, conversions, or measurable improvements your systems produced. **Ready for the challenge?** If you love solving difficult technical problems and want to build something ambitious, PlanITROI is where you can make an impact. Bring your engineering expertise, working agents, ideas, and your drive to succeed. We'll bring 25 years of industry experience, enterprise relationships, a substantial market opportunity, and the ability to move fast. **Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow.** *PlanITROI offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and more. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at all levels of the organization.* Learn more: PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| DigitalDreamsProject.com

customers** ----------------------- * Join Business Strategists in technical discovery to identify integration needs and system limitations. * Support customer demos, solution testing, and jobs.description: **Own Your Intelligence** ------------------------- Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team. Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high\-performance training, and deployment into one full\-stack system for post\-training at frontier scale \- from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open\-source models trained end to end for long\-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full\-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **Role Impact** This is a customer facing role at the intersection of cutting\-edge RL/post\-training methods, applied data, and agent systems. You’ll have a direct impact on shaping how advanced models are aligned, evaluated, deployed, and used in the real world by: * **Advancing Agent Capabilities:** Designing and iterating on next\-generation AI agents that tackle real workloads—workflow automation, reasoning\-intensive tasks, and decision\-making at scale. Working with applied data from real deployments to continuously refine policies, improve reasoning, and enhance reliability and safety. * **Building Robust Infrastructure:** Developing the distributed systems, evaluation pipelines, and coordination frameworks that enable these agents to operate reliably, efficiently, and at massive scale. Building data capture, processing, and versioning workflows for feedback, model traces, and reward signals. * **Bridge Between Customers \& Research:** Translating customer needs and insights from applied data into clear technical requirements that guide product and research priorities. Collaborating closely with RL and eval teams to ensure real\-world signals inform model alignment and reward shaping. * **Prototype in the Field:** Rapidly designing and deploying agents, evals, and harnesses alongside customers to validate solutions. Using applied evaluation data to iterate on model performance and discover new capabilities. **Customer\-Facing Engineering** * Work side\-by\-side with customers to deeply understand workflows, data sources, and bottlenecks. * Prototype agents, data pipelines, and eval harnesses tailored to real use cases, then hand off hardened systems to core teams. * Translate customer insights and evaluation results into roadmap and research direction. **Post\-training \& Reinforcement Learning** * Design and implement novel RL and post\-training methods (RLHF, RLVR, GRPO, etc.) to align large models with domain\-specific tasks. * Build evaluation harnesses and verifiers to measure reasoning, robustness, and agentic behavior in real\-world workflows. * Integrate applied data collection and analytics into the post\-training process to surface regressions, emergent skills, and alignment opportunities. * Prototype multi\-agent and memory\-augmented systems to expand capabilities for customer\-facing solutions. **Agent Development \& Infrastructure** * Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI agents for automation, workflow orchestration, and decision\-making. * Extend and integrate with agent frameworks to support evolving feature requests and performance requirements. * Architect and maintain distributed training and inference pipelines, ensuring scalability and cost efficiency. * Develop observability and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) to ensure reliability and performance in production deployments. **Requirements** * Strong background in machine learning engineering, with experience in post\-training, RL, or large\-scale model alignment. * Experience with applied data workflows and evaluation frameworks for large models or agents (e.g., SWE\-Bench, HELM, EvalFlow, internal eval pipelines). * Deep expertise in distributed training/inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, sglang, Ray, Accelerate). * Experience deploying containerized systems at scale (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform). * Track record of research contributions (publications, open\-source contributions, benchmarks) in ML/RL. * Passion for advancing the state\-of\-the\-art in reasoning, measurement, and building practical, agentic AI systems. **What We Offer** * Cash Compensation Range of $150\-300k \+ equity incentives * Flexible Work (remote or San Francisco) * Visa Sponsorship \& relocation support * Professional Development budget * Team Off\-sites \& conference attendance **Growth Opportunity** You’ll join a mission\-driven team working at the frontier of open, superintelligence infra. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to: * Shape the evolution of agent\-driven, data\-informed solutions—from research breakthroughs to production systems used by real customers. * Collaborate with leading researchers, engineers, and partners pushing the boundaries of RL, evaluation, and post\-training. * Grow with a fast\-moving organization where your contributions directly influence both the technical direction and the broader AI ecosystem. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** **The Opportunity** The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) plays a critical role in ensuring the **reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence** of Qualys platforms and services. This role operates at the intersection of software engineering and operations, applying automation, observability, troubleshooting, and reliability engineering practices to maintain highly available production systems and improve customer experience. The SRE will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams to monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, automate operational processes, and continuously improve system reliability. **Where This Role Sits** The SRE role partners closely with **Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams** to ensure production systems remain resilient, scalable, observable, and operationally efficient. The role provides hands\-on support for cloud\-native and distributed systems, including **Kubernetes, Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud\-based data platforms**, while contributing to incident response, automation, monitoring, and reliability improvements. **Key Responsibilities** **Reliability and Operations** * Monitor production applications, infrastructure, and distributed systems to identify issues and maintain service health. * Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, escalation, and root\-cause analysis. * Support highly available and scalable production services and workloads. * Monitor system performance, resource utilization, availability, latency, and overall service health. * Participate in on\-call rotations and follow established incident management processes. * Support capacity planning and identify potential reliability and performance risks. * Assist engineering teams in resolving production issues and implementing corrective actions. * Contribute to post\-incident reviews and continuous reliability improvements. **Data Platform and Distributed Systems** * Support the operation and monitoring of **Apache Spark workloads and Kafka pipelines**. * Monitor distributed data\-processing workloads and investigate performance or availability issues. * Assist with troubleshooting Spark jobs, Kafka pipelines, application failures, resource constraints, and related production issues. * Develop an understanding of distributed systems concepts and their operational requirements. * Support data platforms and technologies such as **Delta Lake and S3** where applicable. * Apply basic SQL skills for troubleshooting, validation, and operational analysis. **Kubernetes and Cloud Operations** * Assist with **Kubernetes deployments, resource monitoring, application troubleshooting, and operational support**. * Monitor containerized applications and investigate resource, availability, and performance issues. * Support cloud environments such as **AWS, OCI, or Google Cloud Platform**. * Work with infrastructure and engineering teams on configuration, deployments, and operational workflows. * Develop familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud\-native operational practices. **Monitoring and Observability** * Monitor applications, infrastructure, and distributed workloads using tools such as **Prometheus and Grafana**. * Create and maintain dashboards, alerts, and monitoring configurations. * Analyze logs, metrics, and system behavior to identify and troubleshoot production issues. * Track reliability indicators such as availability, latency, performance, resource utilization, and service health. * Contribute to improvements in observability and proactive issue detection. **Automation and Platform Engineering** * Develop scripts and automation to reduce repetitive manual operational tasks. * Create tooling for monitoring, log analysis, troubleshooting, deployments, and operational workflows. * Use **Python, Bash, Go, or similar** **programming/scripting** **languages** to automate operational processes. * Support CI/CD and automated deployment workflows. * Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and self\-service capabilities where applicable. * Continuously improve operational processes through automation and standardization. **Collaboration and Continuous Improvement** * Collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams to improve system reliability. * Assist development teams in designing and operating production\-ready services. * Document system architectures, operational procedures, troubleshooting steps, and best practices. * Create and maintain **runbooks, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides**. * Proactively identify reliability risks and opportunities for operational improvement. * Contribute to SRE best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives. **What Good Looks Like** * Proactively  s and analyzes system metrics, logs, and application behavior. * Collaborates effectively with engineering and infrastructure teams to resolve production issues. * Continuously improves system reliability, observability, scalability, and operational efficiency. * Builds a strong understanding of production systems and applies SRE principles to day\-to\-day operations. **Distinguishing Expectations** The SRE is measured by improvements in **reliability, automation, operational efficiency, observability, and service availability**. For an early\-career SRE, success is demonstrated through: * Effective monitoring and troubleshooting of production systems. * Rapid learning of complex production environments. * Reduction of manual operational effort through automation. * Consistent participation in incident response and root\-cause analysis. * Improvements to monitoring, documentation, and operational processes. * Growing ownership of production services and reliability\-focused initiatives. **Required Qualifications** * **0–3 years** of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical role. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Basic understanding of **Linux/Unix systems**, processes, memory, networking, and system troubleshooting. * Fundamental understanding of **distributed systems and cloud\-native technologies**. * Experience or familiarity with **Kubernetes and containerized applications**. * Familiarity with **Apache Spark, Kafka, or similar distributed data\-processing platforms**. * Strong programming and scripting fundamentals in **Python, Bash, Go, Java, Scala, or similar languages**. * Ability to write scripts for automation, monitoring, log analysis, and operational tasks. * Basic **SQL** knowledge and strong problem\-solving skills. * Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as **Prometheus and Grafana**. * Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as **AWS, OCI, or Google Cloud Platform**. * Understanding of basic networking, security, and distributed systems concepts. * Willingness to learn production systems, debugging techniques, and SRE practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with **Delta Lake, S3, or distributed data platforms**. * Understanding of **CI/CD** and automated deployment processes. * Familiarity with **Terraform, CloudFormation, or other Infrastructure as Code tools**. * Experience with scripting\-based automation or internal tooling projects. * Familiarity with tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, ELK, Splunk, or AppDynamics**. * Experience with large\-scale or distributed systems. * Understanding of reliability engineering principles and automation best practices. * Exposure to incident management, on\-call processes, and postmortem practices. * Cloud certifications are a plus. * Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and troubleshooting skills. **Core Competencies** **SRE \| Linux \| Python / Bash / Go \| Coding \& Scripting \| Spark \| Kafka \| Kubernetes \| Cloud Platforms \| SQL \| Monitoring \& Observability \| Automation \| Distributed Systems \| Troubleshooting \| Incident Response \| CI/CD \| Reliability Engineering** **Work
