Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams. * Opportunity to work with cloud\-native, distributed, and large\-scale production systems. **ABOUT QUALYS** Qualys, Inc. is a pioneer and leading provider of cloud\-based IT, security, and compliance solutions, serving more than 10,000 customers across over 130 countries. Qualys delivers innovative security and compliance solutions that help organizations simplify security operations and reduce risk. Qualys is an Equal Opportunity Employer, please see our EEO policy.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Healthcare Integrations
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric \& Healthcare Integrations** **Location:** Dallas–Fort Worth, TX **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Work Arrangement:** In\-Office **Compensation:** 125,000–150,000 per year, depending on experience **About the Role** We are a growing multi\-site healthcare organization building a centralized data and analytics platform to support better operational decision\-making, reporting, automation, and future AI initiatives. We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Data Engineer to lead the development of this data foundation. This is not primarily a reporting or dashboard development role. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that moves data from our core operational systems—including our electronic health record (eClinicalWorks) and CRM (HubSpot)—into Microsoft Fabric. You will have significant ownership over how our data platform is designed from the beginning and will work directly with operational and technical stakeholders to turn fragmented healthcare and business data into reliable, reusable data products. **What You Will Build** Your initial focus will be establishing our Microsoft Fabric environment and creating a scalable data architecture that can support the organization long term. You will: * Design and implement our Microsoft Fabric data architecture using OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, notebooks, and related Fabric services. * Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines from eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, APIs, databases, files, and future enterprise systems. * Work with REST APIs, FHIR APIs, webhooks, batch exports, and other integration methods to reliably extract source\-system data. * Establish raw, validated, and analytics\-ready data layers using a medallion\-style architecture. * Clean, standardize, deduplicate, and reconcile data across systems. * Develop data models for patients, referrals, appointments, providers, procedures, cases, outcomes, and other operational entities. * Develop methods for matching records across systems when identifiers are inconsistent or unavailable. * Create reusable curated datasets that support Power BI reporting, operational analytics, automation, and future AI applications. * Implement incremental loading, change detection, schema management, error handling, logging, alerting, and pipeline monitoring. * Establish data quality checks and processes for identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected source data. * Implement appropriate security, access controls, and governance practices for healthcare data. * Use Git and CI/CD practices so data pipelines and transformations are version\-controlled, documented, and maintainable. * Monitor Fabric usage, performance, capacity, and cost as the platform grows. * Document architecture, data definitions, pipelines, dependencies, and operating procedures. * Maintain and improve the platform after the initial implementation rather than treating the project as a one\-time migration. **First 6–12 Month Priorities** A successful candidate should be able to take ownership of the platform from architecture through production. Early priorities will include: * Assess our existing systems, data sources, reporting requirements, and Microsoft environment. * Design and configure the initial Microsoft Fabric architecture. * Establish secure and reliable ingestion from HubSpot and eClinicalWorks. * Create a raw historical data layer that preserves source\-system data. * Build cleaned and standardized datasets that reconcile information across systems. * Create an initial analytics\-ready data model for high\-priority operational reporting. * Implement automated pipeline monitoring, data\-quality validation, documentation, and recovery processes. * Establish engineering standards that allow additional data sources and use cases to be added without rebuilding the platform. **Required Experience** We are looking for someone who has actually built and operated modern data platforms, not someone whose experience is primarily reporting or visualization. Strong candidates should have: * 4\+ years of professional data engineering, data platform, or data integration experience. * Hands\-on experience building production solutions with Microsoft Fabric or a closely related Azure data stack. * Strong SQL skills. * Strong Python and/or PySpark skills. * Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Factory/Pipelines, notebooks, Delta tables, or equivalent technologies. * Experience integrating third\-party systems through REST APIs. * Experience implementing incremental data loads rather than relying only on full data refreshes. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, relational modeling, lakehouse architecture, and analytics\-oriented data modeling. * Experience troubleshooting API authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes, malformed records, pipeline failures, and other real\-world integration issues. * Experience with Git, source control, and CI/CD practices. * Experience implementing monitoring, logging, data\-quality validation, and alerting for production pipelines. * Ability to work independently and make practical architectural decisions in an environment where the data platform is still being built. **Healthcare / Integration Experience** Healthcare experience is strongly preferred. Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable: * Healthcare EHR/EMR data * eClinicalWorks * FHIR / HL7 * Healthcare operational or clinical data models * HIPAA\-regulated data environments * Patient identity matching or Master Patient Index concepts * HubSpot APIs and CRM data * Microsoft Entra ID and Azure security * Microsoft Purview or other data governance tools * Power BI semantic models Direct eClinicalWorks experience is a major plus but is not required if you have strong healthcare API/FHIR integration experience and can quickly learn unfamiliar source systems. **What This Role Is Not** This is not a Power BI developer position with occasional data engineering responsibilities. Power BI knowledge is useful, but the primary responsibility is building the reliable data infrastructure underneath reporting, analytics, automation, and AI applications. We need someone comfortable working at the level of APIs, pipelines, Python, SQL, data models, cloud architecture, security, and production operations. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first year, we want to have a maintainable Microsoft Fabric environment where data from our major systems is automatically collected, validated, standardized, and made available through trusted datasets. Instead of analysts repeatedly extracting and cleaning data manually, the organization should be able to rely on centralized datasets with clearly defined metrics and lineage. The platform should also be designed so additional sources, analytics use cases, automation, and AI capabilities can be added over time without rebuilding the underlying infrastructure. **Why This Role Is Different** You will be joining at the beginning of our data platform build rather than maintaining an architecture that has already been established. You will have significant influence over the architecture, engineering standards, data models, and technologies that become the foundation for how the organization uses data going forward. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building systems, solving difficult integration problems, and owning a data platform end\-to\-end. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer, AI and DevSecOps
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- RadarFirst is seeking a Lead Platform Engineer, AI \& DevSecOps Engineer to lead the next stage of our cloud, security, reliability, and AI operations maturity. This role will own the platforms, practices, and operating model that enable our engineering teams to build, deploy, monitor, secure, and continuously improve production SaaS systems and agentic AI capabilities. Since launching RadarFirst's first agentic AI offering using AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, we are expanding the DevOps remit to include production\-grade AI infrastructure and operations. The person in this role will help mature the environment required by customers in highly regulated industries, including governance, secure agent/tool access, observability, continuous LLM and agent evaluations, traceability, incident response, cost controls, and operational readiness for future agent development. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. The right candidate is an experienced platform, DevSecOps, or SRE leader who can set direction, build shared engineering practices, mentor others, and create a more DevOps\-forward engineering culture across historically siloed teams. This position can be based out of our HQ in Portland, OR, or remote from anywhere in the U.S. **Our Technical Stack** ----------------------- Our front end is built with Angular and Material Design, using TypeScript for strong typing and maintainability. Backend services are written in Go and Nest.js. Technologies currently in use include Packer, Ansible, Docker, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, Go, Bash, Datadog, Git, TeamCity, Jira, Slack, and Google's productivity suite. We deploy on AWS using EC2, ECS, RDS\-hosted PostgreSQL, S3, OpenSearch, Lambda, SES, CloudWatch, IAM, and related AWS services. Our agentic AI environment uses AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, with a growing need for AI\-specific observability, evaluation, governance, and operational automation. **Essential Responsibilities \& Duties** ---------------------------------------- ### **Platform and Reliability** * Own and evolve the DevSecOps, platform engineering, and AI operations roadmap, with clear goals for reliability, security, deployment maturity, developer productivity, auditability, and customer readiness. * Design, implement, and operate secure, scalable, fault\-tolerant AWS infrastructure for SaaS and AI workloads. * Implement automation to reduce manual deployment, provisioning, compliance, monitoring, and support work. * Monitor platform KPIs and cost drivers, including cloud spend, token consumption, model usage, latency, error rates, deployment frequency, change failure rate, recovery time, and operational toil. ### **AI Operations** * Lead the operational maturity of RadarFirst's agentic AI platform, including the management of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, agent/tool governance, policy controls, observability, evaluation workflows, and cost management. * Build observability across infrastructure, applications, and agentic workflows, including logs, metrics, traces, token usage, latency, error rates, tool invocation behavior, evaluation results, and customer\-impacting SLOs. * Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer\-facing teams to ensure AI systems meet expectations for regulated industries, including auditability, access control, privacy, traceability, incident response, and defensible governance. * Define and evolve CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and release\-management practices that improve speed, safety, reproducibility, and rollback confidence. ### **Security and Governance** * Lead incident response and reliability improvement efforts, including post\-incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, alert tuning, runbooks, operational readiness reviews, and long\-term remediation. * Maintain and improve security practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets management, authentication, authorization, vulnerability scanning, and software supply chain controls. ### **Leadership and Culture** * Create shared engineering standards and paved paths that help product engineers ship safely without waiting on bespoke DevOps support. * Drive a DevOps\-forward engineering culture by reducing team silos, improving ownership models, clarifying operational responsibilities, and coaching teams on secure, observable, supportable software delivery. * Mentor DevOps, platform, and software engineers; help develop future technical leaders and raise the organization's operational bar. Opportunity exists for people management for a small team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a closely related engineering role. * Proven track record designing and operating production AWS infrastructure for SaaS or enterprise software environments. * Experience leading technical cal, and troubleshooting skills. ### **Strong Plus** * Hands\-on experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, or comparable agentic AI platforms. * Experience implementing LLM or agent evaluation frameworks, including automated regression tests, golden datasets, human review workflows, prompt/version management, safety checks, and release thresholds. * Experience building governance for agent tool access, including policy enforcement, identity, permissions, audit trails, redaction, approval flows, and controlled access to internal systems. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Datadog, Langfuse, Arize/Phoenix, Promptfoo, TruLens, OpenAI Evals, or similar AI observability/evaluation tools. * Experience with regulated customers in healthcare, insurance, financial services, government, or privacy/security\-sensitive industries. * SaaS scale\-up experience. * Certifications or training such as SANS/SEC\-540, SSCP, CISSP, CAP, CSSLP, HCISPP, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security Specialty, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more likely to doubt the strength of their qualifications, so we encourage you to submit an application if you're interested in this role despite any reservations you may have about your background or skill set. **Who We Are** -------------- At RadarFirst, our mission is to make regulatory risk and data privacy simple, actionable, and sustainable. We're transforming how organizations handle incidents and compliance with automated, purpose\-built SaaS solutions. Recognized as pioneers in privacy, we've earned patents, industry awards, and the confidence of some of the world's most highly regulated industries, from healthcare and insurance to finance and beyond. ### **Our Values** * Build What's Next * Be Good People * Own the Outcome * Customer Success is Our Success * True Transparency ### **Why Join RadarFirst?** At RadarFirst, our team is filled with smart, thoughtful, and forward\-thinking contributors who are experts at what they do. Our culture of innovation and trust is paramount to our success. We work hard, but we also encourage and support a healthy work/life balance. We offer a generous package of benefits and perks that make RadarFirst a great place to work, including: * Comprehensive benefits that include medical and dental, 401k, Life and Disability insurance, generous flexible time off policy, paid holiday time, and 12 weeks paid parental leave. Plus flexible spending accounts for medical, dependent care, and commuter expenses * Community outreach programs to encourage giving back to our community both as a group and individually * Commitment to anti\-racism work and accountability to our short\-term and long\-term equity \& inclusion action plan RadarFirst is a community\-first organization, operating on a hybrid model. We actively support all employees working in the way they need. For those who wish to work from the office, these are some features of our downtown Portland office: * On\-site amenities such as indoor bike racks, showers, lockers, and gym facilities * Casual work environment in an ideal central location, close to great food, shopping, and transportation options *This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E\-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I\-9\.* The salary range for this role is $155,000 \- $175,000 \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.description: **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. jobs.description: ### **About Re:Build** At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. We operate an advanced, end\-to\-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full\-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)* **About Re:Build Optimation** ----------------------------- At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom\-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70\+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning. As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance. At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end\-to\-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting\-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems. ### **Who We Are Looking For** Re Optimation is seeking an early\-career Controls Engineer interested in industrial automation, electrical systems, and PLC programming. You'll gain hands\-on experience designing, programming, and supporting automated manufacturing systems across a variety of industries. Working alongside experienced engineers, designers, and skilled tradespeople, you'll contribute to projects from design through commissioning. We're looking for a curious problem\-solver who enjoys technical challenges, values collaboration, and is eager to develop their engineering skills. ### **What You Get To Do** * **Design and develop** electrical and instrumentation systems for industrial automation and process control. * **Develop and troubleshoot** PLC programs with guidance from experienced engineers, emphasizing reliable, maintainable code. * **Create and maintain** HMI interfaces that improve equipment operation and troubleshooting. * **Collaborate** with customers, engineers, and skilled tradespeople to define requirements and develop practical solutions. * **Support testing and commissioning**, including factory and site acceptance testing, equipment installation, and startup. * **Prepare and maintain** electrical schematics, panel layouts, bills of materials, and technical documentation. * **Coordinate with suppliers** on component selection, quotes, and procurement. * **Participate in design reviews** and resolve hardware and software challenges while maintaining safety and quality standards. ### **What You Bring To The Team** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field. * 0–2 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, instrumentation, automation, or manufacturing. Internships, co\-ops, and academic projects count. * Familiarity with PLC programming platforms such as Rockwell Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or Siemens TIA Portal. * Experience with AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical design software. * Ability to interpret electrical drawings, schematics, and technical specifications. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and organizational skills with a willingness to learn. * Ability to work on\-site in Rochester and/or Rush, NY, with travel to customer facilities as needed. **Preferred Skills** * Hands\-on manufacturing, automation, controls, or instrumentation experience. * Exposure to multiple PLC platforms or industrial communication networks. * Creative, practical approach to engineering challenges. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long\-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits. **The BIG payoff** We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Stage Manufacturing team turns design into reality, owning the build of Terran R's primary structures. This isn't about turning the same bolt every day; it's about building the systems to build the rocket. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real\-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it's up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch. **About the Role:** * Share ownership of operations on our 2 large 3\-axis mills (20'x8'), 2 large 5\-axis mills (20'x8') and VTL (20' diameter) * Help introduce new products to these machines as well as improve current high\-volume work across the 2 large 3\-axis mills (20'x8') and 2 large 5\-axis mills (20'x8') * Collaborate closely with a diverse team of engineers specializing in design, manufacturing, and reliability, as well as internal production teams and external vendors, leveraging their collective expertise to drive progress * Create work instructions, specifications, and best practices across multiple high\-fidelity processes. Help standardize processes across the manufacturing team * Help establish new machining work centers by championing the tooling and process definition needed to build parts for Terran R * Support the shop floor through live issue resolution and provide upstream feedback as we innovate the next generation of manufacturing technology * Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight build **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, aeronautical, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline * 5\+ years progressive and related experience required * 3D \& 2D design/drafting skills per ASME Y14\.5M (NX preferred) * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand process constraints and provide design inputs for improved manufacturability * Direct experience with CNC milling and turning operations across multiple materials * Understanding of machine programming (G\-code) and machine set\-up * Strong engineering fundamentals in statics, mechanics of materials, process improvement/factory design, fastening and joining, machining **Nice to haves, but not required:** * Extensive experience with CNC milling, turning, and drilling operations across multiple materials * Aluminum experience and large parts \>6' is preferred * Extensive experience with designing work holding for complicated machining operations * New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success * Experience in managing projects in a fast\-paced environment **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: AI-first Software Developer (On-site)
jobs.description: About the role Retrevr builds AI tools for veterinary practices: an AI receptionist that answers calls and texts, plus a full practice management platform covering scheduling, patient records, charting, pharmacy, labs, and payments. We're hiring a Software Developer to join our small engineering team in Provo. Demand for new features has outgrown what our current team can ship, so we're moving quickly on this hire. You'd be the third developer on the team, which means your work is visible immediately and you'll have real influence over how things get built. Most of our platform was built with AI coding agents, and that's how we keep shipping fast. We need someone who is extremely proficient with AI\-assisted development: you can keep several agents productive at once, give them specs they can actually follow, and catch what they get wrong before it reaches a clinic. Speed with AI matters here, and so does knowing when not to trust it. The work splits between two areas: internal systems our sales team depends on, and the product vet clinics use every day, including the AI inside it. You'll touch both. This role is open to developers with roughly 1–5 years of professional experience. We care more about how you think, how fast you pick things up, and how well you build with AI than about a specific number of years. What you'll do \- Build and ship features end to end with AI coding agents (Claude Code is our daily driver), from React/Next.js UI to Postgres and edge functions \- Work across the clinic side of the product: scheduling, patient charts, pharmacy, labs, and checkout \- Run agent sessions in parallel, each with a clear spec, and review everything they produce before it ships \- Test and harden AI\-written code for security, data integrity, and performance. We handle patient records and payments, so this matters. \- Help build the AI in our product: the voice receptionist, AI\-assisted charting, and an in\-app assistant for clinic staff \- Develop and improve the internal tools our sales team runs on — dashboards, workflows, reporting, integrations \- Deploy and monitor your own work on Vercel and Supabase, and fix what breaks \- Sit down with the sales team, figure out what they actually need, then build it What we're looking for \- Extremely proficient with AI coding tools: you use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar agents every day and can show us exactly how you work \- Strong enough fundamentals to know when the AI is wrong: JavaScript/TypeScript, React, SQL, and auth \- 1\+ years of professional experience building web applications (internships and substantial side projects count) \- Comfort with Git and a pull request workflow \- Clear communication, and a habit of asking questions early rather than getting stuck quietly \- Comfortable with shifting priorities — on a three\-person team, this week's plan sometimes changes \- Able to work on\-site in Provo, UT Nice to have \- Veterinary or healthcare software experience, or time spent working in a vet clinic \- Next.js App Router (server components, server actions) and Vercel deployments \- Supabase: Postgres, row\-level security, edge functions \- Building with LLM APIs, voice AI, or MCP \- Stripe, Twilio, or other third\-party API integrations \- Tailwind CSS \- Testing with Jest, Vitest, or Playwright \- Experience building internal tools or CRM/sales integrations \- Startup or small\-team experience What we offer \- $50,000 – $85,000 per year, depending on experience \- Unlimited PTO \- A real say in technical decisions and the tools we use \- Short feedback loops: what you build goes live in days, not quarters \- Direct access to the people making product and business decisions Hiring process We're moving quickly on this one: \- Short intro call (\~20 minutes) \- Technical conversation with the team, including a walkthrough of something you've built \- A short live session where you build something small with your own AI setup \- Offer We aim to go from first call to decision within about a week. How to apply Apply through Indeed with your resume. In a couple of sentences, tell us how you build with AI (your tools, your workflow, a project you're proud of) and include a link if it's public. No cover letter required. Retrevr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Engine Performance (Tools) - Central Technology, Unreal Ecosystem
jobs.description: Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. We work with both new and current technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high\-volume obstacles and to deliver player value. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll drive important features and provide other engineers with a clear illustration of extraordinary engineering. The UnEco (or Unreal Ecosystem) team has an impact on a wide array of topics, including audio, test automation, runtime performance, tooling, and CI/CD. As a **Staff Software Engineer** on the UnEco team, you'll gain organizational alignment by building a strong engineering vision and offering creative solutions to technical problems. You will also serve as a mentor for your fellow engineers, helping guide their performance and finding growth opportunities delivering compelling player experiences. The ideal candidate in this role will bring substantial experience in both performance optimization and tooling, enabling them to be versatile across both partnering with game teams to deliver solutions to complex performance issues and provide central tooling solutions to help teams deliver faster and with more confidence. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Be hands\-on in development, writing excellent code that sets a high standard for other engineers. * Work with leadership on prioritization of work efforts and identifying opportunities for impact. * Partner with game teams to diagnose issues and improve player\-facing performance. * Partner with infrastructure teams to analyze and drive recommendations around bandwidth optimization, server density, resource utilization, etc. * Improve and optimize the developer experience, including improving cook and build times, editor load times, and understanding and fixing developer pain points. * Lead the technical execution of multi\-month to year\-plus work efforts across the business unit, holding teams to established standards. * Help teams navigate ambiguity and complexity by breaking down problems, identifying risks, and clearly communicating trade\-offs. * Work on a range of tech stacks including underlying infrastructure, build and test automation, release pipelines, and developer tooling for internal teams leveraging the Riot Unreal Ecosystem. * Work with stakeholders across the organization to address their pain points and exceed their expectations for how optimization and performance improvements can be realized without sacrificing quality. * Be a standard\-bearer and role model of Riot values for your team and others. * Be a force multiplier for your team. Mentor senior engineers on your team and enable them to deliver complex projects. **Required Qualifications:** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience * Expertise with C\+\+ * Experience working with modern video game engines * Experience working with large game teams * Experience working with large code bases * Experience debugging, profiling and optimizing complex projects * Strong knowledge of common game and software design patterns * Experience collaborating with teammates across multiple disciplines * Experience shipping games across multiple platforms * Experience with profiling tools like Unreal Insights or Pix * Experience with tools engineering to support internal development * Experience building and maintaining developer tools that improve engineering productivity and enable efficient software development across teams. **Desired Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Experience with Unreal Engine 5 * Experience building online games * Experience with rendering in Unreal Engine titles *For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision\-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!* **Our Perks:** -------------- Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our **benefits pages** for more information. At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you're working directly on a new player\-facing experience or you're supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we're better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we're looking forward to your application. *It's our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.* *Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:* * *Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data* * *Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors* * *Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks* * *Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters* *These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.*

jobs.title: Director, Identity & Access Management (IAM)
jobs.description: **About Riot Platforms** Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best\-in\-class execution and create successful outcomes. **Who we are** At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution. **About the role** Riot Platforms is seeking a **Director of Identity \& Access Management (IAM)** to lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of our enterprise identity security program. As Riot continues its evolution toward large\-scale AI/HPC and data center operations, identity will be a foundational security control across our corporate, cloud, data center, and operational environments. This leader will be responsible for establishing a modern, scalable IAM program centered on **Zero Trust, least privilege, strong authentication, privileged access management, identity governance, and automation**. The Director of IAM will report into Cybersecurity and partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, Cloud, Data Center Operations, People Operations, GRC, and business leaders. This is a remote position with travel to Riot sites as needed. **What you'll be doing** * Develop and execute Riot’s enterprise **IAM strategy and roadmap** across workforce, privileged, third\-party, and non\-human identities. * Own the architecture and security of **Microsoft Entra ID**, including SSO, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, PIM, RBAC, and identity lifecycle controls. * Mature Riot’s **Privileged Access Management (PAM)** program and eliminate unnecessary standing administrative privileges. * Establish scalable **Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)** capabilities for joiner/mover/leaver processes, access reviews, entitlement management, and segregation of duties. * Implement **least privilege and role\-based access models** across enterprise, cloud, SaaS, and data center environments. * Develop governance for **service accounts, API identities, machine identities, certificates, secrets, and other non\-human identities**. * Establish secure and repeatable processes for **vendors, contractors, partners, and other third\-party access**. * Increase IAM automation and reduce manual provisioning, approval delays, and unnecessary user friction. * Define IAM standards, architecture patterns, controls, and security requirements for new technology implementations. * Partner with Cybersecurity Operations to detect and respond to **identity\-based attacks, credential compromise, privilege escalation, and anomalous authentication activity**. * Define measurable IAM **KPIs and KRIs** and regularly communicate program maturity, risks, and progress to leadership. * Ensure IAM controls support Riot’s **SOX,** **SOC 2 and ISO 27001, regulatory, audit, and broader security requirements**. * Lead IAM engineers and partners while developing the talent and capabilities needed as Riot’s environment grows. **What you'll have** * 10\+ years of cybersecurity, IAM, infrastructure security, or related experience, including significant leadership responsibility. * Demonstrated experience building or materially transforming an enterprise IAM program. * Strong understanding of **Zero Trust, least privilege, identity governance, PAM, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management**. * Experience securing hybrid environments spanning on\-premises infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and modern data center environments. * Ability to translate identity risks and complex technical issues into clear business decisions. * Strong experience partnering across Cybersecurity, IT, HR/People Operations, GRC, Infrastructure, and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to balance **security, operational efficiency, and user experience**. * Preferred experience supporting **data centers, critical infrastructure, AI/HPC, or OT environments**. * Preferred experience implementing identity automation at enterprise scale. * Preferred familiarity with SOX, SOC 2, ISO, NIST CSF, Zero Trust architecture, and related control frameworks. * Preferred experience designing identity controls for cloud workloads and **non\-human identities**. * Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Microsoft Identity, highly preferred. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive Salary: $180,000\-$200,000 base salary (commensurate with experience) \+ bonus \+ sign\-on equity grant. * Long\-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. * 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. * Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company\-paid plans. * Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. *Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Data Catalog
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ At Rippling, Product is responsible for turning extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for our customers. As the Lead Product Manager for Data Catalog, you will own the semantic, ontology and governance layer that makes Rippling’s first\-party, third\-party, and customer\-created data understandable and usable by both humans and AI. This is a foundational product leadership role for Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy. You will define how data is represented, governed, discovered, and used across payroll, HR, IT, finance, external systems, customer datasets, and developer\-built applications. Your work will help Rippling AI answer customer questions correctly, take the right actions, and give internal and external developers a reliable interface into Rippling’s data graph. You will be the product lead for a new, high\-leverage area that touches nearly every Rippling product and depends on deep collaboration across engineering, AI, platform, product, and customer\-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to own the company context layer for AI at Rippling. **What you will do** * Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Rippling’s Data Catalog. * Define how first\-party, third\-party, and customer\-generated data is represented semantically across the Rippling platform. * Build the catalog capabilities that allow Rippling AI to interpret natural\-language questions, resolve ambiguity, map requests to the right data, and return accurate answers or actions. * Establish governance models for sensitive data, including access controls, permissions, and policy\-driven usage across payroll, HR, IT, finance, and external\-source data. * Create the product interface between Rippling AI, Data Cloud, internal product teams, external developers, and the underlying data graph. * Work across approximately ten dependent engineering teams and product areas to identify shared data\-modeling patterns, remove adoption friction, and drive catalog usage at scale. * Build feedback loops with customers, customer\-facing teams, data analysts, engineers, AI teams, and developers to understand hidden pain points and continuously improve the product. * Influence executive and cross\-functional stakeholders on investment priorities, trade\-offs, sequencing, and long\-term platform direction. * Define and track the success metrics that show whether the catalog improves AI accuracy, developer velocity, governance quality, and customer outcomes. **What you will need** ---------------------- * Experience as a senior product leader owning complex data, platform, infrastructure, analytics, AI, or developer\-facing products at meaningful scale. * Deep familiarity with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, analytics products, semantic layers, metadata systems, data governance, or adjacent B2B data products. * Strong product judgment in ambiguous technical domains, with the ability to turn broad platform goals into crisp strategy, roadmap, and execution. * A nuanced understanding of customer needs, business objectives, competitive dynamics, and industry trends in data and AI. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across multiple product and engineering teams, including senior stakeholders and executives. * Strong systems thinking, especially the ability to model data relationships, dependencies, permissions, edge cases, and downstream product implications. * Excellent communication and storytelling skills; you can explain deeply technical concepts clearly and persuade teams to make high\-quality decisions quickly. * AI fluency, including a strong understanding of what good context looks like for an LLM and how product systems can improve AI accuracy and actionability. * A track record of building products that internal teams or developers adopt because they improve quality, speed, flexibility, and reliability. * Comfort operating with high ownership in a late\-stage startup environment where the answer is not already defined. * Production AI experience is a plus, especially experience building products that provide context, grounding, retrieval, governance, or tool/action interfaces for AI systems. * Founder or early product leadership experience may be valuable if paired with strong evidence of building complex, customer\-facing products at scale. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 174,000 \- 290,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area)

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer, Technology, Facilities
jobs.description: We're looking for an AI Product Engineer to build and ship enterprise tools, systems and automations that drive measurable operational savings or improvements across Rivian's Facilities organization. You'll use AI\-native development tools like Cursor, Gemini, and Claude to turn real Facilities problems into working solutions that save time, reduce cost, and eliminate manual overhead. You'll embed directly into Facilities workflows — construction project reporting, capital program tracking, real estate operations, building management — and build automations that have a tangible dollar\-and\-cents impact. **Build \& Deploy** * Build internal applications, AI agents, and workflow automations using LLM\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Gemini, Claude, Glean, etc.) targeting specific Facilities pain points — manual reporting, data entry, schedule tracking, cost reconciliation — with a focus on quantifiable time and cost savings * Stand up no\-code and low\-code solutions, maintainable by non\-technical team members where speed and simplicity are prioritized over engineering complexity * Connect Facilities data sources (ACC, Procore, Kahua, FOS, Databricks) via APIs to support intelligent workflows that unify siloed information * Own the Full SDLC by applying traditional product development rigor to AI\-generated code. You will manage sprint cycles, define technical requirements in Jira, and oversee the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the tools you build. * Conduct code reviews on peer\-built AI tools and own enhancement of deployed solutions based on user feedback and evolving business needs **Learn the Business** * Rapidly build working knowledge of Facilities operations — how capital projects are planned, budgeted, tracked, and delivered — by shadowing project managers, construction teams, and operations staff to find automation opportunities that aren't on anyone's roadmap yet * Understand the Facilities tech stack well enough to identify where AI can eliminate friction and reduce costs * Document solutions, create reusable templates, and contribute to internal playbooks and how\-to guides **Collaborate \& Deliver Value** * Partner with Facilities stakeholders to understand workflows, quantify inefficiencies, and prioritize automations with the highest operational ROI * Translate operational needs into working prototypes and iterate based on user feedback until adoption sticks * Help track and report the impact of deployed solutions — hours saved, errors reduced, costs avoided, scaling without new headcount **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * 4\+ years in a technical role — software development, product ownership, technical program management, or similar * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; OR equivalent practical, hands\-on experience in lieu of a degree * Demonstrated experience building with AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, or equivalent) * Working knowledge of prompt engineering, AI agent design, and LLM application development * Strong foundational knowledge of Agile methodologies, version control (Git), code reviews, and secure deployment pipelines. * Strong UI/UX instincts — can produce functional, clean interfaces without a design team * Strong communication skills; equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with leadership or a working session with project teams * Self\-directed; thrives in ambiguous environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Familiarity with large\-scale construction, real estate, or capital programs * Experience with enterprise AI tools like Glean or similar knowledge management platforms * Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) frameworks and multi\-agent architectures * Prior experience shipping internal tools in a non\-engineering business unit * Track record of upskilling peers or running internal training on new technologies \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== At Robert Half, we're at the forefront of artificial intelligence and data science innovation, driving growth and efficiency across our products and services. jobs.title: AI Controls & Engineering Lead
jobs.description: About Rockefeller Capital Management: Rockefeller Capital Management was established in 2018 as a leading independent financial advisory services firm. Originally founded in 1882 as the family office of John D. Rockefeller, the Firm has evolved to offer strategic advice to ultra\- and high\-net\-worth individuals and families, institutions, and corporations from offices in 35 markets throughout the United States, as well as an office in London. The Firm oversees $237 billion in client assets as of August 31, 2026\. Position: The primary purpose of this role is to enable the safe, deliberate, and accelerated adoption of AI across Rockefeller Capital Management. Partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity (CISO), and AI Risk Governance teams, the individual translates governance requirements into scalable technical controls that govern the firm's AI ecosystem, including agents, copilots, skills, plugins, connectors, and the large language models that power them. AI platforms evolve rapidly, with new models, capabilities, and features released on a near\-weekly basis. This role is responsible for staying ahead of that pace by continuously evaluating emerging technologies from providers such as Microsoft, Anthropic, and other vendors. The individual will assess new capabilities through both a business value and risk lens, providing clear recommendations on whether they should be adopted, piloted, restricted, or deferred. This is a highly hands\-on technical role focused on operationalizing AI governance. Rather than creating policy, the individual interprets existing requirements and implements them directly through platform configuration, policy enforcement, APIs, automation, and administrative tooling across Microsoft and Anthropic environments. The goal is to ensure AI controls are embedded, measurable, and enforceable while supporting the firm's continued innovation and growth. Responsibilities: * Interpret and implement enterprise control requirements. Translate policies, standards, and risk decisions issued by Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, and AI Risk Governance into concrete technical controls, review gates, and deployment standards for AI capabilities. * Configure and script the controls. Implement guardrails directly across Microsoft and Anthropic services — tenant and admin center settings, Copilot and Copilot Studio policies, Azure AI Foundry configuration, Anthropic enterprise administration, Entra access policies, and Purview data protection controls. * Automate governance at scale. Build scripts and automation (PowerShell, Graph API, Python, KQL) to inventory agents and skills, enforce policy, detect drift, monitor usage, and produce audit and compliance evidence. * Own agents and skills end to end. Maintain the inventory, ownership model, and lifecycle — from intake and review through deployment, monitoring, recertification, and retirement. * Run capability review assessments. Evaluate new AI features and use cases against firm\-defined risk, security, and compliance criteria — covering business value, security exposure, data access and entitlement impact, supervisory obligations, operational readiness, and fit with enterprise * architecture standards — and escalate to the appropriate governance body where a policy decision is required. * Assess LLMs and model changes. Test and compare models across providers, track model and version updates, evaluate capability shifts and failure modes, and provide the technical evidence governance bodies need to decide where each model may be used. * Stay ahead of AI evolution. Systematically track roadmaps, release notes, and previews across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Anthropic, and emerging platforms, and translate each change into a clear enable, pilot, restrict, or defer recommendation. * Implement controls for safe sharing and reuse. Configure how agents and skills are scoped, shared, and permissioned in line with approved requirements, including departmental boundaries, intent review, and guardrails against unintended data exposure. * Partner across the firm. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, AI Risk Governance, platform engineering, product, and business teams to confirm intent, close gaps, and ensure capabilities launch with the required controls already in place. * Report clearly to leadership and governance forums. The Enterprise Architect provides architecture leadership across ERP, financial, HR, SaaS, integration, automation, and other enterprise platforms while establishing standards, governance practices, and future\-state architecture. jobs.title: Manager, DevOps
jobs.description: Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source\-to\-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems. Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest\-to\-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community. For more information, visit www.supplier.io. **The Opportunity** The Manager, DevOps is a hands\-on leader who sets direction, builds durable processes, and develops the team that keeps our cloud platforms reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient. You will manage and grow the team while staying close to the technology, and you will be measured on the systems you put in place: how we plan, how we release, how we observe our environments, and how the team executes. The ideal candidate has built high\-functioning DevOps practices before and knows how to bring structure and accountability to a team without slowing it down. **What You Will Do*** Own the DevOps roadmap and delivery commitments across all Supplier.io environments, serving as the single point of accountability for DevOps direction and priorities. * Manage, coach, and develop the DevOps team and own hiring for the team as it grows, including defining roles, interviewing, and onboarding. * Establish and enforce core operational processes, including change management, release management, environment promotion standards, incident response and postmortems, on\-call coverage, and documentation and runbook standards. * Bring legacy, undocumented infrastructure under version control and documentation, and own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including defined recovery time and recovery point objectives for our critical systems. * Bring planning discipline to the function, including sprint planning, estimation, and clear delivery commitments. * Define and drive the observability strategy, delivering centralized visibility across all environments with clear standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM, and owning the related tooling decisions. * Own the cloud cost optimization program, including committed\-use discounts, right\-sizing of compute and databases, and reduction of logging and storage costs. * Drive security and compliance hygiene in partnership with the security function, including least\-privilege access, access reviews, key rotation, certificate automation, and vulnerability remediation. * Stay hands\-on: build and review CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes workloads alongside the team, and lead by example on technical standards. * Partner directly with Data Engineering to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps their pipelines running: Snowflake account and warehouse administration, Airflow orchestration infrastructure, and secrets and connection management for data pipelines. * Coordinate with the STAC on infrastructure decisions, such as cloud architecture, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling, that affect the broader platform, so infrastructure choices stay aligned with company\-wide architecture standards. * Participate in the on\-call rotation alongside the team, especially early on, to stay close to the systems and set the standard for response quality. * Build a culture of automation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the DevOps team and the broader engineering organization. * Partner with software development, data engineering, AI, and platform teams to keep environments consistent and delivery fast, safe, and reliable. * Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and make pragmatic decisions about what to build, buy, and adopt. **What You will Need to Succeed:** * 10\+ years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles with progressive responsibility, including 3\+ years leading or managing engineers with hiring, coaching, and performance responsibility. * A track record of building processes that stick: change and release management, incident response, planning and estimation practices, and documentation standards in a growing organization. * Experience bringing legacy or undocumented infrastructure under management, including introducing Infrastructure as Code and disaster recovery planning where neither existed before. * Strong hands\-on proficiency with CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, or similar), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm), and containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). * Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform. AWS and Azure experience is beneficial. * Experience defining and implementing an observability strategy across multiple environments, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM tooling decisions. * Experience managing cloud spend, including committed\-use or reservation strategies, right\-sizing, and cost accountability. * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to set clear expectations with engineers, influence peers across engineering, and present plans and results to executives. * Judgment to balance keep\-the\-lights\-on operations, project delivery, and longer\-term automation investments. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building or managing distributed teams, including offshore execution teams. * Experience consolidating infrastructure and operations across acquired platforms. * Experience with security automation, compliance frameworks, and policy\-as\-code. * Familiarity with CI/CD for data pipelines and AI/MLOps practices. **We do no accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment/search firms.** Supplier.io participates in E\-Verify. For more information, click here. We will provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. Supplier.io is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Supplier.io is unable to sponsor work visas (e.g., H\-1B, TN, OPT, etc.) for US positions. Candidates must meet in\-country work authorization requirements. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact the Human Resources department at humanresources@supplier.io or 978\-843\-5747\.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Sage is looking for an experienced Principal AI Engineer to build AI\-powered solutions that accelerate and automate complex data migration into Sage products. This is a senior, hands\-on technical role for someone who can independently own substantial engineering initiatives, translate ambiguous problems into practical solutions, and take those solutions from concept through production. This is a hybrid role, three days per week onsite in the San Jose office. **Key Responsibilities** - Design and build AI/ML\-powered solutions for migrating data from a variety of source systems into Sage products. - Apply machine learning, data science, and modern AI techniques to problems including data transformation, mapping, classification, reconciliation, and validation. - Own substantial technical projects end\-to\-end, from problem definition and architecture through implementation and production deployment. - Independently drive solutions to complex and ambiguous technical problems. - Build scalable, reliable production systems rather than prototypes alone. - Contribute to the infrastructure and operational practices required to deploy, monitor, and maintain AI systems in production. - Work closely with engineering, product, and domain experts to translate customer and implementation challenges into technical solutions. - Help establish engineering patterns and best practices for applying AI across Sage's migration capabilities. - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers. Qualifications - 10\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI, or closely related engineering disciplines. - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field from a top\-tier university. - Graduate study or an advanced degree in AI, machine learning, data science, or a related technical field is desirable. - Significant hands\-on experience building and deploying applied data science and/or machine learning solutions. - Strong software engineering skills and experience developing production\-grade systems. - Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, or related AI Ops / MLOps practices is desirable. - Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver large, technically complex projects. - Strong understanding of data pipelines, data transformation, and working with large or complex datasets. - Experience applying modern AI technologies, including LLMs, to real\-world business problems. - Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment with significant technical ambiguity. Perks? We have plenty. - Competitive salaries that landed us top 5% of similar sized companies (according to Comparably) - Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage - 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%) - 32 days paid time off (21 personal days, 10 national holidays, 1 floating holiday) - 18 weeks paid parental leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy offered 1 year after start date - 5 days paid yearly to volunteer (through Sage Foundation) - $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after hire date - Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually) - Library of on demand career development options and ongoing training offerings Dig deeper about who we are: - Who is Sage: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/about\-sage/ - Life at Sage: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/careers/ - Our Values \& Behaviors: https://www.youtube.com/watch?app\=desktop\&v\=vt5JXf\-Gwno\&feature\=youtu.be - How we make a difference: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/sage\-foundation/ - Sage Business Cloud \- SaaS for Every Business: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/products/ \#LI\-MT1

jobs.title: Contract Developer — ColdFusion to PHP Migration
jobs.description: **Contract Developer — ColdFusion to PHP Migration** Senior full\-stack · Contract · Fully remote **Location:** Fully remote (U.S.) **Engagement:** Contract, hourly **Rate:** $50–$75 / hour **Focus area:** Legacy ColdFusion migration to a modern PHP framework **COLDFUSION FLUENCY IS REQUIRED ON DAY ONE** This engagement is too short to learn ColdFusion on. We need someone who can open an undocumented CFML codebase in week one and tell us what it does. Candidates with only casual exposure, or who plan to come up to speed on the job, will not be considered. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We are looking for a senior full\-stack contract developer with real depth in both ColdFusion and PHP to lead the migration of a legacy web application to a modern PHP framework. This is a hands\-on technical role, not an advisory one. You will read, analyze, and decipher an existing ColdFusion codebase — including undocumented logic and legacy patterns — and re\-architect that logic into clean, scalable PHP. You will also build new functional capability in the new architecture as the migration proceeds. Dynamic Digital modernizes outdated technology, builds on proven frameworks, and delivers efficient development that helps our clients grow with confidence. We are a small team, the feedback loop is short, and what you build goes live for real clients. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Codebase audit and deconstruction.** Analyze existing ColdFusion (CFML/CFCs) application logic, data flow, background jobs, and business rules. * **Migration strategy and execution.** Re\-architect and rewrite ColdFusion features into modern PHP — Laravel, Symfony, or structured OOP PHP — keeping business rules intact while clearing legacy debt. * **Feature development.** Design and build new functional modules and RESTful APIs directly in the new PHP architecture. * **Database and data integration.** Maintain, refactor, and migrate relational schemas (MySQL, MS SQL, or PostgreSQL) and tune query performance through the transition. * **Dual\-environment support.** Keep the ColdFusion and PHP systems interoperable — sessions, data, and side\-by\-side execution — during a phased rollout. * **Documentation.** Leave behind a written record of what the legacy system did and how the new one replaces it, so the next developer is not starting where you started. * **Code review and accountability.** Review everything you ship, including anything produced with AI assistance, for correctness, quality, and security. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 7\+ years of professional development experience, with substantial production ColdFusion among it. * **ColdFusion expertise — non\-negotiable.** Extensive production experience with Adobe ColdFusion or Lucee. You can read, debug, and translate both tag and script syntax, legacy includes (cfinclude), custom tags, components (.cfc), and application lifecycle scopes (Application.cfc / Application.cfm). * **PHP expertise.** Strong command of modern PHP (8\.x), object\-oriented architecture, design patterns, and current framework standards such as Laravel or Symfony. * **Migration track record.** You have moved a legacy monolith onto a modern framework before without breaking production business logic. Be ready to talk through one in detail. * **Front\-end proficiency.** Modern JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3 — Tailwind or Bootstrap. * **Relational databases.** Advanced SQL, query optimization, indexing, and data mapping. * **API design.** Hands\-on experience building and consuming RESTful endpoints. * **Version control.** Solid understanding of Git. * **AI\-assisted development.** Comfortable using it, and accountable for what you ship with it. AI\-generated code gets the same review for quality and security as anything you write by hand — which matters more than usual when the source logic is undocumented. * **Independent delivery.** You work from a written scope and deliver with minimal oversight. Most of our coordination is asynchronous. * Work we can review — a portfolio, public repositories, or a system you can walk us through in detail. Formal degree not required. **PREFERRED** * Lucee specifically * Automated testing during migration * CI/CD pipelines * Hosting, DNS, and server migration * WordPress / PHP CMS work * Scheduled jobs and queue systems **HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS** * Independent contractor (1099\). You invoice us; you are not an employee of Dynamic Digital. * Hours and the length of the engagement are set in the written scope before work begins. * Hourly at $50–$75, depending on experience and the scope. Rate is agreed before work begins. * The work is scoped in writing — phases, deliverables, and milestones — before it starts. * Fully remote anywhere in the United States. Our team is in Willow Grove, PA and works Eastern hours. * You control your own schedule, tools, and how the work gets done. Dynamic Digital is a web development agency in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, managed by Sahajanand, LLC. We modernize outdated technology and build on proven frameworks so our clients can grow with confidence. Small team, short feedback loops, and the work you build goes live for real clients. Pay: $50\.00 \- $75\.00 / hour Job Type: contract Education: No education required Work location: This is a remote position Dynamic Digital LLC. 2713 Easton Rd, Willow Grove, PA, 19090
