Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. We are looking for a trailblazing engineering leader who is passionate about empowering developers with AI tools that will innovate the developer experience at Slack. The Developer Experience (DevXP) AI team equips the entire engineering organization with Agentic SDLC solutions that reach all aspects of the development lifecycle. We own AI tooling from end to end: distribution, monitoring, evangelism, evaluation, and cost management, while also building and experimenting with internal tooling like AI code review agents for use across the company. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you are very comfortable in uncharted territory and excel at forging new trails. You are an expert at dealing with extreme technical ambiguity and unforeseen circumstances. You will lead projects and architectural efforts that impact the entire Product, Design, and Engineering (PDE) organization. While keeping close to the details, you are a hands\-on leader who exemplifies Slack’s culture, acting as a technical compass to set and drive the roadmap for how AI accelerates software development at scale. **What You Will Do** * **Set and Drive the Technical Vision** : Define the long\-term technical roadmap for Agentic SDLC. Partner closely with product and engineering managers to navigate complex tradeoffs in strategy, team allocation, and project sequencing. * Architect Globally Optimal Solutions: While you may not always write full\-stack code, you will lead detailed, cross\-boundary conversations about the architecture and design of multiple systems and codebases to ensure we are building optimal, scalable solutions. Highlight and drive systemic change where architecture falls short. * Lead Cross\-Functionally: Collaborate with a wide range of cross\-functional peers—including design, customer experience, finance, business operations, and marketing—to bring strategic clarity to both the engineering organization and Slack as a whole. * Pioneer and Prototype: Build hands\-on prototypes to prove out long\-term technical and product strategies. Establish and nurture a culture of prototyping, experimentation, and calculated risk\-taking within the engineering teams. * Drive Exceptional Ownership: Demonstrate a “can\-do” demeanor where nothing is outside your responsibilities. Do what it takes to deliver the highest quality code and the most impactful features, treating failure as a powerful opportunity for organizational learning. **What You Should Have** * 10–15\+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of driving technical impact at the staff, senior staff, or principal level. * Deep expertise in AI development tools and frameworks (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph) with experience architecting, distributing, and championing these technologies at an organizational scale. * Advanced systems design and architecture skills, with the ability to navigate multiple complex codebases and guide teams toward globally optimal technical decisions. * Expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure and services, specifically designing for high availability, enterprise\-grade security, and massive scale while managing operational costs. * Deep familiarity with developer productivity metrics tracking, evaluation, and large\-scale systemic improvement. * Exceptional cross\-functional leadership and communication skills, capable of distilling extreme technical ambiguity into actionable strategies for both engineering and business stakeholders. * A related technical degree required. **Nice To Have** * Experience using Slack and a keen, critical interest in making the platform better. * Specific leadership experience working within the Developer Experience space, Platform engineering, or internal developer tooling teams. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. jobs.title: Senior AI Data & Analytics Engineer II
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self\-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high\-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross\-functional automation. This role is open to candidates residing in the US. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. **In this role, you will:** * Partner on defining the strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation. * Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics. * Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self\-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well\-modeled data. * Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R\&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning. * Lead complex, cross\-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships. * Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. * Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high\-impact problems: build AI\-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy. * Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps. * Ship high\-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI\-generated work before it reaches production. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands\-on data engineering experience. * Expert\-level Python and SQL, with strong hands\-on data modeling and DBT experience. * Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands\-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).  re engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well\-architected, delivered solutions. * Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs. * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools. * Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks. * Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience. * Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior Architect, Digital Technology
jobs.description: **Who we are:**Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company\-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners. Senior Architect, Digital Technology will architect, design, and deliver business initiatives that drive revenue and/or improve efficiency working in Samsonite’s Digital Technology team. The individual will maintain an in\-depth view of the organization’s technologies and architectures around Ecommerce systems. This role will be accountable for an aspirational roadmap for the Digital stack with a focus on industry specific trends, emerging technologies, and strategic differentiators. The individual will present and socialize the current and future state of Digital Products and Platforms to various stakeholders. This is a hybrid role; we work on site 4 days and remotely 1 day weekly. * Operating as a Forward Deployed Engineer, this role works directly on the front lines of implementation, helping Ecommerce business units integrate and maximize the value of AI/non\-AI products and platforms. * Strong understanding of SFCC, SFRA, CDN, NodeJS, ETL, Build Processes, Web Vitals, Code quality evaluations, Atlassian processes, and Microservices. * Experience in implementation and integration of various solutions such as Product Information Management (PIM), Content Management Systems (CMS), Digital Asset Management (DAM) and A/B Testing Solutions. * Expert understanding of Payment and Order Management systems and integration concepts – REST, SOAP, Batch, SFTP, API Gateways. * Deep understanding of Content Delivery Networks, Network traffic routing and Service Workers. * Experience in headless architecture, progressive web apps (PWA) as well as API Orchestration with an overarching focus on performance optimization. * Demonstrated ability architecting multi\-tenant systems and platforms with a focus on building reference applications, across a variety of platforms. * Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Salesforce Service Cloud is a plus. * Knowledge of IT security and regulatory compliance (PCI, PII, etc.) * Excellent analytical and technical skills and ability to lead, direct and challenge teams in process, methods, and approach. * Strong communication, leadership, and negotiation skills to work closely with business and other cross\-functional teams. * Strong understanding of ecommerce ecosystems and processes that include end\-to\-end data flows and processing from order management, fulfillment, payments, customer service and other backend systems. * Experienced in working across multiple teams and adapting various architectures to meet business needs. **Why you'll love working here:*** **Our employees matter.** As a people\-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based. * **Vibrant culture.** We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long\-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day. * **Socially responsible.** We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models. **What we value:**At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Champion Aerospace LLC** Job Description **Job Title:** Security Engineer **Department:** IT **Reports To:** I T \& IS Manager **Shift/Schedule:** Office Hours **Summary** The Security Engineer is a high\-visibility position responsible for supporting the company's day\-to\-day IT operations while maintaining and improving the organization's cybersecurity program. This role provides hands\-on technical support to employees, helps administer and secure IT systems, and works closely with internal teams and technology vendors to resolve issues and improve the reliability and security of company systems. This position supports a broad range of technologies, including endpoint systems, Microsoft 365, identity and access management, networking, security tools, business applications, and other infrastructure. The Security Engineer will also participate in projects that improve IT services, security controls, business processes, and compliance. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Support day\-to\-day IT and security operations, including alert triage, log review, endpoint monitoring, and assisting with security investigations and incident response. * Provide hands\-on IT support and troubleshooting for Windows workstations, laptops, applications, peripherals, and common network/connectivity issues. Help diagnose and resolve PC problems and escalate more complex issues when appropriate. * Help administer identity and access management systems, including Entra ID, SSO, MFA, directory services, and user onboarding, transfers, and offboarding. Conduct periodic access reviews and help clean up stale accounts and entitlements. * Maintain and improve endpoint security across the company, including EDR health, patch management, configuration standards, disk encryption, and endpoint security controls. * Assist with network and infrastructure security tasks, including firewall rule reviews, VPN administration, network segmentation, monitoring, and identifying configuration issues. * Support the vulnerability management program by assisting with vulnerability scanning, prioritizing findings, coordinating remediation with system owners, and tracking remediation progress. * Provide basic vendor management and coordination, including opening and tracking support cases, communicating with vendors on technical issues, reviewing service or security documentation, and helping ensure vendor commitments and follow\-up items are completed. * Support third\-party and vendor risk management by reviewing security documentation, identifying potential concerns, and tracking remediation or risk acceptance activities. * Contribute to the company's compliance and security programs by helping collect evidence, maintain policies and procedures, complete customer security questionnaires, and prepare for audits and assessments, including CMMC, Cyber Insurance, and other applicable requirements. * Build and deliver security awareness content, including phishing simulations, onboarding training, and internal security guidance. * Serve as a knowledgeable point of contact for employees with IT and security questions, including suspicious emails, lost or replaced devices, access issues, software problems, and security\-related requests. * Document processes, troubleshooting procedures, and runbooks. * Identify opportunities to improve IT and security processes through automation, better documentation, and more efficient use of existing tools. * Participate in an on\-call rotation as needed for critical IT or security issues. **Minimum Job Requirements** * Associate degree in an IT field and/or 3\-5 years of experience in a cybersecurity role **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required** * Strong understanding of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, networking, and common enterprise IT technologies. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, including identity and access management, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, email security, and network security. * Working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. * Familiarity with endpoint management and security platforms such as Microsoft Intune, EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM/logging systems. * Basic understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, switching, and wireless networks. * Ability to troubleshoot PC hardware, operating systems, applications, peripherals, and connectivity problems. * Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. * Comfortable working independently while also collaborating with other IT staff, vendors, and business departments. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, support requests, and competing priorities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and security concepts to employees with varying levels of technical knowledge. * Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation and follow established processes. * Familiarity with scripting or automation using PowerShell, or similar tools is preferred. * Familiarity with IT security and compliance frameworks such as CMMC, NIST, or similar requirements is preferred. * Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, Network\+, Microsoft certifications, CISA, CISM, CISSP, or similar are preferred. **Additional Requirements** * Work will be performed on\-site. * Nights, weekends, and holidays are required at times. * Successful candidates may be subject to a background check prior to starting work. **Working Conditions and Physical Effort** * Physical effort is required. * Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment. * Moderate physical activity. Requires handling of average\-weight objects up to 50 pounds. The employee is expected to adhere to all company policies. **NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other duties assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.**

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is looking for someone to join our Manufacturing Operations team as a Process Engineer in one of four locations: **Nampa, ID**; **Lewiston, ID; Pullman, WA; or West Lafayette, IN**. If you are looking to grow your career and are motivated by solving meaningful problems, we encourage you to apply today! As a Process Engineer, you will identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, helping to increase efficiency, quality, and safety across operations. You will work closely with production and other teams to troubleshoot issues, implement process improvements, and support day\-to\-day manufacturing activities. You will also use data and continuous improvement principles to help drive better performance and reliable results. **A typical day as a Process Engineer might include:** * Providing engineering support in multiple areas of manufacturing. * Specifying, developing, justifying, implementing, and sustaining assembly equipment and materials. * Improving quality, yield, efficiency, and capacity of processes in accordance with strategic objectives. * Applying statistical problem solving to identify root causes. * Evaluating new equipment and processes and process improvement activities. * Interpreting results and providing recommendations to management. * Keeping abreast of new developments in equipment, industry standards, best practices, and developments in assembly processes. * Modeling, teaching, and applying SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles. **This job might be for you if:** * You have a B.S. in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience. * You have two years' experience in process development in a related world class manufacturing company. * You can lead a cross functional team. * You can influence others and reach consensus. * You have project management experience. * You have knowledge of statistics as applied to process capability measurements. * You have effective writing, documentation, and speaking skills. * You can work cooperatively in a team environment. * You have background check results satisfactory to SEL. * You have negative drug test result(s). **It is a plus if you have:** * Thorough understanding of the materials used in the industry. **Physical Requirements** None **About Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories** SEL designs, manufactures, and supports products and systems that protect, monitor, control, and automate electric power systems. Our technologies help detect faults, prevent equipment damage, and reduce the impact of power outages. Our mission is to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical. Employees contribute to practical, high\-quality solutions used every day, where attention to detail and quality directly support the reliability of the electric grid. **Location:** * **Lewiston, ID** – This position is located in Lewiston, ID where you'll enjoy an unmatched quality of life. Enjoy the smaller town life: country space, freedom from traffic, easy access to recreational activities in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests, as well as great schools and universities. * **Nampa, ID** – This position is located in Nampa, ID. You will enjoy a thriving community with a family\-friendly atmosphere, affordable living, and convenient access to the amenities of the greater Boise metropolitan area. With nearby outdoor recreation, including rivers, lakes, mountains, and miles of trails Nampa also has excellent schools, local events, and a growing economy that makes it a great place to live and work. * **Pullman, WA** – This position is located in Pullman, WA. Nestled in Eastern Washington, offering an exceptional quality of life. Embrace the charm of small\-town living with spacious surroundings, no traffic hassles, and easy access to outdoor adventures in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests. Plus, benefit from excellent schools and universities in the area. * **West Lafayette, IN** – This position is located in West Lafayette, IN, a welcoming community that combines small\-town charm with the energy of world\-class university town. Home to Purdue University, the area is known for its innovation, strong schools, and vibrant community. Residents enjoy parks and outdoor recreation, local events, diverse dining options, and an affordable cost of living, all while being conveniently located within driving distance of Indianapolis and Chicago. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Pay Range: $89,400 \- $134,100 annually** We set starting pay based on job\-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. We are looking to fill this position at the Process Engineer level, and we welcome applicants with a range of experience. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly. Associate Process Engineer: $82,000 – $122,900 annually Process Engineer: $89,400 \- $134,100 annually Lead Process Engineer: $107,600 – $161,500 annually **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance and Data Tester
jobs.description: **Great Waters Federal i**s part of the **Seneca Nation Group (SNG)** portfolio of companies**. SNG** is Seneca Holdings' federal government contracting business that meets mission\-critical needs of federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community customers. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn. Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work\-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full\-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non\-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation. We are seeking a detail\-oriented **Quality Assurance / Data Tester** to support the design, validation, and quality assurance of data pipelines and integration workflows across the agency\-wide Halo enterprise cloud platform. Halo serves as a central data infrastructure layer for multiple FDA centers and programs, supporting data onboarding and a range of use\-case development efforts that prepare data for advanced analytics and AI agent consumption. This role operates within a Databricks E2 on AWS environment governed by FISMA High and multi\-tenant security requirements. The position requires close collaboration across a complex, matrixed federal environment. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on tester who can identify defects early, validate the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of legacy on\-premises systems migrating to cloud\-based architectures, and confirm that advanced analytics and AI agent use cases meet defined business and technical requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * Support the design, validation, and quality assurance of data pipelines and integration workflows across the Halo enterprise cloud platform. * Validate data onboarding processes to ensure new data sources are ingested, transformed, and made available accurately and reliably for downstream use cases. * Support the development and testing of Halo use cases, ensuring data is properly prepared and fit for purpose for required analytics. * Verify the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of data migrated from legacy on\-premises systems to cloud\-based architectures. * Validate that advanced analytics outputs meet defined functional, technical, and business requirements. * Test and validate AI agent use cases operating across a complex, matrixed federal environment, confirming that outputs are accurate, consistent, and aligned with intended behavior. * Create clear, thorough, and traceable test cases and test scripts derived from requirements, source\-to\-target mappings, and use\-case documentation. * Execute functional testing to confirm that pipelines, transformations, and platform features perform as designed. * Perform integration testing across interconnected systems, services, and data flows to validate end\-to\-end behavior. * Conduct regression testing to ensure new releases, pipeline changes, or platform updates do not introduce defects into existing functionality. * Perform backend and data\-level testing, including SQL\-based validation of tables, transformations, and aggregations within Delta Lake and Databricks. * Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, prioritizing early detection to reduce downstream rework and risk. * Collaborate with data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and continuously improve test coverage. * Maintain test documentation, traceability matrices, and evidence of test execution to support audit and compliance needs within a FISMA High environment. * Participate in Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and iterative test cycles. **Required Qualifications** * Proven, hands\-on experience in software or data quality assurance testing, including test case design and execution. * Strong experience with functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and backend/data testing. * Solid SQL skills for validating backend data, including complex queries, joins, and aggregations. * Demonstrated ability to identify defects early in the development lifecycle and communicate them clearly to technical teams. * Experience testing data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data migration efforts from legacy systems to cloud platforms. * Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks and AWS, including exposure to Delta tables and data lakehouse concepts. * Experience developing and maintaining test cases, test plans, and traceability documentation. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with close attention to data accuracy, consistency, and edge cases. * Experience working within Agile/Scrum project methodologies. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across cross\-functional, matrixed teams. **Preferred Skills** * Experience testing or validating AI/ML model outputs or AI agent\-based use cases. * Familiarity with medallion architecture, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, and modern data lakehouse design. * Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for data or API testing. * Experience operating within FISMA High, FedRAMP, or other regulated, multi\-tenant federal environments. * Familiarity with defect\-tracking and test\-management tools, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** Seneca Holdings provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, genetic information and/or predisposing genetic characteristics, victim of domestic violence status, veteran status, or other protected class status. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation and training. The Company also prohibits retaliation against any employee who exercises his or her rights under applicable anti\-discrimination laws. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company does give hiring preference to Seneca or Native individuals. Veterans with expertise in these areas are highly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer

as enterprise priorities shift.**General Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy production models, services, and pipelines that are reliable, scalable, and maintainable. * Partner with data science, product, data engineering, and platform teams to translate business problems into technical solutions. * Build and optimize model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining workflows. * Improve model performance, latency, cost efficiency, reliability, and explainability in production environments. * Develop reusable infrastructure, tooling, libraries, and patterns that accelerate team delivery. * Monitor deployed models for performance degradation, bias, drift, and operational issues; recommend and implement corrective actions. * Collaborate with stakeholders to with advances in practices. **Experience / Qualifications** * A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience. * Must be a team player able to work in a programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel) * Strong interpersonal \& collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers **Additional Responsibilities**: * Lead the development and deployment of enterprise AI applications from concept through production. * Build generative AI, agent, copilot, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions for commercial use cases, such as lead triage and routing, account insights, and competitor and peer performance intelligence. * Build AI solutions for core functions, such as engineering design and FMEA support, quality diagnostics and root\-cause analysis, supply chain planning, and procurement contract intelligence. * Put data science models (e.g., forecasting, scoring, anomaly detection, computer vision) into production as reliable services and APIs. * Integrate AI with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, and quality systems so insights show up where people already work. * Build data pipelines that combine structured and unstructured data, including documents, engineering and test data, manufacturing data, and external market data. * Create reusable frameworks, components, and engineering standards that accelerate solution delivery across domains. * Establish testing, evaluation, and release criteria, including accuracy and source\-grounding checks, plus adoption and business\-impact metrics. * Own solutions end to end, from prototype through production support, and iterate directly with business users. * Apply security and access controls suited to sensitive data, including customer, pricing, financial, and engineering IP. * Partner with internal teams and external vendors to ensure AI solutions meet technical, security, and operational requirements. **Additional Qualifications**: * 5\+ years of software engineering experience delivering production applications, including 2\+ years building AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions. * Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, APIs, system integration, cloud technologies, and modern software development practices. * Hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs), intelligent agents, copilots, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), including evaluating and monitoring output quality. * Working knowledge of * Experience integrating solutions with enterprise platforms, business applications, and data ecosystems; exposure to CRM (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, PLM, or MES preferred. * Proven ability to work across multiple business domains and quickly learn new processes; manufacturing or industrial experience preferred. * Azure, Azure AI services, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or Databricks experience preferred. * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field preferred. \#LI\-SK1 **Base Salary Range:** $115,620\.00 \- $158,983\.00 *At Sensata, our employees are the key to our success and growth. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Staff Software Engineer – File Ingestion (Customer\-Facing Services)** ======================================================================== ### **Build the Future of the AI Data Cloud** Snowflake’s File Ingestion team owns the core engines behind **COPY INTO** and **Snowpipe** — the primary arteries landing customer data into the AI Data Cloud at hundreds of petabytes per quarter. We are expanding our core mission to build next\-generation, **external\-facing ingestion services** that directly expose file\-ingest capabilities to external platforms, partner ecosystems, and customer applications. As a **Staff Software Engineer**, you will lead the architectural vision and execution for these mission\-critical, customer\-facing services. You will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput distributed systems, API platform design, and direct customer feature delivery, defining how enterprise data seamlessly flows into Snowflake at global scale. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Drive Technical Vision \& Architecture:** Define the multi\-year architecture and technical strategy for high\-throughput, external\-facing ingestion services and APIs across multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). * **Deliver Customer\-Facing Innovations:** Lead the end\-to\-end execution of enterprise\-grade external features, ensuring low\-latency data landing, high availability, and seamless ecosystem integration (e.g., Snowpark Connect, partner connectors). * **Set Technical Direction:** Author foundational design documents, establish technical standards for reliability, security, and scalability, and lead high\-stakes architectural reviews across engineering orgs. * **Lead Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner closely with Principal Architects, Product Management, Security, and external developer platforms to translate customer requirements into resilient system architecture. * **Elevate Engineering Excellence:** Mentor and sponsor Senior, Mid\-level, and Junior engineers; raise the bar for system design, code quality, testing methodologies, and operational maturity. * **Direct Customer \& Strategic Impact:** Engage with enterprise customer engineering teams to solve complex integration challenges, debug production edge cases at scale, and turn direct customer feedback into core platform capabilities. ### **What We’re Looking For** * **10\+ years** of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud\-native infrastructure in production. * Proven track record of **architectural leadership**, having successfully taken complex, customer\-facing services or external APIs from initial concept to General Availability (GA) and global scale. * **Expert proficiency in Java or C\+\+** (strong preference for engineers comfortable working across both systems\-level C\+\+ and managed service Java frameworks). * Deep expertise in **external API design, cloud service orchestration**, and building resilient, multi\-tenant customer\-facing endpoints. * Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following: high\-throughput ingestion pipelines, distributed query execution engines, messaging/streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar), or database internals. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to drive technical consensus across cross\-functional leadership, product partners, and external technical stakeholders. * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience building and scaling **external developer platforms, SDKs, or public SaaS APIs** serving external consumers. * Deep expertise with **open table formats** (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and integration with ecosystems like Apache Spark or Ray. * Advanced performance engineering expertise: memory management, SIMD, vectorization, lock\-free data structures, or I/O optimization at PB\-scale. * Strong background in metadata management, transactional state machines, or consensus protocols (e.g., Raft, Paxos). * Active contributor to open\-source data infrastructure, cloud\-native compute systems, or query engines. ### **Why This Team** * **Massive Strategic Impact:** You will lead the expansion of Snowflake's most critical data\-path surface into direct, customer\-facing integrations that unlock new platform ecosystems and drive platform volume. * **Broad Architectural Scope:** Your work will bridge edge API layers, control\-plane orchestrators, file scanners/parsers, query planners, and underlying storage engines. * **High Customer Visibility:** Work directly on features that power the external integrations for Fortune 500 enterprises, seeing the immediate revenue and performance impact of your architecture. * **Culture of Technical Leadership:** Partner directly with Snowflake’s top architects and leads in an environment that values deep technical autonomy, rigorous engineering, and long\-term architectural stewardship. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: ***JOB SUMMARY*** The Data Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the university’s modern data platform, including data pipelines, data models, integrations, and analytics\-ready datasets. This role supports Southeastern University’s ability to make timely, accurate, and informed decisions by ensuring that institutional data is reliable, accessible, secure, and well\-governed. This position works closely with Information Technology, Enterprise Applications, Data Analytics, Institutional Research, Enrollment, Advising, Financial Aid, Student Success, Finance, Advancement, and other university stakeholders to transform complex operational data into trusted data assets. The Data Platform Engineer will play a key role in helping the university move from reactive reporting and manual data processes toward a more proactive, customer\-focused, and decision\-driven data culture. The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail\-oriented, service\-minded, and able to bridge the gap between complex systems, institutional business processes, and practical data solutions. ***ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS*** ---------------------------------- *Reports to:*Executive Director Enterprise Services *Supervisory Responsibility:*N/A *Indirect Supervisory Responsibility:* N/A ***ESSENTIAL DUTIES \-****May include, but is not limited to the following:* Data Platform Development * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that move data from core university systems into the university’s data warehouse, lakehouse, or analytics environment. * Develop and maintain data models using SQL, dbt, and related modern data platform tools. * Create reusable, governed, and analytics\-ready datasets that support reporting, dashboards, operational workflows, and institutional decision\-making. * Support the continued development of the university’s data warehouse/data lake architecture. * Build data structures that enable self\-service analytics, AI\-enabled workflows, and faster access to institutional insights. Data Integration and Transformation * Integrate data from university systems such as the student information system, CRM platforms, LMS, finance systems, advancement systems, housing systems, and other enterprise applications. * Transform raw operational data into clean, standardized, and trusted data models. * Translate business rules, source system logic, and operational processes into clear data transformations. * Partner with application owners and business stakeholders to understand data definitions, system behavior, and reporting needs. * Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicate records, missing fields, and process\-driven data quality issues. Data Governance, Quality, and Documentation * Develop and maintain documentation for data models, pipelines, business definitions, lineage, and transformation logic. * Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and testing practices to increase trust in university data. * Support institutional data governance practices, including data stewardship, access control, data classification, and consistent definitions. * Promote standards for naming conventions, version control, deployment processes, and data modeling practices. * Ensure data solutions are secure, FERPA\-aware, well\-documented, and aligned with university policy. Analytics and Business Enablement * Partner with data analysts, report developers, and university leaders to create datasets that support accurate and timely reporting. * Support high\-priority institutional areas such as enrollment, advising, financial aid, student clearance, student success, finance, advancement, and academic operations. * Help reduce dependency on manual spreadsheets, one\-off reporting, and disconnected departmental data processes. * Build solutions that are practical, timely, focused, and aligned with the needs of university decision\-makers. * Assist in creating data products that help departments better understand performance, operations, trends, and opportunities. * Operational Support and Continuous Improvement * Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, scheduled jobs, integrations, and platform performance. * Respond to data issues with urgency, accuracy, and clear communication. * Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve data delivery. * Participate in platform upgrades, migrations, security reviews, and technology modernization efforts. * Stay current with emerging trends in data engineering, analytics, AI, cloud platforms, higher education technology, and data governance. ***ADDITIONAL/NON\-ESSENTIAL DUTIES*** All remaining duties are considered "nonessential" within the context of the ADA, which means that the function could be reassigned to another employee in order to allow a disabled individual to hold the position. Alternatively, the manager could try to provide a reasonable accommodation so that the disabled individual could perform the function. ***LO ing assigned tasks safely and efficiently, and supervisors are responsible for creating and maintaining a safe work environment. * Employees must report any unsafe work conditions or practices, as well as any near\-miss incidents, to their supervisor and Risk Management. * Work\-related injuries must be immediately reported to Security and Human Resources. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist - Identity and Matching Models
jobs.description: ##### **About Spokeo** Spokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships. Thousands of companies also trust Spokeo's 60 billion public records to improve customer research, help verify information, and prevent fraud. Founded in 2006, Spokeo has built a dedicated, remote\-first team with an average tenure of 6\.9 years. Comparably has recognized it as a Best Company for Compensation, Employee Happiness, Perks and Benefits, Support for Women, Work\-Life Balance, and CEO Leadership. ##### **About This Opportunity** Every Spokeo search result depends on one decision: do these records describe the same person, and how sure are we? You will build the models that make that call, on messy data from many vendors and public sources, where there is no answer key to check against. You will own a modeling problem from the first question to the production release, and you will see your work change what customers see. The Data Science team is small, so you work directly with the Director of Data Science and the product owners. If you like designing the test as much as building the model, and you want to mentor teammates as the team grows, this is the place to do it. ##### **What You'll Do:** Rough share of your time, subject to change. * 35%: Build and improve the models that match records and score how confident we are in each result. You will choose the approach, train it, test it honestly on held\-out data, and ship it. * 20%: Design the labels and the measurement. Decide what to hand\-check, build the evaluation sets, and estimate how often we are right when a full answer key does not exist. This includes using AI models to help label at scale, and checking them against human judgment. * 15%: Take models to production on AWS, with ML engineering and DevOps. That covers the retrain schedule, the model registry, and a record of where every model and its data came from. * 10%: Review each data build before it ships. Find what changed, catch regressions, and explain it in plain language to product and sales partners. * 10%: Work with the Product Owner to turn findings into stories with clear targets, and defend the priority of the next research spike. * 10%: Document your methods, review teammates' code, and take part in the DS/ML working group. Tools. What you will work with: Python, SQL, Spark, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, and MLflow. Challenges. Noisy and incomplete records, no large hand\-labeled set to lean on, and opt\-out and retention rules that every model must respect. People. The Director of Data Science, product owners, ML engineers, DevOps, and the DS/ML working group. ##### **Who You Are:** What you have done matters more than the tools you have touched. Equivalent experience counts. * Required: 6\+ years of applied data science, though what you have shipped matters more than the count. * Required: A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field is expected, and a master’s is preferred, or equivalent professional experience. * Taken a model from idea to production in a cloud setting (AWS SageMaker, Databricks, MLflow, or similar), monitored it, and measured how it performed after launch. * Worked with very large datasets (100 million rows or more) using Spark or a similar tool, with Python and SQL. * Judged whether a model is good when no clean answer key exists, for example by sampling and hand\-checking results, and said how confident you are in the number. * Told a real improvement from noise, and explained the result, its limits, and the tradeoffs in plain language to engineers and product owners alike. * Kept a model healthy as its data changed: knowing when labels and models have gone out of date and need refreshing, and writing the process down so a teammate can pick it up. * Handled personal data responsibly, following opt\-out, retention, and lineage rules without being reminded. * Experience matching or de\-duplicating records, using AI to help label data, graph methods, or turning a raw model score into a confidence a product team can act on, is a plus. ##### **Working at Spokeo** Our mission is to advance transparency, and to achieve that goal, we rally around six core values: listening with empathy, understanding the why, clarifying with data, innovating to learn, collaborating to achieve, and insisting on quality. As a remote\-first company, we can hire team members in the following US states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KY, MD, MI, MO, NJ, NV, NC, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, or WY. In addition to a highly competitive base salary, our generous benefits include: * annual bonus program * stock options * 401K matching * 100% medical/dental/vision coverage * unlimited PTO * mental health resources * paid home office equipment * fitness reimbursements * support paying for courses * and more We extend written offers to candidates who successfully complete their selection process. Offers will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, marketplace competition, job leveling, experience, and skills. Privacy Notice for Candidates: https://www.spokeo.com/recruiting\-policy Spokeo is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Spokeo fosters a business culture where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best products, and be relevant in a rapidly changing world. Recruiters or staffing agencies: Spokeo is not obligated to compensate any external recruiter or search firm who presents a candidate or their resume or profile to a Spokeo employee without 1\) a current, fully executed agreement on file, and 2\) being assigned to the open position (as a search) via our applicant tracking solution. ##### **Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process** Spokeo may use artificial intelligence\-enabled tools to support portions of the recruiting process. These tools may help our recruiting team organize, review, and summarize application materials, candidate experience, and interview information. They may also identify potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials for further human review. AI\-enabled tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human judgment. Employment decisions are made by people based on a candidate's qualifications and the role's requirements. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: engineer principal- Data Platform and Services, - ST (Seattle, WA)
jobs.description: Now Brewing – Data Platform and Services Engineering Leaders! \#tobeapartner From the beginning, Starbucks set out to be a different kind of company. One that not only celebrated coffee and the rich tradition, but that also brought a feeling of connection. We are known for developing extraordinary leaders who share this passion and are guided by their service to others. Are you passionate about driving data\-driven innovation? We're seeking a talented Principal Engineer to join our team and revolutionize our data capabilities at Starbucks! This is your chance to make a monumental impact by leading the charge in streamlining and innovating our data platform and services across the enterprise, from corporate and supply chain to our customer, partner and in\-store experience. * Become the leader of a centralized enterprise data management team, ensuring real\-time data access and unparalleled accuracy across all our channels. * Lead the foundation for enterprise data management – your work will pave the way for future innovation at Starbucks. * Champion seamless API integration across our vast digital ecosystem such as commerce, mobile and in\-store order, digital drive through, in\-store digital menu board, corporate and supply chain, fostering a truly connected enterprise experience. If you're a leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and gets energized by tackling complex challenges, we want to hear from you! As a principal engineer of the Data Platform and Services engineering team, you’ll collaborate with solution architects and engineering managers, tackle toughest technical problems in the team to lead our data initiatives and drive technical excellence. You’ll lead a group of passionate engineers in building, sustaining, and enhancing critical data platforms used by Starbucks to help drive customer, store, and partner connections and to gain business efficiencies. You’ll play a key role in architecting, designing and developing advanced data platforms, fostering composable design and architecture, and ensuring our solutions are secure, performant, resilient, scalable, flexible, and extensible. The Principal Engineer of Data Platform and Services will be responsible for: * Communicates highly complex technical ideas, architectural strategies, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Establishes strong cross\-functional, collaborative relationships with business, product, architecture, security, and technology partners to drive alignment and execution. * Provides technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, proactively removing technical barriers and resolving complex development and production issues. * Champions AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and agentic capabilities to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. * Identifies and drives opportunities to embed AI and automation into engineering workflows and platform capabilities, reducing manual effort and accelerating reliable delivery. * Establishes engineering standards and continuously improves build, test, release, and deployment processes through automation. * Conducts research and technical evaluations of emerging technologies, including AI, data, cloud, observability, and platform engineering capabilities, and provides recommendations based on business and technology needs. * Ensures application, data, and infrastructure architectures are scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable, and compliant with company standards and engineering practices. * Implements technologies in accordance with Information Security principles, with particular focus on protecting highly sensitive and regulated data. * Designs and enables highly available platforms while driving automation across operational processes to improve reliability, recovery, and engineering efficiency. * Implements deep telemetry, observability, and measurable success metrics to continuously assess platform health, performance, reliability, and customer impact. * Establishes proactive monitoring and intelligent alerting across platforms to ensure continuous availability and operational continuity of critical systems. * Leverages AI\-driven insights, automation, and observability to enable proactive issue detection, faster root\-cause analysis, and continuous platform optimization. * Drives technical modernization and simplification, reducing technical debt and improving scalability, maintainability, and long\-term platform sustainability. * Ensures solutions and engineering practices comply with company policies and applicable legal, regulatory, privacy, and security requirements, including PCI. **Basic Qualifications** ======================== * Education (minimum education level, degree or certification necessary): * 10\-15 years of professional industry experience with software development and platform manageme ailability, observability, and continuous improvement. * Strong database and data architecture knowledge, with experience across relational and NoSQL technologies such as Oracle, MongoDB, Cassandra, and Couchbase, including the associated development, operational, and performance optimization toolsets. * Deep understanding of enterprise security, RESTful API design, and cloud\-native engineering practices, with hands\-on experience designing and deploying secure, scalable workloads in cloud environments such as AWS and Azure. * Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate architectural concepts, engineering rationale, tradeoffs, and complex technical challenges to both technical and non\-technical audiences. As a Starbucks partner, you (and your family) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, and other voluntary insurance benefits. Partners have access to short\-term and long\-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation from date of hire\*, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 hours worked), eight paid holidays, and two personal days per year. Starbucks also offers eligible partners participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, a discounted company stock program (S.I.P.), Starbucks equity program (Bean Stock), incentivized emergency savings, and financial well\-being tools. Additionally, Starbucks offers 100% upfront tuition coverage for a first\-time bachelor’s degree through Arizona State University’s online program via the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, student loan management resources, and access to other educational opportunities. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. Starbucks will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, and in accordance with its plans and policies. This list is subject to change depending on collective bargaining in locations where partners have a certified bargaining representative. For additional information regarding partner perks and more detailed information about benefits, go to **starbucksbenefits.com**. * If you are working in CA, CO, IL, LA, ME, MA, NE, ND or RI, you will accrue vacation up to a maximum of 120 hours (190 in CA) for roles below director and 200 hours (316 in CA) for roles at director or above. For roles in other states, you will be granted vacation time starting at 120 hours annually for roles below director and 200 hours annually for roles director and above. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job\-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, and internal equity. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Acoustics
jobs.description: Join Starkey as a software engineer and help turn advances in hearing science, acoustics, and signal processing into innovative features that improve people’s lives. Collaborate with talented, cross\-functional teams, grow your expertise in a modern C\#/.NET environment, and make every detail count as we help the world hear and live better. Starkey is a world leader in the manufacturing and distribution of advanced hearing technologies. We are in the business of connecting people and changing lives. Our teams come to work each day focused on ensuring people everywhere have the products and services they need to hear better and live better. Founded in 1967 by Bill Austin, Starkey is known for our cutting\-edge hearing health innovations, industry\-leading research and development, and not being afraid to push the edge of what’s possible. We are headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, have over 5,000 employees in 29 facilities across the globe, and do business in more than 100 markets worldwide. Watch this video to see more of what sets Starkey apart: https://youtu.be/9cUYwTlCepg?si\=wkovx8\_R\_iINfrc6 (https://youtu.be/9cUYwTlCepg?si\=wkovx8\_R\_iINfrc6\) Starkey is looking for a software engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, hearing science, acoustics, and signal processing. In this unique position, you will join our software engineering team and collaborate heavily with other various teams to bring innovative new hearing aid features to market. This is an opportunity to join a team that does meaningful work surrounded by other bright and talented engineers. The ideal candidate for this position is someone who takes pride in learning how complex systems work, has an interest in translating the physical world to the digital one, and pays attention to minute details that others do not notice. In the world of hearing aids, every millimeter, decibel, and bit matters: come join a team that brings that spirit with them to work every day as we help the world to hear better and live better! *You Will Be* * Working in a modern C\#/.NET codebase that is leveraged by all of Starkey’s customer\-facing and internal software applications to program hearing aids * Working with R\&D cross\-functional teams to build and maintain the subsystem of our fitting software that is focused on modelling the acoustics of our hearing aids as well as the impact of new signal processing algorithms on acoustic performance * Collaborating with clinical and customer\-facing teams to debug and root cause issues that audiologists face in the field * Learning to balance tradeoffs and technical constraints that impact acoustic performance, usability, and maintainability for patients and clinicians * Analyzing and presenting data to decision\-making stakeholders * Receiving mentorship from seasoned software engineers and engineers in other disciplines as you learn the hearing aid domain from every angle *Our Culture Provides* * An experienced and knowledgeable team with a culture of professional growth and knowledge sharing * Fun\-loving work environment * An excellent work/life balance * Hybrid work environment * Excellent starting salary, competitive benefits package, and company paid continuing education *You Will Need* * Experience and interest in both software development and acoustics with a bachelor’s degree in at least one of these areas: computer science, electrical engineering, hearing science, audiology (or adjacent domain) * Understanding of object\-oriented software design * A learner’s mindset with a willingness to ask questions and soak up knowledge * Ability to thrive in a team environment * Passion for science, data\-driven decision making, and experimentation *Salary and Other Compensation:* *The target pay rate for this position is between $94,000 \- $131,000 annually. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include: geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.* *This position is eligible for a bonus based upon performance results. There is no guarantee of payout.* *The following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, include medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, company\-paid life and short\-term disability insurance, long\-term disability insurance, employee assistance plan, hearing aid benefits, Paid Time Off, paid holidays, paid floating holidays, paid volunteer service day, paid paternity and maternity leave and tuition reimbursement.* \#LI\-MP1 Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

preventive care covered at 100% in\-network) * Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions * 401(k) with company match (100% match up to 3% \+ 50% match up to 6%) * Company\-paid life insurance and AD\&D coverage * Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage options * Supplemental benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage * Wellness programs, including incentives up to $300 annually and a no\-cost weight management program * Virtual healthcare options, including $0 virtual visits in many cases * Additional voluntary benefits including legal services and pet insurance * Competitive PTO plan for exempt and non\-exempt employees *Stellar Energy Americas Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. This is a senior, hands\-on individual contributor role. You will take on the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure software while balancing the need to maintain and scale existing systems with the need to deliver new capabilities for patients, clinicians, and partners. Your impact will extend well beyond the systems you build yourself. You will help teams make sound architectural decisions, establish reusable patterns and standards, address systemic technical risk, and mentor engineers across multiple teams, raising the bar on design, implementation quality, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering. **The Day to Day** * Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for one or more critical domains within Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's products and healthcare operations. * Partner with Product, Clinical, Data, Security, and Operations leaders to make sure we solve the right problems in the right order, with clear outcomes and measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: At Sure Steel, Inc., we are more than just a construction company. We are builders of success, integrity, and innovation.
