The work focuses on high\-volume, company\-specific tasks such as forecasting, scheduling, document reading and classification, data extraction, and help desk support. These models will lower AI operating costs, keep sensitive data on infrastructure we control, and reduce dependence on any single AI provider. This role works closely with the Wayne development team and provides technical leadership in machine learning, but does not include formal supervisory responsibilities. * Identify, scope, and prioritize machine learning use cases with the Senior AI Strategist, starting small and proving value before scaling. * Select, evaluate, and fine\-tune open\-weight language and vision models on Sure Steel documents, drawings, and operational data. * Build and maintain training datasets, including data collection, cleaning, labeling, and versioning, in partnership with the data owners in each department. * Develop models for forecasting, scheduling, document classification, data extraction, and drawing interpretation. * Deploy models into production on cloud or company\-controlled infrastructure, and integrate them with Wayne and other internal systems through APIs. * Design routing so high\-volume, repetitive work runs on cost\-efficient in\-house models. * Track and report model accuracy, cost per task, and savings against frontier model usage, so each use case shows it pays for itself. * Monitor model performance in production, retrain as data and processes change, and maintain clear documentation for every model. * Protect sensitive data, including HR, payroll, and time tracking information, through secure handling, access controls, and alignment with company cybersecurity standards. * Manage cloud compute for training and inference, keeping spend efficient and predictable. * Stay current on open\-weight models, tooling, and research, and recommend new approaches as the field moves. * Share knowledge with the Wayne development team and help build the company's internal machine learning capability. * Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating machine learning models, including large language models. * Strong proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar). * Experience with fine\-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, or other parameter\-efficient methods. * Experience preparing datasets: collection, cleaning, labeling, and evaluation set design. * Experience deploying models to production, jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Forward Deployed Engineer · Palo Alto · full\-time Build with enterprise customers, own the path to production, and turn repeated lessons into a better product. **About Sycamore** ------------------ Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need. We are a small, engineering\-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders. **The role** ------------ The simplest way to describe this role: you are the engineer in the customer room and the product engineer who ships what the room needs. You will map how an important workflow works today, find where an agent can create a measurable outcome, and build the application end to end, from the user experience and data model through agent tools, integrations, permissions, approval points, and the operational controls needed to run safely. You own the full loop: discovery, implementation, realistic testing, deployment, production debugging, adoption, and iteration. Customer\-specific product work belongs with you, and when the same runtime, connector, memory, or deployment need appears repeatedly, you work with Core AI or Infrastructure to turn it into a reusable capability rather than maintaining parallel custom implementations. **What you will do** -------------------- * Turn ambiguous enterprise problems into clear technical designs, working software, and measurable outcomes. * Build product surfaces for agent conversations, tasks, progress, approvals, artifacts, and operational workflows. * Design APIs and relational data models that accurately represent the customer’s domain and remain understandable as the product evolves. * Build agent instructions, tool interfaces, connector interactions, and durable workflow steps with explicit permission and failure behavior. * Navigate enterprise requirements around authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, data handling, deployment, observability, and change management. * Test realistic user journeys rather than stopping at isolated units or happy\-path demos. * Travel to customer sites when working alongside users will accelerate discovery, delivery, or adoption. **The environment you will work in** ------------------------------------ Our current product environment includes TypeScript, React, TanStack, Tailwind, Python, FastAPI, typed data models, PostgreSQL, durable workflows, MCP\-based tools and connectors, browser automation, and cloud\-native deployment on Kubernetes. We use automated tests, coding agents, traces, evaluations, and production feedback as part of everyday engineering. This is context, not a checklist. We do not require previous experience with every language, framework, or vendor in our stack. Strong engineers who understand systems, learn quickly, and have shipped production software can become effective here without matching our tools one for one. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * 5\-12 years of software engineering experience. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction. * Strong software fundamentals across product design, APIs, data modeling, distributed systems, testing, and production debugging. * Evidence that you personally shipped and operated meaningful software, rather than stopping at prototypes or delegating the production work. * Product judgment. You can find the real problem behind a request, choose a useful first version, and decide what should remain customer\-specific versus become reusable. * Comfort moving across user interfaces, backend services, data, agent behavior, integrations, and deployment when the outcome requires it. * A security\-minded approach to enterprise data, permissions, credentials, approvals, and auditability. * AI\-native. You use coding agents and modern models as a force multiplier while still owning the architecture, understanding the code, and explaining important decisions. * Clear communication and high EQ. You can work with a customer’s CTO, operators, security team, and engineers without losing technical depth. * Comfort with startup ambiguity, fast feedback loops, broad ownership, and regular customer travel. Former founders, early product engineers, and forward\-deployed engineers often do well here when they have retained real code and production ownership. That background is a signal, not a requirement. **What this role is not** ------------------------- * It is not a pre\-sales role that stops at a demo or architecture diagram. * It is not a solutions role that hands requirements to another engineering team. * It is not custom development without product judgment; repeated needs should improve the platform. **Interview process** --------------------- * Application review and a 30\-minute video screen with an engineer. * One two\-hour technical block: Coding for the first hour, then System Design for the second, with a different engineer for each hour. * A role\-specific work trial, scoped to 6–8 hours in one agreed day with host check\-ins, followed by a 60\-minute presentation. * Reference checks, a final interview, and offer. Video and technical interviews are remote. Your host will confirm whether your presentation is onsite in Palo Alto or remote before scheduling. **Why join** ------------ * Work on AI systems that move from enterprise problems to production outcomes quickly. * Own the complete path from workflow discovery through adoption. * Shape both individual deployments and the product used across customers. * Join early enough to define how the engineering team operates and grows. * Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build. * **Hard problems, real impact** Trust architectures, memory systems, multi\-agent coordination. The foundational layer that makes agentic apps work in production. * **Small team, high ownership** Every engineer shapes the product and the culture. No layers of process between you and the work that matters. * **Backed by the best** $65M from Coatue, Lightspeed, Abstract Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, 8VC, and notable industry angels. * **Grow with us** Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a genuine focus on your growth as the company scales.

jobs.title: RF / EMC (Desense) Design Engineer
jobs.description: Engagement type: Agency contractor (yellow badge) \| Team: Device Connectivity – Wireless Design \| Are you ready to be part of a leading global engineering design house specializing in the design and development of state\-of\-the\-art embedded hardware, electronics, and electro\-mechanics? What we’re looking for: * Highly motivated professionals * Motivated RF / EMC (Desense) Design Engineer * Professionals with ability to work both with in\-house projects and on\-site assignments at our customers’ locations About the team The role As an RF/EMC Engineer, you will characterize, root\-cause, and resolve radio desense and electromagnetic interference (EMI/EMC) problems on consumer electronic products. You will connect concepts across EMC design, desense, antenna, wireless communication, and computational electromagnetics to solve complex, novel problems, working closely with antenna, RF, and SI/PI engineers to meet connectivity performance targets on program schedules. You must be responsive, flexible, detail\-oriented, and comfortable spending significant time on the bench, able to succeed within an open, collaborative peer environment. Key responsibilities * Characterize, root\-cause, and resolve desense, EMI, and EMC issues across product programs (Wi\-Fi, BT/BLE, LTE/5G, GNSS, and other radios). * Perform hands\-on bench and lab work: prototype bring\-up, instrumentation setup, near\-field/conducted/radiated measurement, and debug. * Apply EM concepts to solve desense, EMI, RF, antenna, and SI/PI problems in collaboration with antenna and RF engineers. * Perform noise\-source identification, coupling\-path analysis, PSD measurement, and mitigation design (shielding, filtering, grounding, layout). * Use EM simulation and modeling to predict and resolve interference before and during builds. * Support DFM and high\-volume manufacturing by ensuring desense/EMI robustness carries into production. * Support sustaining and field\-issue investigations related to desense and EMI. * Help achieve regulatory and performance goals for radio and EMC compliance. This position may require domestic and international travel. Basic qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (or related field) with 3–5\+ years of relevant experience, OR a Master's/PhD with 2\+ years. * Proven track record of solving desense, EMI, and/or EMC problems on consumer electronic products. * Strong hands\-on bench skills — comfortable owning lab measurement, instrumentation, and debug as a primary day\-to\-day focus. * Strong understanding of EM concepts that help solve desense, EMI, RF, antenna, and SI/PI issues. * Expert with EM simulation tools such as CST, HFSS, and ADS. * Fluency in at least one programming/scripting language (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+) for problem solving and data analysis. * Demonstrated ability to work well within cross\-functional teams (PD, Rel, SI/PI, EE). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred qualifications * PhD in Engineering, Technology, Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience applying optimization or ML techniques (LP/MIP, statistics, machine learning, combinatorial optimization) to EM/wireless design. * Experience with data mining on large datasets. * Experience designing antennas. * Exposure to wireless communication technologies such as LTE/5G, GPS/GNSS, and mmWave. What you’ll love about us * Company Culture – outstanding people and a flexible work environment. * Career Growth Opportunities – being a design house keeps variety in your work. New opportunities happening all the time! * Global Design House – since Syntronic is a global Design House, you will probably work with in a team with engineers from other Syntronic sites (Canada, Sweden, China, Malaysia, Japan). Who we are Syntronic provides our customers a complete portfolio of professional services to support their product development including research \& development, new product introduction, manufacturing and aftermarket services. We adopt the latest technologies in electronics design and software development with a pool of technically skilled staff around the world. Among our customers and partners are some of the world’s most technically\-intensive businesses and organizations. This pushes us forward in designing to satisfy our customers’ needs with a focus on quality, competence, capacity and continuity. Syntronic has today over 2000 employees in 8 countries. Syntronic values diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any time during the recruitment and/or assessment process, please contact our recruiting team and we will make all reasonable efforts to accommodate your request. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: Remote Full Time Experienced Backend Software Engineer * Location: UK, remote with occasional travel In the words of one of our senior clients recently… “Market Research has changed more in the past 3 years, than in the previous 40” About System1\. System1 is The Creative Effectiveness Platform. Our target customers are the world’s largest advertisers. We predict and improve marketing effectiveness. Our advertising and idea tests measure emotion to give our customers the most accurate predictions of the business impact of creativity. About The Role We are looking for a talented and ambitious Backend Software Engineer to join the empowered product team building System1’s next\-generation AI platform. You will help shape how the world’s largest brands predict and improve the effectiveness of their advertising, building the Python services, APIs and integrations that power the platform. You will work as a first\-class member of the product team alongside your Product Manager, Product Designer and Team Lead to discover and deliver outcomes that matter to our customers and our business. This is a rare opportunity to help build a new platform from the ground up, engineer in a genuinely AI\-native way, and work at the speed our market demands. * Are you energised by being a true partner in the product team, helping decide what to build, not just how to build it? * Do you already engineer through Claude Code every day, with your own skills and subagents, and the discipline to own every line you ship? * Are you motivated by outcomes over outputs, and by getting production systems working at scale rather than shipping features for their own sake? Do you want to join us to excite and change the industry? What will you be doing? * Partner as a member of an empowered product team (Product Manager, Product Designer, Team Lead and engineers), sharing accountability for the outcomes your team commits to. * Contribute to continuous product discovery, helping the team assess feasibility early and building quick technical prototypes to test ideas before we commit to building. * Design, build and own Python backend services for our AI platform, from media upload through asynchronous ML processing to insight delivery. * Work API\-first and spec\-driven, defining clean REST contracts that serve headless frontends, internal teams and customer integrations. * Build MCP servers that make System1’s data and capabilities available to AI agents and tools, for customers and colleagues alike. * Engineer through Claude Code day to day, building and sharing skills, subagents and workflows that raise the speed and quality of the whole team. * Take code into production at scale with confidence, bringing the testing, observability and reliability our enterprise customers expect. * Contribute to our infrastructure as code and cloud environment, understanding how your services are deployed, run and scaled. * Work alongside our data scientists to bring models into production, learning the machine learning side of the platform as you go. * Build with enterprise security and compliance in mind, so the world’s largest advertisers can trust the platform with their data. You need to be this kind of person: * A missionary, not a mercenary. You care deeply about the customer problem and the outcome, not just the code. * Outcome\-driven. You measure your success by the change you create for customers and the business, not by tickets closed. * An engineer first, with AI as a force multiplier. You use AI tools to move faster with rigour, not to skip the thinking. * Comfortable with ambiguity and ownership. You don’t wait for a perfectly specified ticket, you frame the problem with your team and go. * A clear communicator, able to explain technical trade\-offs to product, design, data science and commercial colleagues as well as to fellow engineers. * Curious and a lifelong learner, with the integrity to back your point of view with evidence in front of colleagues, customers and stakeholders. * Able to see the bigger picture without losing attention to detail, your code quality is as strong as your product thinking. * A natural collaborator, comfortable working with all departments at all seniorities, and equally able to drive work forward independently. * Passionate about (good!) advertising, how it works and how it can be improved or excited to become so. You need to have the following experience: To be successful in this role, you will have approximately 3–5 years of real\-world software engineering experience and be ready to operate as a first\-class member of an empowered product team, where you’ll have outsized influence on the outcomes we deliver. * Strong commercial experience building backend services in Python. * Experience designing and building REST APIs, ideally spec\-driven, with a clear understanding of what frontends need from a headless architecture. * Experience building SaaS software and taking code into production at scale, whether as part of a team or with personal responsibility for it. * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP). * A working understanding of infrastructure as code and the ability to contribute to it. * Solid experience working with databases and data modelling. * Daily use of Claude Code as an engineering tool, including building your own skills and subagents, with an engineering\-led approach rather than vibe coding. * Experience building MCP servers, or a strong understanding of MCP and a drive to build with it. * Experience working in a product operating model, as part of an empowered, cross\-functional product team. * Familiarity with the security and compliance requirements of enterprise customers. * Familiarity with machine learning systems, or a genuine desire to learn, is a plus. This role will require you to operate across multiple discovery and delivery threads in parallel, balancing speed with the rigour and reliability our customers expect. Benefits We offer a competitive salary and bonus scheme, including health insurance, and pension. Our people are important to us, and we understand that each person has a life outside of work and we therefore offer flexible, remote working within the UK, with occasional travel to get together for company and team meet\-ups. We also offer several wellbeing resources such as “de\-clutter” afternoons for your personal and professional needs. We encourage learning and offer education reimbursement opportunities. We have recognition schemes, and regular socials, including summer and winter parties! We welcome applicants from all diverse communities and encourage our candidates to ask us about reasonable adjustments that we may be able to make to support through our recruitment process and while in post.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Imagine: A Career with Purpose and Possibility Picture this: You are part of a global team of problem\-solvers whose innovations in materials science can make life better. Every day, you help turn ideas into impact using science, technology, and creativity to tackle real\-world challenges. You are part of a company whose work helps improve patient outcomes in healthcare and protects essential consumer goods that people around the world rely on every day. At TekniPlex, you’ll join more than 8,000 colleagues across 12 countries, all united by one purpose: creating safer, smarter solutions that touch daily life. Because at TekniPlex, you don’t just deliver products – you help shape what’s next. JOB SUMMARY TekniPlex is hiring a Process Engineer for our Madison, WI facilities. This role applies engineering principles, team facilitation skills, and statistical process control tools to measure and improve key processes integral to the manufacturing of printed and unprinted laminated packaging materials for the pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Manages key process controls and develops relevant metrics to ensure process variables are quantified and remain within control. Manages small capital projects and cross\-functional improvement teams to improve manufacturing costs and efficiencies while reducing process variability. Prepares proposals \& reports and executes planned projects, including, determining time frames, funding, procedures for accomplishing projects, staffing requirements, and allotment of available resources to various phases of projects. * Work directly with machine operators to identify needs and develop solutions; work with Maintenance on equipment modifications and preventative /predictive maintenance to ensure reliability. * Identify, propose and execute projects to improve customer satisfaction, through performance and product reliability. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and legibly complete timecards and work orders. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures and read blueprints and technical drawings, such as machine, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electrical. Ability to effectively present information in one\-on\-one and small groups situations to other employees of the organization. Ability to effective present information and respond to questions form groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. MATHEMATICAL SKILLS Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra, geometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. REASONING ABILITY Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variable in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization. Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry\-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post\-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences. TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser\-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR. jobs.description: Washington D.C. Regular R\&D \- Security Job ID: A215299B to this job Responsibilities About the Team The Validation organization independently tests whether our security and privacy controls work and meet our extreamly high security and compliance standards. Security \& Privacy (S\&P) sets the standards and builds the solutions. Validation checks that they hold up against real attackers, at scale, and keep working over time. Validation owns the whole cycle from finding issues to fixing them: discovering weaknesses through red teaming, penetration testing and attack simulation across our social, games, education, productivity, and generative AI applications and models; deciding which ones matter based on how they could actually be exploited; driving fixes to completion across the company; confirming that fixes hold; and measuring how well our controls work overall. This covers product security, cyber defense, data protection, identity and access management (IAM), incident response, cloud and corporate infrastructure, privacy, and generative AI and content. About the Role The Head of Validation leads the following teams: Vulnerability Management, Validation Engineeringm Cyber \& Privacy Validation (Penetration Testing and Red Team) and Generative AI \& Content Assurance Validation. Balance broad, whole\-company red team exercises with focused tests of single systems or targets, based on risk, threat intelligence, and business priorities. \- Run Vulnerability Management at scale. Prioritize based on how issues could actually be exploited, hold owners accountable for fixes, and push for fixes that remove whole classes of attack rather than single issues. Use automation to recommend fixes and close gaps faster. \- Make sure fixes hold. Control owners design, run, monitor, and fix their controls; Validation tests them. escalation procedures, and automated tool\-calling capabilities. * Implement conversation management features, including interruption handling, contextual awareness, fallback logic, and transfers to live representatives. * Develop and integrate applications using OpenAI Live/Realtime APIs and other real\-time AI technologies. * Manage streaming audio, transcription, session processing, and system company databases, customer systems, payment platforms, messaging systems, and other business applications. * Develop secure AI\-enabled functions for account lookup, customer verification, payment\-related interactions, scheduling, and transfers to live representatives. * Implement safeguards to ensure AI interactions comply with company policies, security requirements, and applicable legal and regulatory standards. * Maintain accurate and auditable records of AI conversations, system activities, decisions, and automated transactions. * Develop and perform automated testing, conversation evaluations, and quality assurance processes to improve AI accuracy, reliability, and performance. * Monitor system performance, including call outcomes, response times, errors, escalation rates, and other operational metrics. * Design and maintain scalable, highly available systems with appropriate controls for system capacity, error handling, and service interruptions. * Lead technical development from initial concept through production implementation while maintaining system security, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Serve as a senior technical resource for conversational AI technologies and provide guidance to other engineers. * Perform all other duties as assigned. **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Strong software engineering skills with experience developing and supporting production applications. * Advanced knowledge of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and real\-time application architectures. * Strong understanding of large language models, generative AI, conversational AI, and prompt engineering. * Advanced troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and systems analysis skills. * Ability to design secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. * Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer jobs.title: Sr AI Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence! **Overview** ------------ Researches, designs, plans, develops and/or evaluates new, advanced network technologies by translating customer requirements or strategic business objectives into final product design. Work typically includes in\-depth assessment of the customer’s networked application needs, providing network modeling and simulation testing, consulting to further clarify needs, and engineering high\-speed technology network transports to deliver application functionality.**Responsibilities** -------------------- **Why this role exists** ======================== TNS is moving from AI governance and foundations into execution. The platform building blocks are in place or underway — Microsoft 365, Copilot, Entra ID, SharePoint, and Anthropic's Claude models via AWS Bedrock. What we don't yet have is a dedicated person who can both **build and operate the secure, production\-grade AI platform that lets AI work safely against our data** *and* **embed with our lines of business to turn that capability into measurable value.** This role does both. You'll be the technical engine and the on\-the\-ground partner who makes AI a productive, trusted tool across the enterprise — and who multiplies that impact by enabling others to build, not just building yourself. **What you'll do** ================== Your time will span two connected halves. **Build and operate the AI platform** ------------------------------------- **Model platform and private hosting.** Own our Claude deployment on AWS Bedrock end to end — model access and versioning, region and data\-residency decisions, provisioned throughput vs. on\-demand, and the private, VPC\-isolated hosting posture that keeps our data inside our boundary and out of third\-party training. Evaluate and manage additional models where they fit, and maintain a routing layer so applications aren't hard\-wired to a single model or provider. **Harness and orchestration management.** Build and maintain the application harness that sits between our users and the models: prompt and context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, guardrails and content filtering, caching, and fallback behavior. Own the evaluation harness too — regression suites, quality benchmarks, and the release process that lets us upgrade models without breaking what's in production. **Data connectivity.** Design and build secure, governed connections between AI systems and TNS data — Microsoft 365 and Graph, SharePoint, databases, data warehouses, APIs, and line\-of\-business systems. Own the retrieval architecture, indexing and freshness strategy, and the permission\-trimming that ensures every user sees only what they're entitled to see, with no leakage across boundaries. **Security and access control.** Architect least\-privilege access across identity, network, and data layers — IAM and Entra ID, private networking, encryption and key management, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. Defend against AI\-specific threats: prompt injection, data exfiltration through model outputs, insecure tool use, and over\-permissioned agents. Partner with security and governance so every deployment is auditable and compliant by design, with a full audit trail of prompts, outputs, and data access. **Monitoring and observability.** Instrument the platform for production operations — latency, error rates, throughput and quota headroom, output quality and drift, guardrail trips, and anomalous usage. Build the dashboards and alerting that let us find problems before users do, and the usage telemetry that tells us which solutions are actually delivering value. **Cost management.** Own AI spend as a first\-class engineering concern: token\-level cost attribution by application and line of business, budgets and alerting, model right\-sizing (using the cheapest model that meets the quality bar), prompt caching and context optimization, batch processing where latency allows, and provisioned\-throughput decisions. Produce the chargeback and unit\-economics reporting leadership needs to fund the portfolio with confidence. **Reusable foundations.** Turn all of the above into patterns, templates, and guardrails so each new use case is faster, cheaper, and safer to build than the last. **Ship value with the business (forward\-deployed engineering)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Embed directly with teams across our lines of business (Communications, Waypoint, Payments, Corporate/Shared) to identify high\-value AI and automation opportunities. * Prototype quickly, validate with real users, and take the strongest ideas to production. * Drive adoption — measure whether solutions are actually used and delivering value, and iterate until they are. * Enable others: seed and support a networ urable value — reduced cost to serve, shorter cycle times, and volume absorbed without added headcount. * Establish a use\-case intake and prioritization process so demand is triaged by value rather than by who asks loudest. * Deliver AI cost transparency and attribution by application and line of business. * Enable at least one capable AI champion in each line of business. **What you bring (required)** ============================= * Strong software / solutions engineering background with hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI/LLM applications — RAG, agents, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation. * Direct experience with a managed model platform in production; **AWS Bedrock strongly preferred**, along with the surrounding AWS estate (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudWatch, PrivateLink). * Demonstrated ability to build and operate data connectivity to enterprise systems with permission\-aware retrieval. * Working command of enterprise security and data governance: identity and access, data protection, encryption and key management, and AI\-specific threat models. * Production operations instincts — you instrument what you build, and you've owned the monitoring and on\-call reality of a live system. * Cost discipline: you treat inference spend as an engineering constraint and can show where the money goes. * Genuine business fluency and communication skills — you're comfortable sitting with finance, operations, or sales, understanding their problems, and translating them into solutions. * A demonstrated bias toward shipping and adoption, not just building demos. **Nice to have** ================ * Depth in the Microsoft / Azure ecosystem alongside AWS (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Entra ID, SharePoint / Graph) — our environment spans both. * Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive industry — payments, telecom, or financial data. * Self\-hosted or fine\-tuned model experience, and a clear view of when it beats a managed API. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD for AI systems (Terraform, pipelines, automated evals in the release path). * Change\-management or internal\-consulting experience. * Prior forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Who you are** =============== The rare blend of builder and partner. You carry the technical depth of a staff engineer and the people instincts of an internal consultant. You're energized by variety — a private\-networking and key\-management problem in the morning, a finance\-team workflow in the afternoon. You measure yourself by value delivered and adopted, not lines of code. You teach and multiply rather than hoard knowledge. And you operate with ownership: when a deployment is struggling or a cost\-line spikes, you own the fix. **How your success is measured** ================================ In short: reduced cost to serve on named processes, use cases shipped and *sustained* in production, adoption across lines of business, champions enabled, platform reliability and cost\-per\-unit\-of\-value, and a clean security and governance record. For this role, we anticipate paying $150,000 \- $250,000 annually. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package including medical and dental coverage, life insurance, paid holidays and vacations, and a 401K plan with company match. If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about! TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

and cross\-functional teams **Machine Learning \& Data Science** * Strong understanding of predictive modeling and machine learning techniques * Experience selecting, developing, evaluating, and improving ML models * Understanding of statistics, experimentation, and model evaluation * Experience working with large, complex datasets * Experience developing ML workflows from experimentation through production **Software Engineering** * Strong, hands\-on Python development experience, including writing production\-quality, maintainable, and well\-tested code * Experience developing and maintaining distributed data pipelines * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience with CI/CD, Python packaging, and software deployment * Proficiency with Git and modern version\-control practices * Strong familiarity with Linux and command\-line tools * Ability to write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-tested code * Experience using AI coding agents and you. **Why Join Trilliant Health?** You’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, data, software engineering, and machine learning, building technology that helps healthcare organizations make better decisions. You’ll also have a meaningful opportunity to influence technical direction, work on challenging data problems, and collaborate with a highly talented team that values curiosity, ownership, deep listening, and effective communication. **Benefits** * Comprehensive health benefits package * 401(k) plan * Flexible PTO * Equity **Please Note** Trilliant Health is **unable** to provide visa sponsorship for this position. **How to Apply:** If this opportunity sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you! **Please submit your application directly through Indeed to be considered for this position.** Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: Job Description Software Engineer \- AI Content Systems TrueLearn \| Fully Remote About TrueLearn At TrueLearn, we help medical professionals provide the best possible care for their patients. Our learning science–driven platform supports clinicians at every stage of their careers, from board preparation through continuing education. The work we do touches the people who touch patients — which means every line of code, every model, and every experiment we ship has the potential to ripple outward into better care, better outcomes, and better lives. You’ll own meaningful pieces of that system and its integration into the learning platform. The Role Early, foundational work on a consolidating platform. We are building a deeply intelligent, human\-supervised, adaptive learning platform that responds to each learner’s unique needs in real time, empowering them to master their domain. Achieving this visionary goal requires a foundation built on technical excellence and thoughtful engineering, beginning with these essential building blocks: * AI\-forward, full\-stack development. You’ll be crafting the robust full\-stack architecture that supports high\-velocity AI integration, translating complex learning science into reliable, scalable software. * Editorial workflows as the foundation of intelligence. Our content models aren’t just storage—they are the training ground for our AI. You will design intuitive, structured workflows that allow subject matter experts to collaborate seamlessly with AI, ensuring our system remains both human\-supervised and machine\-ready. * A culture of rapid experimentation. We believe the best path to an adaptive learning future is paved with brave experimentation. You will be encouraged to test new approaches, use AI agents to accelerate velocity, and view failures as essential data points in our journey to build something truly transformative. You’ll own features from design through production and make technical calls within your area. You’ll work alongside senior engineers who will push on your thinking as much as you push on theirs, and on a team where asking questions is a sign of engagement, not a gap. How we work. We build with AI coding agents as partners. Our repo has maintained agent context, a doc\-gardening skill that keeps it current, MCP tooling, and instrumentation to measure whether any of it is actually helping. We expect you to use agents to the fullest in your own work and to bring what you learn back to the team. When you find a bottleneck in how we work, we'd rather you tell us and help fix it than work around it quietly. What You'll Do * Build AI powered features within our established content management framework using TypeScript, React, and Next.js * Design how LLM output is structured, validated, and traced back to its source, so AI\-generated content is something experts can trust and audit * Implement multi\-step editorial workflows that streamline collaboration among a wide and diverse group of experts and alongside AI agents; versions, assignments, revisions, audit trails, etc * Design and implement role\-based permissions across collections, so the right experts can do the right things without a support ticket * Implement and extend WYSIWYG editing capabilities to support manual and automated edits, lineage, and history * Write and review db migrations, and reason about how schema changes land in a system people are actively using * Build and maintain integrations with TrueLearn products, platforms, and AI services. * Work directly with cross\-functional team members. See first\-hand the impact of your work * Investigate ambiguous problems and communicate what you find. The most impactful work starts with curiosity * Notice what's slowing the team down and do something about it. Flaky test, undocumented setup step, a review cycle that keeps stalling. The fix is welcome even when nobody asks * Write tests, review PRs, and prepare design proposals. Ask the naive question that turns out to be the right one What We're Looking For * 4\+ years of professional experience building and shipping web applications, with production experience in TypeScript and React. You've worked on software real users depended on, and you can walk us through what you built and why. (Own the Outcome.) * Engineering discipline that doesn't loosen when the work speeds up. AI to  * A steep growth curve and the drive behind it. We care more about trajectory than credentials. Tell us about something you taught yourself because the work demanded it, a problem you stayed with longer than was comfortable, or a skill you have now that you didn't a year ago. We're hiring for who you'll be in two years as much as who you are today. (Always Learning.) * A real interest in the users and the mission. The best engineers here get curious about how they work, care about the experience, and notice friction others have accepted as normal. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Who is USP?** The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide. At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health. USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment. **Brief Job Overview** The Associate Software Engineer – is responsible for supporting and enhancing the Marketo platform through technical configuration, integration management, campaign automation, and data governance. This role partners with IT, Marketing Operations, and Sales Operations to ensure scalable, reliable, and compliant marketing automation processes. The engineer owns day‑to‑day platform operations while contributing to system improvements and cross‑system alignment. **How will YOU create impact here at USP?** As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards. Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments. **The Associate Software Engineer** **has the following responsibilities:** * Support user account creation, access permissions, and role governance across marketing automation and CRM platforms to maintain secure, compliant operations. * Translate stakeholder requirements into technical configurations, reusable templates, and scalable operational solutions within a marketing automation platform (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar). * Help maintain platform architecture — folder structures, naming conventions, tokens, and operational program frameworks. * Build and maintain field mappings and synchronization logic between the marketing platform and CRM (e.g., Salesforce), supporting schema alignment and data quality. * Clone, configure, and test forms, landing pages, and web assets in Sandbox and Production environments using HTML/CSS fundamentals. * Troubleshoot sync issues between systems, including field conflicts, validation errors, and API\-related failures — with support from senior engineers as needed. * Assist with datatype changes, schema updates, and cross\-system compatibility checks to keep integrations stable. * Support Sandbox refresh activities: configuration audits, asset restoration, and sync re\-establishment. * Help build and maintain trigger\-based campaigns, automated workflows, and nurture programs, learning platform\-specific logic on the job. * Assist with segmentation setup, audience management, and basic data governance practices. * Monitor system health and campaign performance dashboards, flagging issues to senior team members. * Support data quality and compliance standards across marketing and CRM systems. **Who is USP Looking For?** The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * 1–2 years of experience in a technical, engineering, or systems support role. * Working knowledge of HTML and CSS; exposure to basic JavaScript is a plus. * Understanding of how APIs and webhooks work, or strong aptitude to learn integration concepts quickly. * Interest in or exposure to CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and/or marketing automation platforms — prior hands\-on Marketo experience is **not required** . * Comfort working with structured data: field mapping, data types, and schema logic. * Strong problem\-solving instincts and willingness to troubleshoot systematically. * Clear communicator, able to explain technical issues to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Additional Desired Preferences** * Any exposure to Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar marketing automation tools. * Familiarity with CRM objects (Leads/Contacts/Accounts/Opportunities). * Coursework or personal projects involving REST APIs or third\-party integrations (e.g., ad platforms like Google, Meta, or LinkedIn). * Certifications are a plus but not expected at this level (e.g., Marketo Certified Associate/Expert, Salesforce Admin). **Supervisory Responsibilities** None, this is an individual contributor role. **Benefits** USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected. **Compensation** Base Salary Range: **USD $71,420\.00 – $93,726\.00 annually** . Target Annual Bonus: % Varies based on level of role. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job\-related reasons. Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor. **Job Category** Information Technology **Job Type** Full\-Time

jobs.title: Application Developer - Quality Engineering (SDET)
jobs.description: Application Developer \- Quality Engineering (SDET) Location: UCHealth UCHlth Admin 2450 Peoria, Department: UCHlth Application Web Develop Work Schedule: Full Time, 80\.00 hours per pay period (2 weeks) Shift: Days Pay: $39\.64 \- $72\.84 / hour. Pay is dependent on applicant's relevant experience Build the quality engineering capability behind digital healthcare experiences. We are seeking a software engineer who is passionate about quality, automation, and creating systems that help teams deliver with confidence. In this role, you will design and own scalable test automation for patient\-facing web and mobile applications, APIs, Epic integrations, and other digital experiences. You will work as an embedded engineering partner, writing production\-quality test code, shaping testability, and integrating fast, reliable quality signals into Azure DevOps pipelines. This is an opportunity to establish a modern quality engineering practice, influence how software is designed and released, and see your work improve the reliability of digital experiences used in healthcare. You will have the opportunity to build more than individual test scripts. You will shape a reusable quality engineering capability that supports multiple teams, improves release confidence, and creates more time for engineers to deliver valuable features. The role offers meaningful technical ownership, close partnership with experienced application and platform teams, and the chance to apply modern automation and AI\-assisted engineering practices to consequential healthcare technology. This is a remote position but you must reside in Colorado. Candidates will be considered for one of the following levels: Application Developer (3\+ years of relevant experience, $39\.64 \- $59\.46 / hour) or Application Developer Senior (5\+ years of relevant experience, $48\.56\- $72\.84 / hour). Responsibilities: * Design, build, and maintain reusable automated testing frameworks for responsive web applications, native and hybrid mobile experiences, REST APIs, and integrated end\-to\-end workflows. * Create stable, readable, and maintainable automated tests using modern tools such as Playwright for browser and API testing and Appium or native frameworks for iOS and Android testing. * Integrate automated tests, quality gates, results, and diagnostic artifacts into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines so teams receive actionable feedback early in the development lifecycle. * Partner with developers, analysts, product owners, architects, and IT testing resources to translate requirements and business risk into effective test strategies and prioritized automation coverage. * Build automation for critical patient and employee workflows, including authentication, session management, deep links, push notifications, device and operating\-system variations, and third\-party integrations. * Develop API and integration tests for Epic EHR, FHIR, web services, in\-house APIs, and other external systems; validate both expected behavior and resilient failure handling. * Improve application testability by contributing code, test hooks, utilities, test data strategies, mocks, service virtualization, and environment configuration in partnership with feature teams. * Investigate failed tests and software defects using logs, traces, telemetry, network data, and debugging tools; distinguish product defects from test, data, and environment issues. * Monitor and improve automation health by reducing flaky tests, optimizing execution time, strengthening diagnostics, and retiring low\-value or redundant tests. * Establish practical quality metrics and baselines, including automated coverage of high\-risk workflows, regression execution time, defect detection timing, escaped defects, and manual effort reduced. * Contribute to code reviews, coding standards, documentation, and shared engineering practices. Coach developers and testers on effective automation, test design, and quality ownership. * Use AI\-assisted development and testing tools responsibly to accelerate test design, code creation, documentation, and analysis while validating accuracy, maintainability, security, and alignment with business requirements. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Pricing
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** Upstart’s Core Pricing team drives key initiatives that directly influence our revenue streams, unit economics, and product strategy. The team builds and evolves the common systems used to translate underwriting insights into accurate risk and profitability decisions for every loan we originate, while enabling a seamless borrower experience across products. As a **Senior Software Engineer on Core Pricing**, you will design and build scalable, reliable systems that power pricing decisions across Upstart’s products. In close partnership with engineering, data science, product, and business teams, you will own meaningful technical projects, improve the architecture and reliability of our pricing services, and help translate complex modeling and business requirements into durable software capabilities. **How you’ll make an impact** * Design, build, and evolve high\-performance, real\-time pricing systems that support critical lending decisions across Upstart products. * Own complex engineering projects from technical design through delivery, balancing scalability, reliability, correctness, and speed of iteration. * Partner with data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate modeling and business requirements into reliable software solutions. * Identify and implement architectural improvements that increase the flexibility, maintainability, observability, and resilience of pricing services. * Contribute to technical standards for system design, testing, monitoring, and operational excellence within the Core Pricing team. * Support other engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing while contributing to sound technical decisions across the team. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or its equivalent, plus **4 years of software engineering experience**. * Experience writing production software in Python and working with Java, Kotlin, or another strongly typed programming language. * Experience designing, building, and operating scalable APIs, distributed systems, or microservices in a cloud environment such as AWS or GCP. * Experience owning the technical design and delivery of complex software projects from development through production. * Experience building production systems with requirements related to scalability, latency, reliability, or correctness. **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of fintech, financial systems, financial mathematics, statistics, machine learning platforms, or decisioning systems. * Experience working on business\-critical systems that affect revenue, profitability, risk, or core product outcomes. * Experience with distributed systems, cloud\-native architecture, platform engineering, continuous integration and deployment, or infrastructure as code. * Experience partnering with data science and product teams to productionize models, decisioning logic, or experimentation capabilities. * Ability to work effectively across engineering and non\-engineering teams on technically complex initiatives. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and  Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $166,900—$230,900 USD At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). Canada \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $153,000—$190,000 CAD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer, NA
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **Technology \& Systems Department** ------------------------------------ The Technology \& Systems department drives technological innovation for the company and advances the technology strategy to support global growth. This includes IT, Software Development, OT / Automation Systems, and business process improvement. At Vantage, we are very hands\-on. In most cases, we specify, purchase, configure, and maintain all networking and server hardware. We also work closely with partner VARs to learn about the latest technology changes, so we can make informed purchase decisions. The Technology \& Systems department participates in designing each of our new data center building’s networking infrastructure, including but not limited to diverse pathways connecting to carriers, meet\-me room hosting (rack, cabs, ladders, cross\-connect panels…), wireless AP coverage, etc. We rely on extreme collaboration with Sales, Construction, Operations, and Corporate Functions to drive simplification and establish global standards with continuous improvement and speed to value. We are working to build a reliable, scalable, sustainable, and secure technology roadmap/landscape that enables us to serve our customers and employees better and be the partner of choice. Our focus is on speed to value with financial and execution discipline. **Position Overview** --------------------- **This role will be based onsite in Port Washington, WI.** The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands\-on infrastructure professional responsible for supporting the deployment, implementation, operational readiness, and ongoing support of IT infrastructure at Vantage Data Centers' Lighthouse campus in Port Washington, Wisconsin. Working closely with Construction, Operations, Engineering, Security, and Technology \& Systems teams, this role helps ensure IT infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, security systems, and building management systems are procured, delivered, installed, tested, documented, and ready to support commissioning and turnover activities. This position serves as a key on\-site representative for Vantage, coordinating vendors, managing inventory, supporting RFIs, tracking project deliverables, conducting quality assurance reviews, assisting with technical deployments, and maintaining alignment between multiple stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines foundational infrastructure knowledge with strong organizational, communication, customer service, and project coordination skills. The role operates within established standards, deployment processes, and service management frameworks to support the successful delivery and long\-term operation of one of Vantage's largest North American campuses. **Essential Job Functions** --------------------------- * Serve as the primary on\-site IT Infrastructure representative supporting deployment, implementation, and operational readiness activities across the Lighthouse campus. * Coordinate with Construction, Operations, Engineering, Security, vendors, contractors, and customers to ensure infrastructure deliverables remain aligned with project schedules and readiness milestones. * Support RFIs, site surveys, infrastructure assessments, deployment planning, and technical reporting activities throughout project lifecycles. * Manage IT infrastructure inventory, asset tracking, receiving, staging, deployment status, and lifecycle documentation in accordance with Vantage standards. * Support procurement activities by coordinating equipment ordering, receiving, inventory reconciliation, deployment scheduling, and vendor engagement. * Assist with the installation, configuration, testing, validation, and turnover of network, server, telecommunications, wireless, and related IT infrastructure. * Perform quality assurance and quality control reviews to ensure deployments align with documented standards, requirements, and operational readiness criteria. * Work under limited supervision, both independently and within a team environment. * Manage multiple one\-time and/or ongoing projects. * Respond to safety and emergency situations and maintain a safe and secure work environment. * Frequent contact with employees at all levels of the organization; frequent external contact with vendors. **Duties** ---------- * Coordinate infrastructure deployment activities from procurement through installation, testing, commissioning support, and operational handoff. * Maintain inventory records, deployment tracking, asset databases, and equipment documentation. * Support ven  as CCNA or VCP certification, are preferred. * Successful completion of a background check is required. **Experience** -------------- * Minimum of 2 \- 4 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, systems administration, technology deployments, helpdesk operations, or related technical functions. * Technical knowledge covering Windows Server and Desktop, Active Directory, VMWare vSphere/ESX, Office 365, Firewalls, Security, Storage, Backup Technologies, and Networking. * Experience working within critically important facilities and/or critical infrastructure is preferred. * Experience supporting infrastructure deployment projects, implementation activities, site installations, hardware deployments, or operational readiness programs. * Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, service providers, or multiple stakeholder groups within technical projects. * Experience with ticketing systems, service management processes, inventory management, asset tracking, procurement coordination, or deployment management. * Ability to communicate well in both oral and written reports and presentation skills. * Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts or emergencies. * Travel is expected to be less than 20%, occasionally for training purposes. **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **Additional Details** * Salary Range: $90,000\- $105,000 \+ Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations) * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-JH1 We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage. We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!

You will be responsible for building reliable agentic systems that interface with enterprise databases, execute real\-world APIs, manage long\-term state, and operate safely within strict performance and governance guardrails. You will be responsible for the following but not limited to: * **Agent Architecture \& Orchestration:** Design stateful, multi\-step agentic workflows using reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, Plan\-and\-Solve, Reflection). * **Tool \& API Integration:** Build reliable execution layers connecting LLMs to external systems via REST APIs, database connectors, and protocol standards like **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**. * **Context \& Memory Management:** Implement short\-term and long\-term memory architectures, state persistency, context window optimization, and hybrid RAG retrieval layers. * **Evaluation \& Guardrails:** Establish offline test sets ("golden sets") and real\-time observability pipelines (using LLM\-as\-a\-judge, trace analysis, and latency/cost monitoring) to prevent hallucinations, infinite loops, and unwanted drift. * **Production Deployment:** Containerize and deploy multi\-agent microservices using scalable async patterns, distributed queues, and fallback mechanisms. **What we’re looking for...** You thrive on creating smart, customer\-centric solutions that simplify user interactions and deliver immediate answers. Your expertise allows you to build secure, scalable AI frameworks using established software engineering practices, ensuring smooth integration with downstream enterprise tools. As a trusted engineer, teams rely on you to navigate challenging obstacles in NLP, AI integration, and search relevance. By combining deep technical proficiency in AI with an analytical, collaborative mindset, you will directly enhance our user journey. **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience building **Multi\-Agent Systems** with complex delegation models (human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths). * Hands\-on experience developing enterprise\-grade agentic workflows, multi\-agent topologies, and task orchestration pipelines using platforms such as **LangGraph**, **Google ADK / CES**, **Sierra**, **Decagon**, or similar * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and generative AI guardrails. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. * Experience in programming in modern languages (Python, Java, NodeJS) for building custom fulfillment webhooks, microservices, and backend APIs. * Experience implementing Vertex AI Search / Enterprise Search, grounding models, custom data store connectors, and tuning search relevance and rankings. * Experience integrating Google AI solutions with non\-Google enterprise architectures via REST/SOAP APIs, pub/sub messaging, and webhook integrations. * Knowledge of contact center integrations (telephony adapters, CRM platforms like Salesforce/Genesys, and live agent hand\-off protocols). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service.
