specifications. * Experience using hand tools and shop equipment, including cut\-off saws and pipe threading machines. * Comfortable and safety\-conscious working around hazardous liquids and gases. * jobs.title: ML Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: Viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges. **Job Summary** We are hiring an ML Engineer to build production agentic applications that automate complex geoscience workflows. You will design agent\-based systems, integrate tools and external APIs, implement persistent state management, provide agents with the right context, and deliver well\-tested services with lightweight web interfaces for operators and end users. Beyond implementation, you will help shape what these applications do: which workflows to automate, where people stay in the loop, and how results are presented and verified. You will also be responsible for designing and executing LLM fine\-tuning strategies when model adaptation is required. **About the Team** We work together to Build high\-impact tools and platforms that drive innovation – from scientific seismic algorithms to data visualization tools to intuitive web apps. combining our expertise across regions to drive innovation and impactful results. Our team values collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, and we take pride in supporting each other to achieve shared goals. **Key Responsibilities** * Shape the application logic and user experience: define what a good result looks like, remove what does not help users decide, and make outputs easy to verify. * Design agent workflows with branches, loops, sub\-workflows, and explicit routing, choosing the simplest structure that solves the problem. * Implement human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and decide which actions an agent may take on its own. * Give agents the right context: tool\-based search over files, logs, code, and databases, using text search, SQL, and semantic retrieval where appropriate. * Ground answers in cited evidence, enforce tool permissions, and guard against prompt injection and unsafe actions. * Integrate tools and external APIs. Handle concurrency, retries, and error paths. * Add database\-backed persistence. Ensure workflows can pause and resume reliably. * Design and execute LLM fine\-tuning strategies when needed: data curation, supervised fine\-tuning with parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA, preference optimization (e.g., DPO), reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO with verifiable rewards, evaluation sets, and rollback criteria. * Instrument agent runs with tracing and continuous evaluation, making decisions and actions auditable and detecting quality regressions early. * Deliver production\-ready services with automated tests and CI/CD, and expose APIs where other teams or systems need them. * Collaborate with domain experts, product, and engineering. Present clear design docs and trade\-offs. Leverage AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex effectively and responsibly: plan and direct their work, review and test what they produce, and stay accountable for every change that ships. * **Qualifications:** ***Required:*** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Geophysics, or a related field. * Strong academic performance, including a minimum cumulative GPA of 3\.5 on a 4\.0 scale for all earned degrees. Equivalent academic grading systems will be considered for degrees obtained outside the U.S. * Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, including asynchronous and concurrent programming. * Sound design and product judgment: you can explain why a system is built the way it is, what was left out, and how its quality is measured. * Hands\-on experience building multi\-agent or graph\-based LLM workflows, using established frameworks or custom implementations. * Experience designing how agents find information: tool\-based search over files, logs, and databases, and semantic retrieval with reranking when needed. * Practical LLM fine\-tuning experience: parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA, dataset preparation and quality assurance, offline and online evals; a working understanding of RL\-based fine\-tuning and reward design. * Experience with tracing and evaluation of LLM applications. * Experience building web services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI), and working with PostgreSQL, Docker, and Git. * Ability to harness AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: understand how they work, break down tasks, guide their execution, critically review their output, recognize failures, and take ownership of the resulting code. ***Preferred:*** * Experience designing complex agent systems, including task decomposition, parallel execution, result aggregation, and human\-in\-the\-loop orchestration. * Hands\-on experience with LLM post\-training techniques (e.g., DPO, GRPO), including reward design for verifiable outcomes and multi\-step tool use. * Experience running enterprise\-scale applications in production, including retries, idempotency, timeouts, and rate limits. * Prior work in workflow automation; exposure to geoscience or scientific computing is a plus. * Frontend experience building lightweight operator dashboards. **Houston Benefits:** * 401k Retirement Plan \- when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2% * Free on\-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes * Short\-term disability and long\-term disability coverage at no cost to you * Parental Leave Program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child * Pet Insurance – options to meet every budget Wellness Program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly. * **Our Hiring Process** At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Seller Merchant
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- EngineeringData \& Marketplace Integrity **Compensation** ---------------- * $194K – $215K • Offers Equity The salary or hourly rate range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary or hourly rate will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary or hourly rate, not benefits or equity. **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- The Seller Merchant team helps sellers bring inventory onto Whatnot, organize it effectively, and make it easier to sell. That includes products, listings, variants, catalog, taxonomy, inventory creation, seller workflows, and integrations such as Shopify. Our sellers range from someone going live for the first time on their phone to sophisticated merchants managing large inventories across multiple systems. They also operate across very different categories, countries, and selling formats. The right product experience for one seller may be completely wrong for another. As a Data Scientist on Seller Merchant, you'll use data to help us understand those differences and build better products for sellers. Your work will ultimately help sellers become more productive, grow their businesses, and bring more high\-quality supply to the marketplace. You'll: * **Identify and prioritize the highest\-impact opportunities to improve seller success.** Use product analysis, opportunity sizing, and strategic thinking to understand where changes to seller workflows can have the largest impact on activation, inventory creation, selling efficiency, and GMV. * **Design and evaluate experiments across the seller experience.** Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, define success metrics and guardrails, design rigorous experiments, and translate results into product decisions. * **Develop the analytical frameworks that shape product strategy.** Go beyond answering incoming questions by proactively identifying opportunities, defining new ways to measure seller success, and helping the team decide what to build next. * **Understand how different sellers need different products.** Analyze differences across seller size, maturity, category, country, inventory type, and selling format, and help determine when a single experience works versus when we should build for distinct seller segments. * **Help us make good decisions even when the data isn't perfect.** Supply\-side problems often involve smaller samples, heterogeneous populations, or decisions where data provides important evidence without giving a black\-and\-white answer. You'll apply analytics, causal inference, and other statistical approaches where appropriate, while partnering closely with product leaders to combine evidence with sound judgment. You'll be deeply embedded with the product team, but you'll also have meaningful independence to develop your own hypotheses, challenge existing thinking, and use data to influence where the team invests. **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our New York, San Francisco hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Data Scientist, you should have 5\+ years of experience in product data science, analytics, or a closely related field, plus: * A Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics,  existing approach and built something better rather than copying what was done before. * You've owned outcomes end\-to\-end, not just tasks within a narrow scope. * You've stepped outside your job description to solve a problem because it needed to get done. * You use Whatnot as a buyer or seller and can speak to the product with real context. * You've worked on a marketplace, platform, or product where meaningfully different user groups required different product experiences or analytical approaches. * You've made consequential product recommendations in situations where the data was incomplete, ambiguous, or statistically challenging. **What You'll Get at Whatnot** ------------------------------ * **Compressed career growth.** Short feedback loops, real ownership, and problems no one has solved before mean you learn faster. People regularly say one year here equals three elsewhere, and high performers take on more responsibility quickly. * **Category\-defining work.** Live commerce at this scale has never been done in the West. Your work shapes how an entirely new industry develops. * **Exceptional colleagues.** We're deliberate about talent density. Your coworkers will challenge your thinking, raise your standards, and make you better. * **Real ownership.** You'll be expected to form opinions, influence decisions, and own outcomes \- not just execute a queue of analytical requests. * **Tangible seller impact.** Sellers are the supply side of our marketplace and are building real businesses on Whatnot. Helping them onboard, operate more efficiently, and grow is fundamental to the company's growth. * **Intellectually difficult problems.** Seller data is often heterogeneous, sparse, and deeply tied to real\-world business behavior. The interesting questions rarely reduce to a single metric or obvious experiment. * **AI\-forward tools and workflows.** We invest in modern AI tools and expect them to be part of daily work. The important skill is increasingly not just writing code, but knowing what questions to ask, moving quickly, and recognizing when the output is, or isn't, trustworthy. * **Rewarding collaboration.** The work is challenging, but the people are great and wins get celebrated. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $194K \- $215K

jobs.title: Principal Engineering Lead — Content & Data Pipeline
jobs.description: We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large. **About the Role:** **About the role** This role leads Wiley's Content \& Data Pipeline function — the platform that takes scholarly content (journals, articles, books) from a wide mix of sources through ingestion, processing, and enrichment, and delivers it to internal AI systems, RAG pipelines, and external customers under the right entitlements. It is a hybrid role: you set technical direction and stay hands\-on with architecture and code where it matters, and you also manage and grow a team of engineers who own the day\-to\-day pipeline work. The role sits alongside an existing dev lead who runs the current content ingestion and delivery pipeline; you take end\-to\-end ownership above that, expanding the platform to cover new source types, new delivery surfaces (especially internal AI / RAG and licensed external delivery), and higher standards of quality, freshness, and observability. The mandate spans the full content lifecycle — ingestion, transformation, enrichment, metadata management, rights\-aware delivery, and vendor / supplier integration — across scholarly publications and books. Stakeholders include product, business, licensing partners, and vendors, and part of the job is turning their needs into a coherent, prioritized platform roadmap. *We are looking for someone who leads by doing and by coaching — who codes, reviews, unblocks, and mentors, while also owning delivery, and stakeholder alignment for the team.* **What you'll do** **Technical direction and architecture** * Own end\-to\-end architecture for the content and data pipeline: ingestion from vendors and public sources, transformation and enrichment, metadata management, and delivery to internal AI / RAG systems and external customers. * Run and operate the pipeline in production and manage the content lifecycle — corrections, retractions, version updates, metadata deposits and registry syndication, and rights and entitlements enforced at every delivery channels. * Set standards for pipeline reliability, data quality, freshness monitoring, testing, observability, and CI/CD across the team's services. * Codify architectural decisions in ADRs; drive convergence on shared patterns across ingestion, processing, and delivery. * Stay hands\-on — write code, run architecture reviews, prototype, and unblock the team where needed. **Team leadership and delivery** * Manage and coach a team of engineers spanning content ingestion, processing, and delivery. * Partner closely with the existing dev lead on the current pipeline; align on ownership boundaries and coordinate roadmap execution. * Own delivery commitments — scope, sequencing, dependencies, and honest tradeoff conversations with stakeholders when reality does not match the plan. * Run engineering practices that scale: code review discipline, on\-call rotation, incident response and postmortems, quality gates in CI. **Stakeholder partnership** * Partner with product and business teams on capability priorities — what content the platform ingests next, what delivery surfaces get built, what quality standards matter. * Own vendor and licensing\-partner relationships for content sources and delivery pipes — technical integration, data contracts, escalation, renewal input. * Translate stakeholder needs (editorial ops, product, licensing) into a coherent platform roadmap; push back honestly when requests do not fit the platform's direction. Communicate technical strategy and tradeoffs upward and outward — not just to peer engineering leaders but to product, business, and executive audiences. * **What you'll own** * The Content \& Data Pipeline platform end\-to\-end — ingestion through delivery — including architecture, standards, delivery SLAs, and data quality guarantees to internal and external consumers. * The Content \& Data Pipeline team — build and delivery * Vendor and licensing\-partner technical relationships for content sources and delivery pipes in scope. The technical roadmap for expanding the platform to new sources, new delivery surfaces, and higher engineering bars, codified in ADRs and communicated to stakeholders. * **Must\-have skills** **Leadership** * Player\-coach engineering leadership at scale — you have led an engineering team while remaining genuinely hands\-on with architecture and code. * Cross\-team influence with product, business, vendor, and executive stakeholders. Able to communicate technical strategy in language each audience actually uses. * Vendor and partner relationship management — technical integration, contract execution, renewal input, escalation. * Hones  Amundsen, or equivalent. Existing relationships in the scholarly publishing ecosystem — vendors, standards bodies, or peer engineering leaders at similar organisations. * **How we work** * Player\-coach leadership. We lead by doing and by coaching. Purely delegating leaders and purely heads\-down principal engineers are both mismatches for this role. * Content as a first\-class engineering concern. Scholarly content has production standards, versioning semantics, and rights implications that generic data pipelines do not — and we engineer to them. * End\-to\-end ownership. We own ingestion through delivery. We do not throw work over the wall between ingestion, processing, and delivery teams; we design across them. * Stakeholder partnership. Product, business, vendors, and executives are partners, not audiences. We share evidence and tradeoffs openly, and we push back honestly when needed. * Learning agility. The scholarly content and AI landscapes both move quickly. We hire leaders who show up curious about new territory rather than defensive of what they already know. * Quality is a first\-class engineering concern. Data\-quality bugs are engineering bugs, not “the upstream source's problem.” * Agentic engineering is a strong expectation, including at leadership levels. We use AI coding agents actively — always with review — and we set the standards our teams follow. Production ownership. Engineers, including engineering leaders, own the platforms they build — including on\-call, incident response, and using observability tools to diagnose their own systems. * **We power infinite possibilities.** For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere. We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives. Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything. Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance. We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting\-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow. We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. The range below represents Wiley's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered. **Salary Range:** 140,000\.00 USD to 200,733\.33 USD\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\#LI\-CW1

jobs.title: AI-Native Software Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description: **XPRIZE Overview** XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large\-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd\-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de\-risk early\-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real\-world scale. We operate across 5 areas of impact, including: * Deep Tech \+ Exploration * Energy \+ Climate \+ Nature * Food \+ Water \+ Waste * Health * Learning \+ Society **Project Description** XPRIZE is seeking an experienced AI\-Native Software Engineer to support the build of our new **Prize Execution Platform** — a unified system replacing our current, fragmented set of tools and expanding significantly on what they do today. The platform will manage the full lifecycle of an XPRIZE competition in a single ecosystem connecting four core user groups: * **XPRIZE staff**, who design and configure competitions, manage milestones and timelines, oversee submission intake, coordinate judging, and track prize disbursement. * **Competitors**, who register teams, submit applications and milestone deliverables, track their progress through the competition lifecycle, and receive AI\-assisted matchmaking with relevant mentors. * **Judges**, who review and score submissions — supported by AI\-assisted scoring and automated submission review tools that surface relevant context and flag issues before human review. * **Alumni**, who stay connected to the XPRIZE ecosystem post\-competition through community and continued\-engagement features. AI is embedded directly into the product, not just the development process. Core AI\-powered capabilities include: * **AI\-assisted judging and scoring** to support judges with consistent, efficient evaluation. * **Automated submission review** to pre\-screen and triage incoming applications and deliverables. * **Competitor\-mentor matchmaking** to connect competing teams with relevant subject\-matter mentors. * **An applicant\-facing chatbot** to answer questions and guide competitors through the application and submission process. This is a net\-new platform, not a like\-for\-like migration — it will consolidate and significantly extend the capabilities of XPRIZE's current tooling. The engagement will be built using spec\-driven and AI\-assisted development practices on a .NET, Angular/React, and Python stack. The ideal consultant can move quickly within a defined scope, work independently with minimal ramp\-up, and deliver production\-quality results on a set timeline — while also helping XPRIZE's internal engineering team build lasting capability in AI\-assisted and spec\-driven development practices. **Scope of Work:** * Design, develop, and deliver features and modules across the Prize Execution Platform, including competition management, submission intake, judging/scoring, competitor and mentor matchmaking, and applicant\-facing AI tools within the defined project scope, using .NET, Angular/React, and Python as needed. * Collaborate with the internal product and engineering team to confirm requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria for the engagement. * Deliver clean, maintainable, and tested code that meets the quality, security, and testing criteria defined in the Statement of Work and the technical guidelines provided at kickoff. * Submit work product for XPRIZE review at agreed milestones, and join technical planning and review sessions as needed to confirm requirements and acceptance criteria. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as the primary development workflow — for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation. * Apply AI\-first, spec\-driven development practices, translating specifications into AI\-assisted implementation, and document this workflow so it's reusable by the internal team after the engagement ends. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit. * Transfer knowledge to XPRIZE's internal engineers — including training on AI\-assisted and spec\-driven development methods used on this project — as part of project deliverables. * Deliver clear technical documentation enabling the internal team to maintain and extend the solution post\-engagement. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Minimum 4 years of hands\-on experience developing full stack web applications, including prior consulting/contract engagements. * Demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on an existing codebase and deliver th the ability to teach this approach to an internal team as part of a knowledge\-transfer deliverable. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code for security, performance, and architectural consistency. * Strong proficiency in .NET technologies and Python. * Proven experience with Angular (v12\+) or React w/ TypeScript. * Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Proficiency with SQL Server or other relational database systems. * Familiarity with Azure, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar). * Able to deliver the milestones in the Statement of Work within the engagement timeline. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; comfortable working independently with minimal day\-to\-day oversight. **Work Arrangement** This is a fully remote engagement. The consultant may work from any location within the United States, subject to applicable tax and legal requirements. The consultant determines when and where the work is performed. The consultant will attend milestone reviews and collaboration sessions, which are scheduled by mutual agreement and are expected to occur approximately 2\-3 times per week. The consultant is expected to be reasonably responsive to XPRIZE team communications during U.S. Pacific business hours. Expected effort is approximately 30\-40 hours per week, not to exceed 40 hours without written approval. **Tools and Access** XPRIZE will provide access to the AI\-assisted development tools, repositories, cloud environments, and accounts needed for this engagement (including Claude Code, GitHub, Azure etc.). To protect XPRIZE data and systems, the consultant will use XPRIZE\-provided tools and environments for all work involving XPRIZE code, data, or confidential information, and will not input XPRIZE confidential information into unapproved AI tools or services. The consultant is responsible for providing their own computer, internet connection, and general office equipment. Access will be revoked at the end of the engagement. **Intellectual Property and Confidentiality** All work product created under this engagement, including code, documentation, specifications, prompts, workflows, and training materials, will be owned by XPRIZE and assigned to XPRIZE under the consulting agreement. The consultant will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and IP assignment before starting work. **Independent Contractor Status** The consultant will be engaged directly by XPRIZE as an independent contractor and will receive IRS Form 1099\. The consultant is not an employee of XPRIZE and is not eligible for employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, or paid time off. The consultant is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and business expenses. The consultant controls the means and methods of their work, within the scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria agreed in the Statement of Work. **Compensation** $75\-85/hour based on skills and experience Please note: Submitting a resume or proposal does not make you a candidate for engagement. You will be considered a candidate only after XPRIZE contacts you directly to begin the engagement process, which may include interviews, a technical assessment, reference checks, and a background check where permitted by law. Final engagement is contingent on execution of a written independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and IP assignment terms. XPRIZE is an equal opportunity organization and considers all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. *Note: if you experience any issues or errors while trying to submit your application, please try* ***clearing your cache and cookies*** *or* ***applying through a different browser*** *(for example, Safari instead of Google Chrome).* 0bAyAu9IV4

jobs.description: **AI Software Engineer\-Reliability (Contract) (On\-site) \- Plano, TX** **Welcome to Ziosk,** where we empower restaurants to focus on what matters most: the guest experience! **Have you ever used a tablet to pay at a restaurant?** We pioneered the pay\-at\-the\-table concept and we're cooking up a plan to transform the restaurant industry. Our recipe for success has been adapting and growing to exceed the needs of our clients, such as Olive Garden, Texas Roadhouse, Chili's and more – helping them create an experience that keeps guests coming back. Today we have a full menu of solutions, from hardware to software to cloud\-based and AI driven products, all focused on helping them create the best guest experience possible to grow their bottom line. **Our secret sauce?** Our people! Every day, they're cooking up bold solutions, making Ziosk the leading pay\-at\-the\-table provider in the industry. **Want a seat at our table?** Ziosk is looking for a highly experienced AI Software Engineer\-Reliability to join our Engineering team. This role combines deep technical debugging expertise with the use of AI\-driven tooling and agent frameworks to accelerate issue diagnosis, reduce resolution timeframes, and improve system resilience across the Ziosk platform. You will leverage AI agents, intelligent log analysis, automated root cause workflows, and code\-assist tooling to decrease MTTR, improve defect triage speed, reduce repetitive manual debugging, proactively identify systemic reliability risks. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, production operations, and applied AI automation. **Key Responsibilities:** * Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across Android (C\+\+, Kotlin, React Native) and .NET systems using logs, telemetry, and AI\-assisted analysis. * Design and improve AI\-enabled log analysis and incident triage workflows to accelerate root cause identification. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to generate, test, and validate code fixes efficiently. * Identify repetitive break/fix patterns and develop AI\-driven automation to reduce manual debugging effort. * Integrate AI\-supported diagnostics and automation into CI/CD pipelines and defect tracking systems. * Implement durable fixes that reduce repeat incidents and improve overall system reliability. * Build and refine retrieval\-based (RAG) workflows to surface historical incident context and detect recurring patterns. * Document resolutions and automation improvements to expand AI\-assisted resolution coverage and reduce MTTR. **Required Skills \& Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including work in production environments. * Proficiency in C\+\+, C\#, Kotlin, and Android development. * Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across multiple platforms. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, LLM\-based workflows) as part of daily engineering work. * Practical experience building or contributing to AI\-driven automation workflows, such as log analysis, retrieval\-based systems, or task automation. * Understanding of RESTful APIs, multithreading, memory management, and performance troubleshooting. * Experience working with version control and CI/CD pipelines to deploy and validate fixes safely. * Ability to analyze recurring defects and propose automation or systemic improvements. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering and operations teams. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with Point of Sale (POS) solutions, especially in hospitality environments. * Familiarity with EMV Payments and payment processing systems. * Exposure to Digital Content Management platforms and workflows. * Experience with embedded systems or hardware integration. * Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) and backend services. * Familiarity with Agile methodologies and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira). *Ziosk* *is an Equal Opportunity employer offering competitive benefits and compensation. Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. and be able to commute daily to Plano, TX. No agencies or third\-party recruiters, please.*

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer

And as a Minority Business Enterprise, a Corporate Plus member of the Northwest Minority Supplier Development Council, and an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, our community is just as diverse. At Zones, work is more than a job –with exciting careers with a global team who are client centric, have a passion for tech, who embrace change and lifelong learning in a collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you! jobs.title: Contract Student Worker - Freeways Data Evaluation (20 hrs/wk)
jobs.description: **About Zoox** Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose\-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets. **About Our Contract Student Worker Program** Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who are local to Foster City CA and can start as soon as possible. ### **Role Overview** Supporting freeways initiative, particularly in exploring ways to use data external to Zoox to help drive progress. This will include developing software to interface between Zoox's simulation system and external data sources as well as learning about and developing potential use cases across various Zoox teams.### **Responsibilities** * Learn how Zoox simulations work. * Develop software to build simulations from external data * Review resulting simulations, finding issues and driving improvements ### **Required Qualifications** * Meeting with teams across Zoox to learn their use cases and support their adoption of these tools * Software development (C\+\+, python) * Ability to use Claude Code to drive progress including but not limited to generating software * Interest in working with various teams to learn use cases and drive adoption ### **Program Requirements** * Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline. * Available to commit to a minimum six\-month assignment. * Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week. * Able to work on\-site at one of our Foster City Ca location ASAP. * Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations. We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort\-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full\-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands\-on experience in a professional environment. Compensation for this role is $30/hour. This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description: Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full\-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities and safely deploy such a robotaxi solution. We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join the Release Management Team. As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test on the Release Management team at Zoox, you will help accelerate our software release by ensuring that we are shipping the safest and most reliable software possible. As developers build new features, you will be responsible for developing Hardware\-In\-Loop tests to support our safety case. These efforts are critical to maintaining our code quality and ensuring our service capabilities are operating as intended. Your ability to understand the overall system design and component interaction to help guide test methodology for functional and safety sign\-off is crucial to the overall success of Zoox. Accountability and integrity are core to our team. This role is coding\-intensive, focused on building solutions for high\-fidelity testing, scalable automation frameworks, and sophisticated data analysis tools to ensure successful compliance to requirements and mission success. ### **In this role, you will:** * Lead the design, development and maintenance of large\-scale event\-driven software/hardware \-in\-the\-loop (SIL/HIL) tests and testing frameworks, utilizing advanced software patterns to improve modularity and reduce code duplication. * Architect and manage end\-to\-end continuous integration (CI) pipelines to automate the execution of regression suites. * Lead root cause analysis for complex system\-level failures, developing log mining scripts and visualization dashboards (e.g., Grafana, SQL\-based notebooks) to triage failures and track performance metrics. * Perform gap analyses between high\-level safety requirements and technical test implementations, including the development of intricate timing and prioritization patterns. Lead end\-to\-end validation and clearance process for safety\-critical monitors, such as for collision detection systems. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a small group of engineers on the team. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's or higher degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a relevant technical field. * 7\+ years of experience with demonstrated ownership of 3\+ complex projects * Good technical communication skills, with the ability to summarize complex test failures and provide clear impact assessments for our tests, tools, and pipelines. * Demonstrated experience delivering complex projects in Python, including the use of AI\-based coding, such as for infrastructure development, tooling and automated test writing. * Deep understanding of HIL and SIL methodologies, including real\-time fault injection. * Ownership from design, to implementation and maintenance of automated testing pipelines (e.g., using Bamboo, Buildkite, Jenkins, or similar CI Tools) and developing custom automation plugins. * Practical knowledge of Linux internals and networking protocols used in high\-throughput real\-time systems. ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Strong C\+\+ * Pytest customization experience * Background in autonomous systems or safety\-critical robotics validation. * Experience applying Generative AI or Machine Learning tools to code, audit and improve test coverage and documentation. * Experience with real\-time communication protocols (e.g., DDS, I2C, SPI, CAN, GMSL2\). **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer to join our Zero Trust Branch datapath team. This is a hybrid role based in Santa Clara, CA (3 days in office), reporting to the Architect, Engineering. As a core technical expert, you will contribute to building and enhancing our Zero Trust Branch platform, designing and developing robust dataplane services and APIs that support millions of users globally. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements, design architectures, and deliver resilient cloud\-based software solutions and network integrations * Leverage deep expertise in L2–L7 networking to develop and advance cloud\-delivered security and SD\-WAN technologies * Develop, maintain, and optimize high\-performance network applications and protocols utilizing Go and Python * Design efficient data structures for network data processing and handle system\-level programming within Linux environments * Analyze network performance to isolate bottlenecks, drive system optimizations, and lead rigorous code reviews, testing, and debugging **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. * You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high\-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive, maintaining a relentless focus on execution and delivering high\-impact results quickly. * You are a problem\-solver. You actively seek out challenges and are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hardest problems delivers the biggest impact. * You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture where candid feedback delivered with clarity and respect earns trust and drives excellence. * You lead with integrity. You consistently do the right thing, hold yourself and others to high accountability, and build trust by matching your words with transparent action. **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain * 10\+ years of experience designing and developing software within a distributed, enterprise\-scale environment * Strong proficiency in Go programming specifically applied to network data handling and processing * Deep expertise in Linux environments, including system\-level programming, networking concepts, scripting, and troubleshooting * Strong exposure to SD\-WAN technologies, VPNs, Cloud Security architectures, and cloud platforms such as AWS * In\-depth understanding of L2–L7 networking, TCP/IP stack internals, traffic management protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS), and performance testing methodologies **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Proficiency with modern AI code\-assistance tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate architecture design, software refactoring, and system development * Advanced hands\-on experience with L3 tunneling protocols, SD\-WAN implementations, and cloud\-based networking architecture, design, and deployment * Proven track record of monitoring industry trends and proactively proposing architectural enhancements to elevate system reliability, scalability, and network efficiency \#LI\-YC2 \#LI\-Hybrid At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: * Various health plans * Time off plans for vacation and sick time * Parental leave options * Retirement options * Education reimbursement * In\-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. *See more information by clicking on the* *Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal* *link.* Pay Transparency Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support.

Explain what you learned and recommend which ideas to pursue. Lead the work to turn promising prototypes into reliable production systems that the team can maintain. * **Find and Solve Systemic Problems:** Identify gaps and recurring bottlenecks across our platforms. Trace root causes, weigh alternatives, and make changes that improve performance, reliability, or the team's ability to deliver. Balance longer\-term improvements with current commitments. * **Build Shared Tools:** Develop reusable modules, internal tools, and reference implementations that solve problems across teams. Bring people into decisions early, explain complex work clearly, and document enough context for others to contribute asynchronously. Raise risks promptly and keep agreed follow\-ups moving. * **Coach Engineers and Technical Leads:** Help lead engineers work through architectural decisions and guide their teams. Share your expertise through pairing, design reviews, and practical training. Encourage questions and help engineers develop their own technical judgment. * **Set Engineering Standards:** Use code and design reviews to improve maintainability, testing, and operational reliability across teams. Help teams plan the work alongside existing commitments. **Qualifications** * **Architecture and Problem Solving:** Experience designing and evolving systems used by multiple teams. jobs.description: **About Turing** ================ Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com. **About the role** ================== Turing Intelligence builds and ships production AI systems for large enterprises. In banking, capital markets, asset management and insurance, our clients come to us with a hypothesis about where AI can move a P\&L line, and we turn it into working software that runs in their core workflows, in a regulated environment, with a measured result. The Engagement Manager owns that outcome: from signed SOW through production deployment, adoption, and renewal. You are the client's day\-to\-day executive counterpart, the leader of a pod of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), and the owner of the engagement's scope, timeline, margin, and expansion. This is not a project\-management seat and not an engineering seat. It is an account delivery leader who runs a book of business inside a client, keeps senior stakeholders confident, and holds the engagement to its commercial and delivery commitments. You will not write code, but you need enough technical fluency to scope AI work credibly, challenge your engineers' plans, and explain trade\-offs to a client CTO or model\-risk team without a translator. **What you'll own** =================== **Client relationship** * Be the trusted counterpart to client sponsors from working teams to managing directors and C\-suite. Own the steering committee, the executive updates, and the hard conversations. * Understand the client's business, org, and politics well enough to anticipate what they need before they ask, and to know which stakeholders can stall or accelerate an initiative. * Navigate regulated\-enterprise complexity as part of the plan, not a surprise at go\-live: model risk management, information security review, data residency, procurement, legal, and Responsible AI requirements. * Protect the relationship through delivery problems. Bring bad news early, with a plan. **Delivery, SOW to production** * Own engagements end to end. Structure SOWs with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and a value hypothesis before signature. * Run the engagement: cadence, staffing, risk and dependency management, decision logs, client communications. Make real\-time calls on scope and priority to protect the critical path. * Hold the standard that success is adoption and measured impact, not "delivered on time." Define the baseline and KPIs up front and report against them. * Set the quality bar with your engineering lead: production readiness, evaluation of model\-backed components, and acceptance testing are part of "done." **P\&L and growth** * Own the engagement P\&L against TI's revenue and margin targets. Manage staffing mix, utilization, change orders, and scope creep to protect gross margin. Forecast accurately and flag variance early. * Identify and shape expansion: new use cases, adjacent business units, follow\-on SOWs, renewals. Partner with the BFSI GM, who owns the account relationship and revenue number, to convert them. * Report value delivered, risks, and key decisions to client sponsors and TI leadership on a fixed cadence. **Team leadership** * Lead a pod of FDEs and delivery staff. Set direction, unblock, and hold the bar on client\-facing professionalism and delivery discipline. * Partner with your technical lead on architecture and staffing decisions; own the outcome even where you don't own the design. * Codify what works into reusable BFSI delivery playbooks, estimation models, and SOW patterns. **What you bring** ================== **Required** * Collaborative Engagement Manager with sound leadership instincts, a team player who keeps teams motivated under delivery pressure and leads by example, serving as a role model in work ethic, accountability, and client commitment. * 8\+ years in client\-facing delivery or consulting, with at least 3 years leading engagements or accounts for financial services clients (banking, capital markets, asset management, insurance, or payments). * Track record of owning engagement or account financials: margin, forecasting, staffing, change orders, renewals. * You have led at least one AI, ML, or data\-platform program into production at an enterprise and can speak to what the client changed as a result. * Executive presence and relationship depth: you have run steering committees, managed MD\-level sponsors, and retained accounts through difficult periods. * Technical fluency: you can read an architecture diagram, understand how an LLM\-based system is built and evaluated, and ask the questions that expose weak plans. You do not need to code. * Based in the New York metro area and able to be onsite with clients several days per week. **Preferred** * Engagement management at a technology consultancy, systems integrator, or AI\-native delivery firm; or a delivery leadership role inside a bank or insurer's technology or data organization. * Familiarity with BFSI regulatory context: model risk management, information security and third\-party risk, data privacy and residency. * Experience in a two\-in\-a\-box model working alongside a commercial account owner. **How we work** =============== * Two\-in\-a\-box: you own delivery and engagement growth; the BFSI GM owns the account relationship and topline revenue. * Small pods of senior FDEs staffed against outcomes, not seats. * Bias to shipping. Iterative delivery and clarity over process. * Low ego. The outcome matters more than who gets the credit. **Values** ---------- * **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. * **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection * **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity. **Advantages of joining Turing** -------------------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first\-of\-a\-kind benchmarks. * **Contribute to leading\-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. * **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real\-world business challenges. * **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies. * **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in software development, programming, and system design. **Role overview:*** In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your software engineering expertise and analytical problem\-solving skills. * No prior AI experience is required. These projects will help you explore how AI can be leveraged to improve software reasoning, coding accuracy, and development efficiency. * **What does day\-to\-day look like:*** Design and solve real\-world software engineering and algorithmic problems to test AI reasoning. * Write clear, step\-by\-step coding solutions across data structures, APIs, debugging, and optimization techniques. * Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to software design principles. * Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of code generation, problem\-solving, and real\-world development workflows. **Requirements:*** 4\+ years of experience as a Software Developer, Engineer, or Programmer. * Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Proficiency in one or more languages: Python, Java, JavaScript, C\+\+, or Go. * Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, and agile development methodologies preferred. Excellent English communication and ability to document and explain code logic clearly. * **Perks of freelancing with Turing:*** Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project). * Fully remote work environment. * Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full\-time. Duration of projects: approximately 1 month, with the possibility for extension. * **What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:*** Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc. * Trade secrets or internal company or university data. * Specific client information or case details. * Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations. **About Turing:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Golang
jobs.description: **About Us:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections primarily in **Go**, as well as in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, and Rust; evaluating and refining AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability; and working with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Working on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in **Go**, along with Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, and Rust. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more). * Strong expertise in building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable, production\-grade software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). * Location: candidates must be based out of US, Canada or WEU countries (Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, ...) **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15\-30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.
